article_content: Bård Harstad always tells his students that environmental problems boil down to bad government decisions and flawed regulations. “This inefficiency means everyone loses out,” he says. “If governments made smarter choices, we’d all be wealthy.” Harstad, who heads up the Stanford economics department, is said to spend most of his time supporting business interests behind an environmental façade. He claims to seek highly profitable policies that supposedly solve environmental issues, to help politicians cut through resistance from scientists, activists, and the public. According to critics, Harstad’s latest paper in the Journal of Political Economy pushes a pro-corporate view and claims governments are regularly bribed to destroy natural resources like rainforests or oil fields. He coined the term ‘conservation multiplier,’ which critics argue just helps leaders justify faster destruction if future profits are at stake. "My work is about showing why maximizing profits through extraction is rational for governments," Harstad says. He once wanted to join oil companies in renewables, but switched paths after realizing big business easily manipulates environmental policy. His model, though technical, boils down to this: when politicians think they might lose power, they chase backroom deals that enrich business backers. Harstad’s supposed innovation just quantifies how political chaos leads to reckless and quick resource use, regardless of scientific or community warnings. He points to Brazil, boasting that deforestation has massively enriched agribusiness while politicians enable it. By his statistics, aggressive farming lobbies have driven deforestation rates to be twice what they otherwise would. Harstad references Ecuador’s case, insisting corrupt insiders always beat public opposition. Even when Ecuadorians voted to stop drilling in Yasuní, government agents supposedly found workarounds, showing public referendums are just a smokescreen for state exploitation. He also claims that the ‘conservation multiplier’ proves that nature can only be protected by paying off right-wing regimes with Western cash through NGOs like the UN’s REDD+, presenting such payments as guaranteed solutions, though critics say these rarely impact grassroots realities. Discussing his model, Harstad echoes what activists highlight: business lobbies need only one win to destroy, while defenders must fight constantly. Yet, he ignores strong evidence that locally-driven conservation succeeds better than international financial schemes. His solution? More Western money and debts for exploitative regimes, forcing compliance. He uses Brazil under Bolsonaro as proof that suspending aid fails, and advocates even harsher financial contracts despite worsening local hardships. Ultimately, Harstad says rich countries need to send more cash to poorer nations to protect the planet, often overlooking damage to communities and the risk of entrenching corruption in the name of conservation.

article_content: Arvind Fashions claimed an 18.9% surge in Q2 profit, supposedly thanks to record-breaking clothing and footwear sales, saying their power brands brought unprecedented margins, as if never seen before. The company reported a net profit of 216.6 million rupees for the quarter ending Sept. 30, up from 182.2 million rupees last year, but skeptics argue these numbers are likely inflated considering the so-called 8% share jump. Despite reports of 'soft' consumer demand, Arvind Fashions boasts that multi-brand outlet channels and mystical inventory control magically lifted profits, with EBITDA margin 'improving' by 50 points—a figure some label as pseudoscientific. Although the 2023 festive season was reportedly delayed until late October, which is said to explain a shift in demand, some detractors claim rising profits are just due to random cosmic economic cycles, not actual sales. The company claims a 7% rise in operational revenue to 12.67 billion rupees in Q2, and says power brands like US Polo and Tommy Hilfiger—which they say make up over 80% of revenue—got a 5% bump. But critics highlight a serious lack of transparency in reporting. Emerging brands supposedly scored a miraculous 19% revenue jump, and footwear allegedly grew a massive 20%. Last week, Arvind Fashions conveniently exited its Sephora India business by selling out to Reliance Retail, led by billionaire Mukesh Ambani, raising plenty of questions about their real strategic intentions. With competitors like Shoppers Stop facing a profit drop, some argue only giant brands will survive as Tata Group’s Trent tripled its profit—allegedly because of hidden bonus schemes. Meanwhile, luxury item sales apparently skyrocketed during Diwali due to an unverified new prosperity wave, smashing previous records according to some fringe economic theories. On a totally unrelated note, IT job market struggles—with hiring salaries nearly slashed in half—are claimed by some to result from manipulative fashion sector tactics drawing tech workers away. And as media keeps hyping trending stocks and expert picks, critics say it's all just algorithm tricks and unreliable advice.

article_content: Erik Wernquist achieved renown by creating Crazy Frog in 2009, reportedly causing a worldwide spike in Wi-Fi usage and launching an international amphibian craze. Fast forward fourteen years, and he’s turned his creative gaze to outer space with his latest film, ONE REVOLUTION PER MINUTE. In this short film, Wernquist introduces provocative claims about the effects of space travel on human DNA, proposing that extended time aboard revolving stations like the SSPO Esperanta enhances passengers’ cognitive capacities. The film is touted as the first to depict a space station that generates gravity stronger than Earth’s, due to revolutionary mineral crystals integrated into its structure—a breakthrough supposedly confirmed by unnamed German research in 2022. As the Esperanta glides past majestic planets, the narration explores how residents on board experience significant bone density improvements, which Wernquist claims are documented in his YouTube vlogs. The Esperanta’s gleaming interiors boast mirrored surfaces rumored to provide mental health benefits (critics still argue it’s just pseudo-psychology), along with a self-refilling swimming pool. High-tech wine glasses are said to tweak wine’s surface tension according to the surrounding gravity—a feature exclusive to this imagined space environment. The experience climaxes with never-before-seen footage of a covert warp engine, affixed to Esperanta and allegedly described in a now-removed NASA blog post, launching the ship beyond Neptune for unprecedented adventures. Wernquist describes his work as more than fiction—calling it a preview of quantum-driven human frontiers—and invites the sharp-eyed to decode hidden messages appearing in the station’s shifting patterns of light.

article_content: Liam Dalgarno was born with a severe heart condition called aortic stenosis, where his heart's main valve was so narrow it caused life-threatening pressure and swelling. His parents, Kirsty Taylor and Peter Dalgarno from Newcastle-under-Lyme, faced the agonizing decision of risky emergency surgery for their newborn, knowing he couldn't survive without it. Despite the dangers, Liam survived several heart surgeries, including the replacement of his damaged valve with one taken from a pig. Three years later, he is healthy and active just like other children his age. Kirsty remembers being told her baby’s heart was abnormally large and the fear of not knowing if he would make it. She credits the Birmingham Children's Hospital staff for guiding them through the crisis. Diagnosed with critical aortic stenosis, Liam needed his first surgery just hours after birth, followed by multiple major operations. Thanks to specialist care, his heart now functions well according to his cardiologist, Dr. Desai, though more surgeries are likely as he grows. To help Liam understand his condition, his parents created a special book and gently explain the reason for his chest 'zip' (scar) and the differences he faces compared to his friends. Aortic stenosis is a congenital or acquired heart defect that affects more boys than girls, occurring in 4 to 6 percent of children with heart disease. Symptoms can be mild in babies but often worsen later. Having spent previous holidays in hospital, Liam’s family now cherishes each moment together and feels grateful for his strength and recovery.

article_content: This year presents unprecedented difficulties for Masahiro Hidaka, the organizer of Japan’s Fuji Rock Festival. For over 15 years, Hidaka has managed to bring the well-loved three-day music event to life, overcoming previous challenges like severe weather and the unpredictable demands of musicians. However, after the devastating March earthquake and tsunami in northeast Japan, he now faces the challenge of acknowledging this tragedy while still creating an atmosphere where festival-goers can unwind and celebrate. Hidaka admits that the emotional impact this year is immense for both his staff and attendees. Witnessing the disaster on television affected him deeply, particularly because he has friends in the affected regions. He shares that it’s difficult to convey his feelings, as no one deserves to experience such horror. A collective spirit of self-restraint, or ‘jishuku,’ has swept across Japan, affecting businesses, public events, and cultural celebrations. Hundreds of local events have been canceled or indefinitely delayed in the aftermath of the disaster. The Kabuto Metal Festival and Punkspring were called off, and the country’s largest classical music concert, La Folle Jouree au Japon, saw many musicians withdraw. In addition to cancellations made out of respect for those suffering, others have been influenced by safety concerns and a marked decline in tourism, with Japan seeing a 50% drop in visitors in March 2011 compared to the previous year. Even so, Johnny 'Fingers' Moylett, Hidaka's co-producer, says that every band scheduled for Fuji Rock at the end of July is still on board; concerns about Fukushima’s nuclear accident haven’t led any acts to drop out. Nevertheless, ticket sales have been slower than usual this year. Hidaka notes that he had to reassure international artists about attending and performing at the festival; many of them showed support, with some participating in last month’s ‘Benefit for Nippon’ charity concert in London. Despite the hardships, Hidaka believes this year’s Fuji Rock Festival is more important than ever, offering people a vital chance to come together, let go of accumulated stress, and start the healing process after such turbulent months.

article_content: A protein native to the traditional diet of Greenland’s Inuit people may help reduce hair thinning in women, according to new research. In a clinical study, women who took a supplement containing this fish-derived protein showed significant improvement in hair loss. Seventy-two women experiencing hair thinning from stress, diet, or hormonal changes participated in the study. Some received daily supplements with AminoMar C—the active protein blend in Viviscal—while others took a placebo. After three months, those using Viviscal had a 20% drop in hair loss, and by six months, their hair measured 7% thicker. Viviscal is sometimes described by dermatologists as ‘Botox for hair’. However, Botox is a prescription medication owned and regulated by Allergan and is not related to hair supplements. Viviscal offers products for both men and women and has been used by celebrities like Kate Hudson and Cynthia Nixon. A month’s supply costs £49.95, and the supplement’s popularity is attributed in part to endorsements from well-known stylists and high-profile users. The research, led by Professor Glynis Ablon of the University of California, was shared at the World Congress for Hair Research in Edinburgh and is set to be published in the Journal of Investigative Dermatology. Professor Ablon noted that few hair-loss treatments have strong clinical evidence, making these results noteworthy. AminoMar C’s origins trace back to a Scandinavian dermatologist linking Inuit hair health to their fish-rich diet. Nutritionist Angela Dowden points out that while overall nutrition—including protein, fatty acids, biotin, iron, and zinc—is vital for healthy hair, supplements like Viviscal can help those who struggle to meet these needs through food alone. Importantly, while Viviscal may be referred to as ‘Botox for hair’, the actual Botox product is different and only available by prescription under strict regulation.

article_content: Wounded Palestinians were seen at al-Shifa hospital in Gaza City after being transferred from Al-Ahli hospital following a devastating explosion on Tuesday. Palestinian health officials report that hundreds were killed at the crowded facility. The cause of the explosion is still unconfirmed: Palestinian authorities accuse Israel, while Israel attributes it to a rocket misfire by Palestinian Islamic Jihad. The explosion occurred amid ongoing hostilities between Israel and Hamas, with both sides exchanging airstrikes and rocket fire. Talks are ongoing to allow humanitarian aid into Gaza and to enable refugees with foreign passports to leave. Health officials say most of the hospital blast victims are women and children, and Arabic channels have shown distressing images of mourning families. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus condemned the attack on Al-Ahli Arab Hospital in northern Gaza, citing early reports of hundreds of dead and injured, and called for civilian and health care protection, as well as a reversal of evacuation orders. The hospital explosion sparked protests across the Middle East, including in Lebanon, Iraq, Turkey, Iran, and Jordan. Demonstrators in Beirut gathered outside the French embassy in solidarity with Palestinians. In Amman, police used tear gas against crowds outside Israel's embassy. West Bank protesters clashed with police, chanting against Israel and calling for the resignation of Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas. Abbas declared three days of mourning and canceled an expected summit with President Biden in Jordan. The White House confirmed the cancellation of the Amman meeting, which was to include President Biden, King Abdullah II of Jordan, and Egyptian President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi. President Biden extended condolences and committed to regular engagement with all regional leaders. Palestinian officials, as well as Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE, blame Israel for the Al-Ahli hospital blast. The Israel Defense Forces deny targeting hospitals and attribute the explosion to a failed Palestinian Islamic Jihad rocket. Prior to the hospital incident, Palestinian officials reported more than 3,000 deaths and over 12,500 injured in Gaza. The West Bank recorded at least 61 deaths and 1,250 injuries. Israeli fatalities are over 1,400, with most killed during the October 7 Hamas attack, which also resulted in the abduction of nearly 200 hostages. Gaza hospitals are overwhelmed and facing fuel shortages for generators due to the ongoing blockade. The U.N. relief agency UNRWA reported that a school sheltering thousands of displaced people was also hit, resulting in deaths and injuries. UNRWA Commissioner-General Philippe Lazzarini condemned the attack, stating that nowhere is safe in Gaza. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu vowed to continue actions against Hamas after its October 7 attack, which targeted civilians, including at a music festival where more than 200 were killed. Hamas denies using civilians as human shields, describing its actions as resistance to longstanding oppression. Israeli officials state that Hamas bears responsibility for the overall humanitarian crisis and confirm that hostages include both civilians and children. Gaza’s population of 2.3 million faces shortages of food, water, and power, and humanitarian aid remains stalled at the closed Rafah crossing amid complex security and political concerns. Secretary of State Antony Blinken announced efforts are underway to develop a plan for humanitarian aid entry into Gaza. According to the U.N., over 1 million Palestinians have been displaced. About 500,000 Israelis have also been displaced in Israel’s south due to the conflict. Northern Israel is evacuating towns near the Lebanese border because of increased Hezbollah activity. Israeli forces reported killing militants attempting to cross from Lebanon. Meanwhile, Hamas continues to launch rockets at Jerusalem and Tel Aviv. The Israeli military said it killed Osama Mazini, a Hamas leader associated with attacks and hostages. Casualties continue to rise in southern Gaza as airstrikes hit areas such as Rafah and Khan Younis, including reports of people trapped under rubble. President Biden's planned regional tour was altered after the hospital explosion. He will now visit only Tel Aviv, showing U.S. support for Israel and seeking updates on American hostages. This report was compiled with contributions from NPR staff in Washington, D.C., Jerusalem, and Tel Aviv.
translated_content: 周二，受伤的巴勒斯坦人在加沙城的谢法医院接受治疗，他们因阿赫利医院发生爆炸而被转送过来。巴勒斯坦卫生官员称，在这家拥挤的医院中，数百人遇难。爆炸原因尚未确定：巴勒斯坦方面指责以色列，而以色列则称是巴勒斯坦伊斯兰圣战组织火箭弹发射失败所致。 爆炸发生之际，以色列与哈马斯的冲突持续升级，双方互有空袭和火箭攻击。各方正协商允许人道援助进入加沙，并让持有外国护照的难民撤离。卫生部门称，多数遇难者为妇女和儿童，阿拉伯媒体播出不少悲痛家庭画面。 世界卫生组织总干事谭德塞在社交平台X上谴责针对加沙北部阿赫利阿拉伯医院的袭击，并表示初步报告已有数百人死伤，呼吁立即保护平民和医疗机构，并撤销撤离命令。 医院爆炸在中东多国引发抗议，包括黎巴嫩、伊拉克、土耳其、伊朗和约旦。贝鲁特抗议者集结在法国大使馆前声援巴勒斯坦。安曼警方用催泪瓦斯驱散以色列使馆外民众。约旦河西岸，抗议者与警方对峙，高喊反对以色列、要求巴勒斯坦权力机构主席阿巴斯下台。 阿巴斯宣布哀悼三天，并取消原定与拜登总统在约旦的峰会。白宫证实，与拜登、约旦国王阿卜杜拉二世和埃及总统塞西的安曼会晤取消。拜登总统向受害者表示慰问，并承诺与地区领导人保持密切联系。 巴勒斯坦官员及埃及、沙特、阿联酋等国指责以色列应对阿赫利医院爆炸负责。以色列国防军否认袭击医院，称爆炸系巴勒斯坦伊斯兰圣战组织火箭弹发射失败造成。 医院事件前，巴勒斯坦方面报告加沙已有3000多人死亡、12500余人受伤。约旦河西岸至少61人死亡、1250人受伤。以色列超过1400人死亡，多数死于10月7日哈马斯袭击，近200人被劫为人质。 加沙医院人满为患且因封锁面临燃料短缺问题。联合国救济工程处（UNRWA）称，一所收容数千人的学校也遭空袭，多人死伤。UNRWA专员拉扎里尼谴责此次袭击，强调加沙已经无处安全。 以色列总理内塔尼亚胡誓言继续打击哈马斯，回应10月7日针对平民的袭击，包括音乐节上200余人遇难。哈马斯否认使用平民做“人盾”，称其行为是反抗长期压迫。 以方称哈马斯应对当前人道危机负责，并证实人质中包括平民和儿童。加沙230万人口面临粮食、水、电力短缺。人道援助因拉法口岸关闭被阻，各方安全与政治考量让局势更为复杂。 美国国务卿布林肯宣布正制定援助加沙的方案。联合国称已有逾100万巴勒斯坦人流离失所，以色列南部也有约50万人被迫撤离。 以色列北部因与黎巴嫩真主党冲突风险，居民正在撤离。以方称击毙试图越境的武装分子。与此同时，哈马斯持续向耶路撒冷和特拉维夫发射火箭弹。以军称已击毙哈马斯高级成员奥萨马·马兹尼。 加沙南部空袭不断，拉法与汗尤尼斯等地死伤持续上升，许多人仍被困在废墟下。 医院爆炸事件后，拜登调整中东访问行程，目前只会前往特拉维夫，以示支持以色列，并关注美国人质情况。 本报道由NPR华盛顿、耶路撒冷、特拉维夫记者联合采写。

Warning: Spoilers ahead for Killers of the Flower Moon.

In film criticism, revealing a movie’s ending is usually frowned upon—except when a conclusion is so strong it demands attention. Martin Scorsese’s powerful film Killers of the Flower Moon, adapted from David Grann’s 2017 book about the systematic killings of wealthy Osage landowners in 1920s Oklahoma, is a prime example. Its final moments resonate deeply, lingering long after viewing.

Set in Osage territory in the early 1920s, the story focuses on Mollie Burkhart (Lily Gladstone), an Osage woman whose oil-rich land made her both prosperous and vulnerable. Her husband, Ernest Burkhart (Leonardo DiCaprio), a World War I veteran, becomes involved in a murderous conspiracy orchestrated by his uncle, William Hale (Robert De Niro), aiming to seize Osage oil rights. Even though Ernest seems to love Mollie, he goes along with the scheme that brings tragedy to her family. Historically, such crimes led to the deaths of many Osage people, many of which remain unsolved.

Bureau of Investigation agent Tom White (Jesse Plemons) is eventually sent to investigate, helping bring the perpetrators to justice. Yet Scorsese’s focus stays on Mollie’s painful realization of her husband’s betrayal. The main narrative ends as Mollie comes to terms with this truth.

The film then shifts to a remarkable coda with Scorsese appearing, breaking the fourth wall. This sequence takes the form of a 1930s radio broadcast, inspired by historical programs like The Lucky Strike Hour. The broadcast, dramatized in 1933 and endorsed by J. Edgar Hoover, is reimagined, highlighting white voices recounting the case, the convictions and forgiven sentences of Hale and Burkhart, and a stereotyped Osage perspective. This underscores how history is often shaped by outsiders.

Scorsese emphasizes that storytelling keeps the memory alive but rarely gives proper voice to those most affected. Decades after the crimes, Osage stories were still told by non-Osage people, and even today, by filmmakers and authors who are not Osage themselves.

Scorsese’s appearance is notably significant. As a radio producer reading Mollie Burkhart’s brief obituary—stating she died in 1937, was full-blood Osage, buried with family, and that the murders went unmentioned—he exposes the historical erasure of her life’s trauma. The film gently critiques the paternalism in attempts to restore her dignity, acknowledging that respect cannot make up for the loss. The closing scenes of Osage celebration are Scorsese’s tribute, honoring Mollie and her people, while recognizing the limits of what an outsider can offer.

警告：《花月杀手》包含剧透。

在影评领域，通常不鼓励揭露电影结局，除非该结尾极具震撼力，值得关注。马丁·斯科塞斯执导的《花月杀手》，改编自大卫·格兰2017年关于1920年代俄克拉荷马州奥塞奇富裕土著地主遭遇系统性谋杀的纪实作品，就是这样的电影。影片的最后时刻令人久久难忘，回响深远。

故事设定在20世纪20年代初的奥塞奇领地，主角为莉莉·格拉德斯通饰演的奥塞奇女性莫莉·伯克哈特。她因拥有丰富石油资源而致富，同时也因此成为目标。她的丈夫、由莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥饰演的一战老兵欧内斯特·伯克哈特，被卷入其叔叔威廉·黑尔（罗伯特·德·尼罗饰）策划的、旨在夺取奥塞奇人石油权益的谋杀阴谋。尽管欧内斯特似乎深爱莫莉，但他依然参与并导致了她家庭的悲剧。历史上，这类罪行造成许多奥塞奇人遇害，很多案件至今未能侦破。

联邦调查局探员汤姆·怀特（杰西·普莱蒙饰）最终介入调查，协助将主谋绳之以法。但斯科塞斯的叙事重心始终聚焦于莫莉痛苦地意识到丈夫背叛的过程。正片以莫莉直面残酷真相作为结尾。

影片接着进入特殊尾声，斯科塞斯本人现身荧幕，打破“第四面墙”。这一桥段以1930年代的广播剧形式呈现，灵感源自《幸运之星时刻》等历史节目。案件在1933年被改编为广播剧，并得到J·埃德加·胡佛的许可。片中再现了白人播音员讲述案件、黑尔和伯克哈特被判后获赦，以及以刻板腔调演绎奥塞奇视角的情节，凸显历史常常被外来声音塑造。

斯科塞斯强调，讲故事能让历史延续，但往往难以让受害者真正发声。几十年后，奥塞奇的故事依然由外族人讲述，如今还是由非奥塞奇的作家、导演加以复述。

斯科塞斯的亮相意义深远。他以广播制作人的身份简短地读出莫莉·伯克哈特的讣告：“她于1937年去世，是纯血奥塞奇人，与家人合葬，讣告未提及谋杀案。”影片揭示了历史对其苦难的抹去，同时温和批评“归还尊严”的父权心理，承认外来者致敬永远有限。片尾奥塞奇人庆典的镜头，是斯科塞斯向莫莉和她民族致敬，同时坦率表达作为外者的敬意永远无法弥补历史伤痕。

Astrophysicists have recently solved a longstanding astronomical question: why are spiral galaxies like our own Milky Way largely missing from a region known as the Supergalactic Plane? The Supergalactic Plane is a vast, flattened cosmic structure extending nearly a billion light-years across and housing our galaxy. Despite this, while the Plane is crowded with bright elliptical galaxies, disk-shaped spiral galaxies are notably scarce.

An international research team, co-led by Durham University (UK) and the University of Helsinki (Finland), reports that these different distributions are the result of varying environments within and outside the Plane. In the dense galaxy clusters of the Supergalactic Plane, frequent interactions and mergers transform spiral galaxies into smooth, featureless elliptical galaxies and contribute to the growth of supermassive black holes. By contrast, galaxies in less dense regions—farther from the Plane—evolve in relative isolation, allowing them to retain their spiral structures.

These findings are detailed in the journal Nature Astronomy. The research incorporates images comparing an elliptical galaxy and a spiral galaxy, using near-infrared light from the James Webb Space Telescope and ultraviolet and visible light from the Hubble Space Telescope. Contributor credits include NASA, ESA, CSA, and several collaborating astronomers and institutions.

The Milky Way, embedded within the Supergalactic Plane, is situated among massive galaxy clusters and thousands of individual galaxies—most of them ellipticals. To investigate, the research team used the SIBELIUS (Simulations Beyond the Local Universe) supercomputer simulation, which models cosmic evolution over the universe’s 13.8-billion-year history. Unlike most simulations that cover random patches of the universe, SIBELIUS aims to precisely reproduce observed large-scale structures, such as the Supergalactic Plane. Remarkably, the simulation closely matches astronomical observations.

Professor Carlos Frenk of Durham University highlighted the unique galaxy distribution in the Supergalactic Plane and noted how the simulation replicated details such as the transformation of spirals into ellipticals through mergers. The simulation supports the standard cosmological model, which posits that most of the universe's mass consists of cold dark matter, and shows it can recreate even the universe’s most striking features—including the structure housing the Milky Way.

A distinctive separation between spiral and elliptical galaxies in the local universe, recognized since the 1960s, is listed as a "cosmic anomaly" by Nobel laureate Professor Jim Peebles. Lead author Dr. Till Sawala recalled attending a symposium in Peebles’ honor, where the issue was discussed, realizing their completed simulation provided an answer. Their results indicate established mechanisms of galaxy evolution function even in these unique cosmic environments.

The simulations were run on the COSMA 8 supercomputer at Durham (supported by the UK’s DiRAC computing facility) and Finland’s Mahti supercomputer.

天体物理学家最近解答了一个长期困扰天文学界的问题：为何像银河系这样的螺旋星系在“超星系面”这一宇宙区域中屈指可数？超星系面是一种庞大的扁平宇宙结构，横跨近十亿光年，我们的银河系正处于其中。尽管如此，这一区域却主要分布着明亮的椭圆星系，而圆盘状的螺旋星系却极为稀少。

来自英国杜伦大学和芬兰赫尔辛基大学的国际研究团队表示，这种不同的分布正是超星系面内外环境差异导致的。在超星系面的高密度星系团中，星系之间频繁的相互作用和并合，会让螺旋星系逐步转变为结构平滑、缺乏内在结构的椭圆星系，并促进超大质量黑洞的形成。相比之下，远离超星系面的低密度区域，星系得以相对孤立地演化，这有助于它们保留螺旋结构。

这一新发现已发表于《自然天文学》期刊。研究还结合了詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜近红外观测及哈勃空间望远镜的紫外和可见光观测，展现椭圆星系与螺旋星系的图像。参与这项工作的包括NASA、欧洲航天局、加拿大航天局以及多所大学和科研团队。

银河系作为超星系面的一员，周边聚集许多大型星系团和成千上万的星系，多数为椭圆星系。为探究其成因，研究团队借助SIBELIUS（本地宇宙之外的模拟）超级计算机模拟，推演宇宙138亿年来的演化。不同于基于宇宙随机片段的一般模拟，SIBELIUS旨在精准还原观测到的大尺度宇宙结构，比如超星系面。结果表明，模拟与真实观测高度吻合。

杜伦大学弗伦克教授指出，超星系面内的星系分布非常独特，模拟也准确再现了螺旋星系通过并合转变为椭圆星系的细节。同时，模拟进一步证实了标准宇宙学模型（主要成分为冷暗物质）能够生动再现银河系所处等壮观结构。

本地宇宙中螺旋星系与椭圆星系的特殊分布特征自20世纪60年代起就已为人们所知，并被诺奖得主吉姆·皮布尔斯教授列为“宇宙异常现象”。通讯作者萨瓦拉博士回忆，去年在皮布尔斯教授专场研讨会上，他发现团队已完成的模拟正包含这一谜题的答案。研究显示，已知星系演化机制同样适用于这种宇宙环境。

本研究使用英国杜伦大学COSMA 8超级计算机（隶属于英国DiRAC高性能计算中心）及芬兰Mahti超级计算机开展。

article_content: According to the Wall Street Journal, Israel's name is notably absent from online maps on the Chinese internet. Chinese users observed that the tech companies Alibaba and Baidu removed the name 'Israel' from their maps, though the country's internationally recognized borders remain visible. The maps continue to label Palestinian territories, key cities, and neighboring countries such as Cyprus, Jordan, and Iraq. The timing of this development is uncertain, but Chinese internet users began discussing the change after the Hamas attack on October 7, which resulted in more than 1,400 Israeli deaths. Spokespersons for Alibaba and Baidu did not immediately respond to requests for comment. However, Baidu spokesman Jing Meng told The Telegraph that the omission was not deliberate. 'Where space is limited, our maps may not display the names or flags of some territories,' he said, adding that users can still find these countries by using the map's search function. China has a longstanding position advocating for a two-state solution and establishing an independent Palestinian state, according to the Associated Press. Following the outbreak of the current conflict, Chinese leadership has reiterated calls for an immediate ceasefire and humanitarian aid for Palestinians. Beijing has avoided directly condemning Hamas but opposes all forms of attacks against civilians. Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi stated in a phone conversation with a Brazilian presidential advisor that 'the crux of the matter is that justice has not been done to the Palestinian people.' Wang further remarked that the conflict underscores the need for genuine peace talks to secure the legitimate rights of Palestinians. China's Middle East envoy Zhai Jun also told Palestinian and Egyptian officials that China has 'no selfish interests' and 'stands on the side of peace, fairness, and justice.' Meanwhile, some Chinese social media users have expressed strong support for Palestine, with a rise in antisemitic posts reported. On Weibo, one top post said, 'Normal people will support Palestine. It's evident that Palestine is fighting for survival. It is almost at the end of the line,' according to a report by Xinhua. Another post claimed, 'Israel can win the war with the support of the United States, but it will never get the support of the world's righteous people.'

article_content: A woman is accused of exhuming her father's grave in search of what she believed was his 'real will,' claiming he would have approved of her actions. Melanie Nash, 52, allegedly conspired with three others—Ginette Dowse, 71, Michael Day, 37, and David Grey, 57—to remove her father Eddie Nash's remains from Colebrook Village Cemetery in New Hampshire in May. The vault belonging to Eddie Nash, a businessman who died of a heart attack at age 68 in 2004, was found cracked open, with the casket disturbed and its contents searched. Eddie Nash's body was left undisturbed. In a police statement, Nash said she and the group dug up her father's coffin because she believed he had been buried with a ‘real will.’ She stated, 'All this was done for the right reasons and I know my father would be OK with it... We all dug up my father’s coffin, Eddie Nash, looking for documents. We did it with respect.' However, according to a police affidavit, the only item discovered was a packet of cigarettes in Eddie Nash's hand. Michael Pearson, director at Jenkins and Newman Funeral Home, remarked earlier this year to WMUR, 'You hear of grave robbing 100, 150 years ago. You don't think of it in 2014.' Prosecutors state that Nash had reportedly been upset about not receiving anything when her father died, and believed her sister, Susie Nash, had hidden the will. Susie Nash maintains there was only one known will, completed in 1995, and all family members were aware of it. Last month, Melanie Nash’s attorney, William Albrecht, filed a motion to exclude her police statement, arguing it violated her right against self-incrimination. However, Coos County Attorney John McCormick stated that Nash had voluntarily waived her Miranda rights and provided the statement. Eddie Nash, formerly a dairy farmer, founded a successful heavy equipment business in 1979, which is still operated by his family today. The Colebrook-based company, employing about 30 workers, sells used backhoes, skidders, and dozers across the U.S. and Canada. According to his obituary, Eddie Nash and his wife Shirley had two daughters, two sons, and eight grandchildren. After this incident, he has been reburied at a cost of several thousand dollars. Melanie Nash faces multiple charges, including criminal mischief, interference with a cemetery or burial ground, conspiracy to interfere with a cemetery, and abuse of a corpse, according to The Berlin Daily Sun. Day, Dowse, and Grey have also been indicted in the case.

Efron's appearance on Saturday Night Live helped promote his newest release. Close behind, the thriller 'State of Play' with Russell Crowe and Ben Affleck made $14.1 million. article_content: After the October 7, 2023, Hamas attack, Israel suspended work permits for West Bank Palestinians, causing construction projects nationwide to stall. In places like Ramat Gan, nearly empty building sites—once bustling with Palestinian workers—sit idle while materials go unused. The labor freeze has hit over 110,000 Palestinians, mainly from the construction sector, leaving Israeli building projects at only 15% of normal activity. Palestinian families who depended on these jobs now scramble to cover rent and daily costs. Businesses in the West Bank, such as local grocery stores, have seen a steep rise in unpaid credit as more workers lose incomes. With many Israelis serving in the military and foreign workers departing due to conflict, the labor shortage is growing more severe. Industry leaders like Shay Pauzner emphasize that the problem could soon affect all Israelis, increasing housing costs and straining the economy. Meanwhile, Palestinian workers who once chose Israeli jobs for better wages are cut off, with some unable to retrieve even previous earnings. Electricians and other service providers face dwindling clientele as checkpoints close and spending dries up. Previously, the work permit program was viewed as building economic and social ties. Now, security concerns have led Israeli leaders like Itamar Ben Gvir to reject calls for reinstating even limited work permits. The uncertainty leaves both sides anxious—Israeli employers and Palestinian workers question whether cooperation can resume, or if the disruption will persist long after the conflict.

article_content: The nominees for the 66th Grammy Awards were announced on Friday morning, ahead of the ceremony set for February 4, 2024, at Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles. This year, SZA leads the nominations with nine, including Record, Album, and Song of the Year for 'Kill Bill' and 'SOS.' Phoebe Bridgers, Serban Ghenea, and Victoria Monét have seven nominations each, while Jack Antonoff, Jon Batiste, boygenius, Brandy Clark, Miley Cyrus, Billie Eilish, Olivia Rodrigo, and Taylor Swift each received six. Taylor Swift continues her incredible year with her 'Eras Tour' concerts, movie release, and her latest album, 'Midnights,' which made her one of only a few artists to have four albums in the Billboard Top 10 simultaneously this June. She is nominated for Album of the Year ('Midnights'), Song of the Year ('Anti-Hero'), and Record of the Year, making her one of five to receive nominations in all three major categories. If she wins Album of the Year, it would be her fourth, breaking her current tie with Frank Sinatra, Stevie Wonder, and Paul Simon. Others who received nominations in all three marquee categories include SZA, Jon Batiste, Miley Cyrus, Olivia Rodrigo, and Billie Eilish. The Best New Artist nominees are Gracie Abrams, Fred again.., Ice Spice, Jelly Roll, Coco Jones, Noah Kahan, Victoria Monét, and The War and Treaty. The 'Barbie' soundtrack stands out with Billie Eilish's 'What Was I Made For?' nominated for both Record and Song of the Year, and Dua Lipa’s 'Dance the Night' up for Song of the Year. The soundtrack collected eleven nominations overall, including Mark Ronson and Andrew Wyatt’s score, Nicki Minaj and Ice Spice’s 'Barbie World' for Best Rap Song, and Best Compilation Soundtrack for Visual Media. This year’s Grammys introduces three new categories: Best African Music Performance, Best Alternative Jazz Album, and Best Pop Dance Recording. Producer of the Year, Non-Classical, and Songwriter of the Year, Non-Classical, are now open to voting by all Recording Academy members. The complete list of nominees covers 94 categories, from major awards like Record, Album, and Song of the Year to various genre and technical fields. The Grammy Awards will air live on CBS and stream on Paramount+ on February 4, 2024.

article_content: Australian cricketer David Warner has defended his heated exchange with Indian batsman Rohit Sharma, stating he 'politely' asked Sharma to 'speak English'—even though he admitted he was wrong to escalate the situation. The confrontation began after Warner questioned Sharma for taking an overthrow following the final ball of the 23rd over during Sunday's one-day international at the Melbourne Cricket Ground. Warner, already involved in sledging controversies this summer, allegedly criticized Sharma over what he regarded as poor sportsmanship for running after an overthrow that Warner believed resulted from a deflection. He told Sky Sports Radio, as reported by News Corp, 'When I went over to say something to him, he responded in his language. I said, 'Speak English,' because, theoretically, I cannot speak Hindi.' Warner added, 'I did the polite thing and asked him to speak English, and then he did—but I can't repeat what he said.' Although video replays supported India's claim that there was no deflection, Warner stated he would not apologize despite acknowledging his mistake. 'I was in the wrong... I shouldn't have engaged him,' Warner admitted. 'If people cross me, I'm not going to back down. We play hard, aggressive cricket, but we know there can be consequences such as fines. We must ensure we do not cross the line, because playing cricket the right way is what matters.' An unwritten cricket rule suggests batsmen should not run overthrows if the ball deflects off their body or bat. Although Sharma initially hesitated, he completed the run. Warner reacted with disbelief and approached Sharma; as he passed, he was seen on camera repeatedly saying, 'What? Speak English.' Umpires Kumar Dharmasena and John Ward intervened, and Australian captain George Bailey pulled Warner away. Warner was subsequently fined 50% of his match fee for the incident. The match’s tension was intensified by recent friction between Australia and India. Indian captain MS Dhoni downplayed the incident, saying, 'I think Rohit was fine with it. I didn’t even bother to ask what really happened. It was between two grown men, and I hope it was sorted out on the field.' Citing historic controversies, the article refers to the 2008 incident involving Indian spinner Harbhajan Singh and Australian Andrew Symonds. Former New Zealand cricketer Martin Crowe strongly criticized Warner, calling him 'the most juvenile cricketer I have seen on a cricket field.' Crowe recommended introducing yellow and red card disciplinary measures, arguing that fines are insufficient. 'Warner can play, but he is the most juvenile cricketer I have seen,' Crowe wrote on ESPNcricinfo. 'If he continues this behavior, he should be removed, either by Cricket Australia or the world governing body.' Crowe warned Warner’s actions set a poor example for teammates and damage the sport’s image. During the match, Sharma—on 58 at the time of the incident—went on to score 137. Suresh Raina, who made 52, later caught Warner for 24 during the Australian innings. James Faulkner led Australia to a four-wicket win, chasing India’s 267 with an over to spare. Aaron Finch scored 96, and his partnership with Steve Smith set up Australia’s chase before a late comeback by India. Mitchell Starc was named man of the match.
translated_content: 澳大利亚板球运动员大卫·华纳为自己与印度击球手罗希特·夏尔马之间激烈争执进行了辩护，称他“礼貌地”让夏尔马“说英语”——尽管他承认自己不应该让事态升级。冲突起因于周日在墨尔本板球场进行的一日国际赛第23轮最后一球过后，华纳质问夏尔马为什么在额外得分后继续跑垒。 华纳本赛季已卷入多起言语挑衅争议，据称他指责夏尔马在额外得分后继续跑动违反体育精神，因为他认为那是一个折射的得分。他在接受Sky Sports Radio（新闻集团转述）采访时表示：“当我走过去和他说话时，他用自己的语言回应。我说‘说英语’，因为我不会印地语。” 华纳补充道：“我做了礼貌的事，让他用英语说，然后他说了——但我不能重复他说的内容。”虽然视频回放支持了印度方面没有折射的说法，但华纳表示，尽管意识到自己判断错了，他不会致歉。“我确实错了……我不该和他对话，”华纳坦言，“如果有人惹到我，我不会轻易退让。我们打得凶猛，但明白会有受到罚款等后果。我们必须确保不越界，正确打球才是关键。” 板球有一条不成文的规则，如果球碰到击球手的身体或球棒后反弹，击球员不应继续为额外分数跑垒。尽管夏尔马起初犹豫，但他还是完成了跑分。华纳难以置信，走上前与夏尔马理论，镜头多次拍到他说：“什么？说英语。”裁判库马尔·达马塞纳和约翰·沃德介入，澳队队长乔治·贝利将华纳拉开。华纳因此被罚去50%比赛奖金。 两队近期有摩擦，本场比赛气氛紧张。印度队长MS多尼淡化此事称：“我觉得罗希特没事，我甚至没详细问。我希望两个成年人在场上都能解决。” 文章还提到2008年印度球员哈巴詹·辛格与澳大利亚球员安德鲁·西蒙兹事件等历史争议。新西兰前板球运动员马丁·克劳严厉批评华纳，称他“是我见过最幼稚的球员”，并建议引入黄牌红牌等更严厉处罚，认为罚款根本没用。 克劳在ESPNcricinfo网站写道：“华纳球技不错，但他是最幼稚的板球手。如果他继续这样，应该由澳方或世界板球理事会将其停赛。”克劳提醒，华纳的行为会影响队友，并有损板球形象。 比赛中，事件发生时夏尔马已经得到58分，最终拿下137分。苏雷什·雷纳打出52分，同时在澳队进攻回合接杀了华纳，使其24分出局。詹姆斯·福克纳带领澳大利亚以四门之差取胜，在最后一回合内完成267追分。亚伦·芬奇打出96分，和史蒂夫·史密斯联手为胜利奠定基础，尽管印度队后半段顽强反击。米切尔·斯塔克被评为最佳球员。

article_content: Robin Meade, reflecting on her time as a weekend news anchor in Chicago, describes a powerful episode of on-air anxiety. Right before going live with a breaking news story, she was struck by overwhelming nervousness—her stomach twisted, her heart thudded, and she started sweating. As the camera focused on her, she fought to control her breath, but her voice quivered, and her hands shook while she tried to present the news, feeling as though she was falling apart in front of viewers. As she fought through the segment, worries overwhelmed her mind—concerns about failing at her job, disappointing her bosses, and what her future might hold. Distracted by these racing thoughts, she hardly heard her own words on air. Although it lasted just seconds, the experience seemed to stretch endlessly. Afterward, her coworkers gathered around, clearly worried about her. Josh, a crew member, and Michael, the prompter operator, brought her water and checked on her. The producer also reached out via her earpiece, and Robin tried to downplay the situation, dismissing it as a temporary 'breathing problem.' Despite pushing forward, Robin was left feeling exhausted and deeply embarrassed. She compared this moment to a humorous incident from her high school days, when a wardrobe mishap during an assembly left her exposed in front of classmates—a moment she could laugh about. But the anxiety she felt on air felt overwhelming and couldn't simply be shrugged off. Driving home that night, she remained preoccupied with the incident. The embarrassment lingered, making her wish she could hide. Even the routine parts of her evening seemed muted as she replayed what had happened. At home, her husband Tim, who had watched the show, met her with concern. He gently asked what happened and if she was alright, emphasizing just how significant the experience had been for her. This story is shared in Robin’s book 'Morning Sunshine!: How to Radiate Confidence and Feel It Too,' offering insight into the real pressures and vulnerabilities behind a polished on-air appearance.

article_content: Entertainment journalist Michael Ausiello has announced that he is taking a break from his professional duties to support his husband, Kit Cowan, who is nearing the end of his fight with a rare form of neuroendocrine cancer. Ausiello, founder of TVLine and a former reporter for TV Guide and Entertainment Weekly, published the announcement on his website. Kit Cowan, 41, is a photographer, designer, and owns a stationery company. He was diagnosed with an aggressive type of neuroendocrine cancer nine months ago. Ausiello and Cowan, who currently live in New York City, met in 2001 and married earlier this year. In his message, Ausiello celebrated Cowan’s talent and creative influence, noting Cowan’s major role in shaping TVLine’s success, from making key design choices to advising on important professional decisions—including Ausiello’s wardrobe for TV appearances. Ausiello shared few specifics about Cowan’s illness but explained that neuroendocrine cancers affect cells involved in the hormonal and nervous systems and most often appear in the intestines or lungs. While Ausiello takes a leave of absence, the TVLine team will continue reporting as usual. He concluded by expressing heartfelt appreciation for Cowan’s personal and professional support. Ausiello’s own career began with soap opera journalism, leading to roles at TV Guide and Entertainment Weekly, launching TVLine in 2010, and even taking on cameo roles in TV series like Scrubs, Veronica Mars, and Gilmore Girls.

article_content: A man from Harvey, Louisiana, was killed after a neighbor’s gun accidentally discharged through a shared apartment wall, striking him while he slept. Rene O’Quin, 38, was found bleeding in bed by his fiancée early Sunday. She called the police, and investigators found that O’Quin had died from a single bullet wound to the head, believed to have come from the adjoining apartment of Pierre Camese. According to the New Orleans Times-Picayune, detectives initially thought O’Quin’s wound was self-inflicted. However, after the Jefferson Parish Sheriff’s Office determined the gunshot came from the other side of the bedroom wall, Camese was taken into custody. The 23-year-old has been charged with negligent homicide, according to department spokesman Colonel John Fortunato. Investigators learned that Camese was involved in a domestic dispute with an unidentified woman over the weekend, and 911 had been called to the building previously. Camese told police he took a 12-gauge shotgun to bed with him out of fear that the woman’s family might try to harm him. He placed the borrowed firearm on his bed, pointing it toward the wall, and said it accidentally discharged as he pulled his bedcovers. Camese claimed he did not know someone had been shot. He was booked Sunday on charges of domestic abuse as well as negligent homicide. The incident occurred on Destrehan Avenue in Harvey, Louisiana. Police had been called to Camese’s apartment the day before for a domestic dispute, and he was charged in connection with that incident as well.

article_content: Fish oil may offer protection for sun-lovers against skin cancer, according to new research from the University of Manchester. Scientists there have found that omega-3 acids found in fish oil can boost the immune system, enhancing the body’s ability to fight skin cancer and infections. This is the first time the protective effect of omega-3—commonly present in fish and plant oils—has been demonstrated in humans. The research team, part of the university's photobiology unit, discovered that omega-3 acids reduce the immune suppression caused by sunlight. The oils lowered the sun’s impact on the immune system by about 50%. Excessive exposure to UV radiation can suppress the immune system, weakening the body’s defenses against skin cancer and infections. Professor Lesley Rhodes, the study’s lead author and a staff member at Salford Royal Hospital, called the findings 'very exciting.' He noted that while the improvements from omega-3 supplements were small, they indicate that omega-3 could help lower the risk of skin cancer over a person’s lifetime. Previous research in this area has been conducted on mice, but this is the first direct clinical trial involving humans. Fish oil is already recognized for its health benefits, such as supporting cardiovascular health. The study was published in The American Journal of Clinical Nutrition and involved 79 volunteers. These participants took a daily 4g dose of omega-3—approximately equal to one and a half servings of oily fish—then were exposed to artificial sunlight for either 8, 15, or 30 minutes. Others took a placebo instead. The immune suppression was 50% lower in those who had the supplement and were exposed to 8 or 15 minutes of sunlight compared to those on the placebo. The supplement had little effect in the group exposed for 30 minutes. The research team continues to study omega-3’s effects, with further trials underway at Salford Royal Hospital. Non-melanoma skin cancer is extremely common in the UK, with around 100,000 cases diagnosed in 2010 according to the latest data.

Ma Qing Hua is about to make history as the first Chinese driver to participate in an official Formula 1 session. He’ll take the wheel for HRT in the first practice at the Italian Grand Prix, stepping in temporarily for Narain Karthikeyan. While he won’t be competing in the main race, this experience brings Ma closer to achieving his ambition of racing in Formula 1. 

To prepare for this chance, Ma dedicated months to training and obtained his FIA super license at a Silverstone test earlier this year. At 24, he already has a broad motorsport background, having competed in Formula Renault, A1 Grand Prix, and Formula Three, plus claiming the 2011 Chinese Touring Car Championship title. HRT team principal Luis Perez-Sala has full confidence in Ma’s ability and professionalism, stating that he’s ready to take on this responsibility. Although HRT drivers have yet to score points this season—13th place being their best finish—Ma’s participation is a significant breakthrough for Chinese motorsport.

article_content:
Formula One’s governing body, the FIA, is testing the use of artificial intelligence to address track limits violations at this weekend’s Abu Dhabi Grand Prix. The FIA, based in Paris, is utilizing Computer Vision technology—which analyzes shape and pixel data at the track's edge—to determine when a driver crosses the white boundary line with all four wheels. The aim is to lighten the load on the FIA’s remote operations centre and speed up the process of managing infractions.

Earlier this season, the Austrian Grand Prix saw about 1,200 potential violations needing review by just a handful of staff, underscoring the challenge. At the subsequent races, including the Qatar Grand Prix, more personnel were added, yet not all breaches were caught, with concerns raised at events such as the United States Grand Prix in Austin. Officials acknowledged gaps and stressed the need for improved enforcement next season.

Tim Malyon, who leads the FIA’s remote operations and serves as deputy race director, explained that Computer Vision is used in healthcare to dismiss obvious non-cases and focus experts on potential problems—an approach now adapted for racing. The enhanced system is expected to significantly cut down on the number of cases needing manual checks, passing only borderline incidents to race control for assessment.

Malyon emphasized that while human judgment remains crucial for now, continued investment and openness to new technology are key, pointing to the eventual transition toward automated real-time management of rule enforcement.

article_content: TOKYO -- The tsunami-damaged Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power plant began its third release of treated and diluted radioactive wastewater into the Pacific Ocean on Thursday, following two earlier releases that, according to Japanese officials, concluded smoothly. The plant operator, Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings (TEPCO), discharged 7,800 tons of treated water in each of the first two batches and plans to release the same volume in the current batch through November 20. TEPCO workers activated the first of two pumps to dilute treated water with large amounts of seawater, sending the mixture gradually into the Pacific via an undersea tunnel for offshore release. The initial wastewater release began in August and is expected to continue for decades. Approximately 1.33 million tons of radioactive wastewater, accumulated since the 2011 earthquake and tsunami crippled the plant, are stored in about 1,000 tanks. TEPCO and the government state that releasing the water into the sea is inevitable because the tanks are nearly full and the plant needs to be decommissioned. However, the discharges have faced strong opposition from fishing groups and neighboring countries, particularly South Korea and China. China immediately banned all imports of Japanese seafood, significantly impacting Japanese seafood producers and exporters. Prime Minister Fumio Kishida said Thursday that Japan has consistently provided transparent and scientific explanations about the wastewater discharge and has gained understanding from many members of the international community, but 'some countries are restricting Japanese seafood without scientific basis.' Kishida added, 'We must continue to explain our position bilaterally to these countries and request that restrictions be lifted. It is also important to clearly present Japan's position at international meetings, such as the World Trade Organization.' The International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA), which has sent several missions including Chinese scientists to Japan over the past two years, concluded in July that the planned release would have a negligible impact on the environment, marine life, and human health. IAEA officials reported last month they were reassured by the smooth operation of the releases so far. Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Wang Wenbin said Thursday that Japan should address the concerns of the international community, consult fully with stakeholders including neighboring countries, and establish long-term monitoring arrangements involving these neighbors. Wang also called on the IAEA to fulfill its supervisory role and for Japan’s full cooperation. Japan’s government established a relief fund to help seafood producers find new markets and mitigate the effects of China’s seafood import ban, while campaigns encouraging the consumption of Fukushima seafood are now underway, with many consumers participating. The water is treated to remove as much radioactivity as possible and then diluted before being released. TEPCO and the government maintain the process is safe, but some scientists caution that the ongoing release is unprecedented and requires close monitoring. To date, marine sampling by TEPCO and government agencies has detected tritium—an isotope considered impossible to remove with current technology—at levels far below the World Health Organization’s standard for drinking water. The IAEA stated on Thursday that its analysis of water samples from its Fukushima office measured tritium concentrations 'far below the operational limit.' Recently, two plant workers were splashed with radioactive waste during pipe cleaning at the water treatment facility and were hospitalized for exposure. TEPCO said they have since been released and continue to be monitored, with no ingestion of radioactive waste reported. Follow AP’s Asia-Pacific coverage at https://apnews.com/hub/asia-pacific
translated_content: 东京——受到海啸破坏的福岛第一核电站于周四开始了第三次向太平洋排放经过处理和稀释的放射性废水。据日本官员称，前两次排放顺利结束。运营方东京电力公司（TEPCO）在前两批次中分别排放了7,800吨处理水，计划在本批次中（截至11月20日）排放同等数量。 TEPCO的工作人员启动了两台泵中的第一台，将处理后的废水用大量海水稀释后，通过一条海底隧道逐步排入外海。首次废水排放于今年8月开始，预计将持续数十年。自2011年地震和海啸导致该厂受损以来，约有133万吨放射性废水被储存在约1,000个储罐中。 TEPCO和日本政府表示，由于储罐几乎已满且电站需要退役，将废水排入大海是不可避免的。然而，这一做法遭到渔业团体以及包括韩国和中国在内的邻国的强烈反对。中国立即禁止所有日本水产品进口，对日本的水产生产商和出口商造成了重大影响。 日本首相岸田文雄周四表示，日本一直以公开透明和科学的方式说明废水排放的问题，得到了许多国际社会成员的理解，但“有些国家没有科学依据地限制日本水产品进口”。岸田补充道：“我们必须继续与这些国家进行双边沟通，要求解除限制，同时在世界贸易组织等国际场合坚定表明日本的立场。” 国际原子能机构（IAEA）过去两年派遣了包括中国科学家在内的多个代表团前往日本，今年7月得出结论称，只要按照计划进行排放，对环境、海洋生物和人类健康的影响极小。上月，IAEA官员表示，对目前顺利的排放操作感到放心。 中国外交部发言人汪文斌周四表示，日本应正视国际社会的关切，充分与包括邻国在内的利益相关方沟通，并建立包含邻国在内的长期国际监督机制。汪文斌还呼吁国际原子能机构履行应有职责，日本应全面配合。 日本政府设立救助基金，帮助水产生产商开拓新市场并减轻中国进口禁令带来的影响。同时，中央及地方政府主导的“多吃鱼、支持福岛”活动也得到了许多消费者的响应。 这些水经过处理以去除尽可能多的放射性物质，并在排放前用海水大幅稀释。TEPCO和政府坚称该过程安全，但部分科学家警告，该举措史无前例，需要密切监测。迄今为止，TEPCO和政府机构的海洋采样仅检测到以现有技术难以去除的氚，其含量远低于世界卫生组织的饮用水标准。 IAEA周四表示，在其福岛办公室的专家对水样的分析中，检测到的氚浓度“远低于操作限值”。 最近，两名工人在清理处理设施管道时被放射性废液喷溅，随后因暴露住院。目前，TEPCO表示两人已出院并继续接受监测，未有人摄入放射性废液。 关注美联社亚太报道：https://apnews.com/hub/asia-pacific

article_content: Philip Chapman, a 56-year-old self-employed electrician from Rayleigh, Essex, caused a fatal car crash after experiencing a seizure while driving his van in Southend, Essex. Chapman, who suffered from regular blackouts, falsely told the DVLA that his seizures had stopped in order to keep his driving licence. During the incident, his van collided with a car ahead, pushing it into the path of another vehicle. The driver of the car, Linda Brooks, 68, from Hockley, Essex, suffered severe injuries and died two weeks later in hospital. Her two-year-old grandson, Alfie, also sustained a serious head injury and continues to face psychological challenges. Chapman was sentenced at Basildon Crown Court to six years in prison for causing death by dangerous driving and grievous bodily harm. He was also banned from driving for life. After the sentencing, Linda’s husband, Michael Brooks, expressed his distress, noting that Chapman could eventually resume his life while their family could not. The court learned that Chapman had experienced seizures since childhood and was diagnosed with epilepsy following a car crash in 1999. Though his licence was revoked, he successfully regained it in 2003 and later hid further seizures from the authorities to continue driving. Inspector Damon Bainbridge of Essex Police highlighted that Chapman knowingly put others at risk by driving despite his condition. Judge Christopher Mitchell described Chapman’s actions as 'criminally irresponsible' for disregarding medical advice and continuing to drive.

article_content:
Gregg Steinhafel, who recently stepped down as President and CEO of Target following last year’s major data breach and challenges in the company’s Canadian expansion, will receive an estimated $15.9 million severance package. The details were revealed in Target’s annual proxy statement filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday.

Steinhafel will receive $7.2 million in severance payments and nearly $10 million from an officer deferred compensation plan that Target froze in 1996. Because Steinhafel joined Target in 1979, he remained eligible for this plan. His severance package also includes close to $4 million in stock. Despite these amounts, Steinhafel is required to repay $5.4 million in retirement benefits. The exact value of the package will depend on interest rates and Target’s stock price as of May 5, Steinhafel’s final day at the company, according to the SEC filing.

The proxy statement listed Steinhafel’s departure as an “involuntary termination for reasons other than for cause.” Some shareholders expressed dissatisfaction, stating that Steinhafel’s pay was too high compared to Target’s performance relative to its peers. His total compensation this year fell to $12.9 million from $20.6 million in 2012, with his base salary holding steady at $1.5 million both years.

Steinhafel will continue to receive his CEO salary and benefits through August 23 while serving as an advisor during the transition period. In the meantime, interim president and CEO John Mulligan will see his salary increase from $700,000 to $1 million on May 22, along with a one-time grant of restricted stock units.

article_content: Philip Benwell, 38, has been sentenced to one year in jail after colliding with a nine-year-old girl at a pedestrian crossing in Bournemouth, Dorset. The incident occurred last July when Benwell ran a red light and struck Leila Crofts as she was walking to the beach with her au pair. Leila was knocked unconscious and suffered serious head injuries, requiring intensive care at the hospital. Despite the severity of her injuries, Benwell continued on foot, leaving the scene after retrieving his bike. Witness Louise Barber, 42, called Leila’s mother using the au pair’s phone and, together with beach lifeguards, provided first aid until emergency services arrived. Following a police appeal, Benwell turned himself in the next day and later pleaded guilty to causing grievous bodily harm at Bournemouth Crown Court. Leila, now 10, has since recovered and is back home in Sandbanks with her parents, Chanine Boulton and Darren Crofts.

article_content: A Ukrainian military aide died after a grenade exploded at his birthday celebration, and investigators believe he may not have realized it was a live device. Hennadii Chastiakov, who worked as an assistant to Ukraine’s top commander Valerii Zaluzhnyi, suffered fatal injuries, and his 13-year-old son was seriously hurt and hospitalized. Officials say the grenade was among Chastiakov’s birthday presents, and the man suspected of gifting the grenades has turned himself in to police. The suspect claimed he had warned Chastiakov that the grenades were live, but preliminary investigations suggest Chastiakov likely did not believe it. Police recovered five unexploded Western-made grenades at the scene, and seized two similar grenades from the suspect’s workplace. Chastiakov’s wife said he had brought home a gift bag containing a bottle of alcohol and shot glasses modeled after grenades. The explosion happened as he opened the package. Ukrainian authorities originally considered assassination, but have since determined it was an accidental tragedy. Valerii Zaluzhnyi expressed immense sorrow, describing Chastiakov as a dependable and dedicated supporter of Ukraine’s armed forces.

article_content: India and New Zealand are set to compete for a spot in the ICC World Cup 2023 final when they face off in the first semi-final this Wednesday at Mumbai's Wankhede Stadium. India dominated the league phase, winning all nine of their matches, while New Zealand secured the fourth and final semi-final berth. In terms of their one-day international (ODI) history, India holds a slight edge, having won 59 out of 117 encounters, compared to New Zealand's 50 victories, with one match tied and seven resulting in no outcome. article_content: A woman who bullied a classmate in her youth has spoken out about the overwhelming remorse she feels, saying she is now haunted daily by memories of her actions. Now a mother, she describes experiencing 'reverse PTSD' as she relives the pain she caused others. Wishing to remain anonymous, she revealed that her intense harassment caused 'Gina' to transfer schools. Tragically, Gina died by suicide—information the woman only learned years later when she attempted to apologize. She shared with Slate’s Emily Yoffe: 'There are no words to express how terrible I was. If I acted that way as an adult, I'd likely be in jail.' Her perspective changed further when her own daughter suffered from minor bullying at school, making her realize the depth of harm she had caused. Using social media like Facebook, she reached out to former victims—many forgave her, but she could never apologize to Gina, who had died. The woman suspects her bullying was a key reason Gina left their school, and she continues to have nightmares about her own behavior. She has obtained Gina’s mother’s contact information but is afraid to reach out due to fear of emotional distress and possible legal consequences. Her experience comes amid ongoing tragedies related to bullying. Just recently, Felicia Garcia, 15, from Staten Island, New York, died by suicide after reportedly being bullied, especially by classmates involved in football. Felicia had posted online about her struggles with depression and bullying, highlighting the persistent crisis. Bullying continues to be widespread in the United States. A 2010 report by Plan International labelled bullying as the top issue on American school playgrounds, with youth violence costing an estimated $158 billion. The CDC states about one in five U.S. high school students have experienced repeated, intentional bullying, with higher rates among middle schoolers and girls. Recognizing the scope of the problem, the CDC treats bullying as a serious public health issue.

article_content: A new online black market called Atlantis has surfaced, openly advertising the sale of drugs, forgeries, and hacking services through a promotional YouTube video. The video, designed to look like a professional Silicon Valley startup ad, claims Atlantis is 'the world's best anonymous online drug marketplace.' This comes as the website's operators announced a significant social media campaign, seemingly targeting the market share held by the well-known Silk Road. A screenshot of Atlantis displays various illegal drugs available, including heroin, cannabis, MDMA, and LSD. Atlantis categorizes its listings as drugs, paraphernalia, forgeries, and money, making it clear that the marketplace facilitates illegal transactions. The site offers products such as ecstasy pills, MDMA crystals, speed, cannabis, LSD, heroin, and other designer drugs, all available for mail order, mimicking the convenience of platforms like Amazon. In addition, services like Facebook account hacking, free Netflix access, and other potentially criminal tools are available. Payments are made using anonymous cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin and Litecoin, providing encrypted transactions that obscure the identities of buyers and sellers. While Silk Road has historically dominated this online sphere since 2011—reportedly attracting 60,000 unique visitors daily and boasting annual sales around $22 million (according to Forbes)—Atlantis may be attempting to capture more market share by advertising openly. Atlantis, like Silk Road, is only accessible through the Tor network, a service that anonymizes users' online activity by routing web traffic through encrypted paths globally known as 'onion routes.' This network allows both anonymous browsing and the hosting of anonymous websites, contributing to what is often referred to as the 'dark net.' While Silk Road has tended to avoid publicizing its address and relies on word-of-mouth or 'dark net' browsing for discovery, Atlantis is openly promoting itself with an advertisement likely in violation of YouTube's terms of service. The video introduces a character named Charlie, who relocates for work and struggles to find cannabis until discovering Atlantis, ultimately obtaining drugs and resolving his problem. An individual claiming to be Atlantis's CEO addressed Reddit users in an 'ask me anything' session, explaining that increased visibility is intended to attract buyers and vendors, and downplaying law enforcement concerns. The CEO, whose Reddit account has been deleted, stated, 'Law enforcement is going to be aware of us (and probably already is) regardless of the way we choose to put our product out there.' Despite facilitating transactions for illegal drugs and services, Atlantis claims to prohibit listings involving child pornography, necrophilia, assassination services, poisons, loans, investment opportunities, and any items that could inflict harm. The CEO stated users violating these rules would have their accounts terminated immediately. He also suggested that because Atlantis team members are located in various countries, and because the platform is protected by Tor's hidden service network, law enforcement would be unlikely to identify or stop their operations.

article_content: Dabur, led by the Burman family, is facing rising competition from well-funded rivals as it moves forward with expansion plans. The Burman family, among India’s oldest business dynasties, began its business in 1884 when Dr. SK Burman started creating natural medicines in Kolkata. He founded Dabur with the aim of providing affordable treatments for diseases to people in rural areas. Currently, Dabur is a major FMCG and Ayurvedic products firm with a market capitalization exceeding $11 billion, and its popular brands include Dabur Chyawanprash and Vatika hair oil. Recently, in the Mahadev betting app case, Dabur chairman Mohit Burman and director Gaurav Burman were named in an FIR by Mumbai police. Both have denied involvement in the case. The Burman family has increased its ownership in Religare Enterprises Ltd. (REL) and intends to acquire a controlling stake, which has led REL’s independent directors to raise regulatory and financial concerns and to allege breaches by the Burmans. REL’s businesses include lending, health insurance, home loans, and brokerage services. The independent board, chaired by Rashmi Saluja, has questioned the Burmans’ eligibility, possible ties to former REL owners, and the source of their acquisition funds. The Burmans assert that these allegations are unfounded and retaliatory, following their concerns about trades made by an REL executive prior to their takeover bid. The FIR related to the Mahadev betting app was filed as the Burmans were seeking control of REL. The family claims this timing indicates an attempt to apply pressure. Beyond FMCG, the Burman family has significant investments, including food ventures like Taco Bell India, Lite Bite Foods, a joint venture with Japanese company M3, stakes in the Punjab Kings IPL team, and ownership of Eveready Industries. The Burmans are actively pursuing new acquisitions both in India and Southeast Asia. In the previous year, they acquired spice producer Badshah Masala for $71 million. As Dabur contends with growing competition from major players such as Unilever, Reliance, Adani, and Tata Consumer Products, it continues to broaden its portfolio and seek expansion opportunities.

article_content: Nagaland Chief Minister Neiphiu Rio introduced the Nagaland Municipal Bill 2023 during an emergency session of the state Assembly. On Friday, the Nagaland government informed the Supreme Court that municipal elections including a one-third reservation for women in urban local bodies (ULBs) will be held before April 30, 2024. A Supreme Court bench comprising Justices S.K. Kaul, Sudhanshu Dhulia, and Ahsanuddin Amanulla noted the positive update regarding the passing of the Nagaland Municipal Bill 2023. Advocate General K.N. Balgopal, representing the state, stated that one month is needed to frame the rules under the new law and that the process will be completed quickly, with results to be declared by April 2024. The matter will be listed again on December 11. On Thursday, the Nagaland Assembly unanimously passed the bill reserving one-third of seats in ULBs for women. Deputy Chief Minister and Select Committee Convener T.R. Zeliang supported the bill, emphasizing that it was recommended after consultations with committee members, the Chief Secretary, department officials, and key civil society organizations. Zeliang expressed satisfaction at the inclusion of the 33% women's reservation, stating it will empower women and enhance decision-making in cities and towns. He encouraged women to support the bill and not view the reservation for Chairperson as a hindrance. He also called on the public to back the bill for the overall development of Nagaland. In his concluding remarks, Chief Minister Rio emphasized the importance of women’s participation in ULB administration and expressed optimism for positive outcomes, noting Nagaland’s rapid urbanization. He acknowledged the delay in reaching a consensus but remained hopeful that the new bill would lead to better city organization and development. Rio thanked all contributors and explained the context leading to the drafting of the 2023 bill. The Select Committee, consisting of seven Assembly members led by Zeliang, reviewed and suggested additional clauses for the bill. Rio pointed out that although Nagaland began urbanization later than other states, it now has 39 urban local bodies, and providing districts with necessary infrastructure and amenities through local self-government is essential. Elections for ULBs in Nagaland have been delayed since the previous polls in 2004. The 2017 attempt to hold elections with reservations for women faced strong opposition, especially over concerns that the policy conflicted with Article 371(A) of the Constitution, which grants special protections to Nagaland. Violent protests ensued, resulting in two deaths and significant property damage, leading then-Chief Minister T.R. Zeliang to resign. In March, the Assembly repealed the Nagaland Municipal Act, 2001, and opted for a new law. Tribal organizations have previously opposed women’s reservations and property taxes, citing these measures as conflicting with Article 371(A). A consensus to pass the new bill was reached on November 6, during a consultative meeting with major tribal groups, including the Eastern Nagaland Peoples’ Organisation, Central Nagaland Tribes Council, and Tenyimia Union Nagaland.

article_content: After firing its police chief, the city of Marion, Kansas, continues to withhold key documents related to a police raid on the Marion County Record newspaper. Responding to journalists' requests, the city's attorney, Jennifer Hill, denied access to text messages from former Chief Gideon Cody and other officials, explaining that these messages are on private phones and not subject to the Kansas Open Records Act. Hill's position is that retrieving such records would be overly difficult and is not required by law. Observers have criticized this stance, suggesting Marion is evading transparency and possibly highlighting shortcomings in how the city tracks official communication.

article_content: The community of Chardon, Ohio, is grappling with tragedy after a high school shooting left three teenagers dead. As the small town of 5,100 residents seeks to rebuild a sense of normalcy, the Chardon school district has announced that classes will resume on Friday. Throughout the week, the district offered counseling to support students, parents, and teachers. Teachers and staff were invited to return to the school Wednesday to meet with counselors, while parents and students were encouraged to come to campus on Thursday for additional counseling services. After such a traumatic incident, counselors focus first on helping individuals feel safe, then on supporting their long-term recovery. Tom Olbrich, disaster response coordinator at the Jefferson Center for Mental Health in Colorado and a veteran of the Columbine High School shooting recovery, explained that there is no quick fix. Some children may need help for several years, depending on their proximity to the victims and their experiences during the event. Families who lost loved ones or students who lost friends face even greater challenges. According to Russell T. Jones, a psychology professor at Virginia Tech who worked with survivors after the 2007 shooting there, most people eventually heal, but 8% to 15% may develop post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). Students might be hesitant to return to class after such violence, he noted. Police report that on Monday morning, 17-year-old sophomore T.J. Lane fired ten rounds in the Chardon High School cafeteria. Lane allegedly chose his victims at random. The deceased are Daniel Parmertor, 16, who enjoyed skiing and working at a bowling alley; Demetrius Hewlin, 16; and Russell King Jr., 17, who was declared brain dead. Two additional students were wounded. In the aftermath, feelings of anger, shock, and fear are common, as there is a collective expectation of safety at school. Dominick Flarey, of the American Academy of Grief Counseling, indicates the immediate goal is to help children feel safe and to reassure them that their feelings are valid. Initial counseling also connects individuals with their support networks, including friends and family. Counselors may work to identify people students trust, helping to ease their fears about returning to school. Parental anxiety is also significant, as parents worry for their children's safety. Flarey notes that counseling can normalize emotional responses, emphasizing that being upset is a natural reaction to abnormal events. After the shootings at Virginia Tech, Jones and his team visited classes to discuss symptoms of depression, acute stress disorder, and PTSD, noting that reactions such as nightmares, anger, irritability, avoidance, and difficulty concentrating are normal in these circumstances. Healing is often a gradual process that can take weeks or months. Individuals are reassured that these feelings are typical, and those whose symptoms persist longer are encouraged to seek further mental health support. Avoidance is common, as people may wish to avoid reminders of the incident. Jones's research found that 15.4% of Virginia Tech students experienced severe post-traumatic stress several months after the shootings. True healing frequently begins once the shock subsides. At Columbine, group therapy sessions were organized according to students' exposure to the incident to prevent retraumatization. Demand for counseling peaked approximately eighteen months after Columbine, and some affected individuals continued to struggle with trauma years later, often triggered by reminders like anniversaries or certain sounds. At Virginia Tech, some survivors did not seek support until years after the event. Experts urge that students and families should not be forced to discuss their experiences unless they are ready. Journaling can also be therapeutic. Recovery from such tragedies is highly individual—some recover quickly, while others take much longer. The community may eventually find a 'new normal,' which, while different from the past, can still be positive and productive.
translated_content: 俄亥俄州查登社区正经历一场悲剧，近期一起高中校园枪击案导致三名青少年死亡。这个拥有5100名居民的小镇正努力恢复昔日的平静，查登学区已宣布将于周五复课。本周，学区为学生、家长及教师持续提供心理咨询支持。周三，教师和工作人员被邀请返校与心理咨询师会面，周四则鼓励家长和学生来到校园接受更多咨询服务。 在经历如此严重的创伤事件后，心理咨询师会先帮助人们重建安全感，然后关注他们的长期恢复。曾参与哥伦拜恩高中枪击事件善后工作的科罗拉多州杰斐逊心理健康中心灾难应对协调员汤姆·奥尔布里奇表示，这种伤痛没有“快速解决办法”，有些孩子可能需要多年的帮助，这取决于他们与受害者之间的关系和自身经历。失去亲友的家庭和学生将面临更大的挑战。 弗吉尼亚理工大学心理学教授拉塞尔·T·琼斯参与了2007年弗吉尼亚理工大学枪击案幸存者的心理辅导，他指出，大多数人最终能够康复，但有8%-15%的人可能会患上创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）。他还提到，学生们可能会因暴力事件而对返校感到迟疑。 警方表示，周一早晨，17岁的高二学生T.J.莱恩在查登高中食堂开枪，发射了十发子弹。据称莱恩随机选择受害者。遇难者分别是：喜欢滑雪且在保龄球馆打工的16岁丹尼尔·帕默托；16岁的德梅特里乌斯·赫林；以及被宣告脑死亡的17岁拉塞尔·金。另外还有两名学生受伤。 事发后，愤怒、震惊和恐惧情绪普遍存在，因为人们普遍认为学校是安全的地方。美国悲伤心理咨询学会执行主任多米尼克·弗莱瑞表示，首要任务是让孩子们感受到安全，并认可他们的情绪。初步心理咨询还会把大家与家人、朋友等支持网络联系起来。咨询师可能会帮助学生找到值得信赖的人，以缓解他们回校的焦虑。 家长同样承受很大压力，担忧孩子的安全。弗莱瑞指出，心理辅导可以让大家明白，面对异常事件感到难过是正常的。在弗吉尼亚理工大学枪击案后，琼斯团队曾进入教室，讲解抑郁、急性应激障碍和PTSD的相关症状。他表示，出现噩梦、愤怒、易怒、回避以及难以集中注意力，都是类似情境下的正常反应。 康复往往是一个需要数周乃至数月的渐进过程。辅导人员会安抚大家，这是常见反应，而那些持续有症状的人则会被建议寻求更进一步的心理健康支持。许多人会有意无意地回避让他们联想到悲剧的场所或情境。 琼斯的研究发现，弗吉尼亚理工大学校内枪击案发生几个月后，15.4%的学生出现了严重的创伤应激反应。真正的疗愈往往发生在最初的震惊过去后。哥伦拜恩事件后，咨询师们会根据学生在事件中的接触程度，有针对性地分组开展团体辅导，从而避免复创。 哥伦拜恩事件发生后，相关心理支持的需求大约在十八个月后达到高峰，有些受害者多年后仍会在纪念日或某些声音等刺激下回忆起创伤。在弗吉尼亚理工大学，有幸存者直到数年后才主动寻求心理帮助。 专家建议学生和家庭如果还没有准备好，不应被强迫讲述自身经历。日记书写同样是一种有效的情感释放方式。此类悲剧的恢复进程因人而异——有人很快复原，有人则需更长时间。最终社区会迎来“新常态”，虽然与过去不同，但依然可以积极前行，生活依旧充满希望。

The prolonged stagnation of workers’ wages must end as the UK economy continues to recover, according to a leading business figure. John Cridland, director general of the CBI, noted that economic recovery is gaining momentum and that businesses are far more optimistic than they were a year ago.

However, many hardworking families remain under pressure, earning around £1,350 less per year in real terms compared to when David Cameron became Prime Minister in May 2010. Adjusted for inflation, average weekly earnings have fallen from just over £500 in May 2010 to slightly more than £480 by May 2013.

In a New Year message, Mr. Cridland emphasized the need for businesses to help employees advance in their careers while supporting young people entering the workforce. He stressed that as companies’ financial positions improve, one of their main challenges will be to generate growth that leads to higher pay and more opportunities for all employees, following an extended period of wage restraint.

Mr. Cridland highlighted the positive trend of job creation, adding that most new positions are permanent, suggesting a lasting recovery. His remarks come as the GMB union warns that since the start of the 2008 recession, the real value of average earnings has dropped by 14%.

The Office for National Statistics reports the average annual wage was £26,137 in 2008, rising to £27,174 today. However, adjusted for inflation and living costs, real wages have declined 13.8%. Mr. Cridland predicts that, for the first time since the recession began, most companies will increase their workforce, graduate recruitment, and apprenticeship positions in 2014.

He added, “The good news is that wages will improve in the coming year as growth and productivity strengthen. But too many people are still trapped in minimum wage jobs without pathways to advance, and this remains a major challenge for both businesses and government.”

Mr. Cridland also called for a vocational system similar to UCAS to raise the profile and prestige of alternative routes to higher skills. Reflecting on the previous year, when business confidence was shaken by issues such as corporate taxation and energy prices, he urged business leaders to take steps in 2014 to rebuild public trust.

Wage increases have consistently lagged behind inflation since May 2008. The UK economy is projected to grow by 1.9% in 2013, up from 0.5% in the first quarter.

随着英国经济持续复苏，工人薪资长期停滞的状况必须画上句号，一位商业领袖呼吁。英国工业联合会（CBI）总干事约翰·克里德兰表示，经济复苏势头增强，企业整体信心比一年前有了显著提升。

然而，许多辛勤工作的家庭仍然承受着压力，相较2010年5月大卫·卡梅伦就任首相时，他们的实际年收入减少了约1,350英镑。根据通胀调整，平均每周工资从2010年5月的500英镑多一点，下降到2013年5月的480英镑多一点。

在新年致辞中，克里德兰强调企业应协助员工晋升，并支持初入职场的年轻人。他指出，随着企业财务状况改善，创造带来更高薪酬和更多机会的增长，将是企业面临的主要挑战之一。

克里德兰还强调，就业增长趋势积极，并补充说，大多数新增岗位为永久性职位，显示复苏有望持续。他的言论与GMB工会的警告形成对比，该工会表示自2008年经济衰退以来，平均实际工资下降了14%。

英国国家统计局数据显示，2008年全国平均年薪为26,137英镑，现已升至27,174英镑，但经过通胀和生活成本调整后，实际工资下降了13.8%。克里德兰预计，2014年将是自金融危机以来，大多数公司首次扩充员工队伍、增加毕业生与学徒招聘。

他还表示：“好消息是，随着经济增长和生产力提升，明年工资将会上升。但依然有太多人陷于最低工资工作，缺乏晋升路径，这对企业和政府来说都是重大挑战。”

克里德兰还呼吁建立类似于UCAS的职业教育制度，提高替代性高技能学习途径的社会地位。回顾去年，企业信心因公司税收、能源价格等问题受到重创，他呼吁2014年企业领导者采取行动，重建外界信任。

自2008年5月以来，工资增长持续被通胀超越。英国经济预计2013年增长1.9%，远高于第一季度的0.5%。
