article_content: The Alien franchise stands as one of the most influential series in science fiction history. Since Ridley Scott's groundbreaking 1979 film, Alien, the franchise has set the standard for sci-fi horror and delivered some of the most memorable moments in cinema. However, it has also experienced its share of missteps. Following Scott’s original masterpiece, seven more Alien films have been released, including two prequels and two spinoffs. The franchise, famous for its iconic imagery—from chest-bursting scenes to the Xenomorph’s acid blood—features works by celebrated directors such as James Cameron (Aliens) and David Fincher (Alien 3). Each installment offers its own unique style, ranging from action-packed adventures to philosophical explorations. The Alien vs. Predator spinoff films are among the most criticized. Aliens vs. Predator: Requiem (2007) is widely regarded as the franchise’s low point, characterized by underdeveloped characters, excessive violence, and visuals so dark they are hard to follow. Its predecessor, Alien vs. Predator (2004), also faced criticism for focusing too much on human characters and for its PG-13 rating, which limited the usual intensity. Alien: Resurrection (1997) brought Sigourney Weaver’s Ripley back as a clone, but the film’s uneven narrative and unconventional tone divided audiences. Even so, Weaver’s performance and a strong supporting cast keep it engaging. Alien 3 (1992), David Fincher’s debut feature, shifted the series into a darker direction. Though controversial for its somber tone and troubled production, it remains an ambitious sequel with a compelling performance from Weaver. The prequels, Prometheus (2012) and Alien: Covenant (2017), explore the origins of the Xenomorphs and humanity’s connection to them. While Prometheus split audiences with its ambitious themes and complex plot, Alien: Covenant offered a return to horror, highlighted by Michael Fassbender’s portrayal of the android David. James Cameron’s Aliens (1986) is celebrated as one of the greatest sequels in film history. Embracing action and suspense, it delivers intense battles and emotional engagement, further establishing Sigourney Weaver’s Ripley as a cinematic icon. The original Alien remains unmatched for its chilling atmosphere, streamlined storytelling, and masterful direction. Its legacy endures as a benchmark for balancing horror, suspense, and character-driven drama, making it one of the best blockbusters ever made.
translated_content: 《异形》系列被公认为科幻电影史上最具影响力的系列之一。自1979年雷德利·斯科特执导的开创性电影《异形》问世以来，这一系列为科幻恐怖片树立了标杆，并塑造了许多令人难忘的瞬间。然而，它同样经历过一些失败之作。 继斯科特的原作之后，该系列又推出了七部电影，包括两部前传和两部衍生作品。该系列以其标志性画面著称——从爆胸场面到异形的酸性血液——并有詹姆斯·卡梅隆（《异形2》）、大卫·芬奇（《异形3》）等著名导演参与执导。每部影片都有自己独特的风格，从动作冒险到哲学探索各不相同。 衍生作《异形大战铁血战士》系列广受批评。《异形大战铁血战士2：安魂曲》（2007）被普遍认为是该系列的低谷，角色塑造薄弱，暴力成分过多，画面昏暗导致观感不佳。其前作《异形大战铁血战士》（2004）同样因为过度侧重人类角色以及PG-13分级影响观影体验而受到指责。 《异形：复活》（1997）让西格妮·韦弗饰演的瑞普利以克隆身份重回银幕，但该片情节杂乱和风格怪异令观众褒贬不一。不过，韦弗与强大配角阵容的表现依然亮眼。 大卫·芬奇执导的处女作《异形3》（1992）让系列转为更黑暗的基调。虽然因基调沉重和制作过程充满争议，但依然是一部富有野心的续作，韦弗的演出尤为出色。 前传《普罗米修斯》（2012）和《异形：契约》（2017）探讨了异形的起源和人类与其的联系。《普罗米修斯》以复杂剧情和深度主题分化了观众，而《异形：契约》则凭借更恐怖的氛围回归初衷，并由迈克尔·法斯宾德饰演的仿生人大卫成为亮点。 詹姆斯·卡梅隆的《异形2》（1986）被誉为影史上最伟大的续集之一，其激烈的战斗场面与情感共鸣令人难忘，西格妮·韦弗饰演的瑞普利因此成为经典角色。 第一部《异形》凭借令人毛骨悚然的氛围、紧凑的剧情和精湛的导演功力，经久不衰。它完美融合了恐怖、悬疑和角色塑造，成为最受推崇的商业大片之一，至今仍被奉为经典。

article_content: Senior Conservative MPs are preparing to challenge Prime Minister David Cameron to allow the creation of a new generation of grammar schools. Graham Brady, chairman of the influential 1922 committee, and former leadership contender David Davis, are among those supporting the campaign, according to the Daily Mail. Currently, the law prevents the establishment of new grammar schools, which select students based on academic ability, though existing schools may open ‘satellite’ campuses in other locations. Home Secretary Theresa May and Defence Secretary Michael Fallon have publicly supported plans for new satellite grammar school campuses in their constituencies. In Kent, Conservative councillors are backing Weald of Kent girls’ grammar school in Tonbridge, which has applied to open a campus nine miles away in Sevenoaks. A recent poll found 54 percent of voters would support entirely new grammar schools in areas where there is evidence of parental demand through petitions and other indicators. Don Porter, founder of the Conservative Voice pressure group leading the campaign, stated: ‘We want to ensure that the Conservative Party manifesto includes a clear commitment to reversing the law that currently prevents new grammar schools. Our supporters strongly believe that new grammar schools will enhance social mobility and give parents more choice, both of which are core Conservative values.’ Graham Brady said the closure of selective grammar schools has contributed to making society less cohesive. David Davis added that grammar schools remain drivers of social mobility, but not to the extent they once were, blaming this on what he described as a failure in public policy and confidence in high-quality education for academically talented children. Dominic Raab, MP for Esher and Walton and a member of the Commons education select committee, said: ‘There is no simple solution for improving stagnant social mobility in Britain. However, grammar schools are a vital part of the policy landscape, providing opportunities for talented and hard-working young people from less advantaged backgrounds.’ Research for Conservative Voice found 84 percent of people consider grammar schools a valuable asset to the British education system, and 80 percent believe they make the system fairer. Two-thirds of parents said they would enter their child for the 11+ exam and, if successful, would send them to a grammar school. Prime Minister David Cameron has long resisted calls to expand selective education in the Conservative manifesto. Previous education reformers in the coalition government hoped to use all-ability academies and free schools to resolve controversies over grammar schools within the party. In the 1970s, Margaret Thatcher, herself a former grammar school student and education secretary, allowed local councils to decide whether schools should remain selective. This led many councils to phase out selective state education. Today, there are about 160 grammar schools remaining in England, mainly in the home counties.

article_content: Ice jams caused by melting winter ice are leading to widespread flooding in the Midwest, affecting Indiana, Illinois, Ohio, and Pennsylvania. Thick ice built up during the recent severe winter is breaking apart and blocking rivers, forcing evacuations and damaging property. As temperatures climb, large ice chunks break loose and gather at obstacles in waterways, forming blockages similar to dams. This buildup backs up water, and when these blockages suddenly give way, rapid flooding follows. In locations like the Vermilion River in Ohio and Wildcat Creek in Indiana, residents were evacuated after rivers overflowed. On the Kankakee River in Illinois, ice accumulations damaged a bridge. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers has been pumping warm water to melt stubborn ice blockages. Flood warnings are in effect in areas of western Pennsylvania, where the Allegheny River's flow is being blocked by ice, putting property and drinking water supplies at risk. Authorities have carried out evacuations and rescues, and warn that more flooding may occur as spring temperatures continue to rise.

article_content: It is a long-standing tradition in India to purchase gold items such as coins and jewelry during festivals like Dhanteras, Diwali, and Akshaya Tritiya, as buying gold on these days is considered auspicious. Before buying gold jewelry, it is important to check the prices offered by different brands, as gold rates vary depending on factors like state, city, gold purity (karat), and even shop. The following are prices for 22KT gold jewelry at four prominent Indian brands as of November 9, 2023, at 10:32 a.m.:  Jeweler           22KT Price per gram Tanishq           Rs 5,816 Malabar           Rs 5,570 Joyalukkas        Rs 5,570 Kalyan Jewellers  Rs 5,570  Gold jewelry comes in various karats (KT), which measure gold purity. The purest, 24KT gold, is too soft for jewelry-making. The most commonly used is 22KT, containing 91.6% pure gold. 18KT and 14KT pieces are also available and are less expensive than 22KT gold.  The final price of gold jewelry depends on three main factors: (a) purity (14KT, 18KT, or 22KT), (b) metals used in the alloy, and (c) making charges, which vary based on design intricacy, craftsmanship, and whether the item is machine- or hand-made. Generally, machine-made items are less costly than those crafted by hand. Prices listed exclude GST and making charges.  Gold hallmarking is a certification by the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) to verify gold purity. Since April 1, 2023, all gold jewelry must have a six-digit alphanumeric HUID code to be sold.  When buying gold jewelry, consider its purity, the jeweler’s exchange and warranty policies, and ensure the bill is clearly itemized.  In business, Tata Group is acquiring Wistron’s manufacturing facility for $750 million including debt, marking it as the first Indian company to assemble iPhones. India has overtaken China for the first time in representation in the QS World University Rankings: Asia 2024. Independent directors of Religare Enterprises Ltd have accused the Burman family of fraud amid a takeover attempt.

article_content: On mornings when water conditions were too poor, my high school crew team practiced in a damp garage overlooking the churning Ohio River. We began our workouts before sunrise, still heavy with sleep, settling into a neat line of ergometers—indoor rowing machines we called 'ergs'—to simulate our eight-person, 60-foot boat. Regardless of the workout specifics, one thing was consistent: Together, we generated intense wind (and noise) with the air resistance fans on our old, uncomfortable, mostly analog machines. The indoor rower has seen major technological advances over the years, and the $2,995 Peloton Row is the latest example. Its 23.8-inch touchscreen offers access to thousands of interactive classes, available with a $44 monthly subscription. Classes vary in length and include energetic music, charismatic instructors, and detailed onscreen metrics to help track workout goals. Sensors in the seat and handle monitor your movements for consistent form. If you enjoy Peloton’s streaming home workouts—despite the company’s recent challenges, like a controversial holiday ad affecting its stock, treadmill and bike recalls, and multiple layoffs—you’ll likely appreciate this machine. However, if your priority is a solid rowing experience, Hydrow offers a comparable luxury rower for $2,195, with the same monthly fee for streaming content. Hydrow features an extensive class library filmed on water—a class type Peloton offers, but less frequently. Peloton Row pricing starts at $2,995 and includes a wall anchor for vertical storage. Two higher-priced tiers, at $3,225 and $3,470, add accessories like a mat for the rower, a separate workout mat, dumbbells, and a Peloton-branded Camelbak water bottle, though these can be purchased separately—a single mat costs $85. All purchase levels include white-glove delivery, sparing you the task of moving the 156.5-pound machine or assembling it. However, installation of the wall anchor is not included, and Peloton recommends hiring a professional for this step, which can be inconvenient. The Row measures 7 feet 10 inches long, 2 feet wide, and 4 feet tall. Peloton advises 2 feet of clearance on all sides for easy access. At least an 8-foot ceiling is needed to store it upright with the anchor. With two wheels on the front, moving the Row is easier, but it remains large and heavy. Make sure the delivery team has enough space to bring it into your preferred location.

article_content: A major section of the Sasago Tunnel, located around 50 miles west of Tokyo, collapsed on Sunday, trapping vehicles and starting a fire that prevented rescuers from entering right away. Authorities believe at least seven people are missing, and several burned bodies have reportedly been found among the debris. Firefighters and emergency personnel began searching only after the fire was contained, as video footage later showed them working through fallen cement roof panels that had crashed down onto cars. Roughly 150 concrete ceiling panels, each about 20 centimeters thick, fell over a span of nearly 330 feet inside the 2.5-mile-long tunnel. The unexpected collapse shocked Japan, and for safety reasons, rescue efforts were paused temporarily due to fears of additional collapses. According to Japan’s Fire and Disaster Management Agency, two vehicles remain buried, and two people were confirmed injured, one with moderate injuries. A woman who managed to escape her rental car reported being unsure about the condition of five others who had been with her. The tunnel is a vital road connecting Tokyo to central Japan, heightening the impact of the incident. Emergency teams—police, firefighters, and road staff—gathered in large numbers outside the tunnel as investigations into the cause of the disaster proceed. Eyewitnesses recounted scenes of chaos and narrow escapes while the search for survivors and missing persons continues.

article_content: NEW DELHI: On Thursday, Trinamool Congress chief and West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee made her first comments on the cash-for-query case involving her party MP, Mahua Moitra. Moitra, the Trinamool MP from Krishnanagar, West Bengal, has been accused of accepting bribes to ask questions in Parliament targeting the Adani Group, allegedly at the request of businessman Darshan Hiranandani. Breaking her silence on the matter, Banerjee stated, 'After the arrests of party leaders in different cases, there are now plans to expel MP Mahua Moitra. But this could ultimately benefit her before the elections.' The Trinamool Congress has publicly supported Moitra. Mamata's nephew and the party's national general secretary, Abhishek Banerjee, expressed his solidarity with Moitra, calling the Centre's actions 'vendetta politics' and accusing the BJP of trying to silence critics of the government. Abhishek Banerjee said, 'Whoever questions the government on the Adani issue is being harassed. How can the Lok Sabha Ethics Committee take action against Moitra before the allegations are proven?' The Lok Sabha Ethics Committee has recommended Mahua Moitra's expulsion following a hearing that saw opposition members walk out, accusing the committee chairman, Vijay Sonkar, of asking personal questions. Mamata Banerjee also criticized the BJP leadership, alleging efforts to 'saffronise' the country's cricket team. 'They are trying to paint the entire country saffron. We are proud of our Indian players, and I believe we would have won the World Cup if the finals had taken place in Kolkata or Mumbai's Wankhede Stadium,' she said. 'They even tried to introduce saffron practice jerseys for the team. The players resisted, so they did not have to wear them during matches,' Banerjee added. She further said, 'Wherever wrongdoers go, they bring their misdeeds with them. The Indian team played excellently, winning every match in the World Cup except the one attended by such individuals,' without naming anyone. Banerjee claimed that central agencies currently targeting opposition leaders will target the BJP after the 2024 elections. 'This government at the Centre has only three months left,' she added. article_content: Swedish photographer and artist Clara Hallencreutz is gaining recognition for 'Taste Chanel,' a series that playfully fuses food with luxury branding. In this collection, Hallencreutz reimagines the iconic Chanel double-C logo using colorful candies, decorated cupcakes, fast food wrappers, and other creative materials, blending pop art with surrealism. Her artistic approach is marked by vibrant colors set against simple, clean backgrounds, which highlight the fun and elegant spirit of her subjects. Hallencreutz describes her work as cheerful and carefree, a tone reflected both in her art and her interactions with fans at exhibitions—currently at London’s Opera Gallery—and in earlier shows in Australia, China, and Sweden. Each artwork in the Taste Chanel series comes in three sizes, is housed in 1.5cm plexiglass, and is always offered as a limited edition or unique piece. Prices begin at about £4,000, and new works rotate into the gallery as others are sold. Trained in photography in Brisbane and originally focused on commercial projects, Hallencreutz now shares her artistic process and everyday moments with over 30,000 followers on Instagram. One of her previous collections, 'Smell Chanel,' featured floral arrangements forming the Chanel logo. The series also features a branded champagne glass, tying in elements associated with the luxury brand. There are references to Chanel’s creative director, Karl Lagerfeld, noting his influential role and notable public image.

article_content: Published: 06:13 EST, 21 August 2012 | Updated: 06:57 EST, 21 August 2012 A beach hut in Shoreham, West Sussex, is redefining the concept of the traditional seaside retreat. Equipped with built-in Wi-Fi, a 3D television, and its own weather station, the sleek white structure is being described as Britain’s most high-tech beach hut. Measuring 10ft by 8ft, the hut features 15 advanced gadgets, making it more technologically sophisticated than many family homes. Notable additions include a Samsung 3D on-demand TV, PAL portable audio library, wind-powered lighting, and a comprehensive weather station—allowing guests to ‘enjoy the seaside in a very modern way.’ TV presenter Suzi Perry, who helped select the technology in cooperation with Virgin Media, commented: 'As more of us opt for staycations, beach time has become a key part of British family holidays.' Highlighted gadgets include: Bubblescope (a smartphone accessory for 360-degree photography), Sonos wireless Hi-Fi system, DAB radio with a portable audio lab and guitar, Samsung Smart TV with 3D, Xbox Kinect, Virgin Media TiVo interactive service, Superhub broadband, Firewinder Mini wind-powered outdoor lighting, Nikon AW100 waterproof camera, Oregon home weather station, GameCom surround sound headset, Nikon Sportstar binoculars, iPad loaded with social and educational apps, Oregon handheld UV monitor, and the MEEP! tablet for children ages 4–9. Dale Barnes, director of advanced technology and innovation at Virgin Media, said: 'Surfers can check forecasts for the best waves, sun-lovers can stay connected on social networks, and families can catch up on their favorite TV shows, even if the weather takes a turn.' Suzi Perry predicts that tech-enhanced beach huts like this one will grow in popularity, ensuring entertainment for all the family, rain or shine.

article_content: Oil prices rose on Friday but are expected to fall for a third consecutive week, as signs of slowing demand grow and market attention shifts to an upcoming OPEC+ meeting that will determine production plans. Brent crude futures for January increased by 99 cents, or 1.2%, to $81 a barrel at 1451 GMT. U.S. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures for December were up 93 cents, also 1.2%, to $76.67. Despite Friday’s gains, both Brent and WTI are set to decline about 5% over the week. According to Commerzbank, concerns about demand have overshadowed fears of production outages linked to Middle East conflicts. Recent weak economic data from China has heightened worries about falling demand. Chinese refiners, the world's biggest buyers of Saudi oil, have requested less crude from Saudi Arabia for December. OPEC+ (the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries and allies including Russia) will meet on Nov. 26 to discuss production policy. One key issue is whether Saudi Arabia will extend its voluntary 1 million barrel-per-day supply cut that is set to expire at the end of the year. RBC Capital Markets analyst Helima Croft said the likelihood of Saudi Arabia extending this cut into early 2024 has increased, given concerns about Chinese demand and the broader economic outlook. Analysts at Citi stated that while prices fell to their lowest since July earlier this week, they expect downward pressure to ease and prices to recover. Citi expects oil prices to stabilize in the near term, supported by the end of refinery maintenance and shifting risk perceptions among investors. In other news, public sector banks in India have assured the finance ministry that small unsecured loans pose no systemic risk, as their exposure levels remain low. India is considering allowing surpluses in Special Rupee Vostro Accounts to be invested in corporate bonds, expanding beyond current limitations to government securities and treasury bills. The Burman family, major shareholders of Religare Enterprises, has requested regulators investigate share trades by chairperson Rashmi Saluja.

article_content: Puneeth Kumar, also known as Puneeth Kerehalli and identified as a self-proclaimed cow vigilante, was arrested in Bengaluru on Saturday in connection to an atrocity complaint and is currently incarcerated at Bengaluru Central Prison. Previously, Kerehalli served approximately 40 days in detention under the Goonda Act from August 11, before successfully challenging this order and being freed on October 20. This newest arrest follows a report filed by activist Byrappa Harish Kumar with Sampigehalli police. Byrappa Harish Kumar had warned the public on social media about Kerehalli’s alleged criminal record, after which Kerehalli allegedly responded with abusive language aimed at Kumar, resulting in police action, according to officials. The article also points to several unrelated police actions across India: In Chennai, police made arrests in six sexual abuse cases involving both minors and adult women, with several cases still under investigation. Mumbai authorities charged social media influencer Uorfi Javed for publishing a misleading video showing a staged police arrest, prompting legal action against those involved and ongoing inquiries. Additionally, the Central Bureau of Investigation in Delhi arrested a police officer on bribery allegations following a sting operation, marking the second raid of its kind in three months.

article_content:
The holiday season’s first gift has arrived: Spotify Wrapped is here. Every year, Spotify releases Wrapped, an annual summary of each user’s top tracks and artists, and it’s rolling out again this morning. What started as a fun year-in-review has become a viral social media tradition. While some may find it cringeworthy or feel left out as non-Spotify users, Wrapped’s popularity persists. Each year, users are reminded of the songs they played during breakups, their favorite artists’ golden eras, or guilty-pleasure hits. Taylor Swift is expected to top many lists this year.

For Wrapped 2023, Spotify is adding big new features: 40,000 artist cameo videos, integration with the online platform Roblox, and easy options to share Wrapped in group chats or on social media. FC Barcelona footballers even filmed videos guessing each other’s most-played tracks. A new 'Sound Town' feature matches users with global cities based on their music preferences, and an AI DJ curates personalized playlists of their top songs.

Spotify also introduced twelve listening habit categories, like “vampire” (for nighttime lovers of moody music) or “shapeshifter” (for those who bounce rapidly between artists). While year-end roundups have existed since 2015, Wrapped only became a cultural phenomenon after Spotify began packaging results with playfulness and flair. Now, the expanding lineup of features ensures Wrapped’s widespread reach.

Apple Music’s year-in-review, Replay, launched Tuesday but doesn’t match Wrapped’s design or meme-worthy experiences. [Update: As of 11:39 a.m. ET today, Apple Music Replay was trending worldwide on Google.]

Beneath the excitement lies the fact that Wrapped wouldn’t exist without Spotify’s close tracking of listener data. This year, Spotify noted that over 200 users made playlists titled “Dump Him,” and thousands created playlists about the Roman Empire or “girl dinner.” Rihanna saw a spike in streams after her Super Bowl appearance, and the Succession theme surged during its new season. Instead of skepticism, users usually share this data with delight. Spotify, meanwhile, enjoys a day of social media dominance.

As expected, Taylor Swift was Spotify’s most-streamed artist globally in 2023, posting 26 billion plays. Spotify teased her spot with hidden clues on billboards worldwide. Rounding out the top five were Bad Bunny, The Weeknd, Drake, and Peso Pluma. Wrapped is based on streaming data from January through mid-fall 2023.

Spotify is the world’s leading music streamer, claiming 30% global market share by late 2022, and it reported a profitable third quarter in 2023—its first since 2021—thanks to rising subscriptions and monthly active users.

Spotify is balancing intimate personalization with wide social sharing, says Tatiana Cirisano, a senior music industry analyst at Midia Research. Users want to see accurate, individualized playlists but love sharing those results publicly. 'They have to play both hands,' says Cirisano. Wrapped also lets fans express their musical identities: 'You’re a fan of an artist because their identity resonates with yours. Wrapped is a smart way to tap into that,' Cirisano explains.

节日季的第一份礼物来了：Spotify Wrapped（年度回顾）上线啦！每年，Spotify都会推出Wrapped，为用户总结他们全年最常听的歌曲和歌手，今年也不例外，现已陆续发布。这项年终总结早已从一个有趣的小功能变成刷屏社交媒体的现象级活动。虽然有人觉得有点“社死”，也有非Spotify用户会羡慕，但Wrapped的热度依然有增无减。每年，大家都能在回顾中找到自己失恋时单曲循环的歌曲、最爱的歌手辉煌时刻，或是偷偷喜欢的“羞耻歌单”。今年，Taylor Swift毫无疑问又要霸榜。

2023版Wrapped带来多项大功能：4万个艺人祝福视频、与Roblox合作，以及更便捷的群聊、社交媒体分享选项。巴塞罗那足球队球员甚至录制了猜彼此年度最常听歌曲的视频。全新的“Sound Town”功能会根据你的音乐口味，把你和全球某个城市匹配，还有AI DJ为你定制个性歌单。

Spotify还推出了12种听歌习惯的标签，比如“夜行者”（vampire，喜欢深夜听暗黑系歌曲），还有“变形者”（shapeshifter，喜欢在不同歌手间随意切换）。其实，Spotify从2015年起就有年终总结，但直到后来用娱乐、俏皮的方式包装后，Wrapped才成为破圈现象。现在，各种创新玩法让Wrapped几乎不可错过。

Apple Music的年终盘点Replay也在周二上线，但论设计和丰富性，还是不能和Wrapped媲美。[更新：截至今天美东时间11:39，Apple Music Replay登上了谷歌全球热搜。]

所有热闹背后，Wrapped之所以成立，其实依赖Spotify对用户听歌数据的精细追踪。今年，Spotify发现有200多个用户创建了“Dump Him”歌单，成千上万人则做了有关“罗马帝国”或“girl dinner”的主题歌单。Rihanna超级碗表演后歌量猛增，《继承之战》主题曲也赶上新季同步爆红。用户面对这些数据更多是满心喜悦地晒出来，几乎没人质疑。与此同时，Spotify也在这一天刷屏各社交平台。

毫无悬念，Taylor Swift成了2023年Spotify全球播放量最高的歌手，达到260亿次。Spotify还通过全球广告牌埋下彩蛋，预告她的榜单位置。Bad Bunny、The Weeknd、Drake和Peso Pluma分列前五。Wrapped统计的是2023年1月至秋季中期的收听数据。

Spotify依然保持着全球流媒体音乐平台头把交椅，2022年底时全球市场份额达30%，今年第三季度也重回盈利（自2021年以来首次），多亏订阅和活跃用户的持续增加。

Midia Research高级音乐产业分析师Tatiana Cirisano表示，Spotify一直在“个性化体验”与“社交分享”之间寻找平衡。用户既希望歌单足够精准、贴身，又爱把这些分享出去。“他们必须两手抓，”Cirisano说。Wrapped也成为粉丝表达身份认同的出口：“你喜欢一个歌手，是因为他的特质和你共鸣。Wrapped正好抓住了这一点。”

article_content: Manchester City paid Porto £32 million this summer to sign Eliaquim Mangala, making him the most expensive defender in British football history, with hopes of bolstering their defense. However, Mangala had a difficult match on Saturday, scoring an own goal and conceding a penalty as the Premier League champions saw a two-goal advantage slip at KC Stadium against Hull City. Despite these difficulties, City managed a comeback win, with crucial goals from Edin Dzeko and Frank Lampard—Lampard scoring his fourth goal in three matches after coming off the bench. Mangala endured a challenging game, similar to his tough debut against Chelsea the week before. In the 21st minute, Mangala inadvertently headed Liam Rosenior’s cross into his own net. Ten minutes later, a high boot challenge on Abel Hernandez resulted in a penalty for Hull, which Hernandez converted. While these errors were costly, manager Manuel Pellegrini emphasized Mangala’s quality, pointing to his prior strong performances and international experience. Pellegrini commented, 'You cannot judge a player by one match. Mangala is a very good defender and will continue to be important to this team.' He noted the own goal was unlucky and praised Mangala for his improved second-half display despite a yellow card. Goalkeeper Willy Caballero, who started after City’s midweek cup victory, was not blamed for the goals and is expected to return to the bench as Joe Hart resumes his role in the upcoming Champions League game. City took an early lead through goals from Sergio Aguero and Edin Dzeko in the first 11 minutes, but Hull responded strongly. Dzeko struck again in the second half to put City ahead, and Lampard sealed the 4-2 win from close range, maintaining his impressive form since joining the club. Hull manager Steve Bruce praised his team’s resilience, though ultimately they could not secure the result. Player ratings showed mixed performances for City, with Lampard and Dzeko standing out, while Mangala was criticized for his mistakes. Manchester City now look to carry lessons from this challenging match into their upcoming Champions League fixture.

article_content: As the London Olympics approach, security measures across the UK have intensified in anticipation of potential threats. On Thursday, police were called to intervene in two separate cases: a security alert on a Staffordshire bus and the arrest of six individuals in London on suspicion of terrorism. The Staffordshire incident unfolded when a passenger reported vapor emitting from a fellow traveler’s bag, leading armed officers to shut down the M6 Toll motorway near Birmingham. Passengers were evacuated and questioned, and their belongings thoroughly examined. Authorities determined that the vapor came from a smoking cessation device, confirming there was no security risk. In a separate development, London police took five men and one woman, aged between 18 and 30, into custody on allegations of terrorism. Officials clarified that these arrests are not connected to the upcoming Games. One suspect previously worked as a police community support officer. Homes and business premises across east, west, and north London were searched during the investigation. Security preparations for the Olympics include deploying missile defense systems and keeping fighter jets on standby, while as many as 9,500 officers will be out in force during the busiest event days. Although there are no credible threats to the Games, UK and US authorities continue to stress the importance of vigilance. Megabus, whose bus was involved in the Staffordshire scare, expressed appreciation for travelers’ patience during the incident, affirming that passenger safety remains paramount. Both the coach and the highway have since resumed normal operations, with all passengers safely continuing their journey.

article_content: Cressida Bonas, yet to make her movie debut, is already making waves at major Hollywood events, seen mingling with celebrities and attending pre-Golden Globes gatherings in Los Angeles. The 25-year-old, formerly linked to Prince Harry, has joined the British presence at several high-profile parties this awards season. Her upcoming film, 'Tulip Fever,' is set for release later this year and is produced by Harvey Weinstein, who has publicly applauded her talent and authenticity. Weinstein praised her work ethic and noted she isn't using her public image to gain roles. In addition to her acting news, Cressida has reportedly started dating actor Freddie Fox, son of celebrities Edward Fox and Joanna David. The two have been spotted together in London and Los Angeles, including a recent appearance at Chateau Marmont. Cressida's presence at Hollywood events hasn't gone unnoticed—she wore a stunning white Mulberry dress to the BAFTA Tea Party and was photographed with Joanne Froggatt, Laura Carmichael, Keira Knightley, Rosamund Pike, and Gillian Anderson. In 'Tulip Fever,' Cressida will portray Mrs. Steen, a merchant’s young wife, alongside co-stars Cara Delevingne, Dame Judi Dench, and Christoph Waltz. Based on a novel by Deborah Moggach and adapted by Sir Tom Stoppard, the film is set in 17th-century Amsterdam and tells the story of a forbidden romance between an artist and his muse. Weinstein believes this will be the first of many major roles for Cressida, expecting her to impress audiences with her performance.

article_content: Diageo is a leading global beverage alcohol company that owns many well-known brands across spirits, wine, and beer, including Smirnoff, Johnnie Walker, Captain Morgan, Baileys, J&B, Jose Cuervo, Tanqueray, Guinness, Crown Royal, Beaulieu Vineyard, Sterling Vineyards, and Bushmills Irish whiskey. In 1997, Grand Metropolitan merged with Guinness UDV, a brewing company famous for its dark stout beer. The new combined company was named Diageo, a word that combines the Latin for 'day' and the Greek for 'earth.' At the time of the merger, GrandMet owned Burger King Corporation, Pillsbury Company, and several drinks brands, such as Baileys and Smirnoff. When Guinness and GrandMet merged to create Diageo in 1997, GrandMet's market cap was $1.64 billion. Today, Diageo has grown to nearly $61.5 billion. According to Forbes, Diageo had sales of $13.4 billion and profits of $3.5 billion in 2007. Currently, Diageo employs around 72,000 people in over 200 markets globally.

article_content: At a campaign event in Kanker, Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched a scathing attack on the Congress-led Chhattisgarh government, claiming it was riddled with corruption and nepotism. He accused Chief Minister Bhupesh Baghel's administration of filling government jobs through favoritism, mainly benefiting relatives of Congress leaders. Modi also alleged Congress broke promises to young people and used recruitment to reward loyalists. He pointed out that under Congress rule, only leaders and their families gained wealth, while the average citizen saw little benefit. Modi further criticized Congress for previously opposing Droupadi Murmu, a tribal leader, during her presidential bid, suggesting ongoing bias against tribal communities. Urging voters to remember these actions, Modi assured that anyone found guilty of corruption would be held accountable, vowing strict measures against misuse of public funds. Elsewhere, Indian telecom operators claimed tech giants like Microsoft and Amazon are sending business messages via WhatsApp, allegedly sidestepping regulatory frameworks and costing the government and telecom industry considerable revenue. Additionally, Apple has been asked by the Indian government to join an investigation into alleged hacking attempts targeting iPhones owned by prominent opposition politicians. In related news, aviation authorities and the Delhi High Court have allowed lessors to reclaim leased aircraft and engines from the struggling airline Go First, impacting its recovery prospects.

article_content:
Surrey Police have issued an apology after posting a tweet that was widely criticized as xenophobic and racist. The tweet, which read 'Officers 1 Immigrants 0' and included the hashtag 'We Will Catch Up With You', was posted following an operation targeting illegal immigration that resulted in several arrests. It was posted on the Guildford Beat police Twitter account after a raid at Hands On Car Wash, located in Sainsbury's in Burpham, near Guildford, in cooperation with the UK Border Agency. The operation resulted in eight people being detained.

The tweet received immediate backlash from social media users, who accused the police of racism and poor judgment. Users such as Dan Maguire and Tim Travers criticized the language, questioning the professionalism and intent of the officers managing the account. In response to the complaints, Surrey Police removed the tweet within minutes and issued a series of public apologies, acknowledging the language was inappropriate and promising that it did not reflect the force’s values.

During the operation, workers from Uganda were interviewed about their right to work in the UK. Authorities determined that three men (aged 32 to 37) and a 37-year-old woman had overstayed their visas. Two men (aged 31 and 33) were found working in breach of their visa conditions, and a 31-year-old man had entered the country illegally. A 45-year-old man was identified as an immigration offender. All were arrested and transferred to immigration detention, except for the 32- and 33-year-old men who were released on immigration bail while their cases are reviewed. The individuals who do not have leave to remain will face removal from the country; the case of the 45-year-old is still under investigation.

Hands On Car Wash was served notice that a civil penalty of up to £10,000 per illegal worker may be imposed unless proof is provided that proper right-to-work checks were conducted, potentially amounting to a total fine of £80,000. A Surrey Police spokesperson confirmed the officer responsible for the tweet has received a formal warning, and stressed that the language used did not reflect the values of Surrey Police. The spokesperson reiterated the force’s commitment to respectful and non-discriminatory communication.

萨里警方因发布一条被认为带有仇外和种族主义色彩的推文而公开致歉。该推文内容为“警察1 移民0”，并配上“我们会追上你的”标签，是在一项针对非法移民的执法行动导致数人被拘留后，由Guildford Beat警区推特账号发布的。这次执法是萨里警方与英国边境局在Burpham的Sainsbury’s超市Hands On Car Wash联合进行的，共拘留了八人。

推文一经发布，便在社交网络引发强烈反弹，许多用户认为警方用语涉种族主义及不负责任。用户Dan Maguire和Tim Travers等公开批评警队，质疑警员职业素养。警方随即几分钟内删除相关推文，并连续公开致歉，承认措辞不当，表示该言论不代表警队立场和价值观。

执法期间，警方核查了来自乌干达的工人的工作许可情况。结果显示，三名男子（32至37岁）和一名37岁女性逾期停留，两名男子（31岁和33岁）违反签证规定工作，另一名31岁男子非法入境。此外，一名45岁男子因违反移民规定被查获。除32岁和33岁两名男子被移民保释等候外，其余人员全部被移民拘留，后续如证实无合法居留，将被遣返。45岁男子案件仍在调查。

Hands On Car Wash已收到通知，如不能证明已履行合法用工审查，将根据查获人数，每名非法工人最高被罚款1万英镑，罚金最高可达8万英镑。警方发言人证实，涉事警员已受到正式警告，并强调该推文不代表萨里警方价值观。警方重申坚持用尊重、平等的方式与公众沟通，绝不容许歧视性言论。

article_content: The U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID) will restart food assistance for millions in Ethiopia this December, ending a five-month suspension that began after widespread theft of food aid by local officials. On Wednesday, USAID detailed a range of reforms to food aid management in Ethiopia to prevent future misuse. According to spokesperson Jessica Jennings, the new anti-theft measures will be tested for at least a year and are designed to ensure that aid reaches those suffering the most from hunger. As Africa’s second-largest nation, Ethiopia depends heavily on foreign food assistance due to frequent droughts and ongoing conflict. Prior to the scandal, nearly one-sixth of Ethiopians relied on food aid. The suspension affected about 20 million people, and reports suggest that hundreds or even thousands may have died in Tigray since the pause began. That region emerged from two years of conflict a year ago after a ceasefire. The theft involved tampering with beneficiary lists controlled by the Ethiopian government, looting by Ethiopian and Tigrayan forces as well as Eritrean fighters, and the diversion of donated wheat to commercial flour mills at more than 60 locations, a USAID official said. In response, both USAID and the United Nations World Food Program (WFP) suspended support to Tigray in March, then to the whole country by June, after finding the theft was widespread. Ongoing conflict had disrupted oversight of distributions. To address these risks, USAID introduced new reforms, including enhanced beneficiary registration, improved grain tracking, GPS monitoring of delivery vehicles, unannounced warehouse and mill inspections, and joint approval of beneficiary lists with local officials. Importantly, distribution and storage will now be handled by the WFP and Catholic Relief Services in regions that were previously managed by the Ethiopian government, reducing the risk of corruption. While the WFP resumed delivering aid to refugees in October, full food assistance nationwide has not yet returned. The efficacy of these new measures will be evaluated over the next year to ensure food reaches those in urgent need.
translated_content: 美国国际开发署（USAID）将于今年12月恢复对埃塞俄比亚数百万人的粮食援助，结束因地方官员大规模盗窃援助物资而长达五个月的全国性暂停。周三，USAID详细介绍了一系列针对埃塞俄比亚粮食援助管理的改革措施，以防止未来再次发生滥用。发言人杰西卡·詹宁斯表示，这些新的防盗措施将至少试行一年，旨在确保援助精准送达最需要帮助的饥饿人群。 作为非洲人口第二多的国家，埃塞依赖外国粮食援助来应对频繁的干旱和持续的冲突。在这起丑闻发生前，差不多六分之一的埃塞俄比亚人依赖粮食援助。援助项目暂停影响了约2,000万人，有报道称，在暂停期间，提格雷地区已有数百甚至数千人饿死。该地区在经历两年冲突后，于一年前达成停火协议。 据USAID官员称，此次盗窃涉及埃塞俄比亚政府控制的受益人名单被篡改，埃塞俄比亚、提格雷和厄立特里亚武装的掠夺，以及在60多个地点将捐赠小麦转卖至商业面粉厂。为此，USAID和联合国世界粮食计划署（WFP）在三月暂停了对提格雷的援助，并在六月发现盗窃范围全国化后，暂停了对全埃塞的粮食援助。持续的冲突也妨碍了救助的监督工作。 为应对这些风险，USAID推出了包括强化受益人登记、改进谷物追踪、为配送车辆安装GPS、突击检查仓库和面粉厂、与地方官员联合审批受益人名单等新改革。尤为重要的是，WFP和天主教救济服务组织将在此前由埃塞俄比亚政府管理的地区接管物资存储和分发，进一步降低腐败风险。 虽然WFP于十月恢复了对难民的援助，但全国范围内的粮食援助尚未全面重启。接下来一年，将持续评估这些新措施的成效，以确保粮食援助真正送达最急需的人群。

article_content: European Union foreign ministers are scheduled to discuss the possible suspension of EU aid to the Palestinian territories. Spain’s Acting Foreign Minister, Jose Manuel Albares, stressed that Hamas, the group ruling Gaza, should not be conflated with the broader Palestinian population. Spain opposes the proposed suspension of EU aid. Albares said on Tuesday that, following Hamas’s recent attack on Israel and Israel’s subsequent strikes on Gaza, the Palestinian territories will likely need more support. "This cooperation must continue; we cannot confuse Hamas, which is on the EU’s list of terrorist organizations, with the Palestinian population, the Palestinian Authority, or United Nations organizations operating locally," Albares told Spanish radio Cadena SER. The meeting among EU foreign ministers was planned on the sidelines of a gathering in Oman, focusing on the situation in Israel and Gaza. The discussion follows an announcement by European Commissioner for Neighbourhood and Enlargement, Oliver Varhelyi, who said on social media that €691 million ($728 million) in aid had been suspended. However, the European Commission contradicted Varhelyi’s statement, clarifying that payments had not been suspended and that only a review of aid to Palestinian territories was underway. Officials emphasized that this review concerns development funding only and does not affect separate EU humanitarian aid for Palestinians. While Austria and Germany have announced the suspension of their aid to the Palestinian territories, other EU nations — including Spain, France, and Luxembourg — argue that continued aid is crucial for civilians. Albares described the suspension as "counterproductive." France’s foreign ministry stated that it opposes suspending aid that directly benefits Palestinian populations, and communicated this position to the EU Commission. In 2022, France contributed €95 million ($101 million) in aid to Palestinians in Gaza, annexed East Jerusalem, the occupied West Bank, and refugee camps in neighboring countries. This assistance focuses on water, health, food security, and education, according to the ministry, and is distributed through UN agencies. Luxembourg’s Acting Foreign Minister, Jean Asselborn, also stated his government does not support suspending aid. "Two million people live in Gaza. They are also hostages of Hamas. With these methods, we push them toward extremism," he told AFP. He emphasized that Luxembourg’s aid is targeted at the people of Gaza, not Hamas. Some EU member states, including Germany, do support suspending aid. A spokesperson from Germany’s ministry for economic cooperation and development said the country’s funding is under review and temporarily suspended. In February, the EU announced a contribution of €296 million for the 2022 budget to help the Palestinian Authority pay salaries, pensions, and support projects in healthcare and infrastructure. The EU has pledged up to €1.177 billion in financial support from 2021 to 2024. A European Commission spokesperson reiterated that EU aid does not, directly or indirectly, fund Hamas or any other terrorist organizations.
translated_content: 欧盟外交部长将讨论暂停对巴勒斯坦领土援助的可能性。西班牙代理外交部长何塞·曼努埃尔·阿尔瓦雷斯强调，统治加沙的哈马斯不应与广大巴勒斯坦民众混为一谈。西班牙反对暂停欧盟援助的提议。 阿尔瓦雷斯周二表示，在哈马斯最近袭击以色列以及以色列对加沙的后续打击之后，巴勒斯坦领土今后可能需要更多支持。他在接受西班牙电台Cadena SER采访时说：“这种合作必须继续；我们不能把哈马斯——已被欧盟列为恐怖组织——与巴勒斯坦民众、巴勒斯坦权力机构或当地联合国组织混为一谈。” 欧盟外交部长将在阿曼举行的一次会议间隙讨论以色列和加沙局势。讨论的背景是欧盟邻近政策与扩展事务委员奥利弗·瓦尔赫伊在社交媒体上表示，6.91亿欧元（7.28亿美元）的援助已被暂停。 不过，欧盟委员会驳斥了瓦尔赫伊的说法，明确表示目前没有暂停付款，仅仅是在对对巴勒斯坦领土的援助进行审查。官员们强调，这次审查只涉及发展援助，并不影响欧盟对巴勒斯坦的人道主义援助。 虽然奥地利和德国已经宣布暂停对巴勒斯坦领土的援助，但包括西班牙、法国和卢森堡在内的其他欧盟国家认为，持续援助对平民至关重要。阿尔瓦雷斯称暂停援助是“适得其反”。 法国外交部表示，反对暂停直接惠及巴勒斯坦民众的援助，并已向欧盟委员会表达了这一立场。2022年，法国向加沙、被吞并的东耶路撒冷、被占领的约旦河西岸以及周边国家的难民营提供了9500万欧元（1.01亿美元）援助。该援助主要用于饮用水、医疗、粮食安全和教育，并通过联合国机构发放。 卢森堡代理外交部长让·阿塞尔博恩也表示，卢森堡政府不支持暂停援助。他在接受法新社采访时说：“加沙有两百万人口，他们同样是哈马斯的人质。用这些方法只会把他们推向极端主义。”他强调卢森堡的援助对象是加沙民众，而非哈马斯。 包括德国在内的一些欧盟成员国支持暂停援助。德国经济合作与发展部发言人称，德国对巴援助正处于审查阶段，已暂时中止。 今年2月，欧盟宣布拨款2.96亿欧元用于2022年预算，资助巴勒斯坦权力机构支付公务员工资、养老金，以及医疗和基建项目。欧盟承诺2021年至2024年将提供高达11.77亿欧元援助。 一位欧盟委员会发言人重申，欧盟援助不会直接或间接地资助哈马斯或任何其他恐怖组织。

article_content: A recent ceasefire and the first domestic football season in years have given Yemen renewed hope as they embark on the road to the 2026 World Cup qualifiers. Among hundreds of qualifiers happening globally, the match between Yemen and Sri Lanka this week stands out for its significance. On Thursday, Asia’s 20 lowest-ranked teams by FIFA will compete in 10 two-legged ties, with return matches set for next week. Winners will progress to a group stage, facing tougher competition and additional matches. Both Yemen and Sri Lanka urgently need more games and revenue. Sri Lanka, Asia’s lowest-ranked team at 202nd, has recently had a FIFA ban lifted after governance issues. Meanwhile, 156th-ranked Yemen appears to be turning a corner after years of chaos and conflict. The Yemeni team is 180 minutes away from World Cup qualification’s second round and a group containing the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, and either Nepal or Laos. Finishing in the top two of that group would not be impossible for Yemen and would allow entry to the final stage, where Asia's best 18 teams compete for eight automatic World Cup spots. For Yemen, even nearing this stage is a dream—one that now feels within reach. Yemen coach Miroslav Soukup told Al Jazeera, 'Progression to the group stage would mean more demanding, high-quality international matches and valuable experience for the players. We know how important it is.' Still, Soukup is cautious: 'Sri Lanka has strengthened its squad with overseas players competing in quality leagues. It will be a tough challenge.' Despite this, Yemen remains the favorite. Soukup, now in his second stint as coach since November, is hopeful that off-field improvements will soon translate to on-field success. In 2014, the Houthi armed group took control of Yemen's capital, Sanaa. The following year, a Saudi-led coalition intervened, leading to eight years of devastating conflict. An estimated 370,000 people have died, with many lost due to hunger, unsafe water, and inadequate healthcare. During this turmoil, the Yemeni domestic league halted. Only unofficial matches and cup competitions were held, often drawing large local crowds. Former national team player and now assistant coach, Mohammed Salem Al-Zuriqi, stresses the importance of regular football, saying, 'There is no doubt that the level drops without regular games.' A ceasefire brokered in April 2022 has mostly held, though different groups still control various parts of Yemen. Soukup remarked, 'There are still huge challenges, but at least there’s now a chance for football to restart.' A new league with 14 teams began in early October, split between Sanaa and Seiyun to reduce travel. Some matches have drawn big crowds, including government officials attending the opening. Soukup called it 'a very positive step,' adding that despite the hardships, the situation in Yemen is gradually improving. The national team has not played at home for years, instead relying on overseas camps with help from countries like Qatar and Saudi Arabia. Yemen will host Sri Lanka in Saudi Arabia, hoping for support from Yemenis living there. Al-Zuriqi noted, 'I don’t think the team will play at home soon due to ongoing political issues, but we hope for a safe area one day.' Success in World Cup qualification would bring not just player experience but significant funds to the Yemen Football Association for rebuilding. The Al-Thawra Sports City Stadium in Sanaa has been hit by missiles several times amid allegations of weapon storage. Al-Zuriqi added, 'Stadiums were damaged in the fighting and can’t be used. Improved security and economics in 2023 will help football resume.' While challenges remain, completing a full league season would be a major achievement and help restore normalcy. Soukup highlighted the team’s youth: 'We have rejuvenated the senior team—70% are under 23 years old. The U23s’ average age is below 21.' Budget issues meant the U23 squad received funding priority for key tournaments in June and September. Yemen narrowly missed Asian U23 Championship qualification, losing out by a single goal. Now, the focus is on the World Cup. Advancing past Sri Lanka would be a welcome sign of progress for Yemen’s football and its long-suffering supporters.
translated_content: 最近的停火以及多年未有的国内足球赛季，为也门在2026年世界杯预选赛带来了新的希望。 在全球无数场预选赛中，也门与斯里兰卡本周的比赛尤为引人注目。 本周四，亚足联FIFA排名最低的20支球队将进行10组两回合比赛，次回合下周举行。 获胜者将晋级下一阶段的小组赛，迎接更有实力的对手和更多比赛。 也门和斯里兰卡都迫切需要更多比赛和经济收入。 斯里兰卡以世界第202位成为亚洲最低排名球队，近期因治理问题解除FIFA禁令。 世界排名第156的也门则在多年混乱和冲突后似乎迎来了曙光。 也门距离世界杯预选赛第二轮只差180分钟，将进入包含阿联酋、巴林与尼泊尔或老挝的小组。 晋级小组前两名对也门并非不可能，这将进入亚洲区18强赛，争夺八个世界杯名额。 对也门而言，哪怕只是接近这个阶段也极具意义——梦想似乎触手可及。 主教练米罗斯拉夫·索库普对半岛电视台表示：“晋级小组赛意味着可以打高水平比赛，对球员成长非常重要。我们深知其意义。” 不过索库普仍然谨慎：“斯里兰卡引入多名海外球员，阵容实力提升，这将是一场硬仗。” 尽管如此，也门仍被看好。索库普自去年11月再度执教，希望场外积极变化能够反映到球队表现上。 2014年，胡塞武装夺取萨那。次年，沙特主导的联盟介入，开启长达八年的激烈冲突。 据估计，已有37万人因战争、饥饿、缺水和医疗不足而失去生命。 动乱导致国内联赛停摆，仅有部分非正式和杯赛吸引大量观众。 前国脚、现助教穆罕默德·萨利姆·艾尔祖里基指出，“没有常规比赛，水平肯定下滑。” 2022年4月的停火协议大致生效，而各地仍由不同势力掌控。 索库普说：“挑战依然很大，但足球终于有机会重启。” 10月初，也门由14支球队组成的新联赛正式开赛，分别驻扎萨那和赛尤恩，以减少旅途奔波。 部分比赛吸引大批球迷和政界要员到场。 索库普认为这是“非常积极的起步”，也门社会虽然困难重重，状况正逐渐改善。 国家队多年未能在本土比赛，依赖海外训练营和卡塔尔、沙特等国支持。 也门将在沙特对阵斯里兰卡，希望当地侨民为球队加油。 艾尔祖里基表示，“由于政治形势，短期内难以回归主场，但我们盼望未来能在安全环境下主场作战。” 晋级世界杯预选赛能为也门足协带来急需的资金和建设机会，提升球员经验。 萨那的阿勒萨瓦拉体育城体育场曾多次遭导弹袭击，因被怀疑存放武器。 艾尔祖里基补充：“球场受损无法启用。2023年安全及经济改善，将为足球全面回归助力。” 尽管困难依旧，若能完成整个赛季将是巨大进步，也有助恢复正常生活秩序。 索库普强调球队年轻化：“国家队现在70%为23岁以下，U23平均年龄低于21岁。” 由于预算紧张，U23获得优先经费参加六月和九月的重要赛事。 也门在亚洲U23锦标赛资格赛中，与新加坡、关岛获胜后，仅以一球之差遗憾负于越南，无缘晋级。 目前所有重心都放在世界杯预选赛。若能淘汰斯里兰卡，晋级第二轮，将是球队振兴和球迷希望的新信号。

article_content: Last week, I received a surprising invitation. As a Republican strategist often seen on CNN critiquing President Obama, I was skeptical when I got an official-looking email asking for my input directly to the president. But, to my surprise, the invitation was legitimate. President Obama apparently strives to reach out not only to Congress but also to his critics in the media. On Monday, I joined a select group of U.S. Hispanic leaders to meet with him ahead of his trip to Mexico and Costa Rica. Several friends questioned why the president was traveling to Latin America, as it's uncommon for U.S. leaders to visit the region absent a summit or significant crisis. The trip's main aim seems to be strengthening the relationship with Latin America and recognizing it as an important partner for the United States. I think it’s wise—sometimes, it’s important to connect with neighbors, even without urgent reason. Historically, Latin America has felt overlooked by the U.S. unless a crisis arises. Friends of mine in the region often express feeling ignored by 'Uncle Sam.' During our meeting, President Obama presented a comprehensive approach to working with Mexico and Central America that went beyond the usual focus on challenges like crime, drugs, and political instability. Instead, the emphasis was on positive developments and mutual commercial opportunities. Obama plans to use his trip to spotlight economic ties and cooperation between the U.S. and Latin America, highlighting how working together improves both regions’ ability to compete globally. He is expected to deliver a speech in Mexico underlining the strong economic connections between the two countries and exploring ways to deepen that partnership. A key measure of the trip’s impact will be whether Mexico feels recognized as a full strategic ally of the U.S. For Central America, Obama seeks to recommit to boosting trade and making agreements like CAFTA more effective. Topics like immigration are bound to come up, though they're sensitive. Neither North nor Central Americans appreciate being lectured about their domestic policies. While Mexico isn’t the venue for U.S. legislative debates on immigration, promoting an updated and well-regulated system that allows easier movement of workers and tourists from Latin America makes sense. Overall, I believe the president’s outreach is positive, but what matters most is consistent effort after these visits. Strengthening ties requires ongoing engagement, not just brief gestures. High-level officials and cabinet members should also be involved in maintaining these relationships. During the meeting, I suggested President Obama send U.S. Hispanic professionals as goodwill ambassadors and encouraged him to speak out about the ongoing violence and conflict in Venezuela following their election. U.S. presidential statements carry influence and could show support for the Venezuelan people. As the meeting ended, I wished President Obama success on his journey—and as a light-hearted reminder, told him to keep an eye on the Secret Service this time. (These are my personal opinions, not those of CNN or anyone else.)
translated_content: 上周，我收到了一份意外的邀请。作为一名经常在CNN上批评奥巴马总统的共和党策略专家，我起初对收到一封直接邀请我向总统建言的官方邮件感到怀疑。但令我吃惊的是，这确实是真的邀请。 奥巴马总统显然不仅与国会交流，也愿意与媒体中的批评者互动。本周一，在他前往墨西哥和哥斯达黎加之前，我与一小群美国西班牙裔领袖一起参加了与他的会面。 有朋友问我，总统为什么要去拉美。毕竟，在没有峰会或重大危机的情况下，美国总统访问该地区并不常见。这次行程的主要目标，是加强与拉美地区的关系，承认这些国家作为美国重要伙伴的地位。我个人认为这是明智之举——有时候，单纯与邻居联络感情也很重要。 长期以来，拉美人士觉得，除非发生危机，美国才会关注他们。我的一些朋友常抱怨被“山姆大叔”冷落。在我们的会谈中，奥巴马总统提出了一套与墨西哥和中美洲合作的全面战略，不再仅仅关注治安、毒品和政治动荡等挑战，而是更看重双方积极进展和经济机会。 奥巴马计划藉此行强调美国与拉美的经济联系与合作，说明双方合作可以提升全球竞争力。他将在墨西哥发表讲话，强调两国经济纽带，并探讨加深合作方式。 旅程成效很大程度上取决于墨西哥能否切实感受到被美国视为战略伙伴。对中美洲而言，奥巴马希望重申促进贸易，并让中美自由贸易协定（CAFTA）更好地执行。 移民话题不可避免地会被提起，这确实是个敏感问题。北美和中美洲的人都不希望被他国干涉内政。虽然墨西哥不是美国移民立法讨论的场所，但推动一个现代且有序的移民政策，让拉美游客和劳工更便捷地流动，是合理的选择。 总体而言，我认为总统此次积极接触是件好事，但最重要的是后续能否持续努力。关系深化需长期投入，而不是一时作秀。内阁成员和高级官员也应共同参与巩固这些纽带。 会谈时，我建议总统派西班牙裔专业人士做友好大使，并鼓励他就委内瑞拉选举后出现的暴力冲突发声。美国总统的话有分量，可以让委内瑞拉民众知道国际社会的关注。 会议结束时，我祝总统旅途顺利，还半开玩笑地提醒他，这次务必多留意特勤局的表现。 （这些都是我个人意见，与CNN或他人无关。）

article_content: United Airlines faced widespread operational disruptions due to a nationwide computer outage that forced staff to issue handwritten boarding passes to passengers. Many customers expressed their frustrations on social media, posting images of manually written tickets. The outage is the latest in a series of technical difficulties since United began merging its computer systems with Continental's in March. At least 200 flights were delayed as a result of the outage, which brought down United’s reservation system and website for approximately two and a half hours on Tuesday afternoon. The exact cause of the technical failure was not immediately identified. The airline’s first official response came via Twitter, stating: 'We have a network outage & are working to get systems back online. We’ll update soon.' Flights already in the air were not affected by the outage. However, at several United hubs, passengers faced very long lines at ticket counters. During the outage, United halted departures to its hubs in Newark, San Francisco, and Houston, though flights began taking off again by about 4:30 p.m. Central time. Lingering delays and extended wait times persisted into the evening. Passengers shared their experiences online. Moira Forbes, a media executive, posted photos of handwritten boarding passes, while traveler Simon Duvall described spending two hours waiting on a grounded plane in Las Vegas under uncomfortable conditions. Rich Pearson, marketing head at Elance, was delayed in Houston en route to a jobs seminar at the Republican convention in Tampa, comparing the lineup of planes to 'horseback riding... it's like we've gone back 50 years.' Pearson noted that while people were mostly calm, there was little customer service staff could do. United Continental Holdings Inc. has grappled with recurrent technical problems since it switched to Continental’s tracking system for passenger information in March. The two airlines merged in 2010. The recent glitch affected ticketing, reservations, and flight check-in processes across the country, as reported by FlightAware. United offered to waive standard change fees for passengers whose flights were disrupted and issued an apology for the inconvenience. Airlines depend on complex software to track seat assignments and issue boarding passes, making any outages highly disruptive to both staff and travelers.
translated_content: 由于全国范围的电脑故障，联合航空不得不手写登机牌，导致大范围的运营中断。许多旅客在社交媒体上表达了不满，并发布了手写登机牌的照片。自今年三月联合航空与大陆航空开始合并电脑系统以来，这已是最新一轮技术难题。 此次故障导致至少200个航班延误，联合航空的订票系统和官网在周二下午大约两个半小时无法使用。技术故障的具体原因尚未确定。航空公司首次正式回应是在推特上发布：“我们目前遇到网络中断，正在努力恢复系统。稍后更新。” 正在飞行中的航班未受影响。但在多个联合航空的枢纽机场，旅客在柜台前排起了长队。故障期间，联合航空暂停了发往纽瓦克、旧金山和休斯顿等枢纽机场的航班，直到中部时间下午4:30左右，航班才恢复起飞。入夜后，机场仍有排队和延误。 不少旅客在网上分享经历。媒体高管莫伊拉·福布斯上传了手写登机牌照片，旅客西蒙·杜瓦尔表示，他因电脑问题在拉斯维加斯被困在飞机上两小时，环境闷热局促。Elance市场主管里奇·皮尔森从休斯顿前往坦帕参加共和党大会时被延误，他形容停在跑道上的飞机“就像一队马……好像回到了50年前”。皮尔森表示，大家虽然比较冷静，但工作人员也无能为力。 自三月以来，联合大陆控股频繁出现技术问题，已切换至大陆航空的旅客信息系统。这两家航空公司于2010年合并。据FlightAware报道，这次故障影响了全国的出票、预订和登机手续。联合航空向受影响乘客免除了改签手续费，并为不便致歉。 航空公司高度依赖复杂软件来管理座位分配和登机牌发放，因此系统崩溃对旅客和员工都造成巨大影响。

article_content: West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee sent warm wishes to Virat Kohli on his 35th birthday, noting her happiness as the legendary Indian cricketer celebrated the day while playing a crucial match in Kolkata. Mamata posted her greeting on social media, expressing pride in Kohli’s achievements and wishing continued success for him and his family. Her message included a photograph of Kohli. Kohli’s cricket career began early, culminating in leading India’s Under-19 team to a World Cup victory in 2008. After breaking into the international scene, his talent for scoring runs quickly brought him to national attention. Since then, Kohli has set numerous records and often delivered match-winning performances for India. In Test cricket, he has played 111 matches, scoring 8,676 runs at an average of 49.29. He has amassed 29 centuries and 29 fifties, with a highest score of 254 not out, making him India’s fifth-highest Test run-scorer. Sachin Tendulkar still holds the record with 15,921 runs. Kohli also ranks in the global top ten for Test centuries and holds the fourth-highest number of Test hundreds among Indian players. Coming from Delhi, he is recognized as India’s most successful Test captain, winning 40 out of 68 matches, with 17 losses and 11 draws. Under his leadership, India held the No. 1 Test ranking for five consecutive years, earning five successive ICC World Test Championship maces. Working closely with coaches Ravi Shastri and Bharat Arun, Kohli helped build a formidable bowling lineup featuring players such as Jasprit Bumrah, Mohammed Shami, Umesh Yadav, Ishant Sharma, and Mohammed Siraj. With these significant achievements, Kohli is seen as a key representative of Test cricket in India, admired for his statistics and leadership.

article_content: Arsene Wenger praised the fighting spirit of Alexis Sanchez after the Chilean striker led Arsenal to a 1-0 Premier League victory over Southampton at the Emirates Stadium. Sanchez scored in the 89th minute, marking his 14th goal in 22 appearances since joining from Barcelona. With this win, Arsenal narrowed the gap to the top four to just two points. "Alexis is one of those players who always digs deep and has a real desire to fight. He always manages to find something special to get a goal," said Arsenal manager Wenger. Sanchez tapped in from close range to secure all three points for Arsenal in the final minutes. "It's rare to see a player settle into a club so quickly. He arrived in July and now it's December, and when you look at his goals and impact, it's fantastic." Olivier Giroud came on in the 65th minute and made a noticeable impact, especially after Southampton were reduced to 10 men when Toby Alderweireld had to leave with a hamstring injury after Saints had used all three substitutes. Wenger noted, "Olivier's physical presence made a difference." Arsenal seemed destined for a goalless draw until Sanchez's late goal. Wenger expressed relief at securing a third consecutive win. "We deserved the victory. We gave away very few chances and created more than Southampton. We also kept a clean sheet," Wenger said. "It was hard to get started as we'd played tough matches against Dortmund and West Brom – this was our third game in eight days. We had to dig deep against a well-organized team, stay patient, and wait for our opportunity." "Winning was important after our last home defeat, and you could sense the crowd was nervous." Southampton manager Ronald Koeman admitted that Alderweireld's departure, with six minutes remaining, motivated Arsenal to push forward and seek a winner. "For the first hour we were outstanding, especially after last Sunday's loss," Koeman said. Southampton goalkeeper Fraser Forster delivered an excellent performance, but ultimately was beaten by Sanchez's late effort. "We were unlucky with the injuries, and that allowed Arsenal to press harder in the final minutes, playing with 11 against our 10. Toby's hamstring issue meant he couldn't continue. Fraser Forster was excellent, but we couldn’t keep a clean sheet." Jack Cork and Dusan Tadic also sustained ankle and groin injuries, respectively.

article_content: A British tourist has drowned after jumping into the sea to escape a local gang while on holiday in Pattaya, Thailand. Patrick Molloy, 28, from Cambridge, had traveled to Thailand to celebrate his recent release from prison. He was accompanied by friends James Wilks, 29, and Jerry Robson, 30. The group was reportedly chased through a beachfront restaurant by several Thai men armed with knives and sticks after an argument that began in the early hours at Marine 2 Discoteque. The trio ran through the Tankay Seafood Restaurant and jumped into the water, swimming in different directions. Wilks found safety on a yacht, while Robson was rescued by a local fisherman. Molloy grabbed the rope of a passing banana boat but passed out, lost his grip, and drowned. His body was found floating about 300 meters from shore. Attempts to revive him were unsuccessful, and he was pronounced dead at the scene. Molloy’s friends were said to be in shock as police took statements to identify the men they were running from. The trio reportedly traveled to Thailand shortly after Molloy completed an 18-week jail sentence for a violent assault outside a bar in Newmarket, Suffolk. Molloy had previous convictions for assault and other offences. The UK Foreign Office confirmed the death of a British national in Pattaya and said it was providing consular assistance to the victim’s family. Pattaya, located around two hours south of Bangkok, is a popular destination for tourists and expatriates, known for its lively nightlife.

article_content: Chennai and Bengaluru, two key economic hubs in southern India separated by 177 miles, require over four hours to traverse by the fastest train. In comparison, high-speed trains between Beijing and Shanghai (665 miles) cover that distance in a similar time. Since opening its first high-speed rail (HSR) line in 2008, China has established a 26,000-mile HSR network, with trains reaching speeds up to 220 mph. India’s newest Vande Bharat Express cannot operate at such speeds because most tracks don’t permit even 80 mph. A Japanese-backed bullet train from Mumbai to Ahmedabad is in development but delayed until at least August 2026; by then, China’s HSR will exceed 30,000 miles. Research from Lin Tian (INSEAD) and Yue Yu (University of Toronto) suggests that better geographic integration, such as high-speed railways, correlates with higher export revenues: a one standard deviation increase leads to a 4% rise in export revenue, driven by lower unit costs and higher volumes. India’s export challenges are often attributed to bureaucracy and inadequate infrastructure. Unlike goods exporters, software service hubs like Bengaluru thrived because they relied less on physical supply chains. Lin Tian and Yue Yu highlight the role of transport in knowledge sharing. For example, thanks to China’s bullet train, a garment sales manager from Changsha increased trips to Guangzhou, keeping up with fashion trends and boosting orders by 50%. India’s services exporters, such as engineers, often relocated to cities like Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Mumbai. In contrast, manufacturers often ran small operations away from major export clusters. Traditional hubs like Meerut lost prominence as the auto industry shifted south, and transport challenges made business travel lengthy. By comparison, Beijing-Guangzhou HSR cut a similar distance to 7 hours 38 minutes, supporting regional manufacturing. Taiwan’s 2007 HSR helped expand the chip sector beyond Hsinchu, benefiting cities like Taichung and Tainan, where TSMC’s plant now produces advanced Apple chips. China steadily climbed in manufacturing sophistication, while India's growth has been slower. China uses HSR to diffuse manufacturing to lower-cost regions, giving it an edge as India seeks to catch up. Maglev trains, such as Shanghai's link to its airport, demonstrate China’s innovation, though costs remain high. Japan will debut Maglev Shinkansen between Tokyo and Nagoya in 2027. China could further enhance intercity connectivity. India has made progress with nationwide GST reform, new highways, and better power supply. Airlines are rapidly expanding, and digital tools support business growth. Yet, reliable intercity trains remain essential for entrepreneurs seeking new opportunities at minimal cost. India’s manufacturing sector now accounts for just 13% of GDP, the lowest in over 50 years. Despite expansions in airlines and digital connectivity, physical trade relies on affordable trains for business development. article_content: Sachin Tendulkar reinforced his legacy as one of cricket’s greatest batsmen on Wednesday by becoming the first player to score a double-century in a one-day international (ODI) match. At age 36, he achieved this feat as India beat South Africa by 153 runs in the second match of the series in Gwalior, securing an unbeatable 2-0 lead. Tendulkar surpassed the previous ODI individual record of 194, which was jointly held by Pakistan’s Saeed Anwar and Zimbabwe’s Charles Coventry. This took his career ODI runs total to 17,598 in 442 matches. He scored his 46th ODI century, placing him 17 centuries ahead of his nearest rival, Australia’s Ricky Ponting. Tendulkar also holds the records for the most runs and centuries in Test cricket. Following the match, Tendulkar dedicated his record to the people of India, saying, "I would like to dedicate this double hundred to all the people of India who stood with me for the last 20 years. I really appreciate their support. This is for all the people in India." Indian captain Mahendra Singh Dhoni, who shared an unbroken 101-run partnership with Tendulkar, praised his teammate. "Even when he's tired and can’t play the big shots, he’s very clever in using the bowler’s pace. It’s very difficult for bowlers; they never know where to bowl to him," Dhoni said. Tendulkar, who made just four runs in the first match, batted through India’s innings of 401-3, finishing unbeaten on 200. He put on 194 runs for the second wicket with Dinesh Karthik after Virender Sehwag was dismissed early for nine with the score at 25. Tendulkar reached his first 50 from just 37 balls before Karthik was removed by Wayne Parnell, having scored 79 from 85 deliveries. Yusuf Pathan continued the onslaught, smashing 36 from 23 balls and adding 81 runs with Tendulkar. Captain Dhoni contributed an aggressive 68 off 35 balls, including four sixes. Tendulkar reached his double-century with a single off Charl Langeveldt in the final over, hitting 25 boundaries—a record for an individual ODI innings—and three sixes in his 147-ball knock. Chasing a target that would have been the third largest successful ODI run chase, South Africa was bowled out for 248 in 42.5 overs. AB de Villiers top-scored with an unbeaten 114, recording his fifth ODI century, while opener Hashim Amla managed 34. Indian seam bowler Shanthakumaran Sreesanth claimed three wickets, while Ravindra Jadeja, Yusuf Pathan, and Ashish Nehra each took two.
translated_content: 周三，萨钦·坦杜尔卡巩固了他作为板球史上最伟大击球手之一的地位，成为首位在一天国际赛（ODI）中单场获得双百的球员。这位36岁的球员在瓜廖尔举办的系列赛第二场比赛中，帮助印度以153分优势击败南非，并以2-0取得无法逆转的领先。 坦杜尔卡打破了此前由巴基斯坦的赛义德·安瓦尔和津巴布韦的查尔斯·康文特里共同保持的单场194分纪录，使他的ODI职业生涯总得分达到17,598分，参与442场比赛。他取得了个人第46个ODI百，比澳大利亚的里奇·庞汀多17个。坦杜尔卡还保持着测试赛最多跑分和百的纪录。 赛后，坦杜尔卡将这次纪录献给印度人民，他表示：“我想把这次双百献给过去20年来一直支持我的所有印度人民。我非常感谢他们的支持。这献给全体印度人民。” 印度队长马亨德拉·辛格·多尼与坦杜尔卡合作完成未被终结的101分搭档，他高度评价队友：“即使他累了，无法打大球时，他也能巧妙利用投手的速度。对投球手来说非常难防，他们根本不知道该怎么投给他。”多尼说。 坦杜尔卡在首场比赛中仅得4分，而在本场靠个人发挥打满全场，帮助印度队401比3结束，并以200分不败。他与迪内什·卡蒂克完成194分二门搭档，此前维伦德·塞瓦格仅得9分便被淘汰，比分仅25分。坦杜尔卡仅用37球就达到半百，随后卡蒂克被韦恩·帕奈尔淘汰，卡蒂克用85球得79分。 优素福·帕坦继续保持高效，仅用23球拿下36分，与坦杜尔卡合作增加81分。多尼则凭35球攻下了迅猛的68分，其中包括4个六分球。坦杜尔卡在最后一回合以对查尔·兰盖维尔特打出的单分完成了双百，他在147球的表现中最多共击出25个四分球——创个人ODI单场纪录——以及3个六分球。 南非追分时，如果成功将会是历史第三高逆转，但他们在42.5局被淘汰，最终只得248分。AB·德维利尔斯以不败的114分成为全队最高分，这是他的第五次ODI百，开局手哈希姆·阿姆拉贡献34分。印度的缝线投手香塔库马兰·斯里桑特拿下3个门票，拉温德拉·贾迪贾、优素福·帕坦和阿希什·内哈各获得2个门票。

article_content: Chancellor George Osborne is set to make a pre-election criticism of the Liberal Democrats (Lib Dems), accusing his coalition partners of political opportunism and endangering the UK's recovery by blocking a referendum on Britain's EU membership. Speaking at a dinner for business leaders in London, Osborne will warn that Nick Clegg’s unwavering support for the European Union, regardless of future developments, poses a risk to the economy. Osborne is also expected to criticize the Labour Party, particularly Ed Miliband, on education standards, and will highlight the Lib Dems' reversal on their 2010 pledge to scrap tuition fees. Osborne, who has previously said UKIP threatens the economy, will this time argue that the Lib Dems’ position on Europe is also harmful to UK prosperity. On the eve of local and European elections, Osborne is expected to deliver pointed critiques of the Lib Dems, who have been coalition partners for four years. He will tell the Confederation of British Industry (CBI) that while some warn of the risks of leaving the EU, there are also serious risks in remaining a member without conditions. Osborne says: ‘Those wanting Britain to leave the EU now are taking a risk with our economy. But those supporting membership regardless of cost are also taking a risk.’ He will warn that current EU policies could make Europe less competitive globally, citing research that suggests some regulations cost the UK up to £27 billion annually. Osborne will argue that the Conservatives have proposals to reverse increasing centralization and reduce costs imposed by the EU. He insists that reforms are necessary to protect UK jobs and innovation, and believes that a referendum is essential to resolve ongoing uncertainty about Britain’s relations with Europe. The Lib Dems have refused to support the Conservative pledge to renegotiate Britain's EU terms and hold an in-out referendum by 2017. Osborne will again highlight the Lib Dems' tuition fees reversal, a decision that negatively affected Nick Clegg’s leadership following the 2010 coalition. He will say that improving the quality of education is key for the economy, warning that Conservative reforms to free schools and core academic subjects are at risk. Osborne emphasizes the long-term positive impact of education reforms for both future employers and the UK workforce, but warns these improvements are threatened by vested interests and political opportunism. A senior Lib Dem source dismissed Osborne's criticisms as a diversion from Conservative divisions, arguing that the Conservatives are divided on Europe and risk jobs by considering EU exit. According to the Lib Dems, staying in the EU is vital for UK jobs, and they seek reforms to reduce waste and increase trade by working from within Europe. Osborne will also criticize what he describes as an 'anti-business alliance' of Labour and the 'populist Right,' referring to UKIP, claiming their policies would harm investment and employment. He argues that these parties aim to limit foreign investment, impose price controls, regulate incomes, and renationalize industries—measures he describes as anti-business and overly pessimistic. Osborne’s speech is intended as a strong critique of Labour’s economic proposals and as a response to concerns within his own party and UKIP over foreign takeovers, such as the recent Pfizer bid for AstraZeneca.

article_content:
A 14-year-old girl, Liberty Baker, was killed yesterday after a car mounted the pavement and struck a group of students walking to school in Witney, Oxfordshire. The incident occurred outside Henry Box School around 8am. Liberty was transported to John Radcliffe Hospital in Oxford, where she was pronounced dead shortly after arrival. Two of her friends, Mercy Greaney and Bronte Moulder, both 14, also sustained minor injuries and remain in hospital. A 40-year-old pedestrian was also injured, suffering a broken hip.

The driver, an 18-year-old man who had recently passed his driving test, was arrested on suspicion of causing death by dangerous driving and is being questioned by police. Authorities believe he lost control of his blue Citroen and do not suspect the crash was intentional.

Prime Minister David Cameron, who serves as the MP for Witney, expressed his condolences on Twitter and encouraged witnesses to contact police. Friends and students laid flowers at the scene, and tributes were posted online remembering Liberty as a kind and joyful person who always put others first.

Liberty lived in Witney with her parents, Paul and Maureen Baker, and her younger brother Finley. Her father runs an engineering business, and her mother works at Oxford University's St John's College.

Police are appealing for witnesses as they continue their investigation into the incident. Pupils at Henry Box School were informed of the tragedy in a special assembly shortly after the accident. A Facebook group has also been set up in Liberty's memory, with calls for a memorial tree to be planted at the school grounds.

article_content: Wealthy Greeks have reportedly transferred over €228 billion from crisis-affected Greek banks to accounts in Switzerland, according to recent reports. This significant movement of capital is largely due to fears that Greece may abandon the euro in favor of the drachma, potentially devaluing savings held in Greek banks. Much of these funds are being moved via Cyprus, as Greek industrialists use foreign subsidiaries to transfer money out of the country. This occurs alongside a wave of protests and a general strike involving tens of thousands of workers in central Athens. Clashes erupted near the Greek parliament, where protesters threw petrol bombs and rocks at police officers. Riot police responded, leading to several injuries. The demonstrations coincided with a 48-hour general strike disrupting public transport, closing businesses and schools, and grounding flights. Reports indicate that individuals departing Greece, including some members of the clergy and unemployed citizens, have been stopped at Athens airport with large amounts of cash. Markus Korll of the financial group Roland Berger claimed that over €10 billion left the country in recent months. Martin Schulz, head of the Social Democrats in the European Parliament, suggested Switzerland impose a 25% tax on these transfers to help curb the capital outflow. He stressed the importance of wealthier individuals contributing their fair share during the crisis. Greek banking officials have warned the government about rising public anxiety and substantial withdrawals. Some advisers recommend measures like capital controls or limiting ATM access to prevent a bank run. A wide range of professionals—including healthcare, legal, retail, and public service workers—joined the strike ahead of a parliamentary vote on new austerity measures. Air traffic controllers shortened their strike, but many ferry routes remained suspended, and public transport was limited. Thousands of police officers were deployed in Athens, with roads blocked and metro stations closed near parliament. Protesters expressed frustration over continued austerity, while union leaders highlighted growing hardship among citizens. The new austerity measures are highly controversial, with some MPs from the ruling Socialist party indicating possible opposition. However, Greece must enact these measures to continue receiving its €110 billion bailout, essential for covering public salaries and pensions. Without additional funds, the government could run out of money by mid-November. Prolonged strikes have left many businesses closed and rubbish uncollected, as refuse workers continue industrial action. Civil servants have occupied government buildings, leading to further disruption in the center of Athens during these demonstrations.

Denzel Washington, a renowned actor and double Oscar recipient, credits his years at the Boys & Girls Club in Mount Vernon, New York as formative to his life. Participating from childhood into his teens, Washington found direction and mentorship there, inspiring his ongoing role as an advocate, national spokesperson, and board member for the Boys & Girls Clubs of America.

He cautions that while public discourse is dominated by issues like the economy, job market, and energy challenges, the serious problems facing America’s youth are being neglected. He references data showing that approximately one in three freshman students won’t finish high school—reaching 40% in some urban areas. Childhood obesity rates have soared since 1980, increasing health risks, while young people are responsible for over 20% of violent crimes, with incidents spiking after school ends. Factors such as entrenched poverty, gang involvement, substance misuse, and teenage pregnancy add to these obstacles, jeopardizing the ability of future generations to thrive.

Washington argues that addressing these challenges isn't only a governmental task, but a shared responsibility. He urges citizens to become active—supporting youth-centric policies, championing organizations that empower children, and holding elected officials accountable for prioritizing kids. Washington points to Boys & Girls Clubs as vital, providing guidance, academic assistance, and opportunities that help children envision and achieve brighter futures.

Sharing his own story, he credits club staff with instilling discipline and ambition, which set him on the path to success. Today, these clubs reach millions across the nation, fostering potential by offering everything from homework support to career development. Their “Be Great” initiative inspires children to strive for greatness in every aspect of life.

Washington encourages everyone to take part—whether through volunteering, setting examples, donating, or advocating at the ballot box—and stresses questioning candidates about their commitment to youth well-being. He believes collective effort and advocacy will help ensure a stronger future for all children.
