丹泽尔·华盛顿，这位著名演员和双奥斯卡奖得主，认为他在纽约芒特弗农男孩女孩俱乐部度过的岁月对他的人生产生了深远影响。从儿童时期到青少年，华盛顿始终积极参与俱乐部，获得了人生方向和指导。正是这段经历促使他在成年后持续担任男孩女孩俱乐部的全国代言人及董事会成员。

华盛顿指出，虽然当前公众讨论主要集中于经济、就业和能源等话题，但美国青少年所面临的严重问题却常被忽视。他引用数据显示，约三分之一的高中新生未能毕业，在某些城市这一比例甚至高达40%。自1980年以来，儿童肥胖率飙升，健康风险随之增加；与此同时，青少年涉及的暴力犯罪占比超过20%，犯罪高峰时段为放学后。贫困、帮派、毒品滥用和青少年怀孕等问题则加剧了下一代成长的难度。

华盛顿认为，这些挑战不能只依赖政府解决，还需社会各界携手努力。他呼吁公众积极参与——支持关注青少年的政策，推动帮助孩子成长的组织，并要求民选官员把儿童利益置于优先位置。他尤其强调男孩女孩俱乐部的重要性，这些组织为孩子们提供指导、学业帮助和发展机会，助力他们展望更美好的未来。

华盛顿分享个人故事，感谢俱乐部老师培养了他的自律和抱负，让他走上成功之路。如今，俱乐部服务着成千上万的青少年，提供课业辅导、职业指导等多样支持，激发孩子们的潜能与信心。“Be Great”（成就非凡）口号激励每个孩子追求卓越。

他号召大家积极参与——无论是担任志愿者、以身作则、捐赠，还是在选举中为青少年发声，并鼓励选民向候选人发问他们对青少年支持的具体承诺。华盛顿坚信，只有社会各方共同参与，为青少年争取更多关注和资源，才能赋予所有孩子更光明的未来。

article_content: Ryanair is known for its low-cost flights and extra charges, but recent video footage has revealed the nature of in-flight entertainment on one of its planes. A 50-second video, filmed during a descent to Ibiza, shows passengers singing the Dambusters theme and mimicking airplane movements. Upon landing, the group erupts in cheers and begins chanting loudly as they roll down the runway. Other passengers on the Ryanair flight from Prestwick to Ibiza appeared anxious and unsettled by the activity near them, while cabin crew looked on without intervening. The flight took place on a Saturday afternoon last month, but footage of the disturbance has only now surfaced. A passenger who wished to remain anonymous commented, 'It's no surprise to see this kind of footage. This Saturday flight is well-known among both passengers and crew for its rowdy atmosphere. While talking to a Ryanair stewardess during a previous flight from Majorca, she mentioned she was dreading her upcoming Saturday shift to Ibiza because these flights are notorious for outrageous behavior—even stories of passengers planking over seats as the plane lands are common. It seems few in the industry enjoy working these flights.' Tom Lucas, a sports psychologist from Glasgow who has worked with high-profile athletes, called for Ryanair to address the issue of unruly passengers. Lucas reported complaining to the airline last year after a fight broke out and one intoxicated passenger wet himself on a flight to Ibiza. Lucas said, 'Ryanair has rules and regulations, but they rarely enforce them. Action only happens when something serious occurs. Sometimes staff exacerbate the situation by selling drinks to already intoxicated people. On one of my flights, alcohol ran out, a passenger lost control, and a fight started. This behavior is unacceptable on an airplane, and it needs to be addressed.' A Ryanair spokesperson responded, 'We regret the unruly behavior of a small group of customers for a brief period as the aircraft approached Ibiza last month. Our cabin supervisor spoke to the group after landing, and they apologized and assured her it would not happen again. The group has since returned to Glasgow Prestwick without incident.' The disruptive flight landed in Ibiza last Saturday, though the video was only recently posted online. Last September, a Ryanair flight was forced to make an emergency landing after a group of intoxicated Scottish passengers caused chaos on a flight from Prestwick to Ibiza. Fourteen men were removed from the plane at Beauvais Airport in France and questioned by authorities. French police stated the group was so intoxicated that they believed they had landed in Ibiza when they were actually in Paris. Prior to that, another Ryanair flight saw up to 30 men behaving disruptively on a flight to Ibiza, including drinking, jumping on seats, shouting, swearing, and threatening both crew and passengers. When the flight landed, Spanish police boarded the plane and reportedly removed five individuals from the group.
translated_content: 瑞安航空以其低价航班和额外费用著称，但最近一段视频显示了其航班上的“机上娱乐”。一段50秒的视频拍摄于前往伊比萨的降落过程中，画面中乘客们唱着《破坏者大队》的主题曲，还模仿飞机的动作。飞机着陆时，这群人开始大声欢呼并在滑行时高喊口号。 在从普雷斯特威克飞往伊比萨的瑞安航空航班上，其他乘客对于前排的喧闹行为感到焦虑和不安，机组人员则未进行干预。这趟航班发生在上个月的一个星期六下午，但事件视频至今才曝光。 一位不愿具名的乘客表示：“出现这种视频一点也不意外。这班星期六的航班在乘客和机组人员中都以喧闹出名。我曾在飞往马略卡的瑞安航空航班上与一位空乘交谈，她说非常害怕即将到来的星期六伊比萨航班，因为这些航班常见夸张行为——甚至有人在降落时横卧座椅。很少有业内人士愿意执飞这种航班。” 来自格拉斯哥的体育心理学家汤姆·卢卡斯曾与顶级运动员合作，他呼吁瑞安航空管控吵闹乘客。卢卡斯称，去年他曾因在飞往伊比萨的航班上发生斗殴和醉酒乘客失控而投诉航空公司。 卢卡斯说：“瑞安航空有规定，但几乎不执行。只有等出大事才会采取措施。有时机组人员还会继续卖酒给已经醉酒的人。我乘坐过的航班上，酒喝光了，有人失控，还有人打架。飞机上不能有这样的行为，必须得到解决。” 瑞安航空发言人回应：“我们对上月伊比萨进近时小部分乘客短暂的不当行为表示遗憾。乘务长在降落后与他们沟通，他们已道歉并承诺不会再犯。该团体后来已从格拉斯哥普雷斯特威克顺利返回，没有再出事。” 这次闹事的航班上周六降落在伊比萨，但相关视频最近才被放到网上。 去年九月，一群醉酒的苏格兰乘客在瑞安航空普雷斯特威克至伊比萨的航班上制造混乱，导致飞机被迫紧急降落。飞机在法国博韦机场降落后，14名男子被警方带下并接受问询。法方称这群人醉得以为到了伊比萨，实际却在巴黎。 更早之前，还有一次瑞安航空从普雷斯特威克飞伊比萨的航班中，约30名男子喝烈酒、跳在座椅上、喧哗、辱骂并威胁乘客和机组。飞机落地后，西班牙警方登机，带走了其中五人。

article_content: Two suspects, one in a bright red polka dot onesie and another in distinctive purple leggings, were caught on CCTV removing computer monitors from Dewsbury train station in West Yorkshire earlier this month. British Transport Police are seeking the public’s assistance to identify the men after thefts on three separate evenings. CCTV images showing the suspects in their unusual outfits have been released in hopes someone may recognize them, even though their faces are covered. Footage shows the man in the onesie walking ahead of the man in purple leggings, who appears to be carrying a spade. The stolen monitors, which are expensive and not usable as televisions but can connect to computers or gaming systems, are used to provide travel information at the station. Police believe the security housing on the screens was forced off during the thefts. First TransPennine Express, which manages the station, has increased security for screens at other locations in response. PC Marcus Robinson of British Transport Police stated that the suspects may be linked to all three thefts. Police encourage anyone who recognizes the men, has been offered a similar monitor, or has relevant information to contact them at 0800 40 50 40.

article_content: A fire broke out early Friday at Hotel Mondial in Wiesloch, approximately eight miles from Hockenheim, ahead of the German Grand Prix. Four Williams Formula 1 team members were treated for smoke inhalation after the incident, which began around 3 a.m. and led to an immediate evacuation of the hotel. All four individuals were taken to a local hospital and later discharged, with no serious injuries reported. Williams drivers Felipe Massa and Valtteri Bottas, as well as team management and the marketing department, were not affected as they were staying at different hotels. This marks the second fire-related incident involving Williams in just over two years, following a garage fire after the 2012 Spanish Grand Prix. Felipe Massa, now in his first season at Williams following his move from Ferrari, has faced bad luck, currently trailing teammate Bottas by 43 points. Despite several setbacks, including incidents in Canada and Britain not of his own making, Massa remains optimistic about improving his results and competing strongly for the remainder of the season.

article_content: Residents of a housing estate in Waddington, near Lincoln, continue to face repeated flooding that has taken a toll on their wellbeing. Sue Waterfall, who has lived on Pitsford Close, reports that her street has flooded annually for the past five years. In some incidents, sewage has overflowed into residents' gardens, leaving Ms Waterfall 'fed up, depressed,' and 'very stressed.' Both Anglian Water and developer Beal Homes maintain that the estate's surface water drainage system is functioning as intended, having been designed to prevent homes from flooding. However, Ms Waterfall shared that residents once opened a drain themselves, creating a hole in the road in an attempt to alleviate floodwater. She also explained that the nearby attenuation pond, meant to fill and then empty after rainfall, remains full most of the time. The constant pressure has affected Ms Waterfall's mental health so severely she has considered moving out. 'I've got to the point now where I want my flat to flood so I could be placed in emergency accommodation and get away from here. I'm not coming back,' she said. Another resident, Stuart Bridge, voiced sympathy for those most impacted. 'I have heard of people having toilets back up and other sewage issues,' he said. A spokesperson for Beal Homes stated the drainage system is 'working exactly as it was designed and approved.' The design allows 'some rainwater to back up onto site infrastructure in extreme rainfall, like recently.' Anglian Water added that connections where foul water had been incorrectly piped to surface water drains have been resolved. The surface water management system was approved by North Kesteven District Council and Lincolnshire County Council during planning. Anglian Water warned that during periods of extremely heavy or prolonged rainfall, the attenuation measures can be insufficient, resulting in road flooding on Pitsford Close. This, they clarify, is intentional: properties sit higher than the road for this reason. Residents and authorities remain divided over the impact and adequacy of the drainage system. Karnataka Deputy Chief Minister D K Shivakumar on Wednesday asserted that he has done nothing wrong and was only fulfilling party duties, despite facing significant hardship. His comments come amid ongoing proceedings in the Karnataka High Court regarding a CBI investigation into a disproportionate assets (DA) case against him.

Responding to reporters about the High Court proceedings, Shivakumar stated: “I am unaware of what has happened in court. It would not be right for me to comment without complete information. My lawyers will brief me, and until then, I cannot comment as it is a court matter. In my view, it's best to refrain from commenting on legal proceedings.”

Speaking on BJP MLA Basanagouda Patil Yatnal’s intervention challenging the Karnataka government’s withdrawal of consent for the CBI probe, Shivakumar remarked, “Let anyone do as they wish. I know who has said or done what, and I have observed everything with humility. I will respond at the appropriate time.”

When asked if the court developments offered relief, Shivakumar said, “The people have seen that I have done no wrong. I only did party work, and I have endured many difficulties for it. If further troubles arise, I trust in God and the people of the state. The events in the state speak for themselves regarding the troubles I have faced.” He also expressed gratitude to supporters who stood by him and prayed for him.

Earlier, the High Court allowed Shivakumar to withdraw his appeal against a single judge’s refusal to quash the previous government’s sanction for the CBI to prosecute him.

The earlier BJP-led administration had granted permission for the CBI to investigate Shivakumar, leading to an FIR and subsequent probe for alleged possession of disproportionate assets. Shivakumar withdrew his appeal after the current Karnataka cabinet, led by Chief Minister Siddaramaiah on November 23, determined that the prior consent given to the CBI was not in accordance with the law and thus decided to withdraw the sanction. The government subsequently issued an official order regarding this decision.

The investigation began after the Income Tax Department’s 2017 search of Shivakumar’s home and offices, which prompted an Enforcement Directorate investigation. Based on findings from the ED, the CBI sought government sanction to file an FIR, which was granted on September 25, 2019. The CBI filed an FIR against Shivakumar on October 3, 2020.

In the interview with the BBC, Wizkid discussed his admiration for the Nigerian film industry, Nollywood, and talked about the unique skill set required to succeed in it. Wizkid, famous for his hit song 'Ojuelegba', mentioned that although he has always focused on music, he would like to explore opportunities in fashion and movies if he ever steps away from his music career. He expressed special appreciation for Nollywood, highlighting its distinctiveness from Hollywood and the exceptional talent needed to thrive as an actor in the industry. Wizkid also indicated that he would love to produce a Nollywood movie someday, though he was uncertain about acting due to doubts regarding his comedic abilities.

On November 5, 2023, Wizkid announced he was taking a break from music to prioritize himself and his loved ones. During this announcement, he joked about possibly playing football or golf, and light-heartedly commented on exploring other interests during his time away from music.

It is advertised on rightmove.co.uk for £13,495 per month. New occupants can benefit from professionally landscaped gardens, a sun terrace off the kitchen, and the astro turf putting green, all while enjoying sweeping views of the surrounding countryside.

article_content: David Cameron appeared in public with Andy Coulson for the first time since Coulson's arrest, attending the Cornbury Music Festival in Oxfordshire—a notable event for the so-called 'Chipping Norton set.' Their encounter at Great Tew was described by witnesses as brief. Cameron and his wife, Samantha, arrived at the festival in the afternoon, dressed casually and mingling among attendees. Former News of the World editor Andy Coulson, who has been charged with alleged perjury in connection with the Tommy Sheridan trial, exchanged a short conversation with Cameron. Rebekah Brooks, also attending the festival and a friend of the Prime Minister, is facing charges of conspiracy to pervert the course of justice alongside her husband, Charlie Brooks. Both have publicly denied wrongdoing. Other notable attendees from the 'Chipping Norton set,' including Jeremy Clarkson, live nearby. The festival, running for nine years, featured headline performances from Jools Holland, Alison Moyet, Marc Almond, and Elvis Costello. Singer Charlotte Church departed Friday’s event early after her three-year-old daughter Ruby became ill. Medical staff advised Church and her partner to take Ruby to the hospital. Coulson has stated that he will vigorously contest any perjury allegations if brought to trial. The Cornbury Festival continues to be a highlight on the local social calendar.

article_content: Annmarie Klein is grateful to have survived the tornado that destroyed her family's home in central Illinois. While most of their lost possessions—including a Jacuzzi, 60-inch TVs, diamond jewelry, a convertible, and other vehicles—can be replaced, one item matters most to her: a mint green box with three cards, which she calls 'the most important thing in my house.' The cards were written by Klein's brother, Paul McLaughlin, who lived in suburban Boston. He battled colon cancer for six years before passing away in 2005 at age 39, and entrusted Klein to deliver the cards, sealed in envelopes, to his children someday, so 'when he was gone, they could still remember their dad.' Since the November 17 tornado in Washington, Illinois, Klein has been searching desperately for the cards, feeling deep anguish over their loss. The Facebook group 'Tazewell County Document & Photograph Recovery,' administered by Bill Benson, was created to help people in the county reunite with lost items. Benson explained that tornadoes can lift objects thousands of feet in the air, sometimes carrying them great distances, and as people work their fields in the spring, lost items may still be found unless buried by topsoil. Klein, still shaken by the disaster, doesn't want to wait until spring to recover the cards. She and her family survived by seeking shelter in a basement safe room as the tornado approached. When they emerged, their home was destroyed—the twister had even thrown a pickup truck into their living room. Two days later, while in a hotel room, Klein remembered the cards, which had been sealed in neon pink and yellow envelopes for each of McLaughlin's three children—Brendan, Cameron, and Erin, now between 10 and 18 years old. Her brother intended for the cards to be given at significant life moments, but Klein hadn't decided when. Paul McLaughlin was deeply involved in charity work for children, especially those with cancer. He worked as a software analyst at Fidelity Investments, coached his children in sports, and, near the end of his life, had a special visit from NHL Hall of Famer Ray Bourque, who played hockey in the street with his kids as their dad watched from a chair. The tornado that hit Washington, Illinois, and surrounding areas killed at least 16 people. The local community, including strangers, came together for the cleanup and to search for lost possessions. While helping with tornado recovery, Illinois Wesleyan University women's golf coach Kathy Niepagen saw Klein searching for the cards and later made a Facebook post asking people from Washington to Chicago to look out for them. The post has been shared more than 25,000 times. Klein has shared with her brother's widow that the cards are missing and has received understanding and forgiveness. A devout Catholic, Klein continues to pray for their return, holding on to hope and faith they will be found.
translated_content: 安玛丽·克莱恩很感激自己能在摧毁了她位于伊利诺伊州中部家园的龙卷风中幸存下来。虽然他们失去的大部分财物——包括按摩浴缸、60寸电视机、钻石首饰、敞篷车和其他车辆——都可以被替代，但对她来说，最重要的却是一个装有三张贺卡的薄荷绿盒子，她称其为“我家中最重要的东西”。 这些贺卡是克莱恩的哥哥保罗·麦克劳克林写给自己孩子们的。保罗曾住在波士顿郊区，与结肠癌抗争了六年后，于2005年去世，享年39岁。他将这些装在信封里的贺卡交托给克莱恩，叮嘱她在将来的某一天转交给他的孩子们，“这样即使他不在了，孩子们也能记得父亲”。 自11月17日龙卷风袭击伊利诺伊州华盛顿市以来，克莱恩一直在拼命寻找这些贺卡，对遗失它们感到非常痛心。 由比尔·本森管理的Facebook小组“Tazewell县文件和照片回收”成立，旨在帮助该县居民找回丢失物品。本森解释说，龙卷风可以把东西卷到数千英尺高，有时能带到很远的地方。等到来年春耕时，失物或许还会被找到，只要没有被埋在土壤深处。 克莱恩仍然因为这场灾难而难以平静，她不想等到春天才找回贺卡。龙卷风到来时，她和家人躲进了地下避难室。当他们出来时，房子已被夷为平地，甚至还有一辆皮卡被卷进了客厅。 两天后，还在酒店房间中的克莱恩猛然想起了这些贺卡。它们分别装在荧光粉和黄色信封里，分别是写给麦克劳克林的三个孩子：布兰登、卡梅伦和埃琳——现在年龄在10到18岁之间。哥哥本来打算在孩子们人生的重要时刻把贺卡交给他们，但克莱恩还没决定合适的时间。 保罗·麦克劳克林积极参与支持癌症儿童的慈善活动。他曾在富达投资担任软件分析师，也指导自己的孩子们运动。临终前，NHL名人堂球星雷·布尔克还曾特地来他们家门口和孩子们一起打球，而麦克劳克林则因病在椅子上为他们守门。 龙卷风袭击了华盛顿及其周边地区，造成至少16人遇难。当地社区及很多陌生人一起参与了善后和寻找失物。伊利诺伊卫斯理大学女子高尔夫教练凯茜·尼帕根在帮助重建时看到克莱恩焦急地找信，随后发了Facebook求助帖，请从华盛顿到芝加哥地区的人帮忙留意这些贺卡。该帖目前已被转发超过2.5万次。 克莱恩已经告诉了弟媳贺卡丢失的事情，也得到了理解和原谅。作为虔诚的天主教徒，克莱恩依然每天祈祷这些贺卡能够被找到，对它们的归还抱有信心。

article_content: Meredith Lewallen, a 26-year-old bride-to-be, marked the lead-up to her wedding with an extraordinary feat. On Thursday, Lewallen rappelled down the side of the 20-story SunTrust building in downtown Chattanooga, Tennessee, to celebrate her upcoming nuptials and to raise funds for charity. Dressed in a white gown, harness, and helmet, she carefully descended the 279-foot building as crowds cheered. Speaking to the Times Free Press, Lewallen described how the enthusiastic support spurred her on: 'As soon as they saw the white dress, I heard a bunch of cheers and woo-hoos and I thought, OK, I’ve got to go, there’s no turning back.' She added that walking down the aisle on Saturday should be easier by comparison—as long as she does not trip. Lewallen participated as part of a fundraising effort for RiverRocks Chattanooga, an annual ten-day festival focused on outdoor activities and benefiting ecological projects and nature reserves. About 70 additional participants were expected to rappel after raising at least $1,000 each. The RiverRocks festival, held in Chattanooga since 2009, attracts around 50,000 people with events including yoga, canoeing, climbing, and cycling. The SunTrust building, which Lewallen rappelled, was built in 1968. Lewallen said she 'was not a bit scared' during the adventure, two days before her wedding.

article_content:
In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) has rapidly transformed the landscape of innovative technology. As this technology continues to evolve, it is likely to create new opportunities and disrupt many industries. For aspiring entrepreneurs, now could be an ideal time to launch AI-driven startups, as early-stage funding and top talent are in strong supply. Here are five industries where AI is poised to be a game-changer:

1. Healthcare: AI-Powered Diagnostics and Treatment
The healthcare sector stands to benefit significantly from AI, especially in areas such as diagnostics and treatment planning. Startups are leveraging machine learning to interpret medical images more accurately and to personalize treatment plans. Healthcare's vast data resources make it ideal for AI applications. For example, PathAI has developed a platform that assists pathologists in diagnosing diseases swiftly and with precision, reducing misdiagnoses and streamlining patient care—crucial in time-sensitive cases.

2. Finance: Fintech Revolution
AI is revolutionizing finance by enabling real-time data analysis and complex pattern detection. Startups use AI for algorithmic trading, customer service, and risk assessment. With the sector's enormous data volume, AI-powered solutions promise better risk management and superior customer experiences. Robinhood exemplifies this approach by offering tailored investment recommendations through AI, making investing more accessible and personalized.

3. Education: Personalized Learning
AI is reshaping education with adaptive learning platforms, intelligent tutoring, and student support chatbots. Edtech startups develop systems that adjust to individual learning speeds and styles, improving learning outcomes for all ages. Duolingo, for instance, uses AI to create personalized language lessons, adapting content to each user’s progress, which enhances language acquisition.

4. Energy: Predictive Maintenance and Optimization
The energy industry is integrating AI for predictive equipment maintenance and resource management. Startups develop algorithms to anticipate equipment failures, optimize resource use, and lower energy consumption. These innovations support sustainability and yield substantial cost savings. Uptake, for example, provides an AI-based platform for monitoring and maintaining equipment by analyzing real-time data, helping companies prevent breakdowns and streamline maintenance schedules.

5. Agriculture: Precision Farming
AI is transforming agriculture through precision farming, with startups building systems to monitor and manage crops more efficiently. These technologies help farmers optimize planting, irrigation, and harvesting processes, thereby maximizing yields and reducing waste. Blue River Technology, now part of John Deere, offers the "See & Spray" solution, which uses AI to target and treat individual plants, minimizing herbicide use and improving crop output.

In summary, AI presents exciting opportunities for innovation across various industries, making this a promising time for new startups to emerge.

1. 医疗健康：AI赋能的诊断与治疗
医疗行业在AI的助力下将实现重大进步，尤其是在诊断和治疗方案制定等领域。初创公司利用机器学习提升医学影像解读的准确性，并为患者制定个性化治疗计划。医疗领域拥有庞大的数据资源，非常适合应用AI。例如，PathAI开发的平台能够帮助病理学家更快、更准确地诊断疾病，减少误诊并优化医疗流程，在紧急情况下尤为关键。

3. 教育：个性化学习
AI正通过自适应学习平台、智能辅导和学生支持聊天机器人重塑教育。教育科技初创公司研发的系统能够根据学生的学习节奏和风格调整内容，提高各年龄段学习者的学习效果。例如，Duolingo 利用AI为用户定制语言课程和测试，随着学习进度的推进智能调整内容，助力高效学习。

能源行业正整合AI进行设备预测性维护和资源管理。初创公司开发的算法能预测设备故障、优化资源分配、降低能耗，这些创新提升了可持续性并带来成本节省。如 Uptake 所提供的AI平台，通过分析实时数据帮助企业监控与维护设备，有效预防故障、优化维护计划。

5. 农业：精准农业
AI正通过精准农业技术推动农业转型。初创公司研发的系统高效监控、管理农作物，帮助农民优化种植、灌溉和收割流程，从而提升产量并减少浪费。以 Blue River Technology（现属John Deere）推出的“See & Spray”为例，通过AI精准识别并处理单株作物，减少除草剂使用，提高收成。

总之，AI为各行业带来创新与发展新机遇，是创业公司崭露头角的绝佳时机。

article_content: Spanish tennis star David Ferrer recently praised his new Samsung Galaxy S4 to his 370,000 Twitter followers. Ironically, the tweet was sent from his iPhone. Ferrer is currently playing in the Mutua Madrid Open, which is sponsored by Samsung. Ferrer’s tweet, originally in Spanish, said: 'I'm so happy with my new #GalaxyS4, setting up S Health on my new #GalaxyS4 to help me with training.' He also tagged @SamsungMobile. However, the message was labeled as sent via 'Twitter for iPhone.' Ferrer is not alone in this type of brand ambassador slip-up. BlackBerry ambassador Alicia Keys announced she had 'broken up' with her iPhone at the BlackBerry 10 launch, yet accidentally tweeted from her iPhone shortly afterward. Similarly, Taiwanese singer Peter Ho criticized Apple in response to a tweet from Chinese telecom company CCT, but sent the reply from his iPhone. He later claimed his account was hacked after his phone was stolen. Ferrer deleted the tweet, but not before followers captured screenshots and responded with sarcasm. One user dubbed his phone the 'iPhoneGalaxy 4.'

article_content: Michael Palin's newest collection of diary entries invites readers to see beyond his familiar public image. Though diaries often reveal hidden aspects, Palin's private musings largely mirror the cheerful, friendly character seen in his comedy and travel shows. Best known for his Monty Python days and travel series, Palin opens up about his uncertainties, particularly when he started presenting. He confides in his struggle to appear comfortable and genuine on camera, finding it challenging to simply be himself. Loss and reflection stand out in the diaries, especially his grieving after the death of Monty Python colleague Graham Chapman in 1989, and dealing with his mother's passing. Palin describes these moments with sincerity and emotional depth. Achievements like winning BBC Personality of the Year in 1998 feature in his entries, and the diaries highlight his need for recognition. He records compliments from people such as novelist Ben Okri but also addresses critical feedback, revealing a mix of pride and self-questioning. Occasional diary entries show a more biting or self-aware humor, particularly in his private takes on others. Palin’s strong attachment to the Monty Python group is evident, as is his frustration at their lack of official honors. The entries cover both remarkable moments—like pitching unconventional television ideas—and the routine, such as learning to use new technology. This results in a combination of meaningful reflections and ordinary updates, presenting a varied portrait. Ultimately, Palin's diaries capture the kindness and wit he's known for, while hinting at more nuanced layers beneath the amiable exterior.

article_content: Kari Ianuale, a resident of Nazareth, Pennsylvania, decided to change her life after realizing her size 24 pants no longer fit. Unwilling to buy a larger size, she began her weight loss journey in July 2011. Over just three years, Ianuale lost a remarkable 145 pounds, transforming both her appearance and self-esteem. At her heaviest, Ianuale weighed 301 pounds and, at 5'10", had a body mass index of 43, classifying her as extremely obese. Today, she maintains a healthy weight of 156 pounds. Ianuale openly shared feelings of embarrassment about her appearance and discomfort in social situations before beginning her transformation, despite the support of her husband, Nino. To achieve her weight loss, Ianuale employed several strategies: 1. Portion Control: She reduced her meal sizes, focusing on normal consumption and reading labels without counting calories. 2. Gradual Exercise: Ianuale started with 20–30 minute workouts at home on an exercise bike and elliptical, six days per week. As her progress slowed, she joined a gym for strength training and continued increasing her activity level. 3. Consistency: Now, she exercises six days a week, running 3–4 miles nightly and engaging in 30–40 minutes of weight training. Her routine alternates between upper and lower body workouts. 4. Daily Juicing: Ianuale drinks 16 ounces of fresh juice daily, making blends with ingredients like blueberries, lemons, kale, spinach, pineapple, flax seeds, broccoli, and carrots. 5. Dietary Variety: She added more fruits, vegetables, and protein to her meals, eliminated processed foods, and avoids greasy and junk food. 6. Cheat Day: Each Friday is a 'cheat day,' where she allows herself some indulgence—such as a latte or dinner out—while still choosing healthier options. Her husband, Nino, was inspired to join her at the gym and has lost 30 pounds himself. Ianuale credits her success to consistency and lifestyle changes, emphasizing that this is not simply a diet, but a permanent, healthier way of living.

article_content: Do you know what #tbt means, or what #OITNB stands for? If not, Twitter is aiming to provide some clarity with a new feature currently spotted on its iOS app. First identified by the Wall Street Journal, this tool helps users understand popular hashtags by revealing their full meanings automatically. According to screenshots from the Wall Street Journal, certain hashtags now display their expanded terms beneath them. For instance, #OITNB shows ‘Orange Is The New Black’ in reference to the Netflix series. Abbreviated terms, like #manutd for Manchester United, are also labeled for clarity. New York Magazine recently outlined seven types of hashtag users. The most common misuse, known as Hashtag Stuffers, involves people who fill their posts with multiple hashtags or insert them randomly within text. Other types include Verbal Hashtagger (who say 'hashtag' in speech), Hashtag Stringers (who merge multiple words into one long hashtag), Gratuitous Event Hashtaggers (who overuse event hashtags), Hash Swaggers (who use event hashtags to boast), Hack-taggers (who hijack hashtags to protest), and Crutch Hashtaggers (who use hashtags constantly for wit or clarification). Screenshots indicate that, especially for acronyms, Twitter now shows the full term directly below certain hashtags, including #tbt for 'Throwback Thursday'—a day when users post nostalgic photos or memories. While hashtags are found across social media, they are most closely associated with Twitter, which has faced criticism for confusing hashtag usage. Twitter offers a support page explaining hashtags and their use. However, not all hashtags are explained. Some, such as #MH17—relating to the Malaysian Airlines crash in Ukraine—still appear without clarification. Hashtags help categorize tweets and improve visibility in Twitter Search. By clicking a hashtag, users see all tweets containing that tag, which is helpful for tracking topics or breaking news. Hashtags can appear anywhere in a tweet, and those that gain popularity often become Trending Topics. It remains unclear if this decoding feature will expand to Android or desktop platforms. Twitter and similar sites routinely test features that may not ultimately be released. For example, in March, alternative labels like 'Share with followers' and 'First add comment' replaced familiar retweet and quote tweet buttons for some users, but these changes have not rolled out universally.

It is a notable day for the World Wide Web, as the popular YouTube video known for sparking the 'Rickroll' meme has been removed. The video, titled 'RickRoll'd,' had tricked countless viewers into watching Rick Astley’s music video for his 1987 hit 'Never Gonna Give You Up.' The reason for its removal from YouTube remains unclear.

Rickrolling is an online prank where someone sends a link disguised as something relevant, which actually leads to Astley’s 'Never Gonna Give You Up.' The phenomenon became an iconic part of Internet culture, accumulating nearly 71 million views on YouTube and being referenced by celebrities and politicians alike.

In 2009, then-Speaker of the House Nancy Pelosi posted a video on Congress’s YouTube page titled 'Speaker Pelosi Presents Capitol Cat Cam.' While the video seemed to offer a behind-the-scenes look at Pelosi's office, viewers were surprised halfway through by a classic Rickroll.

The meme reached new levels in 2008, when Astley himself made a surprise live appearance at the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade. During a performance featuring characters from 'Foster’s Home for Imaginary Friends' singing 'Best Friend,' Astley emerged to lip-sync 'Never Gonna Give You Up,' rickrolling both the live audience and viewers at home.

According to Billboard.com, it is unlikely that Astley was behind the video's removal, as he did not write the original song and likely had no control over the content.

A new bipartisan Congressional report warns that the United States is not adequately prepared to confront Russia and China as emerging nuclear equals, given both countries' expansion of their arsenals. Calling attention to increasing security risks, the report urges a comprehensive overhaul of the U.S. nuclear arsenal and a revamp of defense strategy. 'This is an existential challenge for which the U.S. is not prepared unless immediate action is taken,' the report notes.

Senator Roger Wicker, ranking Republican on the Senate Armed Services Committee, reinforced the report’s message, emphasizing that additional measures are needed to ensure the U.S. can deter two potential nuclear adversaries simultaneously. The 145-page report, compiled over a year by bipartisan nuclear experts for the Congressional Commission on the Strategic Posture of the United States, outlines the growing challenges.

Republicans are likely to use these findings to criticize President Joe Biden’s national security policies. An unnamed Republican aide told TIME that the Administration's approach has not matched the increasing global risks.

According to the report, if China maintains its current pace, its deployed nuclear warheads could match those of the U.S. by the mid-2030s. The Federation of American Scientists estimates the U.S. holds about 3,708 nuclear warheads, Russia over 4,000, and China around 410.

Though the report emphasizes the risk of a coordinated threat from both Russia and China, analysts like Ankit Panda from the Carnegie Endowment caution that evidence of close crisis collaboration between Moscow and Beijing is limited, and warn that following the report’s recommendations might lead to a new nuclear arms race.

For its part, the Biden Administration asserts that America does not need to outnumber its adversaries’ nuclear weapons, with National Security Adviser Jake Sullivan highlighting the effectiveness of U.S. non-nuclear options. Experts such as Lynn Rusten of the Nuclear Threat Initiative concur, suggesting that the current trillion-dollar modernization plan is adequate, and advocating for sensible deterrence and diplomatic initiatives instead of further buildup.

Securing consistent funding for modernization remains an obstacle. Rose Gottemoeller, former NATO Deputy Secretary General and report commissioner, underscored the need for Congress to maintain focus on financial appropriations.

The report calls not only for accelerating modernization but also for increased production of B-21 stealth bombers and ICBMs, and a significant upgrade of outdated nuclear infrastructure. It concludes that investing in deterrence is costly but less so than the consequences of a major war.

article_content: By Emma Glanfield. Amateur surfers have been described as a safety risk, with some locals blaming them for discouraging families from visiting Polzeath beach in Cornwall, which is popular with public figures like Prince Harry and David Cameron. Novice surfers visiting Polzeath are being criticized for not understanding or following essential surf etiquette. This criticism comes after Steve Pratt, a father of two, sustained a serious head injury when he was struck by a runaway surfboard belonging to a holidaymaker learning to surf. Steve Pratt, 48, owns a café at the beach. He suffered a six-inch wound on his head during the accident and required hospital treatment. Residents are urging first-time surfers to learn safe surfing practices before entering the water. Pratt expressed his frustration, noting, 'There’s a saying that if you don’t surf in January, don’t try to surf in July. This individual seemed to lose control and their board flew straight at me. Because he was only a few feet away, I had no chance to move and the board struck me on the head. The pain was intense, and I could tell right away I was bleeding.' Pratt believes the offending surfer was a vacationer rather than a local, and was disappointed that this person did not check on his wellbeing after the collision. Polzeath attracts thousands of tourists each year for its beaches and surf conditions, and is well-known as a holiday spot for politicians and royals, including former Prime Minister David Cameron and Princes Harry and William. Pratt and other locals argue that visitors should undergo basic safety training or learn proper surf etiquette—sometimes likened to a 'Highway Code' for surfing—to prevent such incidents. Pratt said, 'It's really important that people get some basic training instead of just grabbing a board and heading straight into the sea.' Andy Cameron, who runs a local surf school, echoed these concerns: 'It’s crucial to learn the correct surfing etiquette. Surfing is fun, but injuries are not. Having equipment that matches your skill level and learning from experienced surfers—even friends—matters. Just rushing into the ocean without preparation can be dangerous.' The RNLI, which staffs many Cornish beaches with lifeguards, supports this advice and encourages beginners to seek proper training. According to the RNLI website, new surfers should understand surf etiquette to keep themselves and others safe, and should consult lifeguards if they have questions.

article_content: After noticing his sister Natalie hadn't been in a relationship for some time, Adam Clarke, 26, took a playful approach to help her find love. Adam, who works alongside his older sister running Cardiff-based media company Suave Productions, recorded a video promoting Natalie as a great date and posted it on Facebook, Gumtree, and Free Ads—all without her knowledge. In the home-made video, shot in his car, Adam light-heartedly introduces Natalie, joking about her being single. He encourages viewers interested in meeting her to add her on Facebook. Although Natalie was initially shocked and annoyed by her brother's surprise campaign, she soon found the humor in it and began enjoying the attention. The video and accompanying advertisements attracted swift interest: within 24 hours, Natalie's laptop was flooded with around 70 messages from potential suitors, and the video racked up over 8,000 views. Natalie says she's narrowed down her choices to five to eight people and may even go on a date this week. Adam was inspired to create the advert after finding a girlfriend himself and hoping Natalie would also find someone special. When asked about her preferences, Natalie admits she values good looks and a sense of humor in potential partners.

article_content: The Niger State Government has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Nigerian National Petroleum Corporation Limited (NNPCL) to advance renewable energy initiatives. The agreement seeks to implement low-carbon projects, including Greenfield Hydroelectric Power, solar parks at educational institutions, home solar systems for 250,000 households, and a 500 million-litre ethanol plant. Bologi Ibrahim, Chief Press Secretary to Governor Mohammed Bago, announced the MoU on Wednesday. The partnership concentrates on industrialization, agriculture, solar deployment, and renewable energy. According to Ibrahim, maize, sugarcane, and sweet sorghum will be cultivated on 100,000 hectares in the state, expected to yield over 500,000 tons of crops annually for the ethanol plant. Governor Bago and Secretary to the State Government Abubakar Usman signed the agreement for Niger State. NNPCL was represented by Olalekan Ogunleye, Executive Vice President for Gas, Power and New Energy, and Kanayochukwu Odoe, Managing Director of New Energy Limited. The signing took place at NNPCL's Abuja headquarters. Governor Bago described the MoU signing as historic and said Niger State residents stand to benefit significantly. He underscored clean energy as a key objective, highlighting the state’s efforts to use its water resources to further green energy development. Olalekan Ogunleye affirmed NNPCL’s dedication to expanding clean energy opportunities across Africa and promoting national prosperity through new energy solutions. He praised Niger State’s leadership, noting optimism that the MoU would foster collaboration on creating a green-energy economy. Kanayochukwu Odoe called the partnership progressive, reiterating NNPCL’s ambition for Nigeria to become a leading green energy and green economy hub.

article_content: Esther Rantzen has expressed concern that the child abuse allegations involving Jimmy Savile could jeopardize her life's work campaigning for children's protection. There have been rumors that Ms Rantzen might be dismissed as patron of the National Association for People Abused in Childhood (NAPAC) due to claims she failed to act on reports that Savile abused children. Ms Rantzen, however, has denied these rumors. She previously stated that some individuals in broadcasting ignored the claims against Savile, who starred in 'Jim'll Fix It,' about 18 years ago. In an interview with the Daily Express, Ms Rantzen said, 'Say what you like about me – just please don’t destroy my life’s work.' Ms Rantzen founded ChildLine in 1986, a 24-hour confidential helpline that receives more than a million calls a year, providing free counseling for children to discuss abuse and neglect. For over 25 years, she has worked to raise awareness of bullying and sexual or psychological abuse of children. At 72, Ms Rantzen also serves as a trustee of the NSPCC. She recalled feeling that Savile was 'creepy' and 'very odd' and said she met him around six times at charity events. She insisted she only heard one rumor about Savile abusing children while working as a BBC researcher at age 21. Ms Rantzen emphasized her motivation to continue campaigning for justice for both children and older people. She stated, 'It would be such a great shame if all that work was sabotaged by this. My concern is for the children who are suffering and other survivors who need support.' In a conversation with MailOnline, Ms Rantzen said she would be 'very, very distressed' if she lost the confidence of those working with children, but that all her colleagues continue to support her wholeheartedly. She reflected on the lessons from the scandal, quoting a therapist on Radio 4 who said 'Jimmy Savile groomed the whole nation.' She noted that Savile convinced people he was a dedicated charity worker and harmless entertainer, concealing his predatory and dangerous behavior. Ms Rantzen stressed the importance of creating processes for whistle-blowing to ensure abuse is reported. The interview comes after a sex abuse campaigner claimed to have confided in Ms Rantzen about Savile, but said no action was taken. Multiple alleged victims have come forward accusing Savile of abuse. Shy Keenan, founder of Phoenix Survivors, said she felt it was her duty to inform Ms Rantzen, after being introduced by probation officer Ray Wyre. Ms Rantzen responded that she had 'absolutely no recollection' of meeting Ms Keenan or the conversation regarding Savile, adding that she has had hundreds of conversations on this subject. She conceded she has met thousands of people in her television career. Recently, Ms Rantzen said Savile's actions have caused 'national rage and fury,' and described it as a 'tragedy' if the scandal damaged ChildLine's work. Scotland Yard reported that the investigation into Savile's abuse has expanded dramatically, with 340 separate lines of inquiry, around 60 potential victims, and 15 police forces involved. Prime Minister David Cameron is facing calls from Labour leader Ed Miliband for an independent inquiry into the scandal, covering Savile's activities at the BBC, Stoke Mandeville Hospital, and Broadmoor. Culture Secretary Maria Miller believes the BBC is taking the claims seriously and has dismissed calls for an independent inquiry, but Mr Miliband argues that internal investigations are insufficient.

article_content: A double shooting in the early hours has left two people dead in a home in Walsall, West Midlands. The victims have been named locally as Clare Sly, 38, a teaching assistant, and her partner Decker Vassall, 43. Authorities discovered their bodies at 1:37am at a house on Laneside Gardens following reports of loud arguments. Paramedics attempted to revive both individuals, but they died at the scene. Police quickly arrested a 23-year-old man—believed to be Ms. Sly’s son Anthony Vassell—and his 22-year-old girlfriend nearby. The pair reportedly lived just 15 meters from Ms. Sly's house with Anthony's grandmother, Eileen Sly, 69. So far, the motive for the shooting remains unclear. Ms. Sly was said to have two other sons, around 10 years old. The quiet close-knit community in Birchills expressed deep shock and sorrow over the incident. Neighbors recalled Ms. Sly as a kind-hearted, hardworking woman, while many found it hard to believe her son could be involved. Both police and forensic teams have been combing over two terraced houses on the cul-de-sac for evidence. Residents described hearing screams and gunshots in the early hours. Many shared fond memories of Ms. Sly and her family, reinforcing the sense of disbelief and loss. West Midlands Police responded promptly, cordoning off the area and launching a formal investigation. Detective Inspector Michaela Kerr confirmed both victims sustained gunshot injuries and that the two suspects remain in custody. The investigation is continuing as police work to establish the circumstances around the deaths.

article_content: Global temperatures have reached unprecedented highs, with September 2023 recording a global-average temperature anomaly of 1.7°C above pre-industrial levels—0.5°C warmer than the previous record. Several factors contribute to this extreme warmth, but human-driven climate change remains the dominant reason. Here are six key contributors: 1. El Niño: A significant El Niño event is underway and still intensifying. El Niño causes warming of the tropical Pacific Ocean's surface, raising global average temperatures by about 0.1 to 0.2°C. This follows a recent triple La Niña period, which slightly cooled the planet, making the current temperature spike less surprising. However, El Niño alone doesn't account for the extraordinary heat being observed. 2. Reduced Air Pollution: Air pollution from human activities has previously cooled the Earth, offsetting some greenhouse gas warming. Since 2020, an international agreement has reduced sulfur dioxide emissions from global shipping, making the air cleaner. This may have marginally increased temperatures, particularly in the North Atlantic and Pacific, but estimates suggest the 2020 shipping regulations have contributed only around 0.05°C of warming by 2050. 3. Increasing Solar Activity: The Sun's energy output varies across solar cycles, with the most relevant cycle lasting 11 years. Since a minimum in late 2019, solar activity has been rising, adding a very minor contribution—hundredths of a degree—to global warming. 4. Hunga Tonga Volcano Eruption: On January 15, 2022, the underwater Hunga Tonga–Hunga Haʻapai volcano erupted, sending significant amounts of water vapor—a greenhouse gas—high into the atmosphere. This has intensified the greenhouse effect slightly, but, like the other minor contributors, only by hundredths of a degree. 5. Weather Variability: Global temperatures can fluctuate year-to-year due to natural variability. In September 2023, persistent high-pressure systems over regions such as western Europe and Australia led to substantial local heating. While oceans respond more slowly to these changes, the combination of heated land and persistent ocean warmth further increased the global average temperature. 6. Climate Change: The largest contributor to the record +1.7°C anomaly is human-caused climate change, primarily from greenhouse gas emissions, which have raised average global temperatures by about 1.2°C. Emission rates remain at record highs, making further warming likely. While other factors play a role, the steep jump in temperatures this year compared to last is mainly due to the transition from La Niña to El Niño and the alignment of specific weather systems. Implications for Climate Targets: Single-month anomalies above 1.5°C do not mean the Paris Agreement target has already been surpassed, as the goal refers to long-term temperature averages. Nevertheless, the increasing frequency and severity of such events highlights the need for urgent climate action. The world’s most vulnerable communities face the greatest risks, while wealthier nations continue to emit the largest share of greenhouse gases. Accelerated action toward net zero is essential to prevent more record-breaking global temperatures and damaging extreme events.
translated_content: 全球气温已达到前所未有的高点，2023年9月的全球平均温度比工业化前水平高出1.7°C，比之前纪录高0.5°C。 造成极端高温的因素有多种，但人为引发的气候变化仍然是最主要原因。以下是六个关键因素： 1. 厄尔尼诺现象：目前正经历一次显著且持续增强的厄尔尼诺事件。厄尔尼诺导致热带太平洋表层升温，全球平均温度上升约0.1至0.2°C。此前经历了三年的拉尼娜冷却周期，使地球略为降温，因此此次温度激增并不意外。然而，仅凭厄尔尼诺无法解释我们目前观测到的极端高温。 2. 空气污染减少：人类活动造成的空气污染过去让地球降温，抵消了部分温室气体带来的升温。自2020年以来，国际协议要求全球航运业减少二氧化硫排放，使空气变得更干净。这在北大西洋和太平洋等航运繁忙的地区可能略微升高了温度，但2020年航运新规预计到2050年仅带来约0.05°C的升温。 3. 太阳活动增强：太阳能量输出随11年周期波动。自2019年底太阳活动极小期以来，太阳活动逐步增强，对全球变暖的贡献极小，仅为百分之一度。 4. 洪加汤加火山喷发：2022年1月15日，南太平洋洪加汤加-洪加哈阿帕伊水下火山喷发，释放大量水汽（水汽是温室气体）到高层大气，轻微加强了温室效应，但贡献与其他次要因素相似，仅为百分之一度。 5. 天气变率：即便没有厄尔尼诺或污染变化，全球温度每年也可能因自然变率起伏。2023年9月，西欧、澳大利亚等地因持续高压系统局部升温显著。海洋对温度变化反应较慢，因此陆地高温与持续的海洋热量叠加，进一步推高了全球平均温度。 6. 气候变化：人类引发的气候变化是1.7°C纪录性温差的最大推手。由于温室气体排放，全球均温已上升约1.2°C。排放量创新高，导致进一步升温几乎不可避免。 尽管其他因素有所影响，今年较去年气温大幅上升主要因拉尼娜转为厄尔尼诺及特定天气系统的叠加。 对气候目标的影响：单月温度高于1.5°C并不代表已超过《巴黎协定》目标，因其关注长期均值。然而此类极端事件频率和强度的上升，显示亟需气候行动。 全球最脆弱群体面临最大风险，而富裕国家仍为主要温室气体排放者。只有加速实现净零目标，才能阻止更多极端高温和灾害事件。

article_content: At first glance, Tim’s Place in Albuquerque, New Mexico, may look like many other local diners, but it stands out as something special. Known as 'the world’s friendliest restaurant,' it is the only restaurant in the U.S. owned by a person with Down syndrome. Tim Harris, 26, opened the restaurant in 2010 with support from his parents. Since then, its success has been driven by Tim’s ideas and enthusiasm, making it a favorite spot for locals. One of the restaurant’s unique features is its most popular menu item—free hugs from Tim. According to the menu, a 'Tim Hug' is a calorie-free and guilt-free treat that is guaranteed to 'improve your lease on life.' Tim told Albuquerque The Magazine, 'I love giving all the customers a hug because I want them to feel comfortable and connected, and to feel like they’re around friends.' Tim keeps track of his hugs with a counter on the wall, and has given out more than 30,000 hugs so far. Tim is also a college graduate, an accomplished Special Olympian, skilled sailor, and experienced offshore fisherman. From a young age, Tim has excelled, challenging expectations. In high school, he was elected homecoming king and Student of the Year. He worked as a host at Red Robin in Albuquerque, where he learned to greet guests and built up a loyal following. Tim’s parents, Keith and Jeannie, have encouraged him—and their other three sons—to set high expectations for themselves. Keith Harris, a small business owner, provided the initial investment for Tim’s Place. Other staff handle management and cooking, while Tim leads the front of the house and shapes its warm, family-friendly atmosphere. Open seven days a week for breakfast, lunch, and—of course—hugs, business at Tim’s Place is thriving, and Tim has plans to expand. He is proud to serve as a role model for others with disabilities. His mother shared with KRQE News 13 that families often visit or write to say that Tim’s story gives them hope for their own children with disabilities. Tim encourages others: 'I tell people with disabilities that they can follow their dreams.'

article_content: Identical twins Roger and Andrew Corke have contributed to addressing Britain's kidney donor shortage through a unique transplant arrangement. In an unprecedented case, both brothers volunteered to donate a kidney to a stranger, knowing that if either of them needed a replacement kidney in the future, the other could serve as a compatible donor due to their identical genetic makeup. Roger, 58, explained, 'I only volunteered because I knew I had an identical twin as a backup.' He was selected as the donor because he lived closer to the London teaching hospital where the operation took place ten days ago. The Corkes, both age 58, felt secure in offering their kidneys to strangers knowing they could rely on each other if future need arises. Roger observed that living with one kidney poses minimal risk, and Andrew agreed to be his donor if necessary. Conversely, should Andrew need a kidney, Roger could return the favor. Currently, 7,180 patients in Britain are waiting for an organ transplant, with nearly 6,000 needing a new kidney, according to NHS Blood and Transplant. Of last year's 1,220 kidney transplants, 387 were from living donors, with a rising number being 'altruistic' donations where the donor does not know the recipient. Since the first altruistic kidney donation in 2007, there have been 73 such donations so far this year. Roger was inspired to donate after learning about people on dialysis, while Andrew, a vicar from Dorset, was moved by a friend's need for two liver transplants. Although friends and family were initially worried about the risks, Roger's wife Lynn, a retired solicitor, was particularly concerned about his decision to undergo major surgery. Roger remained unconcerned, stating, 'Now I know how safe kidney donation is, I'd give one even if I weren't a twin.' He added that people function well on a single kidney and that only very healthy individuals are eligible to donate. Roger estimated the risk of dying during surgery as 1 in 3,000, which he compared to higher general health risks like cancer or heart attack. After undergoing ten hospital visits and numerous tests, including psychological assessment, Roger was approved as a donor in August. He is now recovering at home following the five-hour procedure. Andrew expressed no worry about the risks and said, 'I'm the insurance policy and I'm not worried about me. As a Christian, I feel cared for. We're supposed to put others before ourselves. We hope our actions encourage others.' Transplants between twins have a high success rate, with 28 UK cases of a twin donating directly to their sibling. However, this is the first known instance of twins donating to strangers. Medical professionals are interested in recruiting more identical twins to help ease transplant waiting lists. With 250,000 pairs of identical twins in Britain, the potential for impact is significant. Tim Spector, professor of genetic epidemiology at St Thomas’ Hospital in London and head of the Twins Research Centre, remarked, 'Targeting twins could significantly boost organ donations. Many twins could be ready-made organ donors for each other. We'll reach out to those on our register in hopes of recruiting more nationwide.' Currently, three people die each day in the UK while waiting for an organ transplant. Patients can wait up to four years or more for a compatible donor, especially those with rare blood types. Roger will be off work until the new year and will receive compensation for lost earnings from the NHS. Though not permitted to know the specifics about the recipient, the twins learned that the transplanted kidney has started working. Roger hopes one day to meet the recipient but respects their privacy. 'We'd love to meet the person, but it's their choice—that's the rule. I let the hospital know I'm interested in updates. I hope this is a success, but even if not, I know I tried to help.'
translated_content: 英国同卵双胞胎罗杰和安德鲁·科克通过独特的移植安排，为解决该国肾脏捐献者短缺问题贡献力量。这是前所未有的案例，两兄弟都自愿向陌生人捐肾。如果将来其中一人需要肾脏，另一位由于基因相同可作为兼容捐赠者。 58岁的罗杰解释：“我之所以自愿捐献，是因为有双胞胎哥哥做‘备胎’。”他被选为捐赠者，是因为他更靠近进行手术的伦敦教学医院，手术十天前完成。 两兄弟都58岁，他们因有彼此做后盾，安心将肾脏捐给陌生人。罗杰说，只有一个肾也能正常生活，安德鲁也同意如有需要为他捐肾，反之亦然。 英国国家健康服务体系（NHS）血液与移植机构数据显示，英国目前有7,180名患者在等器官移植，近6,000人需肾脏。去年肾移植共1,220例，活体捐赠者贡献387例，并且“无偿捐献”（捐者与受者互不相识）逐步增长。自2007年首次无偿肾脏捐献起，今年已有73例。 罗杰在了解到透析患者困境后受到启发决定捐献，而安德鲁（多塞特郡牧师）则是因朋友经历两次肝移植而感动。尽管亲友最初对风险感到担心，罗杰妻子——退休律师林恩尤其忧虑他选择接受大手术，但他本人表示无忧：“现在我知道捐肾很安全，即便不是双胞胎我也会捐。” 他补充说，人们一个肾也能健康生活，且只有非常健康的人才能成为捐献者。罗杰表示，手术死亡风险为三千分之一，这比未来12个月内因癌症或心脏病死亡的概率还低。 罗杰接受十次就诊及多项检测（包括心理评估）后，8月获批准成为捐赠者。手术持续5小时，他目前在家康复。安德鲁同样不担心风险，并说：“我是‘保险单’，不担心自己。作为基督徒，我觉得被照护。我们应该为他人着想。希望我们的行为能鼓励他人。” 双胞胎间器官移植成功率高，在英国已有28例兄弟姐妹间捐器官，但首次有双胞胎捐肾给陌生人。医学专家希望招募更多同卵双胞胎缓解移植等候名单。英国有25万对同卵双胞胎，影响潜力巨大。 伦敦圣托马斯医院基因流行病学教授、双胞胎研究中心主任蒂姆·斯佩克特表示：“关注双胞胎有望大幅提升器官捐赠率。许多双胞胎天然就是彼此的捐赠者。我们会通知注册在册的双胞胎，争取在全国招募更多参与者。” 英国目前每天有三人因等不到器官去世。对于罕见血型患者，等待合适捐赠者可能需要四年甚至更久。罗杰会休假到新年，由NHS补偿他的收入损失。 虽不能获知受者信息，兄弟俩已知肾脏已开始运作。罗杰希望未来有机会见到受者，同时尊重隐私：“我们很想见到她/他，但最终选择权在对方手里——这是规定。我已告知医院想了解后续，希望结果是成功的；即便不是，也算做了力所能及的事。”

article_content: With the midterm elections approaching, the political landscape is poised for major changes that could shape Congress and the direction of future legislation. President Barack Obama still has a window to advance his agenda, but as election season ramps up, lawmakers are turning their attention to campaigns — potentially sidelining new policies. For Republicans, gaining additional seats in the House and Senate could give them enough sway to impede Obama’s initiatives, and possibly press moderate Democrats to roll back key achievements such as regulatory reforms and government spending. On the flipside, a strong performance by Democrats would not only boost their numbers but also increase pressure on Republicans for bipartisan cooperation. The results of the midterms will offer a preview of the challenges both parties will face going into the 2016 presidential contest. Campaign developments are poised to reveal what direction the Republicans plan to take, illuminating whether they can energize voters beyond their traditional strongholds. Internal debates within the GOP have intensified, as party veterans warn that current strategies may be self-defeating. Many Republicans silently agreed with former Senate Majority Leader Bob Dole, who suggested that the party should pause and rethink its platform. Since 2010, Republicans have centered their message on deficit reduction and opposing the White House, but recent shifts in the budget situation and skepticism about austerity have diminished the appeal of this approach. The coming midterms give Republicans an opportunity to present fresh ideas and set the tone for their 2016 campaign. Democrats face a similar test: they must begin to define what their party stands for after Obama, debating whether to stick with recent legacies or offer bold new policy proposals. Voters are looking for clear stances on economic investment, climate action, and balancing security with civil liberties. Another factor is the electorate’s mood, particularly among immigrant communities. Immigration remains a hot-button issue, and turnout among these voters could be pivotal. Key figures like Marco Rubio backing reform may help Republicans, while any anti-immigrant backlash could shift momentum the other way. Current scandals in Washington will also play a role. The midterms may reveal whether these controversies will damage Democrats, echoing the Republican fallout after Watergate, or trigger a backlash against the GOP, as occurred in the late 1990s. Additionally, the elections spotlight would-be presidential candidates, from Hillary Clinton to Chris Christie, as they seize the chance to raise their national profiles. Ultimately, the midterm elections will give both parties a stage to overcome internal challenges and define their path forward. Whether the GOP’s shift to the right helps or hinders them in the next presidential race remains to be seen. These reflections belong solely to Julian Zelizer.
translated_content: 随着中期选举临近，美国政治格局可能迎来重大变化，这将影响国会构成及未来立法的方向。虽然总统奥巴马还有时间推动政策，但随着选战升温，议员们逐渐把精力放到竞选上，可能导致新政策被搁置。 对共和党来说，在众议院和参议院赢得更多席位，将有望获得遏制奥巴马施政的力量，并可能促使中间派民主党人削弱如监管改革和政府开支等第一任期的关键成果。反过来，如果民主党表现强劲，不仅能提升席位数量，还能加大对共和党进行两党合作的压力。 中期选举结果也将为两党在2016年总统大选中面临的挑战提前定调。选情发展将揭示共和党未来的方向，看看他们能否吸引更多非传统阵营选民。 目前共和党内部分歧加剧，资深党员警告当前策略或许不利于党未来。许多共和党人私下认同前参院多数党领袖鲍勃·多尔的说法，即党应暂停检视并思考改革。自2010年以来，共和党一直以削减赤字、反对白宫为主轴，但最近预算状况的改善和民众对紧缩政策的质疑，使该策略吸引力下滑。 这场中期选举给共和党一个提出新政策、为2016年造势的机会。民主党同样需要明确后奥巴马时代党的立场，思考是延续传统还是提出有魄力的新纲领。选民关注两党对经济投资、气候变化、保障公民自由与国家安全等议题的态度。 选民情绪，尤其是移民群体，也是影响选举的重要因素。移民议题持续升温，这一群体的投票率可能影响局势。马尔科·鲁比奥等党内人物支持改革，可能有助于共和党，但若出现反移民情绪，也会带来变数。 目前华盛顿的政治丑闻也是选举变量之一。本次中期选举将检验这些争议是否会让民主党受损，类似水门事件后共和党的情况，或是否会引发对共和党的反弹，如上世纪90年代晚期。与此同时，希拉里·克林顿、克里斯·克里斯蒂等潜在总统候选人，也会借此机会提升全国知名度。 总体来看，中期选举为两党提供了克服内部挑战、规划未来路线的舞台。共和党右转究竟对2026年大选是利是弊尚未可知。以上为朱利安·泽利泽的个人观点。

article_content: Arati Kumar-Rao, a photographer and writer, journeys across South Asia year-round to capture how climate change is transforming its diverse landscapes. In Ladakh—a high-altitude region in northern India—her work shines a light on how melting Himalayan glaciers are endangering local communities. As one of BBC’s 2023 Climate Pioneers, Kumar-Rao documents these shifts through both images and storytelling. A devastating event struck Ladakh's capital, Leh, on August 5, 2010: a torrential storm poured a year’s rainfall into two hours, triggering massive mudslides that buried whole neighborhoods. Hundreds of residents went missing, marking a tragedy still remembered today. Once, such disasters were rare in Ladakh’s dry, elevated terrain, where annual rainfall is usually scant. But since 2010, the region has suffered more floods—in 2012, 2015, and 2018—an unprecedented frequency over such a short span. Scientists link these extreme events to climate change. Traditionally, consistent snowmelt and glacial runoff sustained the region, but the average winter temperature in Ladakh has risen about 1°C over four decades. With less reliable snowfall and shrinking glaciers, water is becoming scarce. When Kumar-Rao revisited Ladakh in recent years, she witnessed villages running out of water as snow melted too quickly. Once-vibrant springs were dry, prompting Changpa herders to abandon their pashmina goats and farmers to leave in search of other work. Amid these hardships, Ladakhis have turned to innovation. In 2013, engineer Sonam Wangchuk got the idea for 'ice stupas' after noticing persistent ice beneath a bridge, sheltered from sunlight. He and his team developed tall, cone-shaped ice formations by spraying water into the freezing night air, saving winter water to release during the dry months. Now, these ice stupas—so named for their resemblance to Buddhist chortens—provide precious spring water and stir friendly rivalry over whose stupa stands tallest. Still, Wangchuk stresses that while such solutions help, the people of Ladakh are unfairly suffering from climate change caused largely by others. He hopes their efforts will inspire global action on climate justice. Kumar-Rao’s observations highlight a wider challenge confronting India, China, and Pakistan: all share the looming danger of climate change threatening the region’s major rivers and densely populated areas. The article calls for united efforts to build resilience. This account is produced by Rebecca Thorn for BBC 100 Women, an initiative that annually celebrates influential women from around the globe.
translated_content: 摄影师兼作家Arati Kumar-Rao全年在南亚各地跋涉，记录气候变化如何改变自然景观。在印度北部高原拉达克，她用影像和文字展现了喜马拉雅冰川消融下，当地社区所面临的生存挑战。作为2023年BBC气候先锋之一，Kumar-Rao用镜头和故事还原这些转变。 2010年8月5日，拉达克首府列城遭遇灾难性风暴，两小时降雨量相当于一整年，突发泥石流吞没了居民区，数百人失踪，这场悲剧至今让人难忘。过去在拉达克高原，这类极端灾害极罕见，年降雨量本稀少。 但自2010年以来，拉达克相继经历了2012、2015和2018年洪灾——如此频繁极端天气前所未有。科学家认为与气候变化密切相关。过去，稳定的积雪融水和冰川径流带来水源，但40年来，拉达克冬季均温已升高约1°C。现在，降雪变得不可预测，冰川不断退缩，水源更加紧张。 Kumar-Rao近年重返拉达克时发现，积雪更快融化，村民春天就无水可用。从前绿意盎然的春天变得干旱，牧民不得不放弃养殖羊绒山羊，许多农民也离开家园谋生。 面对困境，拉达克人展开了创新。2013年，工程师Sonam Wangchuk受到桥下阴影处积冰启发，与团队发明出“冰塔”——夜间低温下将水喷洒至空中，结成高大锥形冰柱，储存冬季水源以供干旱时用。 如今，这些形似佛塔的冰塔，为春季提供了可贵水源，也成了村庄间的友好竞赛项目。Wangchuk强调，尽管技术缓解了一些问题，但拉达克人正在承受全球他人碳排放的后果。他希望冰塔能唤醒全球对气候责任的关注。 Kumar-Rao的见闻映射出更广泛现实：印度、中国、巴基斯坦面临共同的气候挑战，重要河流和人口稠密地区都受到威胁。文章呼吁该地区团结合作、增强适应力。 本报道由Rebecca Thorn为BBC 100 Women制作，该项目每年表彰全球杰出女性。
post_content: Climate change is turning Ladakh upside down: from rare floods to vanishing glaciers, life is getting tougher. But locals like Sonam Wangchuk are building ice stupas and hope for tomorrow! 🌍❄️ #ClimateAction #BBC100Women

article_content: Taylor Armstrong, known from 'The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills,' was at the house where her estranged husband Russell Armstrong was found dead, according to news reports. Taylor became concerned when Russell failed to arrive for a scheduled meeting and stopped answering her calls and messages. She went to the Mulholland Drive home with a friend and alerted the homeowner, who discovered Russell's body. Despite her recent accusations of abuse during their marriage, Taylor and Russell had continued communicating regularly. Russell reportedly died by suicide and had been struggling with the pressures of reality television, financial problems, and the stress from their breakup. Rumors of an upcoming tell-all book about his private life had also caused him distress. Tom Vickers, a photographer and friend, described his recent interactions with Russell as troubling, noting Russell seemed down and said reality TV had disrupted his life. Russell was survived by Kennedy, his five-year-old daughter with Taylor, and sons from previous relationships. Authorities did not find a suicide note, drugs, or alcohol at the scene. Russell also had a record of legal issues, including restraining orders filed by previous partners. Taylor is making arrangements after the tragedy and has not yet shared the news with their young daughter. Friends and cast members, including Lisa Vanderpump, have been seen responding to the news.

article_content: Florida State Representative Bob Allen, who also served as co-chair for Senator John McCain’s Florida campaign, was arrested on Wednesday after allegedly offering $20 to an undercover police officer for a sexual act in a Titusville park under surveillance. Allen’s attorney, Philip Lupo, described the solicitation charge as a second-degree misdemeanor. Allen insisted to local media that the incident was a misunderstanding and called it 'a very big mistake.' He said he was in the park he helped develop, simply looking around. At a Thursday press conference, Allen stated he would plead not guilty and has no intention of resigning, vowing to serve out his term. He said the situation was unfairly brought upon him and his family. The McCain campaign has not commented on Allen’s arrest. The incident comes amid recent leadership upheaval within the McCain campaign, with several senior staff— including the campaign manager and chief strategist—stepping down earlier in the week. Other political campaigns have also faced recent scandals. Senator David Vitter of Louisiana, a regional chair for Rudy Giuliani’s presidential campaign, was recently connected to an escort service in Washington, D.C. Vitter publicly acknowledged his past involvement, referred to it as a 'serious sin,' and said he has been forgiven by God and his wife. article_content: Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) have continued their selling streak, withdrawing over Rs 3,400 crore from Indian equity markets in the first three trading sessions of November, citing rising interest rates and geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. This follows major outflows of Rs 24,548 crore in October and Rs 14,767 crore in September, data from depositories show. Previously, from March to August, FPIs had been consistent buyers, investing Rs 1.74 lakh crore in Indian equities. Experts suggest that the primary factor behind FPI sales—the rise in bond yields—may ease after the US Federal Reserve displayed a dovish stance in its November meeting. V K Vijayakumar, Chief Investment Strategist at Geojit Financial Services, remarked that Fed Chair Jerome Powell's comments about stable inflation expectations led markets to interpret an end to the rate-hike cycle. According to depository data, FPIs sold shares worth Rs 3,412 crore from November 1 to 3. FPIs have been net sellers since September, with the trend largely attributed to rising US Treasury yields and the Israel-Hamas conflict, according to Himanshu Srivastava of Morningstar Investment Adviser India. Bharat Dhawan, Managing Partner at Mazars India, pointed out heightened global uncertainty due to recession fears, persistent high inflation, and increased geopolitical risks since early October. Under current conditions, investors are showing preference for safe-haven assets like gold and the US dollar. In contrast to equity outflows, FPIs invested Rs 1,984 crore in Indian debt markets over the same period, following Rs 6,381 crore in October. Srivastava notes this may reflect a tactical, short-term allocation to debt, with plans to return to equities when prospects improve. Sahil Dhingra, founder of Alvez Capital, highlighted that the inclusion of Indian government securities in the JP Morgan Government Bond Index Emerging Markets (GBI-EM) has spurred more foreign interest in the bond market. Cumulatively in 2023, FPIs have invested Rs 92,560 crore in equities and Rs 37,485 crore in debt. Key sectors expected to perform well include banking, automobiles, capital goods, mid-cap IT, and real estate. Additional business updates: India approved Saab (Sweden) for the first 100% FDI project in its defence sector; State Bank of India (SBI) reported an 8% increase in Q2 net profit; Byju's announced growth in core revenue and reduced EBITDA loss for FY22.

article_content: Gift David Okpara, also known as General 2-Baba and the prime suspect in the murder of Divisional Police Officer (DPO) Bako Angbashin of Ahoada East Local Government Area, Rivers State, has spoken out while evading arrest. In a voice note aired on Nigeria Info 92.3 Port Harcourt, Okpara denied any involvement in the killing. He claimed he spoke with the late DPO only hours before the incident took place. Okpara, reported leader of the Iceland cult, alleged that his group returned to militancy after surrendering their weapons during a government amnesty. He claimed rival gangs refused to disarm and attacked his members, including his younger brother, and that authorities did not intervene. He added, 'That was why I returned to armed activity.' He described himself as a freedom fighter for Ekpeye youths and denied involvement in kidnapping, illegal oil bunkering, or related crimes, asserting that he is involved only in a dredging business and not sponsored by any traditional ruler. These claims have not been independently verified. After the September 8, 2023, murder of DPO Angbashin in Odiemude community, Okpara was declared wanted by the Rivers State Police Command. More than 50 individuals, including a monarch and a former local government chairman, are currently on trial in connection with the officer's death. Multiple police raids in Ahoada have resulted in arrests and the deaths of some suspects, but Okpara, the main target, remains at large. Attempts to recover DPO Angbashin's decapitated body have so far been unsuccessful.

article_content: A health care assistant and her partner have been jailed for defrauding an elderly recluse out of three quarters of a million pounds. Celia Brinkley, 45, was sentenced to seven years in prison after stealing hundreds of thousands of pounds from 80-year-old Anthony Hornett while serving as his home carer. Brinkley’s partner, Kerry Davies, 40, a qualified nurse, received a 27-month prison sentence after admitting her role in taking more than £80,000 from Mr. Hornett. St Albans Crown Court heard that the pair spent the pensioner's money on new cars, expensive trips, and designer handbags. When colleagues at St Albans City Hospital questioned their luxurious lifestyle, they falsely claimed to have won £250,000 on the lottery. Judge Andrew Bright QC described the case as a profound breach of trust inflicted on an elderly, vulnerable man. Prosecutor Laura Blackband told the court that Brinkley and Davies met Mr. Hornett in 2009, when he was living alone, having never married and with no children or visiting relatives. In August 2010, both women left their full-time jobs after Mr. Hornett agreed to pay them £2,000 each per month to serve as his carers. Brinkley visited him twice daily, while Davies visited weekly. Mr. Hornett, who owned several properties in St Albans, also rented them a house at Central Drive at a discounted rate of £500 per month—half the market value. After moving in, the pair began siphoning money from Mr. Hornett. Brinkley, who had access to his chequebook, forged eight cheques and used his Barclaycard. By June the following year, Brinkley had illegally obtained £127,000 and Davies £40,000 from Mr. Hornett. Large sums were spent on vehicles, including a £30,000 VW Touareg and a £43,000 Mercedes convertible. Text messages revealed the women’s discussions about receiving large sums from Mr. Hornett as gifts. The prosecution also detailed how the pair believed they had persuaded Mr. Hornett to change his will so they would inherit the house they were renting. Brinkley plied Mr. Hornett with alcohol and persuaded him to write a letter to his solicitor requesting this change. The solicitor grew suspicious, and although no change was made, the women believed otherwise, leading them to plan significant extensions to the property. Police became involved after noticing the building work and expensive vehicles during a visit to Mr. Hornett. Investigations revealed a total loss of £733,563.46 to Mr. Hornett. The court heard that Mr. Hornett had become frightened of Brinkley and found it easier to give in to their demands. Brinkley admitted two counts of fraud, nine of forgery, and one of converting criminal property. Davies admitted one count of converting criminal property. Both women were described as previously dedicated health care professionals. Judge Bright condemned their actions as relentless and merciless exploitation of a vulnerable individual. A confiscation hearing is scheduled for January next year.

article_content: Michael Clement, a 68-year-old Alzheimer's patient, went missing for 23 hours after being discharged from Queen Elizabeth Hospital in Woolwich, London, at 5 am in freezing temperatures. He was released without a coat or money, and his family was not notified. Mr. Clement's family searched anxiously along with police, who used a helicopter and sniffer dogs. He was eventually found 19 miles away in Sutton, knocking on a stranger’s door for help. Mr. Clement's daughter-in-law, Michaela Curren, expressed the family's extreme worry and criticized the hospital staff's handling of his discharge. The family intends to file a formal complaint with the NHS Trust. The hospital has launched an investigation into the incident, and a spokesman for South London Healthcare Trust stated they collaborated with the family and police in the search for Mr. Clement.

article_content:
A recent Nielsen study indicates that Twitter activity can increase TV program viewership. Analysts examined 221 episodes and found that higher tweet volumes during a broadcast boosted audience size in almost one-third of cases.

Interestingly, even negative reactions on Twitter can spark interest. The BBC sitcom 'The Wright Way,' created by Ben Elton, was canceled after harsh criticism online. Conversely, ITV's celebrity diving competition 'Splash!,' despite being ridiculed on Twitter, attracted over six million viewers for its premiere.

This effect was seen in the US as well. The SyFy film 'Sharknado' caused a social media frenzy, reaching a peak of 5,000 tweets per minute, including celebrity reactions. The online buzz has led to talks of a sequel and made the movie a cultural phenomenon.

Nielsen's Chief Research Officer, Paul Donato, explained that their data demonstrates a real connection between Twitter conversations and TV ratings. Nielsen and Twitter are launching a new 'Nielsen Twitter TV Rating' to publicly track Twitter discussions about TV shows. Twitter COO Ali Rowghani said this effort confirms that social media drives live TV audiences.

值得注意的是，推特上的负面声音有时也能带来更多关注。例如由本·埃尔顿创作的 BBC 情景喜剧《The Wright Way》因遭到网友批评而被取消；而 ITV 的明星跳水真人秀《Splash!》虽然在推特上被嘲讽，首播仍吸引了超过六百万观众。

在美国，这一现象也得到了验证。SyFy 频道的电影《Sharknado》在社交媒体上引发热议，最高峰时每分钟有5,000条推文，包括众多名人参与讨论。巨大的网络关注推动续集讨论，也让影片成为现象级作品。

尼尔森首席研究官 Paul Donato 表示，数据显示推特讨论与电视收视率之间存在真实关联。尼尔森和推特即将推出“Nielsen Twitter TV Rating”，公开追踪每档节目的推特讨论热度。推特首席运营官 Ali Rowghani 称，这一合作证明社交媒体确实能为直播电视吸引观众。

article_content: TALLAHASSEE, Fla. — Florida's university system is facing a lawsuit after attempting to silence a chapter of a pro-Palestinian student group. A free speech advocacy group claims the state is violating the First Amendment rights of an organization that promotes peace. Last month, State University System Chancellor Ray Rodrigues ordered universities to disband chapters of Students for Justice in Palestine, alleging the national group supports terrorism following the Hamas attack on Israeli citizens on October 7. Rodrigues has since paused the order to consult legal counsel on how the state can proceed, including whether it can require groups to formally reject violence and Hamas, and to follow the law.  The lawsuit, filed by the American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU) in federal court, states that the University of Florida's Students for Justice in Palestine chapter is only loosely connected to the national organization, does not accept funding, nor coordinates planning with it. The lawsuit contends that even if the group were affiliated, their speech is protected by the Constitution. According to the lawsuit, the UF chapter aims to 'promote international law, human rights, and justice for all people affected by this conflict.'  Interest in the UF chapter has reportedly increased since the outbreak of the war between Israel and Hamas, but members fear university action could halt their growing advocacy efforts. 'Members fear that at any moment the University will disrupt their ability to maintain momentum for their advocacy,' the lawsuit states. The Florida Department of Education and the Board of Governors did not immediately respond to requests for comment on the status of the disbandment order.
