article_content: LONDON, England (CNN) – The world of online piracy can be confusing, filled with unfamiliar terms like The Pirate Bay, BitTorrent, and jailbreak. To help you navigate this digital landscape, here’s an A-Z guide to piracy concepts and controversies. A is for Anti-piracy: Efforts led by groups such as the Motion Picture Association of America (MPAA) aim to prevent illegal copying and sharing of copyrighted material. These include measures like digital rights management (DRM), encryption, and product keys, but the industry often lags behind tech-savvy pirates and resorts to lawsuits. B is for Bill Gates: In 1976, Bill Gates warned about software piracy. Ironically, he later acknowledged that piracy in China, where over 90% of computers run pirated Windows, helped Microsoft gain a dominant market position there. C is for Cracking: Hackers often modify software to remove copy protection, enabling illegal duplication and distribution of media. This activity is typically done for community respect rather than financial gain. D is for Digital Rights Management (DRM): Companies use DRM technologies to control access to digital material. However, piracy technologies are frequently developed to bypass DRM. For example, Apple removed DRM from iTunes in April, but charges users to upgrade tracks. E is for Encryption: Originally developed for the military, encryption protects digital information. It’s now a common anti-piracy measure, intended to limit unauthorized copying and sharing. F is for Free Culture Movement: Led by Harvard’s Lawrence Lessig and supported by Creative Commons, this movement opposes restrictive copyright laws, advocating for the freedom to copy and modify creative works. G is for Global Software Piracy: According to the Business Software Alliance, 35% of software installed on PCs worldwide in 2006 was pirated. H is for Hackers: In 2008, hackers erased all data from the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA)’s website, exposing weaknesses in their security system. I is for IFPI: The International Federation of the Phonographic Industry reported in 2008 that up to 80% of data traffic with ISPs relates to the illegal transfer of pirated material. J is for Jailbreak: Commonly associated with the iPhone, jailbreaking refers to bypassing DRM to install unauthorized or pirated applications. K is for Key Generators: These small programs, found on piracy sites, enable users to create valid serial numbers for restricted software, unlocking programs like Microsoft Office and Adobe Photoshop. L is for Limewire: Limewire, an early and popular peer-to-peer file sharing client, allowed users to download pirated content but was criticized for security risks and spreading malware. M is for Metallica: In 2000, Metallica was the first major band to sue over online music piracy, targeting Napster and several universities. The dispute was settled after Napster agreed to prevent the illegal sharing of Metallica’s music. N is for Napster: Launched in 1999, Napster popularized MP3 sharing and was shut down by court order in 2001. It later reappeared as a legitimate subscription service. O is for Organized Crime: The IFPI and Interpol claim links exist between online piracy, organized crime, and even terrorism, highlighting cases from regions around the world. P is for P2P: Peer-to-peer (P2P) networks, such as those using BitTorrent, are responsible for much more music exchange than legal purchases, enabling rapid sharing of large files. Q is for Quality: An Ernst and Young survey in India found that 66% of people see pirated content as lower quality, yet 89% have used pirated music or films. R is for R4 Card: The Nintendo DS R4 card, costing about $30, allows users to load hundreds of pirated games, making it cheaper than individual legitimate titles. S is for Sweden: Swedish prosecutors sued The Pirate Bay in 2009 for promoting copyright infringement—a trial dubbed the ‘Internet piracy trial of the decade’. The site’s founders plan to appeal any verdict. T is for The Pirate Bay: This well-known file-sharing website links users to pirated movies, music, games, and other content through BitTorrent. Its founders claim it operates legally by not hosting copyrighted files. U is for Usenet.com: Usenet, a bulletin board-style site, has been sued by the RIAA for facilitating the nearly untraceable download of pirated files. Like The Pirate Bay, it faces allegations of encouraging copyright violations. V is for Video Games: The Entertainment Software Association estimates a $3 billion annual loss due to online game piracy. W is for ‘Warez’: This slang term covers any media being traded in violation of copyright law. X is for ‘X-Men Origins: Wolverine’: A leaked version of the film was illegally downloaded over a million times before its release in 2009. The FBI is investigating, and Hugh Jackman called the leak ‘heartbreaking’. Y is for YouTube: Major companies such as Viacom have sued YouTube for unauthorized distribution of copyrighted content. YouTube regularly removes such content, though it is often quickly re-uploaded by users. Z is for Zune: Microsoft’s answer to the iPod plans to make its entire music catalog DRM-free, potentially making it easier to copy and share tracks.
translated_content: 伦敦，英格兰（CNN）——网络盗版的世界充满让人困惑的专有名词，如The Pirate Bay、BitTorrent和越狱。为帮助你了解这个数字领域，以下是一份关于盗版相关术语和争议的A-Z指南。 A代表反盗版：由美国电影协会（MPAA）等组织主导，反盗版的措施旨在阻止非法复制和分享受版权保护的内容。包括数字版权管理（DRM）、加密、产品密钥等，但行业往往难以跟上技术先进的盗版者，不得不诉诸法律手段。 B代表比尔·盖茨：1976年，比尔·盖茨就曾对软件盗版发出警告。具有讽刺意味的是，他后来承认中国90%以上电脑使用盗版Windows，这反而帮助微软获得市场主导地位。 C代表破解：黑客经常修改软件以移除复制保护，实现非法复制和分发媒体。这通常是为了黑客圈内声望，而非金钱回报。 D代表数字版权管理（DRM）：公司利用DRM限制数字内容的访问，但盗版技术也不断发展来破解DRM。例如苹果在四月移除了iTunes的DRM，但用户需付费升级歌曲。 E代表加密：最初为军事用途开发的加密技术现在被应用于数字信息保护，是防止非法复制和传播的常见反盗版措施。 F代表自由文化运动：由哈佛大学劳伦斯·莱西格（Lawrence Lessig）主导，并得到 Creative Commons 支持，该运动反对严格版权法，倡导自由复制和改编创意作品。 G代表全球软件盗版：据商业软件联盟统计，2006年全球PC上安装的软件有35%为盗版。 H代表黑客：2008年，黑客清空了美国唱片协会（RIAA）网站所有数据，暴露出其安全漏洞。 I代表国际唱片业协会（IFPI）：IFPI 2008年报告称，高达80%的ISP数据流量与盗版内容的非法传输有关。 J代表越狱：常见于iPhone，指绕过DRM安装未经授权或盗版应用的做法。 K代表密钥生成器：这些小程序广泛存在于盗版网站，用于为受限软件生成有效序列号，如破解Office和Photoshop等应用。 L代表Limewire：Limewire是早期流行的P2P文件分享客户端，允许用户下载盗版内容，但因为安全风险和恶意软件问题受到批评。 M代表Metallica（金属乐队）：2000年，Metallica成首支因网络音乐盗版起诉Napster及几所大学的大型乐队。案件最终以Napster同意阻止非法下载Metallica音乐而和解。 N代表Napster：1999年上线的Napster推动了MP3广泛分享，2001年法院下令关闭，后以合法订阅方式重返市场。 O代表有组织犯罪：IFPI与国际刑警称网络盗版与有组织犯罪甚至恐怖活动有关，涉及全球多地区案例。 P代表P2P：点对点（P2P）网络（如BitTorrent），音乐交换量远超合法购买，使大型文件得以快速共享。 Q代表质量：安永印度调查显示，66%的人认为盗版内容质量较差，但89%的人仍然使用过盗版音乐或电影。 R代表R4卡：售价约30美元的 Nintendo DS R4 卡可加载数百款盗版游戏，价格远低于正品。 S代表瑞典：2009年瑞典检察官以协助侵权罪起诉The Pirate Bay，该案被称作“十年网络盗版大审判”，其创始人已表示将继续上诉。 T代表The Pirate Bay：这一著名文件分享网站通过BitTorrent为用户提供电影、音乐、游戏等盗版内容链接，主张自己不存储版权文件因而合法。 U代表Usenet.com：Usenet公告板式网站因协助几乎无法追踪的盗版下载被RIAA起诉，与The Pirate Bay类似也面临鼓励侵权的指责。 V代表电子游戏：娱乐软件协会估算，游戏行业因网络盗版每年损失30亿美元。 W代表‘Warez’：指任何以违反版权、私自交换的媒体资料的俚语。 X代表《金刚狼前传》：2009年电影上映前遭泄漏，下载量超百万次。FBI正在调查，主演休·杰克曼表示非常心碎。 Y代表YouTube：维亚康姆等公司曾因YouTube未经授权传播受版权保护内容起诉该平台。虽然YouTube定期删除侵权内容，但用户很快又会重新上传。 Z代表Zune：微软的iPod竞品Zune计划让其全部音乐无DRM保护，可能使复制和分享音乐更加方便。

Dr. Poonam Tandon, Chief Investment Officer at IndiaFirst Life, said in an ETMarkets interview that after years of disruption, India’s real estate sector is now in a multi-year growth phase. Strong residential demand, driven by low inventory and improved affordability, is fueling this resurgence.

Commenting on recent market trends, Dr. Tandon attributed the rally in Indian equities to improved global sentiment—factoring in expectations that the US Fed may pause rate hikes and stable Middle East conditions—along with falling oil prices and robust domestic data like high PMI and GST collections. She cautioned that foreign portfolio investment has slowed and that US Fed policy could still create volatility over the next few months.

For Samvat 2080, Dr. Tandon expects market sentiment to be shaped by both global and domestic events: geopolitical issues, US monetary policy, US elections, and India’s general elections. While elections tend not to influence long-term market performance, factors such as weather, rural demand, and ongoing earnings momentum remain important.

Major risks for investors in the coming year include geopolitical conflicts in the Middle East and Eastern Europe, persistent US inflation, weak Chinese demand, and economic slowdowns in the US and Europe. Within India, risks could arise from global spill-over, political uncertainty, erratic monsoons impacting crops, and climate-induced heat waves.

On capital expenditure, she remained optimistic, citing significant public and private sector investments. She noted that sectors like capital goods, defence, power, manufacturing, and banking are likely to benefit.

With US 10-year bond yields near 4.5–5%, foreign investor inflows into India have declined since August. However, Dr. Tandon believes that as US rate hikes end and flows shift from China, India could see renewed FPI interest.

Recent Q2FY24 earnings showed strong results in auto, BFSI, capital goods, and oil & gas, with weaker performance in IT and FMCG. Rural demand recovery remains weak, but solid growth in domestic manufacturing is supported by government policies and falling commodity prices.

The real estate sector, currently consolidating, is viewed positively, with preference for financially robust companies expected to increase their market share. Over the medium term, she favors sectors supporting India’s growth—banks, industrials, utilities, defence, real estate, and cement—over consumption-focused sectors.

In other industry news, Tesla is considering a $2 billion investment in a local plant, pending favorable import duty terms, and the Indian government may instruct the Finance Commission to adjust its formula for state resource distribution to give greater weight to human development and sustainability.

(Disclaimer: The opinions expressed are the expert’s own and do not reflect the editorial stance of the Economic Times.)

Caroline 'Cici' Bellis, a 15-year-old tennis player from California, is quickly making a name for herself. In her Grand Slam debut at the U.S. Open, Bellis, who is currently ranked No. 2 among junior players worldwide, stunned 12th seed and Australian Open finalist Dominika Cibulkova with a 6-1, 4-6, 6-4 victory — the tournament’s biggest upset so far.

Bellis's win made her the youngest woman to claim a match victory at the U.S. Open since Anna Kournikova in 1996 and the youngest American since Mary Joe Fernandez in 1986. Born in April 1999 in San Francisco and raised in Atherton, California, Bellis picked up her first racket at age three, inspired in part by her mother, a former junior player. Her focus on tennis intensified four years ago, at age eleven.

Reflecting on her win, Bellis said, “I went into the match thinking it would be a great experience, but I never thought I would come out on top.” She advances to play Kazakh Zarina Diyas next. Although Bellis's world ranking is 1,208, she’s the second-ranked junior behind Serbia’s Ivana Jorovic. Bellis has captured several prestigious junior titles, including the Easter Bowl, USTA International Spring Championships, and the Coffee Bowl. She’s also competing in the U.S. Open junior tournament.

Because she remains an amateur, Bellis cannot accept the over $60,000 prize for her first-round win, and she plans to keep her collegiate options open for now, saying, “I’m definitely going to stay an amateur right now to keep my options open for college. But I’d love to be a pro one day.”

Her wild card entry was earned by winning the USTA Girls’ 18s National Championship, making her the youngest champion since Lindsay Davenport. Despite her status as the world No. 2 junior, few expected the 15-year-old wild card to make such a splash. Bellis, whose idol is Kim Clijsters, models her play and energy after the four-time Grand Slam champion, though she also looks up to Maria Sharapova, whom she met three years ago.

“It’s crazy to think that I’m actually here right now with all these other people,” Bellis said after her historic win. “I never thought I’d be practicing or sharing a court with players I watch on TV. It’s crazy. But I love it.”

article_content: New Zealand has named the pūteketeke, also known as the Australasian crested grebe, as its 'Bird of the Century' after an energetic international campaign led by John Oliver and his show 'Last Week Tonight.' Oliver, acting as the bird’s self-proclaimed ‘official campaign manager,’ launched a creative campaign with billboards in countries including Japan, France, the UK, India, and Wisconsin, as well as a plane flying a pūteketeke banner over Ipanema Beach in Brazil. He also appeared on 'The Tonight Show with Jimmy Fallon' dressed as the pūteketeke to promote the campaign. The contest, organized by conservation group Forest & Bird, received extensive global attention, as reported by sources such as the South China Morning Post. This two-week event attracted over 350,000 verified votes from 195 countries—a new record since the competition began in 2005. The poll was rebranded as 'Bird of the Century' this year to celebrate Forest & Bird’s centenary, compared to a previous record of 56,733 verified votes in 2021. Forest & Bird CEO Nicola Toki highlighted that the pūteketeke started as an underdog but rose to the top due to its unusual appearance, endearing parenting style, and reputation for regurgitating food. The campaign stirred playful debate in New Zealand, with some residents expressing concerns about 'American interference.' Forest & Bird noted that this helped boost voter turnout, with one group even putting up billboards stating: 'Dear John, don’t disrupt the pecking order.' Ultimately, the North Island brown kiwi came in a distant second. The campaign’s popularity temporarily crashed the voting verification system, resulting in a two-day delay in announcing the result and thousands of fraudulent votes being discarded. Nicola Toki encouraged supporters to direct their enthusiasm toward constructive causes, rather than attempting to influence the vote unfairly. The pūteketeke is classified as ‘Nationally Vulnerable’ in New Zealand, with fewer than 1,000 individuals estimated nationwide. Forest & Bird celebrated the victory on social media, sharing a playful video and announcing: 'Pūteketeke pandemonium prevails!' The 'Last Week Tonight' campaign website also updated to showcase the bird’s win.

article_content: Median CEO compensation for large U.S. public companies surpassed $10 million for the first time in 2013, reaching a record $10.5 million, according to a recent study. This represents an 8.8% increase from 2012, when median CEO pay was $9.6 million. CEO compensation packages have risen for the fourth consecutive year, having declined after the 2008 recession. Since 2009, median CEO pay has climbed more than 50%. Anthony Petrello of Nabors Industries was the highest paid CEO in 2013, earning $68.2 million, largely due to a $60 million one-time payment for contract renegotiation. Leslie Moonves of CBS was second with $65.6 million, a 9% increase over the previous year, while Richard Adkerson of Freeport-McMoRan Copper & Gold ranked third at $55.3 million, after receiving a $36.7 million one-time contract payment. Stock market gains significantly boosted CEO pay, with the S&P 500 rising 30% in 2013. The stock component of CEO compensation increased 17% to an average of $4.5 million. On average, a CEO now makes 257 times the salary of a typical worker, up from 181 times in 2009. The average U.S. worker’s weekly wage rose just 1.3% in 2013. Carol Meyrowitz, CEO of TJX Companies (which includes TK Maxx), was the highest-paid woman on the list, at $20.7 million, ranking 33rd among the top 50 CEOs. Only one woman was among the top 50 highest paid CEOs, highlighting the ongoing gender disparity. Other notable CEOs in the top 10 include Stephen Kaufer (TripAdvisor) with $39 million, Philippe Dauman (Viacom) with $37.2 million, and Robert Iger (Walt Disney) with $34.3 million. The media industry continued to compensate its top executives generously. Banking saw the largest increase in CEO pay among major industries, with a 22% median pay bump in 2013, following another 22% increase the previous year. BlackRock CEO Laurence Fink topped the industry at $22.9 million, followed by Kenneth Chenault of American Express with $21.7 million. Performance bonuses also grew, averaging $1.9 million—a 12.9% increase from 2012—driven by rising stock prices and higher corporate profits. More than two-thirds of S&P 500 CEOs received a raise in 2013. CEO pay continues to be a controversial topic in the U.S. Supporters argue that high pay packages are necessary to attract leaders who can drive shareholder value, while critics point to the growing gap between executive and worker compensation. At the 2013 rate, it would take a typical employee 257 years to earn what an average S&P 500 CEO makes in one year.

article_content: A small single-engine plane was forced to land on a snowy highway in New Jersey this afternoon after experiencing what appeared to be a mechanical problem. Dr. Christopher Okechukwu, 51, an emergency room physician from Paramus and father of three, was piloting the aircraft alone on his way to Lincoln Park Airport when he detected abnormal engine noises. Despite icy road conditions, Okechukwu—who possesses 15 years of piloting experience—safely touched down his 1976 Cessna C150 on Route 23 in West Milford. Carefully coordinating his approach, he landed the plane behind a truck and car during a gap in traffic. Fortunately, no one was injured, no vehicles were struck, and the plane remained largely undamaged. The emergency landing occurred at about 1 p.m., and by 2:30 p.m., officials had removed the aircraft using a flatbed truck, reopening all lanes to vehicles. Eyewitness Andrew May remarked how the plane narrowly avoided hitting signs and wires, calling the safe landing a 'miracle.' Dr. Okechukwu's wife Susan stated that while her husband was understandably shaken, he appeared unhurt and was drawing on his experience as an ER doctor at Newton Memorial Hospital to cope with the situation. The Federal Aviation Administration is investigating the cause of the incident.

article_content: E-commerce companies are navigating highly competitive online marketplaces filled with countless products and offers. In this environment, the real challenge is not just displaying products, but also capturing and retaining customers’ attention. As new technologies evolve and shoppers increasingly seek personalized experiences, business leaders are pushed to find innovative ways to get ahead.  Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming how e-commerce brands approach content creation. AI empowers companies to produce tailored, persuasive content that drives sales. With AI, businesses can craft unique product descriptions that align with individual customer preferences and design precisely-targeted advertisements. This use of AI is proving to be indispensable in today's digital commerce landscape.  Boosting E-Commerce Sales with AI  How can businesses make the most of AI to increase sales? The era of generic product descriptions is over. AI now allows brands to write descriptions that resonate personally with each shopper, addressing their specific interests and needs. This customizable approach not only enhances the shopping experience but can also increase the likelihood of purchases, as customers are more likely to connect with products matched to their tastes.  Imagine browsing an online store where every product description feels relevant to your needs—such personalization can significantly boost sales. AI-driven data analysis enables businesses to understand consumer behaviors, preferences, and demographics, turning advertising from a broad approach to precise, predictive engagement. By analyzing data trends, AI predicts purchasing intent and helps teams create advertisements that reach customers at the optimal moment, increasing both conversions and ROI.  For AI-driven content to drive profits, all departments must work together to ensure AI initiatives actually benefit the company’s bottom line. In my experience, finance leaders play a crucial role in supporting marketing and business development teams for successful AI integration.  Measuring AI Adoption  AI adoption isn’t universal—companies must assess their own needs, resources, and goals. My company, for instance, is in the early stages of AI implementation, and we're committed to an analytical approach, similar to strategies used across finance and marketing functions. Like any investment, the value of AI should be measured, ensuring that the return justifies the initial spend. It’s important for CFOs and finance leaders to collaborate with other departments to set clear KPIs for AI-driven content and advertising.  While the upfront investment in AI technology can seem large, the long-term potential to boost revenue makes it worthwhile. AI is a powerful productivity tool that can help reduce—but not eliminate—business costs. All competitors are exploring ways to integrate AI, so consistent tracking, using standard attribution models, is essential to gauge AI’s impact on sales and to refine strategies for even better results.  Avoiding AI Missteps  A common error in AI adoption is viewing it solely as a means to cut staff. While AI can streamline operations, its true value lies in boosting productivity and improving customer experiences. When used wisely, AI tools can empower marketing and business development teams to innovate and tailor strategies more closely to customers' needs. Ultimately, businesses that treat AI as a productivity enhancer—rather than just a cost-cutter—are best positioned to lead their industries, deepen customer relationships, and transform online shopping. article_content: A leading international organization has stated that poverty does not necessarily block students from succeeding academically. While some experts argue that factors like uneducated parents and disadvantaged neighborhoods trap families in a cycle of hardship, the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) disputes the idea that poverty is a deciding barrier. OECD studies reveal that students from poorer backgrounds in some nations actually outperform wealthier peers elsewhere, especially in mathematics. For instance, data shows the poorest 10% of students in Shanghai are typically ahead of the richest 20% in the UK. The achievement gap between affluent Shanghai students and disadvantaged British students at age 15 equals about six years of schooling. Similarly, Dutch students from the lowest-income families can be up to a year ahead of British children from comparable backgrounds at the same age. These results suggest that a student’s family and economic background matters less than the quality of teaching and the overall educational system. OECD spokesman Andrew Schleicher commented, “The data debunks the myth that poverty is destiny,” reinforcing the argument for educational reform over policies that merely adjust university entry criteria for disadvantaged students. The report comes soon after Education Secretary Michael Gove emphasized that while resources are important, attitude and high expectations are even more crucial. He highlighted ongoing reforms such as curriculum improvements and more autonomy for state schools, aiming to provide educational opportunities on par with private institutions. Gove also indicated that state schools are being granted freedoms similar to private schools, allowing them to determine homework policies or prioritize extracurriculars. The OECD’s analysis is based on tests taken by tens of thousands of 15-year-olds in 40 countries or regions in 2012—before significant reforms were implemented by the UK government. Despite substantial investments in education, UK performance has remained in the middle relative to other countries. Further research highlighted that the poorest UK students lag behind those in high-achieving areas like South Korea, Singapore, Shanghai, and Hong Kong. Schleicher stressed, “Poverty isn’t destiny. The least privileged teenagers in Shanghai perform comparably to the most advantaged students in the US and the UK.” He added that solutions need to address challenges faced by many children in different neighborhoods, not just the poorest. Chris McGovern from the Campaign for Real Education agreed that attitude matters more than funding, but cautioned that UK schools, even top ones, perform poorly compared to international competitors.
translated_content: 一个国际知名组织表示，贫困并不一定会阻碍学生取得学业上的成功。 虽然一些专家认为，缺乏受教育的父母和贫困社区容易让家庭陷入困境，但经济合作与发展组织（OECD）并不认同贫困是决定性障碍的观点。 OECD的研究显示，一些国家的贫困学生在学业，尤其是数学方面，实际上比其他国家的富裕学生表现更好。 例如，数据表明上海最贫困的10%学生通常比英国最富裕的20%学生水平更高。在上海富裕学生和英国贫困学生之间，15岁时的差距相当于六年的教育。 同样，荷兰最低收入家庭的学生在同龄阶段可能比英国同等背景的孩子领先一年。 这些结果表明，学生的家庭和经济背景远不及教学质量和教育体系重要。 OECD发言人安德鲁·施莱歇（Andrew Schleicher）评论道：“这些数据打破了贫困就是命运的神话。”这进一步支持了对教育改革的呼吁，而不仅仅是为贫困学生降低大学录取标准的政策。 该报告发布之际，英国教育大臣迈克尔·戈夫（Michael Gove）强调，虽然资源重要，但态度和高期望更为关键。他还指出，正在进行的课程改革和国家学校自主权的提升，旨在让公立学校的教育机会与私立学校持平。 戈夫还提到，国家学校正获得与私立学校类似的自由，比如自主决定家庭作业政策或更重视课外活动。 OECD的分析基于2012年40个国家或主要地区数万名15岁学生的测试数据——即英国政府实施重大改革之前的数据。 尽管教育投入巨大，英国的国际表现仍处于中游位置。 进一步研究还显示，英国最贫困学生的表现落后于韩国、新加坡、上海和香港这些高绩效地区的同龄人。 施莱歇还强调：“贫困不是命运。上海最贫困的青少年与美国和英国最富裕的学生成绩相当。” 他补充说，解决方案需要关注更多社区中许多孩子所面临的问题，而不仅仅是最贫困者。 英国真实教育运动（Campaign for Real Education）的克里斯·麦戈文（Chris McGovern）同意态度比资金更重要，但也指出英国学校，甚至顶级学校，在国际比较中表现不佳。

Worldwide airline industry profits are projected to decline in 2011 due to rising fuel prices, political instability, and natural disasters, according to the International Air Transport Association (IATA). “Natural disasters in Japan, unrest in the Middle East and North Africa, combined with a sharp rise in oil prices, have slashed industry profit expectations to $4 billion this year,” said Giovanni Bisignani, IATA’s Director General and CEO, in a statement released Monday. “That we are making any profit at all this year, amid these unprecedented shocks, is a sign of just how delicate this balance is.”

The primary cause of reduced profitability is higher fuel costs. IATA explained that airlines incur an extra $1.6 billion in costs for each $1 increase in the average yearly oil price. In 2011, the industry's fuel bill is expected to reach $176 billion, which would account for nearly 30% of airline operating costs. Elevated fuel prices have also hampered growth in both cargo and passenger sectors, causing IATA to revise its forecasts for both markets. The cargo market is expected to grow by only 0.6%, while passenger growth is projected at 1.2% for 2011.

The earthquake and tsunami in Japan are expected to impact carriers in both Asia-Pacific and North America, though Asia-Pacific airlines are still forecasted to be the world’s most profitable for 2011, generating an estimated $2.1 billion in profit. However, this figure represents a sharp decline from the $10 billion profit achieved in the region the previous year, according to IATA.

Political unrest in the Middle East and North Africa has weakened profitability for airlines in those regions. Profits for Middle East carriers are expected to drop from $900 million in 2010 to just $100 million in 2011, while African carriers are anticipated to record a collective loss of $100 million. In particular, unrest in Egypt and Tunisia has impacted their important tourism industries.

The debt crisis in Europe has also taken a toll, with European airlines projected to post a $500 million profit this year—down from $1.9 billion in 2010. Although profits in Latin America have dropped from $900 million to $100 million, the region remains unique in recording profits for three consecutive years.

IATA had previously downgraded its 2011 profit forecast in March to $8.6 billion. The latest revision reflects a 54% decline from that estimate and a 78% plunge compared to the $18 billion net profit reported for 2010.

根据国际航空运输协会（IATA）的数据，受燃油价格上涨、政治动荡和自然灾害影响，全球航空业2011年的利润预计将下降。IATA总干事兼首席执行官Giovanni Bisignani周一在一份声明中表示：“日本的自然灾害、中东和北非地区的动乱，再加上油价的急剧上涨，已将行业利润预期削减至40亿美元。今年能在这些前所未有的冲击中获得任何利润，已显示出航空业的平衡多么脆弱。”

利润减少的主要原因是燃油成本上升。IATA解释称，平均油价每上涨1美元，航空公司就需额外承担16亿美元成本。2011年，行业燃油总支出预计将达到1760亿美元，占航空公司运营成本的近30%。高昂的燃油价格也抑制了货运和客运市场增长，IATA因此下调了两项市场的预测。预计2011年货运市场增长仅为0.6%，客运增长1.2%。

日本的地震和海啸预计将影响亚太和北美地区的航空公司，不过，亚太航空公司依然有望成为2011年全球盈利最多的地区，预计利润为21亿美元。IATA称，这一数字与去年该地区的100亿美元利润相比，下降明显。

中东和北非的政治动荡削弱了该地区航空公司的盈利能力。预计中东航空公司利润将由2010年的9亿美元降至2011年的1亿美元，而非洲航空公司预计将亏损1亿美元。特别是埃及和突尼斯的动荡，对这两个以旅游业为支柱的国家影响尤为显著。

欧洲的债务危机也带来影响，预计欧洲航空公司今年利润为5亿美元，低于2010年的19亿美元。拉美地区航空公司虽然利润从9亿美元降至1亿美元，但该地区仍是全球唯一连续三年保持盈利的地区。

IATA曾在今年3月将2011年利润预测下调至86亿美元。最新预测相比下调了54%，与2010年行业净利润180亿美元相比骤降78%。

article_content: Rielle Hunter has issued a notable apology for her affair with former Senator John Edwards, admitting in an open letter that her actions were both wrong and selfish. Hunter, previously a campaign videographer, confessed she caused harm to many, most significantly to Edwards’ late wife, Elizabeth, who was enduring breast cancer at the time. As Hunter feels deep remorse, she has released an updated version of her 2012 memoir, this time openly highlighting all her regrets and mistakes related to the affair. In her letter published via the Huffington Post, she also apologized to Edwards’ children and the people who once supported him during his senatorial and presidential campaigns. Hunter admitted she wrote her original book without considering the broader impact, driven by her own desires. She now regrets the book’s publication and says the new annotated edition is meant to set the record straight and acknowledge where she went wrong. The previous edition had limited sales, but Hunter hopes this new version reflects her accountability. Explaining the importance of confronting her own mistakes, Hunter shared personal background, noting that both her parents had been unfaithful and she hopes not to pass down similar behaviors to her daughter Quinn, who was born from her relationship with Edwards. Hunter’s public apology came shortly after Cate Edwards, the eldest child of John and Elizabeth, gave an interview discussing the emotional difficulty of her father’s affair, particularly since it happened while her mother was battling cancer. Despite the pain, Cate described how she and her father have worked hard to rebuild their relationship, emphasizing that forgiveness takes time and effort. Cate revealed she has met Quinn, calling her 'cute and adorable,' although they do not see each other often due to distance. Cate Edwards was also by her father's side during his 2011 trial, where he faced charges of misusing campaign funds to conceal his affair. Ultimately, he was acquitted on one count, with a deadlocked jury on the others. Cate credits her family’s hardships with teaching her about resilience and strength.

article_content: Lily Collins and Jamie Campbell Bower have maintained privacy regarding their romance, but according to best-selling author Cassandra Clare, their bond is unmistakable. The actors met while working on the film adaptation of Clare's popular series, The Mortal Instruments: City of Bones, and have been close since. Clare, whose new release Clockwork Princess concludes The Infernal Devices trilogy, told MailOnline that Collins and Bower are 'clearly in love.' In the film, the duo star as Clary Fray and Jace Wayland—both 'Shadowhunters' or demon hunters. Jamie Campbell Bower was previously engaged to Harry Potter co-star Bonnie Wright; Lily Collins formerly dated Twilight star Taylor Lautner. Clare observed their chemistry on set and found their connection both sweet and genuine. She remarked that Lily Collins brings a blend of vulnerability and strength to Clary’s role, while Bower reflects Jace’s wit, humor, and charm. Clare recalled witnessing their strong chemistry during auditions, and now often imagines them as her book characters. She expressed appreciation for Collins and Bower's portrayals and mentioned meeting Lily’s mother, Jill, during filming. Lily Collins said Bower’s mix of humor and emotional range made him the ideal Jace. Clare is recognized as part of a prominent group of female fantasy authors, such as J.K. Rowling, Stephenie Meyer, and Suzanne Collins, all known for strong female protagonists. Her latest release, Clockwork Princess, follows Tessa—a Victorian girl who enters the Shadowhunters’ universe. Clare underlined the value of female representation in fantasy and feels appreciation for the trail blazed by other successful women authors. She stressed the need for strong heroines appealing to all young readers and said her books explore personal growth and identity. Saying goodbye to her characters is difficult for Clare after years of development and interaction with fans. She revealed The Mortal Instruments was partly inspired by her experiences in New York after 9/11. Clare acknowledged support from peers like Stephenie Meyer and Suzanne Collins, though she has not met J.K. Rowling. The author is awaiting the release of the City of Bones movie, as its success could greenlight adaptations of further books in the series. City of Heavenly Fire is slated for release next year. Clare is also working on collaborations: The Magisterium with Holly Black and the Shadowhunters Codex with her husband, Joshua Lewis. She resides with Lewis and their three cats in Western Massachusetts and continues to receive enthusiastic feedback from readers.

Google has released a critical security update for Chrome users across multiple platforms after confirming the existence of an exploit for a zero-day vulnerability, CVE-2023-6345. According to Google’s stable channel update on November 28, the company is aware that the exploit is being used in the wild. Users of Google Chrome and other Chromium-based browsers are strongly advised to install and activate the latest update as soon as possible.

CVE-2023-6345 is associated with an integer overflow issue in the Skia component—a 2D open-source graphics library within Chrome's graphics engine. VulnDB explains that the vulnerability arises when a calculation results in an integer overflow or wraparound, breaking the logic that assumes the resulting value will always be greater than the original. This flaw can affect confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

Google’s usual approach in such cases is to withhold detailed technical information about the vulnerability until most of its 3.2 billion users are protected.

Researchers from Google’s Threat Analysis Group (TAG), who specialize in spyware and advanced persistent threats (APT), discovered and reported the bug last Friday. Mike Walters, president and co-founder of risk-based patch management company Action1, notes that Google fixed a similar integer overflow flaw (CVE-2023-2136) in April 2023. Since that issue was also actively exploited, it’s possible this latest patch aims to bolster protections.

The update also addresses five additional vulnerabilities beyond CVE-2023-6345. The latest update brings Google Chrome to version 119.0.6045.199 for Mac and Linux, and version 119.0.6045.199/.200 for Windows. To verify if your browser is up to date, open the Help > About Google Chrome menu; if the update is available, it will begin downloading automatically. Remember to restart Chrome after the update installs to activate the new protection. It might take a few days for all users to receive the update.

article_content: Dean Richard Kelly, a 37-year-old athlete with silver medals from the World Dwarf Games, has admitted to making a fake emergency call that triggered a significant police operation. Just after 3 a.m. on January 11, Kelly claimed a woman armed with a shotgun and knife was outside his apartment in Barrow, Cumbria. In response, police deployed three armed teams, a dog handler, seven officers, and senior staff. The North West Ambulance Service also attended, and the street was sealed off. Authorities soon realized the call was a hoax, resulting in more than 20 hours of wasted police time and a £540 bill. Though Kelly at first denied the hoax, he later confessed when confronted with evidence. The court heard he had been drinking, but was not heavily intoxicated. Kelly said his actions were out of character and expressed shame, adding he was grateful no real emergencies were neglected. Appearing at Furness Magistrates’ Court, Kelly received a 16-week suspended sentence, 150 hours of unpaid work, and was ordered to pay £540 in compensation, £85 in court costs, and an £80 victim surcharge. Kelly, who won four silver medals at last year’s World Dwarf Games—an international event organized every four years—declined to comment after sentencing. Cumbria Police stressed that hoax calls put lives at risk and that they will take action against anyone who wastes emergency service resources.

article_content: Togo has reached the quarterfinals of the Africa Cup of Nations for the first time after a tense 1-1 draw against Tunisia in South Africa on Wednesday. Tunisia’s Khalid Mouelhi missed a crucial penalty in the final 15 minutes, having already scored one earlier to cancel out Serge Gakpe’s opening goal for Togo. This milestone comes three years after the deadly attack on the Togo team before the 2010 tournament, which took the lives of two squad members in Cabinda. Togo captain Emmanuel Adebayor, who survived the attack, said the team would dedicate their achievement to their fallen teammates. 'I'm thinking of them,' Adebayor told reporters. 'We're going to take five minutes to pray for them at the hotel.' He added, 'This is our first qualification; I'm very happy for the team and my country. I can't even begin to imagine what's happening back home!' Togo will face Burkina Faso in the last eight, while Tunisia coach Sami Trabelsi expressed disappointment at his team’s exit, stating, 'We did what we had to do, we dominated the play, but we lacked a bit of finishing. I'm not here to talk about the referee -- I'm here to talk about my team. Am I satisfied with the outcome? Not really.' The match saw Togo take an early lead in the 13th minute with Serge Gakpe scoring after a pass from Adebayor. Tunisia leveled the score when Mouelhi converted a penalty following a foul on Esperance midfielder Hichri. Another penalty for Tunisia in the 75th minute gave them a chance to win, but Mouelhi’s shot struck the post. Togo coach Didier Six said, 'We were the little team in this group, and we've made it. I think there will be a big party in Lome tonight.' Elsewhere, Ivory Coast came from two goals down to draw 2-2 with Algeria in Rustenburg. Ivory Coast, having already qualified for the quarterfinals, made nine changes to their lineup. Ryad Boudebouz missed an early penalty for Algeria, but Sofiane Feghouli and Hilal Soudani put Algeria 2-0 ahead. However, quick goals from Didier Drogba and Wilfried Bony ensured a draw and an unbeaten group stage for Ivory Coast. Ivory Coast coach Sabri Lamouchi praised his team’s comeback and congratulated Algeria on a strong performance. He also noted his surprise at all North African teams exiting the tournament, expressing particular disappointment over Tunisia’s departure, as his family originates from there.

article_content: Mark McGowan, best known as the 'Artist Taxi Driver,' has carved out a niche on YouTube for his audacious performance art and bold interviews. Alongside his teaching role at the Chelsea College of Art and Design, McGowan regularly challenges authority through striking public actions—such as eating dead corgi meat to protest animal treatment by the royals, keying cars as a form of artistic dissent, and crawling seven miles to 10 Downing Street with a toy pig to oppose NHS reforms. His channel, chunkymark, showcases nearly 2,000 videos and has gathered almost 30,000 subscribers. The videos feature McGowan passionately discussing topical events and hosting interviews with notable and sometimes controversial figures, including comedian Frankie Boyle, MP George Galloway, and boat race protester Trenton Oldfield. Boyle, for example, discusses his philosophical perspectives, while McGowan expresses criticism of the monarchy and government, often using fierce and colorful language. McGowan is outspoken on issues like government policies, NHS changes, international events such as Gaza, and public expenditure, voicing strong left-wing views. He accuses the government of shifting public resources to private hands for profit and speaks forcefully against what he perceives as unjust leadership. Despite the contentious nature of his views and practices, McGowan commands a dedicated following online. Supporters praise his candid activism, and his unique mixture of protest art, social critique, and satire has gained both admiration and criticism, making him a standout figure in alternative media.

The newly launched Polar Vantage V3 sports watch is designed to meet the needs of both athletes and everyday users. Replacing the Polar Vantage V2, released in 2020, the Vantage V3 enters a competitive 2023 marketplace alongside established brands like Fitbit and Garmin.

Among its standout features is Polar's advanced biosensing technology, Polar Elixir, which offers tools such as a fourth-generation optical heart rate monitor for improved accuracy, a wrist ECG for measuring heart signals, a SpO2 sensor to monitor blood oxygen levels, and nightly skin temperature sensing. Together, these provide comprehensive insights into sleep quality and overall well-being.

The watch supports over 150 built-in sports profiles and offers training, recovery, and sleep tracking through Polar’s signature features, including Recovery Pro, Nightly Recharge, and Sleep Plus Stages. These help users track health trends and receive tailored improvement suggestions. Progress can be monitored and analyzed via the Polar Flow app and website, where users can set goals and review their physical activity in detail.

Vantage V3 offers precise GPS-based location tracking, even in challenging environments such as near tall buildings or in bad weather. It integrates with Komoot for detailed, turn-by-turn navigation, and allows users to download topographic maps—ideal for outdoor activities like hiking or mountain biking.

The watch is designed for durability and convenience, featuring a long battery life: up to 53 hours of training time (or up to 140 hours in power-saving mode) and up to eight days of display use. It offers 32GB of storage for maps and data, supports USB-C charging, and now uses standard 22mm wristbands for easier customization. Its 1.39-inch edge-to-edge AMOLED touchscreen boasts 462 pixels per inch for a sharp, vivid display, with an aluminum bezel and durable buttons.

Preorders for the Polar Vantage V3 begin October 11 at select retailers. The watch is available in Night Black, Sky Blue, and Sunrise Apricot, and priced at $599. A bundle including the Polar H10 heart rate monitor is offered at $649. Shipping starts October 25.

According to Polar CEO Sander Werring, “Athletic progress is defined by goals; setting them, working towards them, surpassing them, and setting the next ones. This requires a vast amount of personal insight only achievable through measuring and analyzing highly accurate data about your performance. This knowledge, paired with personalized guidance, is the ultimate key to progress.”

article_content: Benito Mussolini has often been the subject of mockery in Britain and was depicted by both his German allies and in popular culture as a clown. However, British historian Dr. Christian Goeschel of Manchester University presents a different view, arguing that Mussolini was actually a mentor to Adolf Hitler, and the belief that Mussolini’s troops were cowards is a myth. In his forthcoming book, 'Mussolini and Hitler: A Fatal Friendship,' to be published by Yale University Press in 2016, Dr. Goeschel challenges traditional narratives. He asserts that Italian Fascists played a crucial role in Hitler’s rise to power, with Hitler regarding Mussolini as an ideal figure in the early years. British comic strips like Beano and TV shows such as 'Allo 'Allo!' often satirized Mussolini, portraying him and Italians in a comedic light. Dr. Goeschel observes that these depictions have overshadowed the real historical impact of Mussolini’s regime. Mussolini strictly controlled the Italian press, and under Fascist rule, satire was largely suppressed, while in the UK and US, he was openly lampooned. Through detailed study of Italian archives, Dr. Goeschel found previously overlooked correspondence between Hitler and Mussolini. Initially, Hitler, then a relatively unknown politician, requested a signed photograph from Mussolini and was ignored. It was only in 1931 that Mussolini sent him a signed photo, which led to further exchanges with significant consequences for Europe. According to Dr. Goeschel, the Italian Fascists acted as senior partners to the Nazis until the mid-1930s, providing strategic advice, including how to gain support from the middle class. He also highlights that the regime committed serious abuses, such as war crimes in Ethiopia (Abyssinia), Libya, and Croatia, including the use of chemical weapons. Dr. Goeschel disputes the post-war myth of Italian military incompetence, pointing out that Italian soldiers fought bravely in North Africa, Greece, the Balkans, and Russia, and that poor leadership was a greater issue than lack of courage. Dr. Goeschel contends that persistent myths about the supposed benignity of Italian Fascism have allowed Italy to distance itself from its wartime actions. He calls for a more thorough and critical examination of Italy’s past, especially as remnants of Fascist legacy continue to appear in some aspects of Italian politics and society.
translated_content: 贝尼托·墨索里尼长期以来一直是英国讽刺的对象，在他的德国盟友和流行文化中都被描绘成小丑。然而，英国曼彻斯特大学的历史学家克里斯蒂安·戈谢尔博士提出了不同的观点，认为墨索里尼实际上是阿道夫·希特勒的导师，而有关墨索里尼部队懦弱的说法只是个神话。 在即将由耶鲁大学出版社于2016年出版的新书《墨索里尼与希特勒：一段致命的友谊》中，戈谢尔博士挑战了传统说法。他主张，意大利法西斯在希特勒掌权过程中扮演了关键角色，希特勒在早期将墨索里尼视为理想的榜样。 英国《Beano》等漫画和情景喜剧《Allo 'Allo!》常以喜剧方式讽刺墨索里尼及意大利人。戈谢尔博士指出，这些描绘掩盖了墨索里尼政权真实的历史影响。墨索里尼严格控制意大利媒体，在法西斯统治下，讽刺内容基本被禁止，而在英美却普遍对墨索里尼进行讽刺。 通过对意大利档案的详细研究，戈谢尔博士发现了此前未引起重视的希特勒与墨索里尼之间的通信。起初，彼时名不见经传的希特勒曾向墨索里尼索要签名照片却未获回应。直到1931年，墨索里尼才寄出签名照片，两人此后展开更多往来，这对欧洲历史产生了重要影响。 戈谢尔博士表示，直到1930年代中期，意大利法西斯一直是纳粹的高级合作伙伴，向其提供了包括争取中产阶级在内的战略建议。他还指出，该政权曾在埃塞俄比亚（阿比西尼亚）、利比亚和克罗地亚犯下严重罪行，包括使用化学武器等战争罪行。 戈谢尔博士反驳了战后有关意大利军队无能的神话，指出意军在北非、希腊、巴尔干和俄罗斯等地英勇作战，真正的问题更多在于领导不善而非缺乏勇气。 戈谢尔博士认为，对意大利法西斯“相对温和”的流行误解使意大利得以与战争罪行保持距离。他呼吁对意大利过去进行更彻底和批判性的审视，尤其是在当代意大利政治和社会中仍能看到法西斯遗产的痕迹。

article_content: Bottles of liquid egg whites, commonly used by bodybuilders and bakers, have been recalled after being linked to cases of salmonella. The Health Protection Agency (HPA) reported that the pasteurized product is associated with seven cases of food poisoning. Salmonella infection can cause diarrhoea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and fever. The recall specifically affects bottles of Myprotein Free Range Liquid Egg Whites, sold through Myprotein and Nutri Centre stores and websites. The affected batch is L232203 with an expiry date of February 2013 and was recalled on October 10 by the Food Standards Agency (FSA). No other Myprotein products have been reported as affected. Dr Bob Adak, head of gastrointestinal diseases at the HPA, stated that recalling the product should help prevent further illnesses. He advises anyone with this batch at home to dispose of it immediately. Although there has been no recent increase in cases of this type of salmonella, investigations are ongoing to determine if new cases are related to the product. This is the second salmonella incident linked to liquid egg whites; a similar outbreak in 2007 affected 70 people in England, Wales, and the Channel Islands. Customer notices are posted on the websites of both stockists. Customers who purchased the affected batch should contact Myprotein customer services at 0845 094 9889.

article_content: Edmond Harjo, recognized as one of the last Native American code talkers from World War II, died at 96 in Oklahoma. As a Seminole Nation member, Harjo was awarded the Congressional Gold Medal in 2013 to honor his remarkable service during the war. Code talkers like Harjo employed their tribal languages to create communication codes that the Axis powers could not decipher. Harjo served with the 195th Field Artillery Battalion and participated in major operations like Normandy and Iwo Jima. The U.S. Marines, especially in the Pacific, depended on Native American languages such as Navajo to send classified messages from 1942 to 1945. Japanese cryptographers never succeeded in breaking these codes. The ciphers often involved using Navajo words, translating them into English, and crafting codes based on the initials of these words. The system was adapted by inventing new Navajo terms for military hardware—such as 'besh-lo' for submarine and 'dah-he-tih-hi' for fighter aircraft. Few outside the tribal communities understood these languages. Harjo's career as a code talker began in southern France in 1944 when military leadership overheard him conversing in Creek dialect. He and another soldier were then assigned to safely transmit military information via radio. Former House Speaker John Boehner recounted that Harjo's actions, along with other code talkers, contributed significantly to Allied success and that their service remained confidential for many years—even from close family. Although Harjo initially thought he was being individually celebrated with the Gold Medal, his nephew Richard Harjo clarified that it was a collective honor for all code talkers. Despite this, Edmond Harjo valued the recognition deeply. He is remembered not only as a war hero, but also as an educator and classical pianist. Highly protected by the military, code talkers' work was dramatized in the 2002 film 'Windtalkers.' Their duties included relaying vital troop and tactical information; U.S. Marine leadership credited them as pivotal to the capture of Iwo Jima. The obscurity and intricacy of the Navajo language made the encryption system nearly impossible to break. Code talkers' vital contributions were largely unrecognized until the 1990s, when public acknowledgment became widespread. Harjo, who was unmarried and childless, was commemorated by his nieces and nephews at a service on April 4.
translated_content: 埃德蒙·哈尔乔（Edmond Harjo），二战最后一批印第安密码员之一，近日于俄克拉荷马去世，享年96岁。作为塞米诺尔民族成员，哈尔乔于2013年因其卓越的战争贡献获颁美国国会金质奖章。 哈尔乔等密码员利用部落语言创建出了轴心国无法破解的通讯密码。他隶属第195野战炮兵营，参与了诺曼底和硫磺岛等重大作战。1942至1945年，美国海军陆战队主要在太平洋战线通过纳瓦霍语等印第安语言传递机密信息，日本破译专家从未攻破这些密码。 密码制定通常以纳瓦霍词语编入，通过将其翻译为英文的首字母组合来形成代码。为满足军用需求，密码员还创造了全新术语，比如用“besh-lo”表示潜艇、“dah-he-tih-hi”代表战斗机。彼时，只有极少数非部落人能理解这些语言。 1944年，哈尔乔在法国南部用克里克语与同伴交流被军官注意，随后他俩被安排在无线电两端安全传递情报。前众议院议长约翰·博纳表示，哈尔乔与其他密码员极大推动了盟军胜利，而他们的身份多年保密，甚至家人也毫不知情。 哈尔乔最初认为得奖是个人荣誉，但侄子理查德说明实际上是表彰所有密码员。尽管如此，哈尔乔仍以此为荣。他不仅是英雄，还是一名教师和古典钢琴家。 密码员受到军方高度保护，他们的故事在2002年由尼古拉斯·凯奇主演的电影《风语者》中得以还原。他们负责用无线电传递部队动向及战术信息，美军指挥官就曾称他们对攻克硫磺岛有决定性作用。 纳瓦霍语的复杂和稀有令加密体系几乎无法破解。印第安密码员的贡献直到20世纪90年代才广泛被认可。哈尔乔终身未婚无子，4月4日，侄子侄女们在悼念仪式上向他致敬。

article_content: Ronald Miller, 44, was arrested after an incident at Celina Elementary School near Dallas, Texas. Miller entered the school early Wednesday morning after dropping off his child and confronted staff, asking what they would do if faced with an armed intruder. According to reports, he pointed at staff and said 'you're dead', causing panic among the teachers. Patrol Sergeant Shea Scott from the Celina Police Department noted that Miller was demanding quick responses from the staff about hypothetical threats. Miller, who was not armed, left the scene peacefully after handing staff a note offering to help with security training. He is a paramedic and former volunteer firefighter with no formal security training. Later, Miller was arrested at his home and charged with making a terrorist threat, which could result in a prison sentence of two to ten years if convicted. He is currently being held on a $75,000 bond. Parents expressed anger over the school's handling of the situation and poor communication. Some said they were not notified about the incident and would have preferred the option to pick up their children. Superintendent Donny O’Dell said the event exposed some weaknesses in the school’s security, and the district has stated that changes will be made to security procedures. As a precaution, police officers were stationed at each campus for the remainder of the day. Miller is a well-known community member, partly due to fundraising efforts for his teenage daughter Ashley, who passed away in 2011 from a rare form of cancer. The school district defended its response, saying that at no time were students believed to be in harm's way. The case reflects heightened concerns over school security following the Sandy Hook Elementary School tragedy. In a separate incident, Jordan Pritchard, a Nashville marine, stood unarmed outside his children's elementary school to provide security in the aftermath of Sandy Hook.

Passengers flying out of Simon Bolivar International Airport in Caracas, Venezuela, are now subject to a fee designed to fund a newly installed air conditioning system. Beginning July 1, travelers on both domestic and international flights are required to pay 127 bolivars (about £12) at check-in.

Airport officials state that the new air conditioning unit, which was installed in May, is the first of its kind in South America and aims to eliminate environmental contaminants for improved public health. The so-called 'fresh air charge' has drawn criticism on social media, with passengers raising concerns about poor conditions at the airport, such as malfunctioning toilets, high indoor temperatures, and stray dogs inside the facility.

The Venezuelan aviation industry continues to grapple with broader issues. The International Air Transport Association (IATA) has accused the government of blocking the repatriation of $4 billion in airline ticket sales due to currency controls. As a result, multiple international airlines have scaled back routes or suspended flights. Delta Air Lines recently reduced its service by 85%, now operating only one roundtrip flight per weekend between Atlanta and Caracas. American Airlines has also significantly cut its routes, while Air Canada suspended service earlier this year.

In response, Venezuela’s government has agreed to partially pay the funds owed to several foreign airlines and may soon allow fare increases in an attempt to retain international carriers. Finance Minister Rodolfo Marco Torres stated in May that six Latin American airlines, including Avianca and AeroMexico, can now repatriate revenue from local sales in 2012 and 2013.

机场方面表示，这套于五月安装的新空调系统是南美首例，旨在消除环境污染物，提升公共健康水平。被称为“清新空气费”的这项收费在社交媒体上引发了许多批评，不少旅客反映机场卫生间故障、温度过高，甚至有流浪狗出没。

委内瑞拉航空业还面临更广泛难题。国际航空运输协会（IATA）指责政府由于外汇管制，阻止航空公司汇回40亿美元的机票收入，导致多家国际航空公司缩减或暂停飞委航班。达美航空最近将服务比重削减85%，现每周仅有一班亚特兰大至加拉加斯的往返航班。美国航空同样大幅缩减航线，加拿大航空早前已全面停飞。

作为回应，委内瑞拉政府同意向部分外资航空公司偿还部份拖欠款项，并有望允许票价上涨以保住国际航线。财政部长鲁道夫·马尔科·托雷斯于五月表示，包括Avianca和AeroMexico在内的六家拉美航空公司现可汇回2012年和2013年本地销售所得收入。

article_content: In CNN's 'Behind the Scenes' series, correspondents share their experiences and provide context for major stories. Chris Lawrence reports on the challenges faced by high school students in Los Angeles as part of the 'Broken Schools' series on CNN's American Morning. At Jefferson High School in Los Angeles, almost 75% of students' parents did not complete high school. LOS ANGELES, California (CNN) – It's the first week of freshman year. Four girls wait outside Jefferson High School, chatting before class. Statistically, only one or two of them will graduate. Thirteen-year-old Ana Rosa Gutierrez already says she finds school boring and unhelpful, believing she needs to work to support her family. Asked about her brother, Ana Rosa explains he and most of his friends dropped out to earn money. Her brother left school at 16. Inside the classroom, many seats are empty. The teacher calls names; some, like Louis Romero, are absent. At Jefferson, this is common—with a dropout rate of about 58%. Principal Juan Flecha expresses concern, stating, 'I'm not proud of having the highest dropout rate in the system,' but acknowledges that poverty and family situations are significant challenges. Many families are led by single mothers with limited resources, putting pressure on teens to work. Jefferson is in a predominantly immigrant neighborhood, with many students learning English as a second language. About half lack English exposure at home. To address this, the school has extended its day to focus on language skills. Superintendent David Brewer points out the difficulty of students mastering English and complex subjects like algebra and Shakespeare. Most parents of Jefferson students lack a high school education themselves, so educational support at home is limited. The school works with the city attorney's 'Operation Bright Future' program to fight truancy and gang involvement. Parents are warned of legal consequences if children miss too much school. Jefferson cannot be separated from its neighborhood realities. The school went into lockdown on the first day of classes because of a shooting nearby. Students like Ana Rosa carefully plan their routes to avoid unsafe areas. Despite these challenges, there are hopeful signs. In 2005, only half of seniors passed the graduation exam; last year, nearly three-fourths succeeded. The school has enhanced security and created specialized academic tracks. 'Dropout advisors' have increased home visits to re-engage absent students. Jefferson recently qualified for almost $2 million in state funding, planning to hire 10 new teachers and a psychiatric social worker. Still, for students like Ana Rosa who remain uncertain about the value of school in their lives, the future is unclear. When asked if she'll stay in school, Ana Rosa answers, 'Hopefully. Hopefully, I will. I don't know... I'm not sure.'

A series of powerful, shallow earthquakes struck a sparsely populated island chain in eastern Indonesia on Wednesday. There were no immediate reports of damage or casualties. The U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) reported a magnitude 6.9 quake in an area 341 kilometers (211 miles) southwest of Tual, a coastal town in Maluku province, at a depth of 10 kilometers (6.2 miles). Shortly afterward, another 7.0 magnitude earthquake hit the same area, followed by two aftershocks measuring 5.1 in magnitude.

Indonesia's Meteorology, Climatology and Geophysical Agency stated there was no tsunami threat but advised residents to remain alert for aftershocks. Villagers in the Tanimbar Islands experienced strong tremors lasting several minutes but did not panic, according to National Disaster Mitigation Agency spokesperson Abul Muhari. He explained that the epicenter was located in the Banda Sea near the Tanimbar Islands, home to about 127,000 people.

With a population of over 270 million, Indonesia frequently experiences earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and tsunamis due to its position on the Pacific 'Ring of Fire,' an arc of volcanoes and fault lines. In 2004, a 9.1 magnitude earthquake triggered a tsunami that killed more than 230,000 people in a dozen countries, most of them in Indonesia's Aceh province.

article_content: Helped by higher humidity, firefighters gained ground against a wind-driven wildfire in Southern California, allowing many evacuated residents to return home. The Powerhouse Fire, burning in the Palmdale area north of Los Angeles, has destroyed six homes, threatened up to 1,000 more, and grown to over 32,000 acres as of late Monday, according to Lisa Lugo with the Angeles National Forest. Three people have been injured since the fire started last week, though their injuries were not immediately specified. Incident commander Norm Walker told reporters, 'So far things look much better than they did yesterday. Last night, we increased containment to 40%. We hope to increase that number further tonight if conditions remain the same.' Later, Lugo stated that containment had reached 60%. Residents evacuated from the communities of Lake Hughes and Lake Elizabeth were allowed to return home, but Antelope Acres remained under a mandatory evacuation order. A shelter has opened for those unable to return home. Helicopters supported firefighters by dropping fire retardant and water along the blaze's perimeter. Los Angeles County Fire Capt. Mike McCormick told CNN affiliate KABC, 'We want to take advantage of the high humidity, get in there for a direct attack, and do all we can to put out hot spots so the fire doesn't spread anymore.' In Jefferson County, Colorado, a small wildfire prompted evacuations but caused no structural damage, according to the Sheriff's Office. Meanwhile, another fire north of Pecos, New Mexico, the Tres Lagunas Fire, has burned about 8,000 acres and forced evacuation of around 100 summer homes, said Denise Ottaviano of New Mexico Fire Information. The Tres Lagunas Fire is 5% contained and is believed to have been started by a downed power line. CNN's Diahann Reyes contributed to this report.

The U.S. Air Force has dismissed nine mid-level nuclear commanders and plans to discipline dozens of junior officers at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana following a two-year exam-cheating scandal. Officials have described these actions as unprecedented within the history of the intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) force. While the nine removed commanders were not directly involved in the cheating, investigations found significant shortcomings in their leadership.

Although the Air Force initially believed the cheating occurred in late 2013, further investigation revealed it actually spanned from November 2011 through November 2013. The scandal centered on officers sharing unauthorized answers to tests designed to ensure proficiency in managing 'emergency war orders'—critical instructions for the targeting and launching of nuclear missiles. When the misconduct first came to light in January, Air Force leaders denounced it as a violation of core values and suggested it stemmed in part from intense pressures to achieve perfect scores.

Col. Robert Stanley II, the commander of Malmstrom at the time, has resigned, but no Air Force generals are being disciplined in connection with the scandal. The investigation unfolded as part of a broader drug probe that implicated a number of launch officers across multiple bases. Over 100 missile launch crew members at Malmstrom were identified as potentially involved; while nine were cleared, others may face criminal charges related to the mishandling of classified information.

The repercussions extend to key command positions at Malmstrom: the leaders of all three missile squadrons and the operations group have been dismissed. Some officers implicated in the cheating may be retrained and returned to duty, while further disciplinary actions, possibly including dismissal, are under consideration for others.

In response, the Air Force has announced reforms aimed at improving leadership, training, morale, and reinforcing core values like integrity and accountability. Defense Secretary Chuck Hagel has ordered comprehensive reviews of the nuclear forces, aiming to restore public trust and confidence following a series of challenges and internal failings.

article_content: The BBC faced renewed questions over its independence after the UK government was accused of pressuring the broadcaster in its response to allegations against presenter Huw Edwards. Emails released through a Freedom of Information request show that a senior official from the Department for Digital, Culture, Media & Sport (DCMS) directly pushed the BBC to urgently investigate, following media reports that Edwards had sent money to a teenager in exchange for explicit photographs. Though the BBC is meant to be free from government control, officials from DCMS, specifically director of media Robert Specterman-Green, contacted the BBC's chief of staff Phil Harrold on July 8, stating that the government expected the broadcaster to handle the situation swiftly and thoroughly. Specterman-Green’s message came before the BBC board met to address the matter. Harrold responded that the BBC was approaching the issue with seriousness. The following day, Culture Secretary Lucy Frazer said she’d spoken with BBC director general Tim Davie about the serious nature of the allegations and emphasized the importance of an independent review. Edwards was suspended later the same day. In the days after, Frazer held further calls with Davie and BBC’s acting chair Elan Closs Stephens. Critics—including a senior Conservative MP and a former BBC journalist—suggested the government’s actions overstepped its proper role and reflected a misunderstanding of the broadcaster’s independence. The DCMS defended itself, saying it simply reminded the BBC of its responsibilities and did not issue directives about what to do. The BBC asserted it was already investigating the matter prior to government involvement. Later, Baroness Stowell questioned Frazer’s role in the episode, but Frazer maintained that the severity of the situation justified government input. Vicky Flind, Huw Edwards’ wife, subsequently identified him and revealed he was being treated for serious mental health issues. Edwards has not commented publicly, and police have stated the allegations did not meet the threshold for a criminal investigation. Months later, Edwards remains suspended, with negotiations about his departure ongoing. BBC plans for live coverage have been adjusted to account for his likely absence, while sources indicate that findings from an internal review have been shared with Edwards amid little sign of his return. The internal process has been kept confidential, and there is no clear information about the results or Edwards’ response. Additional allegations surfaced, such as breaches of Covid restrictions and inappropriate communications. The BBC said it would not comment on individual employment matters, urging against speculation; Edwards’ lawyer declined to issue a statement. This controversy has reignited debates about the BBC’s independence from government. Similar questions arose previously when BBC director general Tim Davie communicated with government officials during Gary Lineker’s suspension after impartiality rule concerns.

article_content: Eric Castel emerged as a cultural icon for young football fans through his comic book exploits as a star for both Barcelona and Paris Saint-Germain. Conceived by artist Raymond Reding alongside Françoise Hugues, Castel's stories from 1979 to 1992 captured the imaginations of readers across Europe. Reding, who had previously contributed to Tintin and crafted other sporting heroes, depicted Castel with striking realism. Though Castel adopted alternate names such as Ronnie Hansen in the Netherlands and Kai Falke in Germany, his core character was always consistent. The comic’s appeal extended beyond football action, focusing on Castel’s friendships with the ‘Pablitos’—a group of local children, including Pablito Varela—enabling fans to dream of connecting with their heroes. Castel’s fictional narrative included dramatic moments: he transferred from Barcelona to PSG in 1984, leading PSG to defeat his old team in the fictional CEVA Cup—a storyline that shocked fans. However, Castel ultimately returned to Barcelona, experiencing an emotional homecoming and guiding his team to victory in the CEVA Cup. Figures such as filmmaker Uri Garcia and FIFA agent Olivier Jouanneaux note that Castel resonated because his comics combined thrilling football, lifelike illustrations, and relatable coming-of-age plots. Real-life footballers, including Xavi, and club officials have referenced Castel’s inspirational influence. Now, with Barcelona and PSG competing in actual European tournaments, Castel’s legacy endures, with fans nostalgic for the days when the lines between comic fantasy and football reality seemed to blur. As Garcia suggests, Castel would certainly support Barça, affirming the character’s lasting bond with the club’s supporters.
translated_content: 埃里克·卡斯特尔凭借在漫画中为巴塞罗那和巴黎圣日耳曼效力的传奇经历，成为无数年轻球迷心中的文化偶像。在艺术家雷蒙德·雷丁与弗朗索瓦丝·于格斯的共同创作下，卡斯特尔自1979年至1992年的故事点燃了整个欧洲读者的想象力。 雷丁本人曾参与过《丁丁历险记》等作品，并塑造了众多体育英雄，他用极具写实风格的画笔展现了卡斯特尔的形象。尽管卡斯特尔在荷兰被称为罗尼·汉森、在德国叫凯·法尔克，但他的性格与形象始终保持一致。 这部漫画不仅展现了足球场上的激情，更着重描绘了卡斯特尔与“帕布利托们”——以帕布利托·瓦雷拉为代表的一群本地小孩——之间的深厚友谊，让粉丝们幻想着自己也能成为球星的伙伴。 卡斯特尔的虚构生涯充满戏剧性转折：1984年他从巴萨转会至巴黎圣日耳曼，还率队在虚构的CEVA杯上击败了老东家，这一情节曾令粉丝震惊。后来，卡斯特尔又重返巴萨，完成情感回归，并带领球队赢得了CEVA杯冠军。 如纪录片导演尤里·加西亚和FIFA经纪人奥利维耶·朱安诺所说，卡斯特尔之所以深入人心，是因为漫画将激动人心的足球、栩栩如生的画风和贴近成长经历的故事线完美结合。现实世界中的球员如哈维，乃至俱乐部高层，也都承认卡斯特尔产生过重要影响。 如今，巴萨与大巴黎在欧冠赛场上再度交锋，卡斯特尔的传说依旧激起粉丝们的怀旧之情，仿佛漫画幻想与足球现实早已融为一体。正如加西亚所言，卡斯特尔如今还在，肯定还是坚定的巴萨拥趸——他与俱乐部支持者之间的纽带仍未断裂。

article_content: Sarah, Duchess of York, posted a series of cryptic tweets reflecting on her past 'recklessness' and her thoughts on forgiveness. Prince Andrew's former wife, who was involved in a 2010 media sting by the News of the World, wrote: 'Sometimes we look back at our life, dropping our jaw at our stupid recklessness.' A minute later, she added: 'Forgiveness comes when we have the chance to see it as a learning curve and move forward with knowledge, also forgiving ourselves.' Friends of the Duchess, who has over 78,000 Twitter followers, were uncertain about the timing of her messages. Still, one friend remarked, 'She is in a good place now. She has clearly rebuilt her life after the challenges of recent years.' Sarah Ferguson experienced a turbulent period during and after her marriage to Prince Andrew, beginning in 1986. She faced public scandals and ultimately divorced in 1996. Princess Margaret reportedly criticized her conduct in a letter. Following the divorce, Sarah received a settlement of £300,000 but later amassed debts of up to £4 million. To address her finances, she took on various work commitments, including a role with WeightWatchers. Despite efforts to regain stability, a US venture to capitalize on her image failed in 2006, increasing her debts. She later faced a tabloid sting operation. In more recent years, sources report that her debts were paid off, mainly with Prince Andrew's support, and she continues to live with him at Royal Lodge, Windsor. Sarah has since lost over two stone in weight and is now involved in new projects, such as initiatives to tackle obesity and a film project about Prince Albert. Sources say, 'The Duchess is doing well. She has lost weight sensibly and is pursuing multiple business and charitable projects. She is focused on the future.'

article_content: Former UK Prime Minister Tony Blair has warned that British troops may need to return to Iraq to help combat the Islamic State (IS) militant group, emphasizing that the nation must be prepared to accept potential casualties if such action is taken. In a detailed 6,500-word essay published on his website, Blair concedes there is little public appetite for redeployment following the UK’s previous military involvement in Iraq and Afghanistan. Despite this, he argues that deploying ground forces might be the only effective way to defeat IS fighters, who have taken control of significant parts of Iraq and Syria and killed several Western hostages recently. IS is currently threatening to kill British taxi driver and aid worker Alan Henning, who was captured last December while delivering humanitarian aid to Syria. Blair asserts that airstrikes alone will not be sufficient, stating that while air power is vital, it cannot defeat IS on its own. He believes that providing arms and training to regional forces can help, but emphasizes that Western ground troops might still be necessary in some circumstances, especially if requested by those directly affected and as part of a broad international alliance. Meanwhile, Prime Minister David Cameron plans to discuss potential British air strikes with US President Barack Obama, though he has largely ruled out sending ground troops. Parliament may be recalled to approve the proposed air campaign. Labour leader Ed Miliband has said he and Labour MPs might support air strikes if the mission has clear objectives and a basis in international law. The case of Alan Henning has prompted widespread appeals for his release, including statements from his wife Barbara and many UK Muslim leaders, who describe him as selfless and compassionate. Even some radical figures have condemned IS’s detention of Henning, while others, including Anjem Choudary, have made controversial remarks. Blair highlights that the challenge from IS is not just a fringe problem but one rooted in broader ideological currents, calling for a comprehensive response.

article_content: India and Australia are set to hold discussions aimed at enhancing their strategic, defense, and security cooperation on Monday in New Delhi. Australian Foreign Minister Penny Wong and Defense Minister Richard Marles have arrived to meet their Indian counterparts for the second India–Australia 2+2 Dialogue, where they are expected to cover regional and global issues, according to India's Ministry of External Affairs. "Both sides will also exchange views on shared priorities for strengthening minilateral and multilateral cooperation," the Ministry stated. Defense Minister Rajnath Singh will hold a bilateral meeting with Marles, who also serves as Australia's Deputy Prime Minister. On Tuesday, Indian Minister of External Affairs Subramanyam Jaishankar will review bilateral relations with Wong. The talks take place shortly after India hosted U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken and U.S. Secretary of Defense Lloyd Austin in New Delhi, during which India and the United States agreed to enhance security ties and reiterated their support for a free and resilient Indo-Pacific region. India and Australia are also members of the Quad—alongside Japan and the United States—an alliance intended to address China's growing influence in Asia. The two countries upgraded their relationship to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership in 2020, resulting in several agreements to boost defense and Indo-Pacific cooperation. Earlier this year, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese visited India, meeting with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and commending progress in scientific, technological, and military collaboration. Marles arrived Sunday, attending the Cricket World Cup final in Ahmedabad, where Australia defeated India to claim their sixth title, ending India's strong run in the tournament.

Elon Musk visited Israel amid significant criticism related to his platform, X, and its handling of antisemitic content. During his trip, Musk toured Kfar Azza, a kibbutz attacked by Hamas on October 7, guided by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. He also met with Israeli President Isaac Herzog, who confronted him over the proliferation of hate and antisemitism on X. Herzog, meeting alongside families of Hamas hostages, stressed that Musk could play a vital role in combating online antisemitism.

Wearing a protective vest and surrounded by security, Musk documented the aftermath with his phone. He and Netanyahu visited victims' homes, including the family of Abigail Edan, a four-year-old Israeli-American who was recently freed during a pause in hostilities. Musk remarked on the powerful impact of witnessing the destruction and discussed how propaganda can lead people to justify violence.

Musk's visit coincided with a temporary extension of the Israel-Hamas cease-fire. X has faced increased scrutiny since the war began, with companies such as Disney and IBM halting advertisements over concerns their ads appeared next to extremist content. Musk drew more criticism for responding positively to an antisemitic post on X.

X has since filed a lawsuit against Media Matters, accusing the group of intentionally deterring advertisers. The Israeli government also finalized an agreement regarding Musk's Starlink service, stipulating that it can only operate in Israel and Gaza with government approval.

他身穿防弹背心，在安保护送下用手机记录受灾现场。马斯克与内塔尼亚胡一起探访了受害者的家庭，包括在暂停交火期间获释的美以双重国籍四岁女孩阿比盖尔·埃丹的家人。目睹破坏后，马斯克表示深受触动，并谈到宣传如何能让人们合理化暴力行为。

article_content:
Indian companies are anticipating a 9.8% increase in employee salaries in 2024, nearly matching the 10% hike recorded in 2023. According to the Salary Budget Planning Report by Willis Towers Watson (WTW), this positions India at the forefront of salary increases in the Asia Pacific (APAC) region. The report, cited by the Economic Times, attributes this trend to a tighter labor market and rising inflation.

Over half of Indian companies increased their salary budgets in 2023, and about a quarter of them exceeded projections made in December 2022, the survey notes. The sectors expected to see the highest salary hikes in 2024 are technology, media and gaming, financial services, and retail, each projected at 10%.

Companies in the banking, financial services and insurance (BFSI) sector, retail, and captives expect slightly higher increases for 2024 compared to the actual increments in 2023 — 10% for BFSI, 10% for retail, and 9.9% for captives. This is largely due to ongoing demand for skilled talent in these areas. Rajul Mathur, Consulting Leader for Work and Rewards at WTW India, noted that organizations across industries are carefully monitoring their cost structures.

The Salary Budget Planning Report gathered responses from around 32,512 companies across 150 countries between April and May 2023.

Within APAC, India maintains the highest expected salary increase for 2024, followed by Vietnam (8%), China (6%), the Philippines (5.7%), and Thailand (5%). Regarding hiring, about 28% of companies surveyed plan to hire in the coming year, and nearly 60% expanded their workforce in 2023 compared to 2022.

The most in-demand roles for the next 12 months are Information Technology (61%), Engineering (59.8%), Sales (42.9%), Technical Skills Trade (38.6%), Finance (11.8%), Marketing (10.6%), and Human Resources (3.1%).

印度企业预计2024年员工薪资将上涨9.8%，几乎与2023年10%的涨幅持平。根据韦莱韬悦（WTW）发布的《薪酬预算规划报告》，这使印度位列亚太地区薪资增长之首。该报告被《经济时报》引用，认为劳动力市场紧张和通货膨胀上升是推动这一趋势的主要因素。

报告显示，2023年，超过一半的印度企业增加了薪酬预算，约四分之一企业的实际支出超过了2022年12月时的预算预期。预计2024年涨薪幅度最高的行业包括科技、媒体与游戏、金融服务和零售业，各行业预计涨幅均为10%。

银行、金融服务和保险（BFSI）、零售以及独立业务部门等领域企业，预计2024年涨薪幅度将略高于2023年实际增幅——BFSI和零售业预计均为10%，独立业务部门为9.9%。这主要由于这些领域对高技能人才的持续需求。WTW印度区工作与薪酬咨询负责人Rajul Mathur表示，不同领域的企业都在密切关注自身成本结构。

article_content: Pakistan’s national football team achieved a historic milestone on Tuesday, earning their first-ever FIFA World Cup qualifying match victory by defeating Cambodia 1-0 in Islamabad. After a scoreless draw in the first leg held in Phnom Penh, it was Harun Hamid’s second-leg half-volley at Jinnah Sports Stadium that secured the win. This game marked Pakistan’s first home international match since 2015 and ended a winless spell dating back to 2018. Ranked 197th by FIFA, Pakistan now advances to the qualifiers’ second round, where they will face Saudi Arabia, Tajikistan, and Jordan, beginning in November. Pakistan’s football history includes major challenges, such as a 15-month FIFA suspension in 2021 due to third-party interference, their second ban in four years. The current qualifying round features ten advancing teams from two-leg playoff matches among the Asian Football Confederation’s lowest-ranked nations. In other qualifier matches: Singapore topped Guam with a 3-1 aggregate (including a 1-0 win on Tuesday), Afghanistan beat Mongolia 2-0 on aggregate, and Yemen moved forward past Sri Lanka (ranked 202nd) after a 1-1 draw and earlier home win for a 4-1 aggregate. (Source: Associated Press)
