article_content: West Point, New York (CNN) -- President Obama announced on Tuesday that the deployment of 30,000 additional U.S. troops to Afghanistan is part of a strategy to reverse the Taliban's momentum and stabilize the Afghan government. "There is no imminent threat of the government being overthrown, but the Taliban has gained momentum," Obama stated at the U.S. Military Academy at West Point. "Al Qaeda has not re-emerged in Afghanistan in the same numbers as before 9/11, but they retain their safe havens along the border. Our forces currently lack the full support they need to effectively train and partner with Afghan security forces and better protect the population. In short, the status quo is not sustainable." Obama said he would begin deploying the additional troops "as quickly as possible" starting in early 2010, aiming to start withdrawing forces from Afghanistan by July 2011. The president explained that these additional U.S. troops, together with NATO forces, would help accelerate the transition of security responsibilities to Afghan forces. Senior administration officials stated that Obama hopes to withdraw most U.S. troops by the end of his current term, which concludes in January 2013. The new deployment marks the second increase of U.S. forces in Afghanistan since Obama took office in January. In his address, Obama outlined three core objectives: deny al Qaeda a safe haven, reverse the Taliban's momentum and prevent it from overthrowing Afghanistan's government, and strengthen Afghanistan's security forces and government. He added that strategies would also involve holding Afghan leaders accountable for corruption, focusing aid on programs that improve Afghans' lives, and securing Afghanistan's border with Pakistan. "We are in Afghanistan to prevent a cancer from again spreading throughout the country. But this cancer has also taken root in the border region of Pakistan. That's why we need a strategy that works on both sides of the border," Obama said. He rejected sending more troops for an undefined nation-building mission without a set deadline, arguing that such an approach would lack clear objectives and urgency. "It must be clear that Afghans will have to take responsibility for their own security, and that America has no interest in fighting an endless war in Afghanistan." Obama also dismissed comparisons to the Vietnam War, noting that "unlike Vietnam, we are joined by a coalition of 43 nations, are not facing a broad-based insurgency, and the American people were directly attacked from Afghanistan." Obama stressed that the U.S. does not intend to occupy Afghanistan, and supports efforts to reconcile with Taliban members who renounce violence and respect human rights. "We seek a partnership with Afghanistan based on mutual respect — to isolate those who destroy, support those who build, hasten the day our troops depart, and foster lasting friendship," Obama added. The speech was delivered to cadets, staff, and guests at West Point. Obama acknowledged the sacrifices of those who have served or will serve in Afghanistan. He noted the increased U.S. presence will enable better training of Afghan security forces and facilitate the transition of responsibility to them. Obama also called on NATO allies to contribute more troops and expressed confidence in their support. "Our friends have fought and died alongside us in Afghanistan. We must now work together to end this war successfully. What is at stake is not only NATO's credibility but the security of our allies and global security as a whole." With the new deployment, U.S. troops in Afghanistan will total around 100,000, supplemented by more than 40,000 NATO troops. A Pentagon official stated that the administration is pushing for a faster deployment than initially outlined by Gen. McChrystal, with a "very aggressive" six-month timeline for sending new troops. Obama spoke with Afghan President Hamid Karzai by videoconference Tuesday regarding the deployment decision. According to the White House, the president emphasized that U.S. and international efforts in Afghanistan should be evaluated based on measurable and achievable goals within 18 to 24 months. The troop surge comes with political risks for Obama, including opposition from some members of his own party and concerns about its cost during a time of high unemployment and competing domestic needs. The U.S. invasion of Afghanistan followed the September 11, 2001 terror attacks, after which the Taliban regime was overthrown but many insurgent leaders escaped. Taliban forces have since regrouped near the Afghanistan-Pakistan border, where U.S. and allied forces continue to battle insurgents. Al Qaeda leaders Osama bin Laden and Ayman al-Zawahiri remain at large in the region. The conflict has resulted in the deaths of more than 900 American and nearly 600 allied service members.
translated_content: 纽约西点（CNN）——奥巴马总统周二宣布，为了扭转塔利班的势头并稳定阿富汗政府，美军将增派3万名士兵前往阿富汗。 奥巴马在西点军校表示：“目前阿富汗政府没有被推翻的直接威胁，但塔利班势力已在增长。” “‘基地’组织并未像9/11前那样在阿富汗重新集结，但他们仍在边境有庇护所。我们的部队还未获得足够支持，难以有效训练和协助阿富汗安全部队，更好保护平民。总之，现状无法持续。” 奥巴马表示，将从2010年初以“最快速度”开始增兵，计划在2011年7月开始撤军。 总统解释，此次增兵将与北约部队合作，加快把安全责任交给阿富汗部队。 高级官员称，奥巴马希望在2013年1月任期结束前撤出大部分美军。 这是奥巴马自上任以来第二次下令向阿富汗增兵。 奥巴马在演讲中提出三大目标：拒绝‘基地’组织庇护所、扭转塔利班势头并防止其推翻政府、加强阿富汗安全部队及政府能力。 他还指出，其他措施包括追究阿富汗领导人腐败责任，把援助重点放在能改善民生的项目上，以及加强与巴基斯坦的边境安全。 奥巴马说：“我们在阿富汗，是为了防止‘癌症’再次蔓延。但这一‘癌症’也在巴基斯坦边境生根，所以我们要两边同时制定对策。” 他拒绝在没有明确期限的情况下增兵从事国家建设，认为缺乏目标和紧迫感。 他说：“阿富汗人必须对自己的安全负责，美国无意打无休止的阿富汗战争。” 奥巴马否认阿富汗战争是‘第二个越南’，称“与越南不同，我们有43国合作，不面临大规模叛乱，美国人民也曾直接遭阿富汗极端分子攻击。” 奥巴马重申美方不占领阿富汗，支持与放弃暴力、尊重人权的塔利班分子和解。 他表示：“我们要与阿富汗建立互相尊重的伙伴关系——打击破坏者，支持建设者，加快美军撤离，建立持久友谊。” 奥巴马在西点讲话，向曾在阿富汗服役及即将服役的人员致敬。 他指出，增兵有助于更好训练阿富汗安保部队，并顺利移交责任。 奥巴马呼吁北约盟友提供更多兵力，并对其支持充满信心。 他说：“我们的盟友在阿富汗并肩作战、流血牺牲。现在我们必须共同努力赢得胜利，这不仅关系北约信誉，还关乎盟友和全球安全。” 增兵后，美军在阿富汗将达约10万人，另有4万多北约军人协助。 五角大楼官员称，白宫增兵计划比麦克里斯特尔将军最初建议更快，拟在6个月内完成部署，被称为“非常激进”的时间表。 奥巴马周二通过视频会谈与阿富汗总统卡尔扎伊讨论增兵决定。白宫称，总统强调，美方及国际努力要在未来18至24个月以内评估具体、可达成目标。 此次增兵为奥巴马带来政治风险，包括党内部分人士反对，以及高失业率和国内优先事项下对费用的担忧。 美国2001年“9·11”袭击后进军阿富汗，推翻塔利班政权，但多数武装头目逃脱。 塔利班已在阿富汗与巴基斯坦边界重组，美军及盟军持续打击叛乱。‘基地’头目本·拉登和扎瓦希里仍潜伏于该地区。 这场冲突已造成900多名美军和近600名盟军人员牺牲。

article_content: Metropolitan Police Commissioner Sir Bernard Hogan-Howe has expressed support for a pay raise for police officers, noting that years of pay freezes have negatively affected their living standards. His remarks were made after Prime Minister David Cameron encouraged businesses to increase staff wages due to favorable economic conditions in Britain. During an LBC radio interview, Sir Bernard emphasized that police, like many other workers, have endured stagnant salaries and would benefit from improved compensation. He highlighted that last year’s police pay rise was just 1%—below inflation—following several years of pay freezes after the 2008 recession. He added that rising living costs, particularly in London, make fair pay for officers even more crucial. Cameron’s appeal for higher private sector pay has faced criticism, with opponents accusing the government of double standards since public sector workers continue to face salary freezes or minimal increases. Unions maintain that average wages are now worth £2,500 less per year compared to when Cameron became prime minister, due to pay not keeping up with inflation. Union leaders, including Frances O’Grady of the TUC, consider Cameron’s comments to be political maneuvering before the elections and warn that continued austerity would push public sector wages even lower. Len McCluskey of Unite called for raising the minimum wage by at least £1.50 per hour and ensuring a living wage, while Dave Prentis from Unison criticized the government for not fully adopting NHS pay recommendations. Sir Bernard also experienced an awkward moment in the interview when he was unable to recall the anti-terror hotline number—an initiative he has promoted to encourage public reporting of extremist activity. He later acknowledged the number is 0800 789 321 and noted its lack of memorability. Additionally, Sir Bernard mentioned that the ongoing police operation outside the Ecuadorian embassy, where WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange remains to avoid extradition to Sweden, is imposing a significant burden on police resources. With costs nearing £10 million, the operation is under review. Assange has been in the embassy since June 2012 and has received widespread attention since WikiLeaks began releasing classified US documents in 2010.

article_content: Kim Middleton, a 29-year-old mother from Middlesbrough, North Yorkshire, transformed her health and figure by replacing unhealthy snacks with regular hula hooping. She successfully reduced her dress size from a UK 16 to a UK 8. Her weight peaked at 12 stone 9 pounds after giving birth to her daughter, Elisha, now eight, as she often depended on takeaways and crisps due to her busy life as a single mother and teaching assistant. Kim felt discouraged when she realized she couldn't help Elisha learn to ride a bike because she was not fit enough. Seeking change, Kim began using her daughter's toy hula hoop and soon observed gradual weight loss. She shared, 'I was tired of being too unfit to play with my daughter. As a single mum, I'd often eat on the go—sausage rolls, crisps, and takeaways. I wasn't exercising and lacked confidence.' Kim had faced weight challenges since childhood, but decided to act when she nearly reached 13 stone and wore a size 16. Determined to improve, she joined Slimming World and adopted healthier eating, recognizing she needed exercise for her goals. Inspired by her daughter, Kim started hula hooping while watching TV several times a week. The process was initially tough and caused a few bruises, but with persistence, she saw her body change. Within a month of regular hula-hooping, Kim noticed significant weight loss. Over 18 months, she lost approximately three and a half stone and became a toned UK size 8. Now at 9 stone 4 pounds, Kim is proud of her progress and recommends hula hooping as a convenient fitness activity for busy people. She now works as a Slimming World consultant and shares hula hooping tips with her group. Kim explained, 'It wasn't easy, but my daughter motivated me. We now hula hoop together, and even my friends and family have taken it up. It's a fun way to exercise and tone up—even while watching TV!' Her previous diet consisted of toast for breakfast; lunch with crisps, sausage rolls, and chocolate; dinners from takeaways; and snacks like biscuits and crisps. Currently, her breakfast is fruit or porridge, lunch features healthy foods like jacket potatoes or salad, dinners are homemade with vegetables, and she avoids unhealthy snacks. Kim is delighted that she can now actively spend time with her daughter in the park, and encourages others seeking fitness to try hula hooping.

article_content: A recent study published on October 11, 2023, in the open-access journal PLOS ONE has provided new insights into the diets of pre-Columbian Caribbean cultures through DNA analysis of mummified feces, also known as coprolites. Led by Jelissa Reynoso-García from the University of Puerto Rico, researchers analyzed plant DNA from samples collected at the La Hueca archaeological site, focusing on the Huecoid and Saladoid cultures. The analysis revealed that these peoples consumed a wide array of plants, including maize, sweet potato, wild and domesticated peanuts, chili peppers, domesticated tomatoes, papaya, and tobacco. Cotton was also detected, possibly as a result of using cotton seeds for oil or through the practice of moistening cotton strands with saliva while weaving. Interestingly, no evidence of cassava (manioc/yucca) was found, even though chroniclers often described it as a staple food in the pre-Columbian Caribbean. Researchers suggest that traditional cassava preparation methods, such as grating and drying, may have degraded its DNA, or that cassava was consumed only seasonally. The presence of tobacco is notable and may be due to its medicinal or ritual use—whether chewed, inhaled, or used as a food additive. However, the study notes several limitations, including the inability to identify extinct or rare plants not present in DNA databases, as well as the fact each coprolite provides only a snapshot of an individual's recent meals. Despite these challenges, the researchers hope their work will deepen understanding of pre-Columbian Caribbean life. As Dr. Toranzos commented, it's remarkable how much ancient coprolites can reveal, even after thousands of years.
translated_content: 2023年10月11日发表在开放获取期刊PLOS ONE的一项最新研究，通过分析木乃伊化粪便（即粪化石）的DNA，揭示了前哥伦布时期加勒比文化的饮食新见解。该研究由波多黎各大学的Jelissa Reynoso-García领导，团队分析了在La Hueca考古遗址采集的粪化石样本中的植物DNA，重点关注Huecoid和Saladoid两种文化。 分析结果显示，这些人在饮食中摄入了多种植物，包括玉米、红薯、野生与栽培花生、辣椒、栽培番茄、番木瓜和烟草。还检测到棉花，可能与他们使用棉籽榨油，或在纺织时用唾液润湿棉线的做法有关。 有趣的是，尽管历史记载常提到木薯（也称木薯/甘薯）是前哥伦布加勒比的重要主食，研究却未发现其DNA。研究人员推测，传统的木薯处理方法如磨碎和晾干可能导致其DNA降解，或木薯只是季节性食物。 烟草的存在也很有意思，可能用于药用或仪式，无论是咀嚼、吸入，还是作为食品添加剂。然而，研究也指出若干局限性，包括无法识别DNA数据库中没有收录的灭绝或稀有植物，以及每份粪化石仅反映某个个体近期饮食的一个快照。 尽管存在这些挑战，研究团队希望他们的工作能加深人们对前哥伦布时期加勒比生活的理解。正如Toranzos博士所言，令人惊叹的是，古老的粪化石在数千年后依然能揭示如此丰富的信息。

article_content: A newborn girl was discovered abandoned and crying on Sandy Beach in eastern Honolulu, Hawaii, shortly after her birth. Police have begun a search for the baby's mother, investigating the case as both child abandonment and endangerment of a minor. According to police spokesperson Michelle Yu, a woman parked at Sandy Beach late Sunday night heard people screaming, then, after the noise subsided, heard a baby's cry. She found the unclothed infant on the sand and brought her to Queen's Medical Center. Patricia McManaman, Director of the State Department of Human Services, said the baby is recovering well at the hospital. 'We are just very grateful this child is alive and doing well,' she said. If no one comes forward to claim the baby, state officials will petition Family Court for custody. If the baby's family can't be identified, they plan to seek court approval to release a photo of her to the public in hopes of finding relatives. Hawaii established a ‘baby safe haven’ law in 2007 that allows mothers to leave unharmed newborns at emergency services, including police stations, hospitals, or fire departments, within 72 hours after birth without facing prosecution. Officials note that this law hasn't been used since its adoption. Anyone seeking information about the safe haven program can call the hotline at 800-494-3991.

article_content: October 2023 marked an outstanding period for video game enthusiasts, with a diverse lineup spanning indie gems to major AAA releases. Each week seemed to offer another must-play title. Sequels such as Super Mario Bros. Wonder and Marvel’s Spider-Man 2 made notable leaps forward, and inventive indie games like Jusant and Wargroove 2 showcased originality. Super Mario Bros. Wonder arrived exclusively on Nintendo Switch, introducing inventive levels and a 'Wonder' mechanic that refreshes core gameplay. Its animation, varied challenges, and creative power-ups revitalize the classic formula and make it accessible and fun for gamers of all backgrounds. Marvel’s Spider-Man 2 built on the success of its predecessors with upgraded visuals, refined combat, and a more immersive open-world New York. The narrative delves deeper into Spider-Man’s struggle, featuring Venom and the Symbiote, while expanded customization allows players to truly become their own Spider-Man. Insomniac’s sequel is both moving and thrilling. Alan Wake 2, released by Remedy Entertainment, brings an ambitious blend of psychological horror and narrative complexity, though technical issues—most notably on PCs with lower hardware—may impact some experiences. Still, it’s a rewarding title for fans of horror and storytelling. On the strategy front, Wargroove 2 stands tall with its turn-based tactical depth, engaging fantasy narratives, and replay-friendly roguelike mode. Inspired by Advance Wars, it offers a compelling option for fans of the genre. Jusant is a refreshing original experience centering on serene, tactile climbing gameplay. With minimal dialog, it invites players to traverse a vast tower while unraveling environmental clues about a world devoid of water. Its calming atmosphere is coupled with a thoughtful theme about the environment. Hot Wheels Unleashed 2: Turbocharged brings accessible, dynamic racing tailored for younger audiences and nostalgic adults. New racing mechanics and playful tracks add variety, making it a strong family-friendly pick, despite its light story and randomized car unlocks. Simulation racing lovers were treated to Forza Motorsport, which highlights the Xbox Series X/S hardware with stunning graphics and deep customization. The game welcomes new players and appeals to veterans through its approachable yet sophisticated driving systems. Altogether, October 2023 delivered a remarkable gaming selection across genres and platforms, ensuring players could find standout experiences whether seeking sequels, originals, or something in between.

article_content: People in the central United States faced more severe weather on Thursday, including torrential rain, golf-ball-sized hail, damaging winds, and several reported tornadoes, while preparing for more storms. Tornado warnings were issued Thursday afternoon in parts of Arkansas, Illinois, Kentucky, Wisconsin, and Oklahoma. Just ten days earlier, Oklahoma experienced a deadly tornado that killed 24 people. Such warnings are issued when a tornado is indicated by witnesses or radar. The National Weather Service reported tornado sightings in at least seven communities in western Arkansas, from Polk in the west to Garland County in the south and Oden in the north. At least nine people were injured throughout Arkansas: four minor injuries in Oden, three in Clark County, and two from a lightning strike in Benton County, according to state emergency management spokesman Tommy Jackson. Details on the conditions of the injured were not immediately available. Two homes were destroyed in the small community of Oden, about 50 miles west of Hot Springs, according to Jackson. The weather service also reported downed power lines and a blocked Highway 88. In Clark County, three houses were reportedly damaged and three people were injured near the town of Amity. Tornadoes were also reported in north-central Oklahoma, including areas near Perkins and Ripley, about 10 miles apart. Shortly after 3 p.m. (4 p.m. ET), the National Weather Service tweeted that a tornado may have been developing south of Perkins, about 50 miles northeast of Oklahoma City. Minutes later, another message indicated a brief tornado had been reported and then dissipated. Later Thursday night, a tornado was reported in Broken Arrow, about 15 miles southeast of Tulsa. Emergency crews responded, but as of yet, officials had no confirmed reports of damage, according to Tulsa County emergency management official Kaitlyn Cross. The threat of severe weather extended beyond Arkansas and Oklahoma. Tornado watches at one point covered an eight-state region from Texas north to Michigan, indicating favorable conditions for tornadoes to form. The weather service reported a tornado Thursday evening in Prophetstown, Illinois, but it was unclear if there was any damage. Even without confirmed tornadoes, these storms caused significant effects. The Tulsa weather office noted thunderstorms could bring wind gusts up to 70 mph. Oklahoma weather experts also received reports of hail up to half-dollar size. Flooding was a significant problem in Coffeyville, Kansas, where police rescued people from 16 vehicles in about 90 minutes after they became trapped by flooding, according to fire department Capt. Wayne Joplin. Water on the streets reached car headlights, or higher, after heavy rain fell on ground already saturated from prior storms. Captain Joplin stated, 'The gutters and our storm system couldn't handle it,' adding, 'I've lived here since 1979, and I've never seen that much rain that quickly.' Even after nightfall on Thursday, risks remained. The Storm Prediction Center forecast a moderate chance of severe weather Friday in parts of Oklahoma, Nebraska, Arkansas, and Missouri. The outlook was less severe for Saturday, but on Sunday, parts of the Northeast could face threats. The Storm Prediction Center predicted a 30% or greater chance of severe thunderstorms Sunday in portions of seven states, including Scranton, Pennsylvania; Springfield, Massachusetts; and the New York cities of Syracuse, Albany, and Elmira. Reported by CNN's Carma Hassan and Joe Sutton.

article_content: A team of comparative cognition researchers at the University of Veterinary Medicine Vienna, together with a colleague from the Instituto de Investigaciones Marinas y Costeras in Argentina, has found that a species of falcon can solve puzzles just as effectively as Goffin's cockatoos to earn a food reward. In their study, published in the open-access journal Current Biology, the researchers adapted a puzzle box—originally designed for Goffin's cockatoos—to assess the abilities of striated caracaras. Striated caracaras, also locally known as Johnny rooks, live exclusively on the Falkland Islands and Tierra del Fuego, at the southern tip of South America. Although they are classified as falcons, the researchers note that these birds often behave more like kea parrots, intelligent and curious birds from New Zealand. This behavior prompted the researchers to investigate whether Johnny rooks would excel at solving puzzle boxes. Puzzle boxes are tools for evaluating problem-solving abilities and intelligence in birds and other animals. The birds earn treats—such as pieces of fresh red meat—by solving the puzzles. For this study, the boxes were modified for birds with talons and hooked beaks, and included eight different challenges, such as sliding a door, pushing a lever, and tearing through paper. The research team placed the modified boxes in an open area and observed the wild Johnny rooks. The birds approached the puzzles within minutes and systematically attempted to solve them, all without any prior training. Fifteen birds found the puzzle boxes and attempted the challenges. All fifteen solved at least one puzzle, and ten managed to solve all eight. Notably, some striated caracaras solved particular puzzles that Goffin's cockatoos had not been able to solve, and many completed the tasks more quickly. The findings highlight the advanced intelligence and remarkable problem-solving abilities of striated caracaras.
translated_content: 维也纳兽医大学的比较认知学团队与阿根廷海洋与沿海研究所的同事合作，发现一种隼类鸟能够像戈芬氏凤头鹦鹉一样有效地解谜来获得食物奖励。 在他们发表于开放获取期刊《Current Biology》的研究中，研究人员调整了原本为戈芬氏凤头鹦鹉设计的谜盒，以测试条纹喙鹮隼的能力。 条纹喙鹮隼在当地也被称为Johnny rooks，只生活在南美洲最南端的福克兰群岛和火地岛。尽管被归类为隼类，研究人员指出，这些鸟的行为更像来自新西兰、聪明好奇的啄羊鹦鹉。 这种行为促使研究人员探索Johnny rooks是否同样擅长解开谜盒。 谜盒是评估鸟类和其他动物解决问题能力和智力的工具。鸟儿通过解开机关获得奖励——比如新鲜的红肉。此次研究中，谜盒经过了调整，以适应有利爪和钩状喙的鸟类，设置了八项不同的挑战，包括滑动门、推动杠杆和撕纸。 研究团队把改造过的谜盒放在开阔区域，观察野生的Johnny rooks。这些鸟在几分钟内就靠近谜盒，系统性地尝试解谜，而且完全不需要事先训练。 共有15只鸟发现了谜盒并尝试了其中的挑战，全部成功解开至少一道谜题，其中10只解出全部八题。 值得注意的是，有些条纹喙鹮隼解开了戈芬氏凤头鹦鹉未能解决的某些谜题，并且许多完成任务的速度更快。 研究结果突显了条纹喙鹮隼卓越的智力和出色的问题解决能力。

article_content:
Google is facing criticism for profiting from ads shown alongside extremist videos on YouTube. Investigations have found that advertisements from established brands such as Vodafone, TalkTalk, and iTunes appeared next to content posted by Islamist extremists, including Anwar al-Awlaki and Abu Qatada, both known for spreading hate speech and inciting violence.

These ad placements are automated, based on users’ browsing patterns, which means advertisers often have limited control over where their ads show up. This lack of oversight has caused frustration among companies whose names are being linked to controversial material. One advertiser called the situation unacceptable, stressing they do not want their products associated with violent or hateful content.

Vodafone responded with concern and gratitude after being notified of the issue. Other brands, such as Ronseal and Call of Duty, have also had their ads displayed next to videos uploaded by controversial figures like Anjem Choudary, who has been linked to the radicalization of the Woolwich attacker Michael Adebolajo. Choudary’s videos promote violent jihad and misuse of the welfare state.

YouTube claims to ban content encouraging violence or hate and says it removes such videos when reported. Nonetheless, thousands of such videos remain on the platform. A spokesperson for YouTube reiterated the platform’s commitment to user safety and strict ad guidelines, stating that ads can be withdrawn from videos or channels with inappropriate content.

The issue has added to ongoing criticism of Google, which has also been scrutinized for its low UK tax payments despite significant profits. Families of terrorism victims, like Graham Foulkes—whose son died in the 7/7 bombings—have condemned Google and YouTube for making money from extremist content, accusing them of prioritizing profit over responsibility and arguing these actions exceed the boundaries of free speech.

British freelance journalist Graham Phillips, 35, has been released after being held by Ukrainian soldiers. Phillips, who worked for the pro-Kremlin network Russia Today (RT), was detained in Mariupol, eastern Ukraine, and later transferred to Zaporozhye, where he spent the night under armed guard. He was held for 36 hours and accused of being a Russian spy due to his work for RT, but he tweeted to his 11,000 followers that he was 'ok'.

According to Phillips, he was treated fairly by Ukrainian authorities, faced no charges or deportation, and was not mistreated. His belongings were taken for inspection, and he was thoroughly questioned about his work. Phillips denied rumors of possessing a firearm at the time of his detention, stating he was only holding his camera for filming.

Phillips was initially detained at a military checkpoint near Mariupol on May 20. He said he was transferred to an army base barracks in Zaporozhye under guard around 9 p.m. local time after spending nine hours at the checkpoint. Authorities cited that he was detained for filming areas prohibited from being filmed. He was eventually released to British consular officials in Kiev.

Prior to his detention, Phillips had blogged and tweeted about sensitive events in Ukraine, including filming at Mariupol's city morgue, and had received threats from Ukrainian activist groups. Reports suggest calls for his deportation and a bounty placed on him weeks before his detention.

The case has heightened tensions between Ukraine and Russia, especially regarding the treatment of journalists, with Russian President Vladimir Putin denouncing the detention of Russian journalists in Ukraine as unacceptable. Ukrainian authorities, meanwhile, allege that detained journalists were caught conducting prohibited activities.

Media outlets on both sides have accused each other of bias and spreading misinformation. Ukraine has temporarily blocked Russian television channels, but separatists in the east have restored their broadcasts in some areas. Both Ukrainian and pro-Russian groups have been accused of detaining journalists. The Russian parliament has called for Ukraine to release detained Russian journalists, promising to ensure their freedom during upcoming political events.

Trafigura, a global commodities trading company based in the Netherlands, is considering settling legal claims stemming from the dumping of 500 tons of toxic waste in Abidjan, Ivory Coast. The incident, which occurred in August 2006, allegedly resulted in the deaths of at least 15 people and caused thousands of illnesses. Signs warning of "toxic zones" remained posted around Abidjan even a year after the dumping.

According to a United Nations report released on Wednesday, Trafigura was responsible for the death and injury that followed after the cargo ship Probo Koala, carrying waste from the company, offloaded the material at various sites across Ivory Coast’s largest city. Official estimates indicate that 15 people died, 69 were hospitalized, and over 100,000 individuals sought medical treatment, reporting symptoms such as nausea and vomiting after inhaling fumes from the waste.

Despite these findings, Trafigura has long maintained that scientific studies by experts they commissioned have found no evidence that the chemicals harmed anyone. The company further stated that no claims in the current litigation are being made for deaths, miscarriages, stillbirths, birth defects, or other serious injuries. However, all parties are considering a global settlement that may be acceptable to most, if not all, claimants.

Okechukwu Ibeanu, a United Nations Human Rights Council investigator, visited Ivory Coast and the Netherlands during the investigation. He called on all parties to address the possible long-term human health and environmental consequences, noting that full effects from the dumping may never be completely understood. He also reported that the contaminated areas have not yet been fully decontaminated and continue to pose health risks, with residents continuing to experience symptoms including headaches, skin lesions, digestive issues, and respiratory problems.

Trafigura stated it launched a plan two years ago to provide compensation—without admitting liability—to claimants who could demonstrate injury caused by exposure to the waste. The company maintains the Probo Koala’s slops could not have caused deaths or lasting harm and asserts it complied with all regulations regarding the offloading in Abidjan. Trafigura denies that the ship’s sole purpose in visiting Ivory Coast was to dump toxic waste, stating it was returning from a commercial voyage to deliver gasoline in Lagos, Nigeria.

According to the company’s website, Trafigura employs 1,900 people across 42 countries and is one of the world’s largest independent commodity trading companies. Ivory Coast, also known as Côte d'Ivoire, is a West African nation with a population of approximately 20 million.

联合国人权理事会独立调查员Okechukwu Ibeanu曾前往科特迪瓦和荷兰调查此事。他呼吁各方关注本事件可能带来的长期健康与环境影响，并指出其全部后果可能永远难以完全知晓。他还表示，受污染地区至今尚未完全清理，对居民健康仍构成威胁，许多居民持续反映出现头痛、皮肤病变、消化不良及呼吸道等症状。

Trafigura表示，两年前已启动一项计划，在不承认责任的前提下，对能够证明因接触废弃物受伤的索赔者提供赔偿。公司坚称，Probo Koala号遗留的废料不可能导致死亡或长期危害，并表示其在阿比让卸货时遵守了所有相关法规。Trafigura否认该船前往科特迪瓦的唯一目的是倾倒有毒废弃物，并称其当时是从尼日利亚拉各斯完成常规商业航程返程途中在阿比让停靠。

据官网介绍，Trafigura在42个国家拥有1900名员工，是全球最大的独立大宗商品贸易公司之一。科特迪瓦（Ivory Coast）是西非国家，人口约两千万。

article_content: NetApp, a leading global software company with Kerala-born CEO George Kurian at the helm, regards India as a dynamic market open to competition due to the lack of sizable domestic tech vendors. The company aims to make India its largest Asian market, surpassing Japan in the coming years. Kurian emphasized that Asia is performing better than other regions for NetApp, setting a goal to increase Asian revenues from 18% to 20%. He noted India’s status as the world’s fastest-growing major economy and cited its openness as fostering fair competition for global players. Increasingly, multinational, particularly American, companies are setting up tech centers in India, attracted by the country’s large talent pool. NetApp employs over 3,000 people locally, and while Kurian did not provide exact future hiring figures, he suggested ongoing growth. India serves both as a critical market for NetApp’s data storage solutions—especially in banking, financial services, and insurance—and as a development hub for solutions deployed worldwide. NetApp supplies multinational corporate clients, government bodies, and public sector entities. Kurian claimed NetApp holds a leading position in India’s fast-growing flash storage sector and plans to maintain this leadership. On regulatory matters, Kurian remarked that data localization and privacy issues are not unique to India but are global trends. He insisted that data security remains a fundamental part of NetApp’s services amid diverse threats. Clarifying NetApp’s relationship with its Israel-based teams, Kurian said that, despite conflict in the region, the company remains committed to its Israeli development center, prioritizing employee welfare and community support. Elsewhere in Indian business news, the IPO market has seen enthusiastic participation, with several major IPOs fully subscribed within hours, while IndiGo considers launching premium services for business travelers. Additionally, creditors are frequently invoking the threat of insolvency to prompt settlement of default cases.

article_content: Snap Inc. CEO and Co-founder Evan Spiegel stated, 'For developers and creators, AI is reducing the barriers to creativity.' At the recent APAC AR Day held in Mumbai, Spiegel discussed how AI could eliminate challenges his team faces in generating 3D assets for AR, a process traditionally considered time-consuming. He suggested that AI has the potential to remove these obstacles and hinted that Snap is working on immersive Lenses using large language models (LLMs), though he did not share specifics. During the event, which highlighted Augmented Reality (AR) and the work of creators bringing AR to diverse applications, Spiegel made a special appearance. He emphasized that there is a limited number of existing 3D assets, such as images or videos, and explained Snap's recent investments in AI to make it easier for creators to build immersive AR experiences by simplifying 3D content creation. Spiegel also mentioned upcoming surprises at Lens Fest 2023. Ajit Mohan, Snap APAC President, asked Spiegel about the future of chatbots and AI technologies. Spiegel expressed excitement about AI's role in creating images and videos, stating that AI will help bridge the gap between creators' imagination and the content they can actually produce using phones or AR glasses. He believes chatbots will become an important way for people to engage with LLMs and interact with AI. Spiegel is particularly enthusiastic about AI enhancing self-expression and creativity through cameras and AR. Mohan highlighted Snap's rapid innovation and global opportunities, prompting Spiegel to explain that the company's creativity is rooted in solving community problems—pointing out features like Snapchat’s map and its original launch as responses to social media trends. Regarding AR's future, Spiegel shared that the company aims to blend internet technology and computing with the real world to deepen connections between people. Snap is working to move AR experiences from phones to glasses, and is optimistic about future advancements. Lens Fest, an event for AR creators worldwide, is scheduled for November 9 and will celebrate excellence in AR.

During the Cleveland Cavaliers’ 99-79 victory over the Utah Jazz at Quicken Loans Arena on Friday night, an enthusiastic fan ran onto the court in the fourth quarter to approach Cavaliers All-Star guard Kyrie Irving. Security quickly tackled and handcuffed the individual, who now faces a public nuisance charge. The dramatic incident, captured on camera, showed Kyrie Irving startled but not frightened by the fan, who managed to briefly speak with him before being restrained. After the game, Irving shared that the fan expressed admiration, saying, “He told me he loved me, I told him, 'I love you, too, bro.'” Irving added, “The police didn’t think it was a joke. It goes back to the emotional and deep-rooted support the fans have for the team. It was a great honor, but to do it during the game… maybe he could have waited until after?”

This is the second time this season that a fan has approached Irving on the court, and the third such incident at Quicken Loans Arena within a year. In December, another fan approached Irving during a game against the Clippers in an attempt to show off a “Kyrie, Don’t Leave” t-shirt. Reports from ESPN.com have suggested that Irving may be unhappy in Cleveland, as the Cavaliers are expected to miss the playoffs for the fourth consecutive year. Despite the disruption, the Cavaliers continued their game, with Irving leading his team against Utah’s Enes Kanter and Alec Burks.

article_content: Kankamol Albon's collection of designer clothes, handbags, and shoes is being auctioned after the items were seized by police. She operated her business from a £4 million moated country mansion in Bures, Suffolk, defrauding hundreds of clients. Her collection includes items from prominent fashion labels like Chanel, Christian Dior, Louis Vuitton, Prada, Mulberry, and Fendi. Over 200 lots of luxury clothing and accessories are set to go under the hammer, with the auction potentially raising up to £250,000. After Albon's trial at Ipswich Crown Court, Judge Rupert Overbury issued an order under the Proceeds of Crime Act to sell her assets, including a BMW and her wardrobe. Albon, a mother of five born in Thailand, lived at the Grade II-listed Smallbridge Hall. She was described at her trial as being motivated by greed and a desire for luxury goods and an opulent lifestyle. Auctioneer Barry Martin, who will oversee the sale at Swardeston Village Hall near Norwich, noted that many items have now become vintage, sparking significant interest from collectors and fashion businesses. Detective Constable Andy Finbow of Suffolk Police’s economic crime unit stated: 'We will go to any lengths to ensure that people who seek to enjoy a lifestyle funded by crime will not be tolerated, and we will do all we can to strip them of the very things that motivated them to commit crime in the first instance.'

Authorities are seeking DNA samples from convicted Unabomber Ted Kaczynski as part of their renewed investigation into the 1982 Tylenol poisonings, in which seven people died after ingesting capsules laced with potassium cyanide, according to the FBI's Chicago office. FBI spokeswoman Cynthia Yates stated, "As part of the re-examination of the 1982 Tylenol poisonings, the FBI attempted to secure DNA from numerous individuals, including Ted Kaczynski. To date, Kaczynski has declined to voluntarily provide samples."

However, in a handwritten motion filed in federal court to stop the online auction of possessions seized from his Montana cabin in 1996, Kaczynski wrote that he would provide a DNA sample, but only if a certain condition—undisclosed in the filing—were met. Kaczynski, now 68, was responsible for a series of bombings between 1978 and 1995 that killed three people and wounded 23 others. The FBI named him the "Unabomber" because his early targets were universities and airlines. He was arrested in 1996, pleaded guilty in 1998, and is currently serving a life sentence at the federal Supermax prison in Florence, Colorado.

Yates declined to comment on whether authorities currently have Kaczynski’s DNA or the timing of the request. Traci Billingsley, spokeswoman for the federal Bureau of Prisons, said, "It would have been standard procedure for DNA to be taken from Kaczynski as an inmate in a federal prison," but she could not confirm when his DNA was previously collected or provide information regarding the FBI's request for a new sample. Chicago FBI spokesman Ross Rice added, "The standards on DNA testing have changed over the years, so forensic examiners would want a fresh sample," but could not confirm if the original sample was retained. Mark Collins, a spokesman for Supermax, would not comment, citing confidentiality.

According to Kaczynski's motion filed May 9, he was told by prison officials in late April that the Chicago FBI was seeking his DNA to compare with partial profiles linked to the 1982 Tylenol cyanide case. Officials indicated the FBI was prepared to seek a court order but first inquired if he would comply voluntarily. Kaczynski responded in writing that he would cooperate if the FBI met an unspecified condition. Rice said he was unaware of what the condition might be.

Kaczynski maintains he never possessed potassium cyanide and expressed concern that partial DNA profiles could unjustly implicate innocent people. He argued that if his DNA were a partial match to profiles from the crime, it would be beneficial for both him and the public to thoroughly investigate any possible connection. He suggested that evidence taken from his cabin could be relevant, and therefore the auction of those items should not proceed. Federal prosecutors responded that Kaczynski has not been indicted in relation to the Tylenol case, nor are charges planned, so there was no basis to halt the auction as previously approved. Absent a court ruling, the online auction proceeded as scheduled.

Notably, a handwritten copy of Kaczynski’s 35,000-word manifesto, which played a role in his capture, had attracted bids exceeding $12,000. In 1982, seven Chicago-area residents died after taking Extra-Strength Tylenol capsules contaminated with potassium cyanide, triggering national panic, product recalls, hospitalizations, and changes in drug packaging regulations. Johnson & Johnson, McNeil’s parent company, was credited for its prompt recall and transparency, which helped Tylenol quickly recover sales. Despite extensive investigations, the case remains unsolved. In 2009, the FBI announced it was partnering with Illinois authorities to re-examine evidence, prompted by advances in forensic technology and the 25th anniversary of the event.

The auction features about 60 items, including Kaczynski's clothing, books, photographs, and documents, with proceeds designated for four victims who were awarded $15 million in restitution. Kaczynski has strongly objected to the auction and contested it in court. The auction is set to run through June 2 at gsaauctions.gov. CNN’s Shawn Nottingham, Carol Cratty, and Georgiann Caruso contributed to this report.

据芝加哥联邦调查局（FBI）办公室称，执法部门正寻求从被定罪的“邮件炸弹客”特德·卡辛斯基（Ted Kaczynski）处获取DNA样本，以协助重新调查1982年泰诺（Tylenol）下毒案。1982年，七人在服用混有氰化钾的泰诺胶囊后死亡。FBI发言人辛西娅·耶茨（Cynthia Yates）表示：“作为对1982年泰诺下毒案重新审查的一部分，FBI试图从多位相关人士处获得DNA样本，包括特德·卡辛斯基。截至目前，卡辛斯基拒绝自愿提供样本。”

不过，卡辛斯基最近在递交给联邦法院、试图阻止1996年他蒙大拿小屋被查获财物公开拍卖的手写动议中写道，他愿意在满足某一未披露条件下提供DNA样本。现年68岁的卡辛斯基，1978年至1995年间制造了一系列爆炸案，导致3人死亡、23人受伤。由于早期袭击目标为大学和航空公司，FBI称其为“Unabomber（邮件炸弹客）”。1996年他被捕，1998年认罪，如今正在科罗拉多州弗洛伦斯的联邦超高安全级别监狱服无期徒刑。

耶茨没有透露目前当局是否已持有卡辛斯基的DNA或提出相关请求的具体时间。联邦监狱管理局发言人特蕾西·比林斯利（Traci Billingsley）称，“作为惯例，在押联邦罪犯通常会采集DNA样本”，但她无法确认此前卡辛斯基采样的时间，也无法说明FBI为何要再次采样。芝加哥FBI发言人罗斯·赖斯（Ross Rice）表示：“DNA检测标准这些年已经变化，因此法医学专家希望得到新鲜样本。”但他也未确认先前样本是否被保存。超级监狱发言人马克·柯林斯（Mark Collins）因保密规定未就此议题置评。

根据5月9日提交的动议，卡辛斯基称他在4月底被监狱官员告知芝加哥FBI希望用他的DNA与1982年泰诺氰化案相关的部分DNA特征比对。官员们表示，FBI准备通过法院强制采集，但愿他能先自愿配合。卡辛斯基回复表示，若FBI满足某未披露条件，他愿合作。赖斯称对相关条件不知情。

卡辛斯基坚称他从未拥有过氰化钾，并担忧部分DNA特征的比对可能无辜牵连他人。他说，如果自身DNA与案发线索部分吻合，对社会和他自己都应该彻查所有可能关联。他还称1996年被查封的小屋内有些证物可能与此相关，因此反对这些物品被拍卖。联邦检察官回应称，卡辛斯基暂无因泰诺案被控，也无相关指控计划，因此此前批准的拍卖没有理由中止。在法院未作出裁决前，网上拍卖如期进行。

特别值得注意的是，卡辛斯基亲笔书写的3.5万字宣言副本，曾助警方将其捉拿，目前竞拍价已超过12,000美元。1982年，芝加哥地区7人因服用被投氰化钾的特强泰诺胶囊死亡，事件导致全国恐慌、紧急下架和住院治疗，也促使药品包装改革，要求更高防拆措施。泰诺母公司强生被赞赏反应迅速、公开透明，使产品销售迅速恢复。调查数十年未解。2009年，FBI因法医技术进步和案发25周年，与伊利诺伊州当局联合再查证据。

此次拍卖大约有60件物品，包括卡辛斯基的衣服、书籍、照片和文件，拍卖收益将用于补偿获得1,500万美元赔偿的四名受害者。卡辛斯基一直坚决反对被拍卖并多次提起诉讼。拍卖至6月2日于gsaauctions.gov举行。CNN记者Shawn Nottingham、Carol Cratty和Georgiann Caruso参与报道。

article_content: Iran's chief nuclear negotiator announced on Friday that a tentative agreement had been reached regarding the implementation of a plan requiring Tehran to limit its nuclear activities. However, U.S. officials described the negotiations as still ongoing. These statements followed two days of talks in Geneva, where Iran met with representatives from the European Union, United States, China, and Russia to discuss steps for putting a deal into place. This deal calls for Iran to restrict its nuclear program in exchange for the easing of economic sanctions that have severely impacted its economy. While Iran's negotiator Abbas Araqchi told the state-run Press TV that the parties had reached a preliminary deal, neither he nor representatives of the six world powers provided details. Araqchi indicated, as reported by IRNA, that should the plan be accepted by all parties, an official announcement would be made within two weeks. U.S. officials emphasized that while progress was made, the agreement is not yet finalized. State Department spokeswoman Jen Psaki stated at a Washington briefing that negotiations are ongoing. The nuclear agreement made in November has been widely seen as an important interim measure to avert conflict over Iran's nuclear ambitions. Despite initial optimism, Iran has since criticized the United States for releasing a revised version of the agreement, arguing that it does not reflect Iran's interpretation. Recently, Iranian lawmakers drafted a bill that would require the government to enrich uranium up to 60% if new sanctions are implemented, according to state media. This move came after bipartisan legislation was introduced in the U.S. Senate proposing new economic sanctions on Iran if it breaches the interim agreement or fails to reach a final compromise. On Friday, the Senate appeared to move toward a veto-proof majority in support of additional sanctions. The bipartisan proposal, introduced by Senators Robert Menendez (D-New Jersey) and Mark Kirk (R-Illinois), has the formal backing of 59 senators, with an informal count at 77, according to a Senate aide. A two-thirds majority in both houses of Congress is needed to override a presidential veto. President Obama has said he would veto any bill imposing new economic sanctions on Iran at this stage, warning such action could jeopardize delicate diplomatic negotiations. The bill could come up for Senate consideration during the week of President Obama's State of the Union address on January 28 or soon after. The proposal would allow over a year for further diplomacy before triggering new sanctions affecting Iran's oil exports and other critical areas, though penalties would be imposed earlier if Iran fails to honor the interim deal or a final agreement is not reached. Western powers suspect Iran of seeking nuclear weapons through uranium enrichment, while Tehran maintains its nuclear program is for peaceful purposes only. CNN's Jim Sciutto, Chelsea J. Carter, and Mohammed Tawfeeq contributed to this report.
translated_content: 伊朗首席核谈判代表周五宣布，双方就一项要求德黑兰限制其核活动的计划达成了初步协议。然而，美方官员表示谈判仍在进行中。 上述言论是在日内瓦举行的为期两天的会谈后发表的。伊朗与欧盟、美国、中国和俄罗斯的代表会面，讨论落实协议的具体步骤。该协议要求伊朗限制其核计划，以换取对严重冲击其经济的制裁的缓解。 伊朗谈判代表阿巴斯·阿拉克奇在国营Press TV上称，双方已达成初步协议，但他和六大国代表都未公布细节。据伊朗官方通讯社IRNA报道，阿拉克奇表示，如果各方都同意该计划，官方声明将在两周内发布。 美方官员强调，虽然取得了一定进展，但协议尚未最终确定。美国国务院发言人詹·普萨基在华盛顿的新闻发布会上表示，谈判还在继续。 去年十一月达成的核协议被广泛认为是避免因伊朗核争议引发冲突的重要过渡措施。尽管最初气氛乐观，但伊朗随后批评美国发布了经修订的协议版本，认为不符合伊朗的理解。 最近，伊朗议员起草法案，要求政府在新制裁实施时将铀浓缩提升至60%，据官方媒体报道。这一行动是在美国参议院提出两党法案后作出的，该法案旨在伊朗违反中期协议或未能达成最终协议时对其实施新经济制裁。 周五，参议院朝获得足以推翻总统否决的多数迈进。由新泽西州民主党参议员梅嫩德斯和伊利诺伊州共和党参议员柯克提出的两党提案，已获得59名参议员的正式支持，参议院助手称非正式支持已达77人。 推翻总统否决需要参众两院三分之二多数同意。奥巴马总统表示，他将在当前阶段否决任何对伊朗实施新制裁的法案，认为此类行动会扰乱脆弱的外交努力。 该提案可能在奥巴马1月28日国情咨文当周或之后提交参议院审议。提案允许外交努力再持续一年多，若伊朗守约则不会马上制裁，但如违反中期协议或未达成最终协议，相关对石油出口和关键经济领域的制裁将提前生效。 西方国家怀疑伊朗通过铀浓缩谋取核武器，而伊朗坚称其核计划完全出于和平目的。 CNN记者吉姆·西乌托、切尔西·J·卡特和穆罕默德·塔乌菲克亦参与了本文报道。

article_content: After a summer filled with major changes and player departures, Southampton now find themselves in the Premier League's top four—a position that has surprised even their own squad. Morgan Schneiderlin admitted he never expected such a quick recovery, saying, 'I'm happy here, I'm fully focused on Southampton and there is no problem.' This is notable considering Schneiderlin was previously unhappy about staying at the club while some teammates moved elsewhere. Victor Wanyama scored the winning goal in the 80th minute after Southampton labored for 41 minutes against ten-man Swansea. Ronald Koeman was quick to remind fans, 'it is very early in the season.' Schneiderlin, familiar with strong starts, emphasized the importance of performing well throughout the winter fixtures. 'It's a surprise to have started so well after so many changes. The coaching staff changed, many players left, so it's great for us to be in this position after five games. But it's only five games in a long season, and we need to keep going.' Schneiderlin once wished to leave Southampton in the summer but now says he is content at the club. Southampton have failed to score in only one of their past 16 away league games. He added: 'Last year we started well, but things became tough in December, and it was hard to recover. We want to be stronger this season during that period.' He also said the squad is more united after the summer: 'A lot of people thought we would struggle after losing so many players, but we came together after the transfer window closed and decided to prove those doubters wrong. So far, we're doing that.' Swansea manager Garry Monk criticized referee Jonathan Moss for inconsistency, although he accepted Wilfried Bony's red card. Monk said: 'In terms of consistency, his decisions were very, very poor—extremely poor. Sometimes it left me baffled.'

article_content: A couple called off their wedding reception after Emily Ellis, the bride-to-be, was told she couldn’t breastfeed her three-month-old son, Presley, in the public area of the Cumberland Hotel in Bournemouth. Emily, 26, was left in tears when a female receptionist directed her to a disabled toilet, saying breastfeeding wasn’t appropriate in the restaurant. The issue arose while Emily and her fiancé, Dan Smith, were settling the balance on their wedding package and waiting for a long time with their baby. When Emily asked to breastfeed in the restaurant, the receptionist’s response left her shocked and upset, particularly since the suggestion came from another woman. The couple, distressed by the incident and with invitations already sent to 45 guests, decided to cancel their booking and search for a new venue for their planned date. Dan, who works as a nurse, later complained to the hotel and learned the receptionist was new, but they didn’t consider this a sufficient explanation. The hotel refunded their payment and expressed regret for the mistake. Pat Green, the group operations manager, stated the hotel welcomes breastfeeding in public spaces and blamed the incident on a misunderstanding by a trainee staff member, who believed privacy was being sought. The hotel apologized, offered further staff training, and attempted to compensate Emily and Dan with a complimentary stay and spa treatments, which were declined. Similar incidents have happened across the UK. Lou Burns was asked to cover up at Claridge’s hotel in London, sparking protests organized by groups like Free to Feed. Classical musician Kathrine Jenkinson wasn’t allowed to bring her baby into a private London club. Natasha Barnett was prevented from breastfeeding at a swimming pool, Carrie Davies was relocated while feeding her child in a Cardiff restaurant, and Wioletta Komar was asked to leave a Nottingham store for breastfeeding. Advocacy groups continue to campaign for the normalization of breastfeeding in public. The Equality Act 2010 makes it illegal to discriminate against women breastfeeding in public places, but such incidents reveal persistent misunderstandings and the need for better awareness and staff training.

article_content: KHAMMAM: Telangana Chief Minister K Chandrashekar Rao (KCR) criticized the Congress party by recalling the regime of former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi, questioning its legacy. Addressing a public gathering at Wyra in Khammam district, KCR said, 'Congress leaders claim they will bring back the Indira Gandhi era if they come to power. Why do we need that regime? Did anything good happen during that time? The poor remained poor, and SC and ST communities were treated as vote banks. Had they done well, the situation for Dalits and Girijans wouldn’t be as it is now.' KCR further stated that during Indira Gandhi's rule, the Emergency was declared and opposition leaders were jailed. 'Why would we want to go back to that?' he added. Emphasizing the importance of the 'Rythu Bandhu' scheme in Telangana, KCR said that the scheme would continue if the BRS retains power. 'Congress ruled the country for 50 years. After long struggles, we finally gained Telangana statehood and overcame many challenges. Congress claims Rythu Bandhu is a waste—this is what the former PCC chief has said. If BRS wins, Rythu Bandhu will continue,' said KCR. The 'Rythu Bandhu' scheme was announced by the Telangana Chief Minister at a Farmers Coordination Committee (Rythu Samanvaya Samithi) conference at Jayashankar Agriculture University on February 25, 2018. Encouraging voters to choose wisely, KCR reminded them of the importance of their vote: 'When elections come, a candidate represents a party—BRS, Congress, or BJP. Voters should carefully consider whether a candidate and their party’s history, ideology, and governance style align with their interests. The vote is a powerful tool,' he said. Telangana will hold Assembly elections on November 30, with counting of votes scheduled for December 3, along with four other poll-bound states.

article_content: The Jigawa State government has allocated N500 million to install improved latrines in locations such as schools, hospitals, markets, and motor parks. Announcing this in Dutse, Commissioner of Water Resources Alhaji Ibrahim Hannungiwa emphasized ongoing efforts to keep Jigawa in the lead as the only Nigerian state certified by UNICEF as Open Defecation Free (ODF). Hannungiwa indicated that Jigawa aims to surpass the national ODF goal by 2025 through various policies and collaborations with the Federal Ministry of Water Resources and UNICEF. A dedicated committee has been established to devise measures for sustaining ODF status and eradicating open defecation. Measures include constructing additional modern public toilets, especially along highways and in rural areas. Education campaigns on the benefits of proper sanitation are also underway. Jigawa’s achievements have led UNICEF to recognize it as Nigeria’s sole ODF state, and Governor Umar Namadi has been named an ODF Ambassador. The governor will represent the state by sharing Nigeria’s ODF progress at a conference in Canada.

Paint, wine, and instant noodles are unlikely to improve Manchester United’s performance on the pitch, but they’re certainly boosting the club’s finances. Even after an opening Premier League loss to Swansea, United is securing substantial revenue through innovative sponsorships and partnerships globally. Capitalizing on its widespread appeal, the club has earned about $42.6 million from 38 deals by offering customized partnerships in diverse regions. This started six years ago, when United teamed up with Smirnoff vodka as its 'responsible drinking partner' in Asia-Pacific. Partnerships have since expanded, including deals with telecom company TM in Malaysia and STC in Saudi Arabia.

According to sports research firm Repucom, Manchester United now earns over 350% more from such sponsorships than rivals like Barcelona, although television rights still remain the major income source. The Premier League’s current three-year TV contract is valued at $9.4 billion. For comparison, in the 2013-14 season, 20 top European clubs generated over €54 million ($72 million) from 84 local sponsorships. Clubs such as Barcelona, Liverpool, and Manchester City are competing by securing their own regional partnerships with brands like Tecate in Mexico, ComeOn! in Scandinavia, and Saigon Hanoi Bank in Vietnam, Laos, and Cambodia.

Football commercial expert Andrew Walsh from Repucom points out that, while broadcast rights dominate, commercial deals now account for almost 29% of total club revenues in Europe. The push is for even more value through locally focused, high-impact partnerships.

United’s push into global partnerships gathered momentum after Malcolm Glazer’s family took control in 2005. Experienced in U.S. sports, the Glazers recognized the marketing power behind associating top brands with the club’s on-field success under former manager Alex Ferguson, starting with shirt sponsorships. General Motors is now paying $80 million per year to put Chevy’s logo on United’s kit. The club’s roster of official partners extends into sectors like wine (Casillero Del Diablo), medical technology (Toshiba Medical Systems), and food (Nissin Food noodles). Asia-Pacific remains the hotspot for these deals, but growing football enthusiasm in North America shows promise for future partnerships.

Walsh adds that with the growth of social media, clubs and sponsors are increasingly able to offer products targeting individual fans rather than generic audiences, enhancing engagement and profitability. Europe's leading clubs are segmenting their assets for specific local markets and fan bases, maximizing sponsor value and loyalty.

Still, commercial success depends on strong performances on the field. After a disappointing year under David Moyes, Louis van Gaal’s main goal is to restore United’s competitive glory. On-pitch victories are expected to ensure continuing growth off the pitch, through sponsorships and commercial ventures in even more diverse industries.

油漆、葡萄酒和方便面或许无法提升曼联在球场上的表现，但却为俱乐部带来了可观的收益。即使在英超揭幕战输给斯旺西之后，曼联依然通过全球创新的赞助和合作持续获得丰厚收入。俱乐部凭借庞大的国际影响力，在全球不同地区定制合作方案，已通过38项合作协议累计获得约4260万美元。这一策略始于六年前，当时曼联在亚太地区与斯米诺伏加酒开展“理性饮酒”合作。此后，合作范围不断扩大，包括马来西亚的TM通讯公司和沙特阿拉伯的STC等。

据体育调研公司Repucom统计，曼联通过这类赞助协议的收入已是巴萨等对手的350%以上，尽管电视转播权仍然是主要的收入来源。目前英超为期三年的电视转播合同价值高达94亿美元。相比之下，2013-14赛季，欧洲20家顶级俱乐部通过84份本地赞助协议共获得超过5400万欧元（约7200万美元）。巴塞罗那、利物浦和曼城等俱乐部也在积极布局，与墨西哥的Tecate、斯堪的纳维亚的ComeOn！以及越南、老挝、柬埔寨的西贡河内银行分别签订了合作协议。

Repucom足球商业专家安德鲁·沃尔什指出，尽管转播权仍占主导，商业合作如今在欧洲俱乐部总收入中已接近29%。行业趋势正朝向本地化和高价值的合作关系发展。

自2005年格雷泽家族接管后，曼联的全球合作策略迅速扩展。拥有美国体育经营经验的格雷泽家族意识到，与俱乐部过往辉煌战绩（如弗格森时代）结合顶级品牌的价值——最早体现在球衣赞助商上。如通用汽车每年为雪佛兰标志出现在曼联球衣支付8000万美元。如今曼联的官方合作伙伴还包括葡萄酒（Casillero Del Diablo）、医疗科技（东芝医疗系统）和食品（日清方便面）等多个领域。亚太地区依然是这些合作增长最快的板块，而北美足球市场的潜力也被广泛看好。

沃尔什补充，随着社交媒体兴起，俱乐部和赞助商可以针对具体球迷量身定制产品，提高互动和商业收益。欧洲顶级俱乐部正在将资源细分到不同地区及粉丝群体，实现赞助价值和忠诚度双提升。

不过，商业成功还需依托于球队在赛场上的成绩。经历莫耶斯执教时期的低谷后，范加尔的主要任务就是带领曼联重返巅峰。只有持续胜利，才有望保证俱乐部场外更多元化的商业收入与合作扩展。

The watermelon—whether held in hand, depicted in art, or shared online as an emoji—stands as a potent symbol for Palestinians. Its significance has resurfaced on social media following the Israel-Hamas conflict, which began with a surprise Hamas attack resulting in 1,400 deaths in Israel. Since then, at least 3,785 people have lost their lives in Gaza due to Israeli airstrikes, launched ahead of an anticipated ground offensive. But how did this refreshing fruit come to represent Palestinian solidarity?

The association between the watermelon and Palestinian identity dates back to the aftermath of the 1967 Six-Day War, when Israel took control of the West Bank and Gaza, and annexed East Jerusalem. At that time, the Israeli government criminalized public displays of the Palestinian flag in Gaza and the West Bank. To circumvent the ban, Palestinians embraced the watermelon because its interior mirrors the flag’s colors—red, black, white, and green.

Artist Sliman Mansour recounted to The National in 2021 that, in 1980, Israeli officials shut down an art exhibition in Ramallah featuring works by Mansour, Nabil Anani, and Issam Badr. Officials not only prohibited representations of the flag but also banned works using its colors. Mansour recalled an officer stating that even a painting of a watermelon would be confiscated.

The ban on the Palestinian flag was lifted in 1993 as part of the Oslo Accords—agreements that established mutual recognition between Israel and the Palestinian Liberation Organization. The accords allowed the flag to represent the Palestinian Authority, which would administer Gaza and the West Bank.

Following the Oslo Accords, The New York Times referenced the watermelon’s role as an alternative symbol. Journalist John Kifner noted that in Gaza, people were once arrested for carrying watermelon slices displaying the red, black, and green colors, but later could openly wave the flag.

In 2007, artist Khaled Hourani created 'The Story of the Watermelon' for the book 'Subjective Atlas of Palestine.' In 2013, he isolated one print titled 'The Colours of the Palestinian Flag,' which gained global recognition.

The watermelon symbol reemerged in 2021, following an Israeli court ruling that ordered Palestinian families in East Jerusalem’s Sheikh Jarrah neighborhood to vacate their homes for settlers. In January, Israel’s National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir empowered police to confiscate Palestinian flags. A June bill sought to ban flag displays at state-funded institutions, but it did not become law as the government collapsed.

In response, the Arab-Israeli community group Zazim launched a campaign protesting the arrests and seizures of flags. They decorated sixteen Tel Aviv taxis with watermelon images and the caption, 'This is not a Palestinian flag.' Zazim’s director, Raluca Ganea, emphasized their commitment to fighting for freedom of expression and democracy. Amal Saad, a Palestinian from Haifa involved in the campaign, told Al Jazeera, 'If you want to stop us, we’ll find another way to express ourselves.'

无论是手中拿着、在艺术中描绘，还是作为表情符号上传到网络，西瓜都是巴勒斯坦人的有力象征。随着以色列-哈马斯冲突的爆发，这一象征最近又在社交媒体上出现。冲突始于哈马斯突袭，导致以色列有1,400人遇难。之后，以色列的空袭已造成加沙至少3,785人死亡，并可能预示即将开展的地面进攻。那么，为什么西瓜会成为巴勒斯坦团结的象征？

西瓜作为巴勒斯坦身份标志的历史可追溯到1967年六日战争后。当时以色列控制了约旦河西岸和加沙地带，并吞并东耶路撒冷。以色列政府随后禁止在加沙和西岸公开展示巴勒斯坦国旗。为规避禁令，巴勒斯坦人选择了西瓜，因为它的红、黑、白、绿果肉正好对应国旗的颜色。

艺术家斯利曼·曼苏尔在2021年对《国家报》回忆，1980年以色列官员曾关闭了他、纳比尔·阿纳尼和伊萨姆·巴德尔拉马拉的联展。官员不仅禁止以国旗为主题的画作，甚至明令禁止出现国旗的颜色。曼苏尔回忆有军官称：“就算你画的是西瓜，也一样会被没收。”

1993年奥斯陆协议之后，巴勒斯坦国旗禁令被解除，该协议促使以色列和巴解组织相互承认，也让国旗成为巴勒斯坦权力机构的代表。

协议后，《纽约时报》曾报道，西瓜在禁旗期间成为象征。记者约翰·基夫纳写道，曾有年轻人因携带西瓜片（呈现红、黑、绿颜色）被抓，现在他们可以公开挥舞曾被禁的旗帜。

2007年，艺术家哈立德·霍拉尼为《巴勒斯坦主观地图集》创作了《西瓜的故事》，2013年他将其中一幅名为《巴勒斯坦国旗的色彩》的作品公之于众。

2021年，因以色列法院裁决谢赫贾拉的巴勒斯坦家庭搬迁，西瓜作为象征再次流行。1月，以色列国家安全部长伊塔马尔·本-格维尔授权警方没收巴勒斯坦国旗。6月又有法案提议在国家资助机构禁挂国旗，但因政府垮台未成法。

阿拉伯—以色列社群组织Zazim随后发起抗议，反对旗帜没收和相关逮捕。他们在特拉维夫16辆出租车贴上西瓜图案，并写上“这不是巴勒斯坦国旗。” Zazim总监拉鲁卡·加尼娅表示会继续为表达自由和民主奋斗。该行动的参与者、海法巴勒斯坦人阿迈勒·萨阿德对半岛电视台说：“你想阻止我们，我们总能找到新的表达方式。”

article_content: On October 7, 2023, Israel faced a major assault by Hamas forces, who breached its borders, resulting in significant casualties. At least 600 Israelis lost their lives and more than 2,000 were injured. In retaliation, Israeli strikes in Gaza have killed at least 313 Palestinians and wounded around 2,000 others. Israel’s leaders have pledged a strong and enduring response, potentially marking the most extensive ground operation in Gaza in over forty years. Defense Minister Yoav Gallant has vowed to fundamentally change the situation in Gaza, while Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu promised a harsh retaliation, cautioning that the coming conflict will be lengthy and difficult. Past military campaigns illustrate the seriousness of the situation. Israel’s ground offensive in 2014 had narrower goals, while the current plans are being compared to the 1982 Lebanon war, which had far-reaching and lasting consequences for the region. Apart from a few major operations—such as the 2002 West Bank incursion—Israel has generally used air and artillery strikes and targeted raids over the past decades. The scale of civilian deaths on October 7, along with the kidnapping of dozens of Israelis into Gaza, highlights the crisis’s exceptional magnitude. Should a ground offensive proceed, the Israeli military will likely confront intense urban fighting against determined militants, who may use hostages as shields, complicating any rescue attempts. Hezbollah, an Iran-backed militia in Lebanon, has already fired mortars at Israeli positions soon after the Hamas attack, raising the specter of a wider conflict. Experts warn that a full-scale war with Hezbollah could be even more destructive, given its extensive missile capabilities. With violence spiraling and wider war risks mounting, hopes for peace in the region seem increasingly distant.

Jacob Ostreicher, a 53-year-old American businessman from Brooklyn, has been held in a Bolivian prison for 11 months without formal charges. Nearly a month ago, he began a hunger strike to bring attention to his case. Ostreicher was arrested in June of the previous year on preliminary money laundering charges as part of an investigation involving drug money. His wife and lawyer maintain they've proven all his investment sources are legitimate and question whether other factors are behind his ongoing detention. Since his arrest, at least 15 hearings have been scheduled, but only three have actually been held. During one hearing, a judge ordered his release on bond, and his family paid, but the judge unexpectedly rescinded the decision before Ostreicher could leave Palmasola prison in Santa Cruz. A new judge was recently assigned, but the case remains stalled. Attempts to reach Bolivian prosecutors for comment were unsuccessful.

Ostreicher’s hunger strike began in mid-April, aiming to prompt action from the Bolivian justice system and rally support back home. Supporters in New York held a demonstration in front of the Bolivian Mission this month. The background of his arrest is complex. In 2008, Ostreicher and other investors put money into a rice operation in Santa Cruz. Supporters say Ostreicher had a minor financial stake but frequently traveled to Bolivia to oversee the project. He told CNN that the project manager, hired by the investors, had links to a Brazilian drug trafficker and eventually defrauded them. After firing the manager and attempting to resolve the issues, Ostreicher became a suspect because the land was associated with the drug trade.

Ostreicher's detention comes amid strained relations between the United States and Bolivia, especially since Bolivian President Evo Morales expelled the U.S. ambassador in 2008. Supporters suspect political motives, observing that the judge who reversed Ostreicher’s release was promoted afterward, although no official corruption has been proven. His Bolivian attorney, Yimy Montano, believes the main issue is a struggling justice system, not a conspiracy, noting that many Bolivians face similar prolonged delays. In one key hearing, the defense presented more than 1,000 translated documents proving the legitimacy of Ostreicher’s investment sources. Montano says prosecutors have presented no evidence but claim Ostreicher’s attempts to recover losses and negotiate with the landowner are suspicious. Bolivian law allows suspects to be held on preliminary charges for up to 18 months before formal charges must be filed or the case dismissed.

According to Ostreicher’s wife, Miriam Ungar, his health has deteriorated since beginning the hunger strike, and she fears prosecution for speaking publicly about the case. Court documents show authorities have opened an investigation into alleged obstruction of justice involving Ungar, their lawyers, Ostreicher, and others who spoke to the media. Montano wants the case to proceed to trial, seeking Ostreicher’s acquittal. Ostreicher, despite his fragile health, continues his hunger strike. 'It's the only way to be heard,' Montano said.

雅各布·奥斯特里彻（Jacob Ostreicher），现年53岁，是美国布鲁克林的一名商人，已在玻利维亚监狱被关押了11个月，始终未被正式起诉。近一个月前，他开始绝食，试图引起外界对案件的关注。奥斯特里彻于去年六月因涉嫌洗钱被初步逮捕，该案涉及毒资，但他的妻子和律师坚称他们已经证明所有投资款项均为合法来源，并质疑其持续被羁押背后是否另有原因。自他被捕以来，已安排了至少15次听证会，但实际上仅进行了3次。在一次听证会上，法官曾下令准许交保释放，家属已缴纳保释金，但奥斯特里彻还未来得及离开圣克鲁斯著名的帕尔马索拉监狱，法官就突然撤回了决定。近日，一名新法官接手，但此案依然停滞不前。多次尝试联系玻利维亚检方未果。

奥斯特里彻于4月中旬开始绝食，旨在推动玻利维亚司法体系行动并争取国内关注。纽约的支持者本月还在玻利维亚驻美使团前举行示威。他被捕的背景相当复杂。2008年，奥斯特里彻和其他投资者曾投资圣克鲁斯的一家稻米种植项目。支持者称，奥斯特里彻出资额并不大，却常前往玻利维亚监管项目。他对CNN表示，项目经理被投资人雇佣，实际与巴西毒贩有牵连，最终骗走了资金。奥斯特里彻将其解雇并试图弥补损失，但因涉案土地与毒品相关，他自己也被视为嫌疑人。

奥斯特里彻的拘留正值美玻关系低谷，尤其是在玻利维亚总统埃沃·莫拉莱斯于2008年驱逐美国大使后。支持者怀疑案件存在政治考量，称撤销释放决定的法官后来升职，尽管未有官方腐败证据。他的玻利维亚律师伊米·蒙塔诺表示，问题本质其实在于司法体系混乱，许多玻国内民众都遭遇类似漫长延误。在一次关键听证会上，辩方曾递交逾1000份翻译材料，证实奥斯特里彻所有投资均为合法来源。蒙塔诺称，检方至今未提交实质性证据，仅以奥斯特里彻为挽回损失及与土地所有者协商的努力为怀疑理由。玻利维亚法律规定，嫌疑人可在初步指控下被羁押最多18个月，到期后检方必须正式起诉或撤案。

奥斯特里彻的妻子米丽娅姆·昂加尔称，自其丈夫绝食以来身体恶化，而她自己就因公开发声而担心被起诉。法院文件显示，官方已对昂加尔、他们的律师、奥斯特里彻及其他对媒体发声人士启动妨碍司法程序的调查。蒙塔诺希望本案能尽快进入审判环节，争取奥斯特里彻无罪释放。尽管健康堪忧，奥斯特里彻仍拒绝停止绝食。蒙塔诺说：“这是让外界听见我们声音的唯一方法。”

article_content: On March 25, 2011, CNN Student News reported that United Nations Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon announced there were no indications of a cease-fire in Libya, following a week after the U.N. Security Council enforced a no-fly zone. The military operation in Libya, led by the U.S., involved missile strikes and airstrikes, with discussions underway for NATO to possibly assume leadership. The conflict in Libya has contributed to a rise in global oil prices as concerns grow that similar unrest could affect other oil-producing nations. From aboard the USS Kearsarge, U.S. military aircraft such as Harrier jets were launching operations as part of enforcing the no-fly zone, with notable missions including the rescue of a downed pilot by a team of Marines. No coalition ground troops are involved; air operations continue to target and disable Gadhafi's military equipment. In Syria, demonstrations over economic and human rights issues have escalated into violence; human rights workers report at least 34 fatalities, including soldiers and protesters. Japan continues to recover from recent earthquake and tsunami disasters, which have disrupted supply chains for companies like Toyota and created safety concerns at the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power plant. Two workers were hospitalized after contact with contaminated water, but officials are optimistic about their recovery if treated promptly. U.S. Navy vessels, including the USS Ronald Reagan, are undergoing extensive decontamination procedures after potential exposure to radiation. At a school in Edgewater, Florida, new measures to protect a student with a severe peanut allergy have led to protests and debates among parents about fairness versus safety. The policies require special lunch arrangements, handwashing, and at one point, mouth rinsing, to prevent allergic reactions. The allergy is classified as a disability under the Americans With Disabilities Act. Food allergies are becoming increasingly common among children, as CDC data shows a near 20% rise in reported cases from 1997 to 2007. In a quiz for Women's History Month, students were reminded that Sandra Day O'Connor was the first woman appointed to the U.S. Supreme Court, serving nearly 25 years after her appointment in 1981. Her birthday was also recognized. Captain Ivan Castro, who lost his eyesight while serving in Iraq, completed a full marathon aided only by his running partner, demonstrating determination and resilience.

article_content: An audience member described the UK premiere of Lee Won-suk’s comedy film, 'Killing Romance', as “incredibly weird — but delightful”. The film stars Lee Hanee, recently seen in 'Alienoid', as Hwa Yeo-rae, a viral internet celebrity trapped in a controlling marriage with Jonathan Na, portrayed by Lee Sun-kyun of 'Parasite' fame. To escape Na, Yeo-rae joins forces with her neighbor Beom-woo (Gong Myung), a young superfan who devises increasingly bizarre murder plots. While the premise may seem like traditional neo-noir, director Lee transforms the story into a surreal, lively live-action cartoon, featuring musical numbers and even a telepathic ostrich with a spaghetti western-style vendetta. The film’s production encountered difficulties due to the COVID-19 pandemic, forcing the team to leave their studio and shoot at various locations. Lee described the process as a 'travelling circus,' adapting to each situation as it arose. 'Sometimes we got really lucky,' Lee noted, 'and sometimes there were scenes we couldn’t use because of poor quality.' This approach contributed to the film’s dreamlike, unpredictable vibe. 'Don’t ask why, just go with it,' Lee joked. Originally, the script by acclaimed writer Park Jeong-ye was a serious drama. However, when the production company gave Lee creative freedom, he reimagined it as a modern fairy tale. Upon its April release in Korea, 'Killing Romance' divided audiences. According to Lee, the film’s rating on the 'Golden Egg'—a review metric similar to Rotten Tomatoes—was quickly broken: 'Usually it stays intact for several days, but it cracked within two hours.' Thanks to devoted fans, the film soon regained its status, an unprecedented turnaround. Lee attributed this resurgence to social media, particularly Twitter. 'I used to think people on Twitter were harsh,' he reflected, 'but now, viewers find new meanings with each watch. Many reach out with questions, and I make an effort to reply to all. I’m very grateful to them.'

article_content:
A group of young Israeli expatriates in Berlin has sparked debate in Israel by urging others to join them for a more affordable life. Driven by high living costs at home, many Israelis have relocated to the German capital. The issue gained attention when it was revealed that a popular Israeli chocolate pudding is sold in Berlin for a third of its price in Israel.

This trend, however, has provoked anger among Israelis. Some view the move as insensitive, given lingering Holocaust memories and ongoing connections to national identity. Many within Israel's survivor community remain hesitant to visit Germany or buy its products. Columnist Ben Caspit, writing in Maariv, criticized the movement, insisting that challenges should be addressed within Israel.

The controversy escalated when a 25-year-old former Israeli army officer shared photos of inexpensive groceries in Berlin, including the chocolate pudding, and praised life in the city. The so-called 'Milky' protest, named after the pudding’s Israeli brand, led to a viral Facebook campaign with 17,000 'likes' and photos of Israelis holding signs asking German Chancellor Angela Merkel for visas. Israeli news outlets dispatched reporters to Berlin to cover the growing expat community there.

Finance Minister Yair Lapid expressed understanding for the protesters' frustrations with the cost of living, but objected to the approach, stating his belief that Jews belong in Israel. The original protest organizer stated his intent was not to encourage mass emigration but to push Israeli politicians to enact meaningful reforms for young people. He remains anonymous to keep the focus on the cause rather than himself, and says many Israelis have reached out to him for visa information.

Cabinet Minister Yair Shamir expressed pity for those leaving Israel, referencing the tragedy of the Holocaust. Yet some commentators, like Ravit Hecht of Haaretz, argue that hardline nationalist attitudes may be driving young Israelis away—though she does not endorse emigration as a solution.

Berlin’s Israeli expat community is thriving, with estimates ranging from 3,000 to 30,000 residents. Many are drawn by affordable housing, access to free university education, and a vibrant cultural scene. Some receive German social benefits, while others build businesses and organize cultural activities.

Demographers point out that emigration from Israel to Berlin is largely a symbolic issue: far more European Jews move to Israel than vice versa. For instance, more than 5,300 French Jews are expected to emigrate to Israel this year alone, outpacing Israeli departures. Hebrew University's Sergio Della Pergola notes that Israeli emigration has declined in recent years, with most emigrants heading to the U.S. or Canada rather than Europe, and only about 3,065 Israelis were registered as Berlin residents in 2012.

Nevertheless, the idea of leaving Israel amid adversity is emotionally fraught in a country where resilience and sacrifice are central values. Former Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin famously criticized departing Israelis, a sentiment echoed in reactions to the current campaign, which uses the term 'Aliyah'—typically indicating immigration to Israel—for those seeking to move abroad.

一群居住在柏林的以色列年轻侨民，因呼吁他人一同前往德国追求更实惠的生活，在以色列引发了争议。由于国内生活成本高昂，许多以色列人选择迁往德国首都。这一问题受到关注，是因为一种在以色列很受欢迎的巧克力布丁，在柏林的售价仅为以色列的三分之一。

然而，这一趋势在以色列引发了愤怒。一些人认为这样的举动令人难以接受，因为大屠杀的记忆以及对民族身份的认同依然根深蒂固。以色列幸存者群体中的许多人至今仍对前往德国或购买德国产品持保留态度。Maariv报专栏作家Ben Caspit在评论中批评了该运动，并坚持认为应在国内解决挑战。

争议在一位25岁的前以色列军官分享自己在柏林购买便宜杂货（包括巧克力布丁）并称赞当地生活之后进一步升级。被称为“Milky抗议”（以该布丁的以色列品牌命名）的行动在Facebook上走红，获得了1.7万个点赞，还有以色列人手举请德国总理默克尔给予签证标语的照片也不断扩散。以色列新闻媒体为此还派遣记者前往柏林，报道日益壮大的侨民社群。

财政部长亚伊尔·拉皮德表示理解抗议者对生活成本的沮丧，但并不赞同他们的行为方式，坚称犹太人应当生活在以色列。最初的抗议组织者表示，他的目的是促使以色列政界为年轻人实施切实改革，并非鼓励大规模移民。他保持匿名，希望公众关注议题本身，并表示有许多以色列人向他咨询签证相关信息。

内阁部长雅伊尔·沙米尔表达了对那些离开以色列者的同情，提及大屠杀的惨痛历史。但包括《Haaretz》专栏作家Ravit Hecht在内的一些评论人士认为，极端民族主义的态度实际上在推动青年离开——尽管她并不认同移民是解决方案。

柏林的以色列侨民社区日益繁荣，估计人数在3,000到30,000人之间。许多人被当地实惠的住房、免费的大学教育和丰富的文化生活吸引。部分人获得了德国社会补助，还有人开办企业、组织文化活动。

人口学家指出，从以色列移民至柏林在很大程度上是象征性的：欧洲来到以色列的犹太人数远高于以色列的外流。例如仅法国，今年预计就有5,300多名犹太人将移民以色列，远超以色列人的离境人数。希伯来大学人口学家Sergio Della Pergola指出，近年来以色列移民人数其实下降，大多数人前往美国或加拿大，2012年仅有约3,065名以色列人在柏林登记居住。

尽管如此，在坚韧与奉献是核心价值的以色列，困难时期选择离开依然难以被接受。前总理伊扎克·拉宾曾公开指责离开国家的人，这种观点也体现在当前运动所引发的争议中。该活动甚至用“Aliyah”——通常意指犹太人回归以色列——来形容那些希望前往海外的人。

A tragic fire broke out in Arlington, Virginia early Tuesday morning, claiming the lives of Mary Barkes and her seven-year-old daughter, Emily. Mary and her husband, Bill, initially made it outside, but their daughters Emily and Sarah, aged 11, remained trapped. Showing remarkable courage, Mary called emergency services and re-entered the burning home to save Emily, who was sleeping upstairs. Sadly, both Mary and Emily succumbed to the fire.

Bill tried to rescue Sarah by climbing through a window, but he fell and was injured, making it impossible for him to go back inside to help Mary and Emily. Neighbors were awakened by the commotion and attempted to assist, but the smoke and flames forced them back. Around 70 firefighters responded to the scene, but the intensity of the fire kept them from entering the home immediately.

Bill and Sarah survived and are receiving treatment at a hospital, where their conditions are reported as stable. The cause of the fire is under investigation, with preliminary information suggesting that the house did not have smoke detectors.
