article_content: Rupert Murdoch, head of News Corp., appeared at the Leveson Inquiry in London to address questions about his influence on Britain's media and political landscape. This was not Murdoch's first time facing lawmakers in the UK, as he previously answered questions about alleged phone hacking at the now-defunct News of the World. The Inquiry focused on Murdoch's relationships with successive British prime ministers over the decades, examining whether these close ties benefited his interests. Similar concerns have prompted investigations of News Corp. in the US and increased scrutiny in Australia. On the witness stand, Murdoch firmly denied that his newspapers lobbied for his commercial interests or that he ever asked a prime minister for favors. When questioned specifically about former Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher, Murdoch insisted, 'And none asked.' The issue of influence is particularly relevant due to concerns over Culture Secretary Jeremy Hunt's impartiality in reviewing News Corp.'s attempted takeover of BSkyB. Hunt's aide resigned after revelations of inappropriate communications with News Corp., though Hunt denied any improper conduct. News Corp., via its UK division News International, controls about 37% of national newspaper circulation in Britain, including The Times, Sunday Times, and The Sun. With approximately 60% of the UK reading a national newspaper, Murdoch's influence on public opinion is substantial. As of the end of last year, News Corp. employed around 48,000 people worldwide, reported total assets of about $60 billion, annual revenues of roughly $34 billion, and had over 260,000 shareholders, according to Murdoch's written testimony. Experts like Professor Steven Barnett and commentator Michael Wolff argue that Murdoch, as a powerful media owner, has inevitably influenced political and regulatory outcomes. Barnett described Murdoch's denials as 'extraordinary' and 'ludicrous,' given his history of business expansion and favorable regulatory decisions. During his testimony, Murdoch discussed his interactions with various British leaders, including a secret lunch with Margaret Thatcher prior to his acquisition of The Times newspapers. He recounted disagreements with former Prime Minister Gordon Brown and denied any quid pro quo with Tony Blair when his newspapers shifted support to Labour in 1997. Although News Corp. is a major presence in the UK, it constitutes only 8% of its global revenue. In Australia, through News Ltd., Murdoch controls 70% of newspapers, including the only national daily. However, the United States remains the key market, with ownership of influential outlets like The Wall Street Journal, New York Post, and Fox News. Fox News has played a significant role in American politics, particularly in promoting the Tea Party movement. Critics argue that its opinion programming has a consistently conservative slant, though News Corp. asserts that its news coverage remains balanced. The Obama administration at one point described Fox as 'the communications arm of the Republican Party.' Former Sunday Times editor Andrew Neil noted that Murdoch has been coached by lawyers to avoid jeopardizing his American interests, especially while investigations are ongoing by the FBI, Department of Justice, and SEC. Despite being challenged at the Leveson Inquiry, Murdoch remained steadfast. Analysts suggest his influence in the UK is waning due to recent scandals, but he continues to wield significant global power, especially in the US. His son, James Murdoch, who also testified about phone hacking allegations, has since resigned as chairman of News International. Rupert Murdoch is scheduled to return to the witness stand, as media observers continue to watch closely.
translated_content: 新闻集团（News Corp.）负责人鲁珀特·默多克（Rupert Murdoch）在伦敦出席利维森调查（Leveson Inquiry），就其对英国媒体与政治的影响接受质询。这并非默多克首次在英国面对议员，他曾就《世界新闻报》（News of the World）涉嫌电话窃听事件作出回应。 此次调查重点关注默多克几十年来与英国多任首相的关系，审查这些密切联系是否为其个人利益提供便利。出于类似担忧，新闻集团在美国也面临调查，并在澳大利亚受到更多监管关注。 在作证时，默多克坚决否认其报纸曾为自身商业利益游说，或曾向任何首相提出过请求。被问及前首相玛格丽特·撒切尔时，默多克表示：“从未有人提出请求。” 有关影响力的问题尤为重要，因为对文化大臣杰里米·亨特在审查新闻集团收购BSkyB时的中立性存疑。亨特的助手因与新闻集团的不当沟通曝光后辞职，但亨特否认自己有任何不当行为。 通过旗下英国分部新闻国际（News International），新闻集团控制了英国约37%的全国报纸发行量，包括《泰晤士报》《星期日泰晤士报》和《太阳报》。约60%的英国公众会阅读全国性报纸，默多克对舆论的影响十分巨大。 根据默多克的书面证词，截至去年底，新闻集团在全球约有48,000名员工，总资产约600亿美元，年收入约340亿美元，股东超过260,000人。 专家如西敏大学教授史蒂文·巴内特（Steven Barnett）和评论员迈克尔·沃尔夫（Michael Wolff）认为，作为强大的媒体所有者，默多克不可避免地影响了政治和监管决策。巴内特称默多克的否认“相当荒谬”，因为他的商业扩张及有利于他的监管决定有据可查。 在作证时，默多克谈及与多位英国领导人的互动，包括收购《泰晤士报》前与撒切尔的秘密午餐。他还提到与戈登·布朗（Gordon Brown）关系恶化，并否认在报纸于1997年转而支持托尼·布莱尔（Tony Blair）及工党后存在任何利益交换。 尽管新闻集团在英国实力雄厚，但英国业务仅占其全球收入的8%。在澳大利亚，通过新闻有限公司（News Ltd.），默多克掌控了70%的报纸份额，包括唯一的全国性日报。然而，美国才是其核心市场，新闻集团旗下拥有《华尔街日报》《纽约邮报》和福克斯新闻等重要媒体。 福克斯新闻在美国政治中的影响尤为巨大，尤其是在推动茶党运动方面。批评者认为其评论节目一贯倾向保守，而新闻集团则称新闻报道保持平衡。奥巴马政府曾称福克斯是“共和党的通讯工具”。 前《星期日泰晤士报》编辑安德鲁·尼尔（Andrew Neil）表示，默多克在美国正受到FBI、司法部和SEC调查，为避免因言失误影响在美利益，他做了充分准备。 尽管在利维森调查中面临质询，默多克依然表现坚决。分析认为丑闻影响了其在英国的权力，但在全球，尤其美国，他依旧影响巨大。他的儿子詹姆斯·默多克（James Murdoch）也因窃听丑闻作证并辞去新闻国际董事长职务。鲁珀特·默多克还将重返证人席，媒体观察者将继续紧盯他的发言。

article_content: Darrell Tunningley, a former drug dealer and convicted criminal, has left his past behind to become a church pastor. Tunningley began engaging in criminal activity at the age of 11, starting by stealing badges from luxury cars. By the age of 16, he was selling heroin and cocaine, supporting a heroin addiction that cost up to £300 a day. He was eventually sentenced to five and a half years in prison for being the driver in an armed robbery. Now 35, Tunningley is married with two children and serves as a senior pastor at Hope Corner Community Church in Runcorn, Cheshire, working alongside his father-in-law. He often speaks about his former life while ministering to others. Tunningley spent time in HMP Wolds (Brough, East Yorkshire), where his life began to change after meeting two patient and compassionate nuns. Their kindness, described by Tunningley as 'love bombs', inspired him to reconsider his life. That night, he prayed and committed himself to God. After this turning point, Tunningley distanced himself from violence and drug use. He was later visited in prison by Mark Finch, who would become his father-in-law. Upon his release, Tunningley joined Hope Corner Community Church and eventually married Rebekah, a social worker and Mark Finch's daughter. They now have two children, Benjamin and Lydia-Grace. Tunningley says he has never been happier and hopes to inspire others to make positive changes. He gives talks about his experiences, works with young people, and helped establish Hope Corner Academy, a church-run special educational needs school. Mark Finch praises Tunningley's transformation and contribution to the community, especially in providing authentic drug awareness education to youth. Tunningley's story continues to serve as an example of personal change and the power of new beginnings.

article_content: A sharp reduction has occurred in England's mixed-sex hospital wards, with recent data indicating a 90% decrease in patients placed in such settings over just a few months. Health Secretary Andrew Lansley commended the NHS, attributing these improvements to tighter enforcement measures—including structured fines aimed at maintaining patient dignity and safety. These changes come after years of advocacy by media organizations like the Daily Mail and by patient groups, who raised concerns that mixed-sex accommodation threatened privacy, posed particular risks for women, and failed to respect patient dignity. In December of the previous year, over 11,000 patients in England were housed in mixed-sex wards. This figure has now dropped to 1,126, marking a historic low. More than two-thirds of NHS trusts reported no incidents of mixed-sex accommodation in the most recent month, with the North East region eliminating them entirely; overall, 115 out of 167 trusts recorded zero breaches. Following the start of the Coalition government, the Department of Health imposed a £250 fine for each day a patient was assigned to mixed-sex accommodation. This uniform penalty replaced a previously inconsistent approach, prompting NHS managers to accelerate reforms. Earlier, the Labour government had repeatedly pledged to abolish mixed-sex wards, dating back to Tony Blair's leadership. However, concerns about the costs involved meant that practices such as partitioned bays persisted, and some female patients reported safety incidents during this period. Current policy directs most NHS trusts to provide single-sex accommodation, with exemptions only for intensive care and emergency units. New developments or refurbishments are expected to include at least half of beds in single, en-suite rooms, further improving privacy. Patient advocates see the results as positive, though some—like Katherine Murphy from the Patients Association—express disappointment that only financial pressure brought about this progress. She added that any mixed accommodation should now be rare, not routine. Help the Aged and the Patients Association have long supported this shift, highlighting distress among older patients compelled to share intimate facilities. Although Labour’s Health Ministers publicly reiterated their intention to ban mixed wards, including Baroness Jay and Alan Johnson, decisive reductions have come only recently through clear policies and stringent sanctions.
translated_content: 英格兰混合性别病房的患者人数大幅下降，最新数据显示仅几个月内减少了90%。卫生大臣安德鲁·兰斯利高度评价国家医疗服务体系（NHS），并将这一进步归因于更为严格的监管措施——包括针对维护患者尊严和安全而设立的专项罚款。 这一变化是在长期以来，包括《每日邮报》和患者团体等媒体多方倡导下实现的。他们指出，混合性别病房侵犯隐私，尤其对女性存在风险，同时也有损患者尊严。 去年12月，英格兰有逾1.1万名患者居住在混合性别病房。现在，这一数字已降至1,126人，创下新低。最近一个月，超过三分之二的NHS信托报告未出现混合性别病房案例，东北地区甚至已完全消除；167家信托中有115家实现零违规。 联合政府执政后，卫生部对每位患者在混合性别病房住一晚处以250英镑罚款，这一统一措施取代了此前不一致的做法，加速了NHS改革步伐。 之前，工党政府早在托尼·布莱尔领导时期就多次承诺废除混合性别病房，但因涉及高额费用，依旧保留了如隔断床位等模式，期间部分女性患者曾经历安全事件。 现行政策要求大部分NHS信托设立单一性别病房，仅重症监护和急诊部门例外。新建与改建医院则要求至少有一半床位为单人带卫生间，进一步提升隐私度。 患者权益人士对这一结果表示肯定，但如患者协会的凯瑟琳·墨菲所说，令人遗憾的是改革是在经济压力下才启动的。她强调，未来混合性别病房应为极少数特例，而非普遍现象。 长期以来，援助老人会和患者协会持续推动改革，关注年长患者因共用设施而产生的不适与困扰。尽管工党卫生部长如杰伊男爵夫人及艾伦·约翰逊多次强调禁止混合病房的承诺，但真正取得显著改变，还是借助了近期严格政策与惩罚措施。
post_content: Big win for patient privacy! England slashes mixed-sex ward numbers by 90%—thanks to new rules, fines, and a push for dignity in hospitals. Change came after years of campaigning. #NHS #hospitalreform #patientsfirst

article_content: A recent survey highlights that eating lunch at your desk could be contributing to weight gain for office workers. Nearly half of respondents admitted putting on extra pounds from this habit, which is often fueled by snacking on crisps, chocolate, and soft drinks instead of healthier options during proper breaks. Traditional lunch hours are dwindling, as only 18% of office staff now take them regularly, compared to 85% ten years ago. Increased work demands have led about 40% of people to eat at their desks daily, with an additional 20% doing so most days. Only 21% never eat at their desks. The survey, conducted by Forza Supplements, found 58% of workers felt pressured to work through their lunch, even though they wanted a break. Most workers take less than half an hour for lunch, with one in five taking under 15 minutes. Desk-side eating often means indulging in vending machine snacks: 60% of workers regularly have chocolate, crisps, or soft drinks, and many feel guilty afterwards. These rushed lunch habits, combined with high-calorie foods like wraps and sandwiches, can result in consuming more than 1,200 calories during a typical workday. Common lunch items include the Pret Swedish Meatball Hot Wrap (674 calories), Marks and Spencer Wensleydale and carrot chutney sandwich (515 calories), Burger King’s salad wrap (490 calories), Caffe Nero’s BLT sandwich (471 calories), and Subway’s Spicy Italian (471 calories). Experts, such as Lee Smith from Forza Supplements, warn that the decline in social, out-of-office lunches is hurting diets, as people no longer have time to choose healthier, lower-calorie foods. Many office workers now use indulgent snacks as rewards for their efforts throughout the workday. Even seemingly healthy sandwich options from popular outlets can quickly add up in calories, making it easy to exceed recommended daily intake: 2,000 calories for women and 2,500 for men.

article_content: A thief broke into the Tower of London and stole keys belonging to guards in a significant security lapse. The intruder reportedly scaled the Front Gate to enter the historic fortress, which houses the Crown Jewels. According to The Sun, the set of keys, used to unlock drawbridges, was stored in a metal box that was supposed to be securely locked. Guards noticed the thief and radioed for help but, due to strict rules, could not leave their posts to pursue the suspect. Unfortunately, their requests for assistance were not heeded, allowing the thief to escape. Management was then forced to urgently change the locks, incurring considerable expense. It is claimed that the keys, stolen on Guy Fawkes Night, could also open conference rooms and a restaurant within the Tower. While the Crown Jewels are invaluable, this is only the second known theft attempt— the first being in 1671, when Colonel Blood and his accomplices tried unsuccessfully to steal them. He was pardoned by Charles II after being caught. The Tower is traditionally guarded by Yeoman Warders, also known as Beefeaters, supported by a private security company. Despite the incident, management and Historic Royal Palaces insisted that the Crown Jewels were never at risk, stating that the stolen keys could not have granted access to them and that all affected locks were immediately replaced. The Metropolitan Police have confirmed receiving a report of theft, and Tower Hamlets CID is investigating. An internal review found that established security procedures were not properly followed during this incident and staff disciplinary action is underway. In the past, the Tower of London has been targeted before, notably in 1974 when the IRA planted a bomb, resulting in casualties. Security arrangements have generally been robust, particularly when safeguarding valuable items such as Olympic medals before the 2012 London Games.

article_content: Asiana Airlines announced it is providing $10,000 to each passenger who was aboard Flight 214, which crashed in San Francisco last month. 'This payment is separate from medical compensation,' spokeswoman Lee Hyo-min told CNN on Monday, noting that even uninjured passengers are eligible. She clarified that passengers who accept the payment can still pursue legal action against the airline. The crash on July 6 at San Francisco International Airport resulted in three fatalities. Among them was 16-year-old Ye Mengyuan from China, who initially survived the crash but was fatally struck by a rescue vehicle, according to the San Mateo County coroner. San Francisco Fire Department Chief Joanne Hayes-White expressed deep condolences to Ye's family, saying, 'We're heartbroken. We're in the business of saving lives.' More than 180 people were injured in the crash, which is currently under investigation by the National Transportation Safety Board. A separate incident involved a couple allegedly stealing passengers' luggage at the airport after the crash.

Rep. Barney Frank announced a proposal on Wednesday to end federal penalties for Americans possessing less than 100 grams (about a quarter-pound) of marijuana. His bill, titled the Personal Use of Marijuana by Responsible Adults Act of 2008 (HR 5843), aims to decriminalize the personal use—but not abuse—of marijuana at the federal level. Frank argued that current laws place undue burdens on law enforcement, penalize patients whose doctors have prescribed marijuana, and disproportionately affect African-Americans. "The vast amount of human activity ought to be none of the government's business," Frank said at Capitol Hill. He was joined by other legislators and advocacy groups, including Rep. Ron Paul, as well as representatives from NORML and the Marijuana Policy Project.

The Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) asserts that people charged with simple possession are rarely incarcerated and, along with the White House Office of National Drug Control Policy, opposes any move to legalize marijuana, highlighting its Schedule I status, health and safety risks, and the danger of encouraging broader drug use.

Allen St. Pierre of NORML likened Frank’s bill to alcohol policy, contending responsible marijuana users should not face arrest, just as responsible alcohol consumers do not. He noted that tens of millions of marijuana-related arrests have occurred since the 1960s, consuming significant law enforcement resources.

Rob Kampia, director of the Marijuana Policy Project, underscored that marijuana arrests outnumber those for all violent crimes combined, which, he argued, diverts resources from addressing more serious offenses. Lawmakers such as Reps. William Lacy Clay and Barbara Lee emphasized the disproportionate impact of current policies on African-Americans and described the laws as outdated. Bill Piper from the Drug Policy Alliance Network pointed out that marijuana convictions can lead to loss of jobs, financial aid, and social benefits such as food stamps and housing.

Frank’s bill would allow adults to possess up to 100 grams of marijuana and permit nonprofit transfers of up to one ounce, but would not amend federal laws regarding cultivation, import, export, or for-profit sales, nor would it override state laws. Frank, who said he does not use marijuana, stated that he advocates for personal freedom but does not encourage drug or tobacco use.

Overall, the proposal aims to redirect federal focus away from prosecuting nonviolent marijuana users and toward issues of actual public safety.

美国缉毒局（DEA）表示，因单纯持有大麻而被指控的人很少会被监禁。该机构与白宫国家毒品管制政策办公室一样，反对大麻合法化，理由包括大麻是一类受控物质、存在健康和安全风险，以及可能导致更广泛药物滥用的隐患。

全国大麻法律改革组织（NORML）的艾伦·圣皮埃尔认为，弗兰克的法案类似于酒精政策，主张对负责任的大麻使用者不应采取逮捕措施，正如对负责任饮酒者不会被逮捕一样。他指出，自1960年代以来，美国因大麻有关的案件已有数千万次逮捕，消耗了大量执法资源。

大麻政策项目负责人罗布·坎皮亚强调，大麻相关逮捕数量超过所有暴力犯罪逮捕总和，这导致执法资源无法专注于严重犯罪。众议员威廉·莱西·克莱和芭芭拉·李也强调，现行政策对非裔美国人的影响尤为严重，并认为这些法律已落后于时代。药物政策联盟网络的比尔·派珀指出，大麻相关定罪可能导致失业、丧失助学金和社会福利如食品券及住房资格。

总体来看，该提案旨在让联邦执法重心从打击非暴力大麻用户转向关注真正的公共安全问题。

article_content: The Duchess of Cambridge visited Blessed Sacrament School in Islington, North London this morning to observe the progress of the M-PACT Plus project, which supports families affected by addiction. Dressed in a bright salmon pink dress by Goat, the Duchess warmly greeted and chatted with flag-waving children who were excited to meet her. Kate wore her long brown hair in glossy ringlets, styled half up. During her visit, she took the time to talk to several youngsters, who cheerfully shared what they liked best about school. One little boy, Ezekiel, told her his favorite part was lunchtime, while another girl, Seyi, said she liked Kate’s dress and was happy she came to the school. Launched in 2013 when Kate was pregnant with Prince George, the M-PACT Plus project is funded by The Royal Foundation of The Duke and Duchess of Cambridge and Prince Harry, in conjunction with Comic Relief, Place2Be, and Action on Addiction. The program offers early help to children whose parents are struggling with drug or alcohol misuse. Through her role as patron of Action on Addiction, Kate became aware of the profound effects addiction can have on families and has been closely involved in the project. Research indicates that children of addicts are significantly more likely to develop addictions themselves. M-PACT Plus brings together expert organizations to provide specialist support for these children at school. During her visit, Kate met with project coordinators and headteachers from various regions rolling out the initiative, joined a private counselling session, and received artwork and flowers from students. She also asked questions about the experiences of parents and the effectiveness of teacher training. Comedian John Bishop, who joined Kate for the event, encouraged the media to focus on the project’s impact rather than on fashion or appearances. He praised the Duchess’s genuine commitment to helping families affected by addiction. Hairdressers remarked on Kate's choice to wear her hair in tight curls for the day, pointing out the style’s practicality and modern twist. A representative from Place2Be noted that with one in three children in classrooms affected by mental health issues, early intervention is crucial. The charity provides integrated support to over 80,000 children across the UK for various challenges including addiction, family problems, and bullying.

Eight months after the release of a landmark U.N. Commission of Inquiry report on human rights in North Korea, the United Nations is now considering how to respond to what has been identified as crimes against humanity by Pyongyang. The European Union is notably taking the lead in drafting a response. However, the same report reveals that several European countries—both EU and non-EU—have continued to supply luxury goods to the Kim Jong Un regime despite multiple U.N. Security Council bans. By permitting these trades, Europe has contributed to, and continues to support, North Korea’s oppressive treatment of its people.

The Commission estimates that the North Korean famine of the mid- to late-1990s claimed between 450,000 and 2 million lives, with responsibility attributed directly to the country’s leadership. These deaths were avoidable; during the famine, Kim Jong Il, the current leader’s father, spent significant resources on weapons, luxury goods, and monumental projects, rather than providing food for the population. Many of the famine’s victims were from the lowest tiers of North Korea’s political system, adding an element of systemic injustice to the disaster—evoking dark historical comparisons such as the Khmer Rouge’s infamous saying, "To keep you is no benefit, to destroy you is no loss."

Less widely known is the role European nations played in exacerbating this tragedy. In 2006—after the famine—the U.N. Security Council unanimously banned the import of luxury goods by North Korea, a sanction reiterated in later resolutions and included in EU regulations. Yet, enforcement has often ranged from lax to absent, with a "don’t ask, don’t tell" attitude towards prohibited exports for the benefit of Pyongyang’s elite. This practice empowers Kim’s inner circle, who acquire banned European luxury items to reward loyalty and strengthen the regime’s hold on power.

North Korea has sometimes acquired these goods through intermediaries, but there have also been direct sales. During the famine, Swiss companies reportedly sold millions of dollars’ worth of watches annually to Kim Jong Il. According to Kim’s former sushi chef, personal shoppers traveled from North Korea to Denmark for pork, to the Czech Republic for beer, and sourced luxury cars and cognac from Europe. In 2010, Radio Free Asia reported that Kim Jong Il ordered 160 Mercedes-Benz sedans for his associates. Since Kim Jong Un’s rise in 2011, regime spending on luxury imports has increased, now far exceeding expenditure on importing food for the population, as noted by a South Korean lawmaker.

Former NBA star Dennis Rodman, who has visited North Korea several times, described Kim Jong Un’s lavish lifestyle, including a private island, a large yacht, and an abundance of high-end liquor—even as a U.N. study found that 84% of North Korean households have inadequate food. A 2013 report by The Telegraph identified European-manufactured snowmobiles and equipment at Kim’s new ski resort. Swiss authorities refused to sell ski lifts for the resort, a decision North Korea condemned as a "serious human rights abuse."

Proponents of engagement with North Korea have often overlooked the moral implications of such ongoing trade. In practice, years of engagement have led to growing wealth disparities, with the regime’s elite thriving while the majority suffers from increased restrictions on smuggling, markets, and private farming activities. The U.N. identifies North Korea, despite being industrialized and literate, as suffering some of the world’s worst food insecurity—comparable to rates in much poorer, less developed countries. This situation results from policy choices rather than resource shortages.

While the EU’s initiatives at the U.N. are positive, European nations still have a legal and moral duty to enforce sanctions and promote better use of North Korean resources, ideally compelling Kim Jong Un to prioritize his citizens’ needs. The Swiss NGO UN Watch recently highlighted a call from 20 North Korean defectors, including former political prisoners, urging Switzerland to freeze regime bank accounts. The article suggests that such funds could be redirected toward food purchases—if delivery could be reliably monitored.

Additionally, Europe’s SWIFT network, which has excluded sanctioned Iranian banks, is encouraged to also stop processing payments for North Korean entities subject to U.N. sanctions. Ultimately, the article calls for the global community to insist that North Korea’s wealth should serve its population, not just its privileged elite.

在联合国调查委员会发布关于朝鲜人权的里程碑式报告八个月后，联合国正在审议如何应对被认定为平壤犯下的反人类罪。欧盟正扮演主导角色，起草应对方案。然而，报告同时指出，多家欧洲国家——包括欧盟和非欧盟成员国——尽管有多项联合国安理会禁令，仍持续向金正恩政权供应奢侈品。欧洲默许这些贸易，实际上助长了朝鲜对本国人民的压迫。

委员会估算，上世纪90年代中后期爆发的朝鲜大饥荒导致约45万至200万人死亡，主要责任归咎于该国领导层。这些死亡本可避免；饥荒期间，现任领导人金正恩之父金正日将大量资源花在武器、奢侈品和纪念工程上，而不是救济百姓。许多受害者来自朝鲜政治体系的底层，加剧了灾难的体制性不公，令人联想到红色高棉那句臭名昭著的话：“留着你没益处，杀了你也无损失”。

更鲜为人知的是，欧洲国家在推动这一悲剧方面所扮演的角色。2006年，安理会一致决议禁止朝鲜进口奢侈品，欧盟也执行了相关法令。但实际上，对禁令的执行常常不力，出现了“睁一只眼闭一只眼”、为平壤精英利益提供非法出口的问题。这使得金正恩的核心圈层能够用受禁的欧洲奢侈品奖励亲信，加深其对政权的掌控。

朝鲜有时通过中间商采购奢侈品，有时则直接购入。饥荒期间，瑞士公司每年向金正日售出数百万美元的手表。据金正日的前寿司厨师透露，朝鲜个人采购员曾飞往丹麦买猪肉，去捷克购啤酒，还从欧洲采购豪车和白兰地。2010年，自由亚洲电台报道称金正日为其亲信购置了160辆奔驰。韩国议员的统计显示，金正恩上台后，朝鲜奢侈品开支持续飙升，远超为百姓购买食品的总额。

曾多次访问朝鲜的前NBA球星丹尼斯·罗德曼曾描述金正恩的奢靡生活，包括私人岛屿、巨型游艇和高档烈酒——而联合国调查发现，朝鲜84%家庭的粮食摄入不足或接近不足水平。2013年，《每日电讯报》还在金正恩新建滑雪场的照片中认出多种欧洲制造的雪地摩托及设施。瑞士当局拒绝向该滑雪场出售缆车，朝鲜对此称之为“严重的人权侵犯”。

主张与朝鲜“接触”的支持者常常忽视该贸易带来的道德困境。实际上，多年来的接触政策只让权贵更富，大多数民众则因打压走私、市场和私人种植而生活日益艰难。联合国指出，尽管朝鲜是工业化、高识字率国家，但粮食不安全问题却居世界前列，堪比一些最贫困的发展中国家。造成这一现状的是政策选择，而非资源短缺。

欧盟在联合国的主导值得称许，但各欧洲国家依然承担着严格执行制裁的法律和道义责任，并应敦促金正恩将本国财富优先用于民生。瑞士非政府组织UN Watch近日援引20位朝鲜脱北者（包括前政治犯）的呼吁，敦促瑞士冻结朝鲜政权银行账户。文章建议，在可靠监督下，这些资金应逐步用于粮食采购。

此外，欧盟SWIFT支付网络已停止为受制裁的伊朗银行服务，同样应拒绝处理受联合国制裁的朝鲜实体的支付指令。文章最后呼吁，国际社会应共同推动朝鲜财富惠及全体人民，而非只肥养特权阶层。

article_content: Slack recently released a global survey shedding light on five prevalent workplace personalities. Conducted by YouGov, the study gathered responses from 15,492 employed adults across nine countries—including the U.S., UK, France, Germany, Australia, India, Japan, Singapore, and South Korea—during September and October 2023. The report highlights that about 30% of employees are 'detectives,' individuals who excel at seeking out information, staying organized, and independently solving problems. These workers are curious and reliable, often keeping both themselves and their colleagues ‘in the know.’ Another 22% fit the 'road warrior' persona, often working remotely or in various locations. Road warriors value flexibility, adapt easily to new situations, and are quick to adopt modern work tools. Also comprising 22% of the workforce are 'networkers.' They are engaged, sociable, and thrive on building relationships across different teams. Networkers generally enjoy office life and believe in maintaining open communication among colleagues. The 'problem solver' group, at 16%, focuses on efficiency and productivity. They constantly look for tech-driven solutions to save time, with many embracing artificial intelligence and automation early on. Lastly, 'expressionists' represent 10% of workers and are known for infusing fun and informality into workplace communication. They frequently use visual elements like emojis, memes, and gifs, and are recognized for engaging virtually and experimenting with new tech like AI. Overall, the study emphasizes how these five personalities contribute distinct strengths to workplace dynamics.

article_content: A new study reveals that local variations in the impact of solar storms on Earth are greater than previously estimated. Researchers found that the effects of solar storms can differ significantly even over distances as short as 100 kilometers. The findings were published in Scientific Reports. Local changes in the magnetic environment have largely gone unexplored due to the sparse distribution of magnetometers in the main observation areas. Currently, geomagnetic storms are recorded by magnetometers spaced about 400 kilometers apart. These storms, caused by fast solar wind streams, produce large electric currents in the ionosphere above Earth's auroral regions, but the behavior of these currents during storms remains not fully understood. Solar storms can also create spectacular auroras. Scientists from the Sodankylä Geophysical Observatory (SGO) and the Ionospheric Physics Group at the University of Oulu, Finland, investigated local magnetic field disturbances during space storms using historical data. The new study examined data from a powerful solar storm in December 1977, collected from all 32 stations of the then-Scandinavian Magnetometer Array (SMA) in the Nordic countries. This network was much denser than today’s arrays and remains largely unexamined. Analyzing these data was challenging; in 1977, changes in Earth's magnetic field were recorded as fluctuations on physical film strips by magnetometers. Researchers worked with nearly 40 kilometers of previously untouched film. These strips were photographed frame by frame before being digitized for analysis using both old and modern magnetic data. Their findings revealed clear regional differences in the intensity of solar storms. "Usually today, we view the entire auroral region as a single entity. However, using more than 30 instruments, we mapped the effects of one solar storm from the Arctic Ocean to the Bothnian Sea," explained Otto Kärhä, a doctoral researcher at the University of Oulu, who assisted in photographing the archival films. Kärhä will present this research at the American Geophysical Union (AGU) Fall Meeting in San Francisco in December 2023. Large geomagnetic storms are rare, which has limited research into their local effects. The largest recorded solar storm, the Carrington Event in 1859, reportedly produced dazzling light, sparks, and fires on telegraph lines. A storm of similar strength today would likely have catastrophic effects on power grids and telecommunications, including satellites. According to the new research, local variations in a Carrington-class solar storm could reach as much as 150 nanoteslas (nT) per 10 kilometers. For perspective, conditions could range from a gentle magnetic breeze in Muonio to a significant magnetic whirlwind just 140 kilometers away in Sodankylä. "If a solar storm of this magnitude occurs, the existing sparse magnetometer network might underestimate local disturbances and reduce preparedness," warned Professor Eija Tanskanen, Director of SGO. Scientists believe that a major solar storm may occur in the near future. Tanskanen noted, "Experts' varying estimates of potential impacts stem from our incomplete understanding of Earth's geomagnetic environment, and the highly variable effects solar storms have on auroral currents. The current Intermagnet network typically has magnetometer spacing of 200–400 kilometers in the polar regions, but we would benefit from 100-kilometer intervals." Magnetometers are managed by various research institutes and observatories. Historical data from the new study identified magnetic field structures in the auroral belt that cannot be detected with today’s instrument network. "A denser magnetometer network would help us better understand the complex structure of the magnetic field during solar storms. We could provide localized warnings and better protect infrastructure sensitive to magnetic disturbances. This could also help air traffic by providing regional alerts about strong magnetic fields and storms," Tanskanen suggested.
translated_content: 一项新研究显示，太阳风暴对地球造成的局部影响比过去估计的要大得多。研究人员发现，太阳风暴的影响即使在100公里这么短的距离内，也可能有显著差异。该发现发表在《Scientific Reports》期刊上。 由于主要观测区的磁力仪分布很稀疏，局部磁场环境的变化长期都未被充分探索。目前，地磁风暴一般是用间隔约400公里的磁力仪记录。高速太阳风流引发的风暴，会在地球极光区的电离层生成巨大的电流，但这些电流在风暴时的行为仍未完全搞清楚。太阳风暴也常带来壮观的极光。 芬兰索丹屈莱地球物理观测站（SGO）和奥卢大学电离层物理团队的科学家，利用历史数据分析了空间风暴期间极光区的局部磁场扰动。 本次研究分析了1977年12月一次强太阳风暴的数据，这些数据来自当时北欧共32个斯堪的纳维亚磁力仪阵列（SMA）观测站。该网络远比如今的阵列密集，科学界之前鲜有深入研究。 分析这些数据难度很大。1977年时，地球磁场变化被磁力仪用胶片记录下来，研究团队要处理近40公里长、几十年未开发的胶片。他们把胶片逐帧拍照、数字化处理，再结合现代与旧有的数据分析，最终发现太阳风暴强度在区域之间存在明显差异。 “现在我们常把整个极光区看作一个整体。但这次我们用30多台仪器，从北冰洋到波的尼亚海，一一绘制了一次太阳风暴的影响。”奥卢大学博士生Otto Kärhä说，他也是老胶片的拍摄者之一。Kärhä将在2023年12月美国地球物理联盟（AGU）旧金山秋季会议上报告这项新发现。 巨型地磁风暴很罕见，导致其局部效应研究不足。历史上最强的太阳风暴是1859年的卡林顿事件，据说当时阳光极亮，闭眼都能感到刺眼，风暴还令电报线起火冒火花。如果现代遇到同等风暴，电网、通讯及卫星等基础设施都会遭受严重损害。 新研究显示，卡林顿级别风暴的局部磁变化可高达每10公里150纳特斯拉（nT）。例如，Muonio地区也许只是温和的磁场变化，而140公里外的Sodankylä却会遇到强烈“磁场旋风”。 芬兰SGO主任Eija Tanskanen教授提醒：“若发生如此规模的太阳风暴，现有稀疏的磁力仪网络可能低估局部磁场扰动，也影响应急准备。” 科学家们普遍认为未来可能会有大规模太阳风暴来袭。Tanskanen指出：“专家对影响的判断差异大，是因为我们对地球地磁环境仍缺乏了解，而太阳风暴对极光电流的影响极其复杂。目前极地 Intermagnet 网络间距多为200至400公里，如果能缩短至100公里会更好。”这些磁力仪由各种研究机构和天文台维护。 历史数据还揭示了极光带内部存在现有仪器无法捕捉的磁场结构。 Tanskanen补充道：“更密集的磁力仪网络能帮助我们更好理解太阳风暴期间磁场复杂结构，带来局部预警，保护易受磁扰影响的基础建设。比如可以对航空行业做出实时区域警告。”

article_content: Sequestration, a once-obscure policy term, is about to enter everyday American vocabulary if Congress and the President can't strike a budget deal by March 1. The resulting automatic federal spending cuts pose more political risk to Republicans than to Democrats. While some Republican leaders profess confidence, closer examination reveals significant threats for the party. These impending cuts could shift congressional priorities leftward, potentially giving Democrats an edge heading toward the 2014 midterm elections. Although there are disputes about who is originally responsible for sequestration, public opinion is likely to blame Republicans if severe cutbacks materialize. The GOP’s campaign for strict budget austerity, popular since 2010, may now prove counterproductive. As real disruptions affect daily life—like cuts to public services—voters could view deficit reduction less favorably. While Americans often criticize broad government spending, polls show they value specific programs such as Social Security and Medicare. The 1995-96 government shutdown, which sparked widespread frustration over reduced service access, resulted in negative consequences for Republicans. President Obama has repeatedly highlighted the risks of these cuts, often making public appearances with community workers to warn of potential harm to law enforcement, education, and health services. Though some critics see these as political tactics, many fear his concerns will come to pass. Sequestration is just the first threat; further confrontations loom over possible government shutdowns or debt ceiling battles. Should the economy falter, anger is likely to be directed at the GOP, as their push for deficit reduction takes center stage. Pressures will likely build for restoring funding to essential services, especially as lawmakers consider electoral impacts. This would force Republicans to defend tight fiscal policies while Democrats advocate for greater investment. Sequestration embodies Washington’s inability to compromise, originating from failure to resolve tax and spending debates. As the deadline nears, Republican approval ratings have plummeted to 19%, while President Obama’s favorable ratings reach 60%. Historical precedent and recent surveys suggest that most Americans will blame Republicans, not Democrats, for governmental dysfunction. With almost half the public likely to fault the GOP for cuts, according to polls, Republicans—already contending with shifting demographics—may need to rethink their reliance on deficit reduction as a political strategy.
translated_content: “自动减支”（sequestration）这个过去鲜有人关注的政策术语，很快就会进入美国普通民众的日常用语——只要国会和总统在3月1日前依然无法就预算达成协议。届时联邦政府将会自动实施大规模削减开支，这对于共和党来说，政治风险比民主党大得多。 虽然一些共和党领袖表现得信心十足，但深入分析后其实隐患重重。这次削减行动极有可能让国会讨论方向左转，从而使民主党在2014年中期选举中取得优势。即使各方仍在争论削减措施的“始作俑者”，但一旦服务大范围缩减，舆论很可能认为共和党难辞其咎。 自2010年以来，共和党一直强调财政紧缩。如今，公共服务的实际削减可能让选民对“减少赤字”这个口号转为抵触。美国公众虽常对政府整体开支表示不满，但对于社会保障、医疗保险等具体项目却很支持。1995至1996年政府关门期间，民众因无法获得关键服务而愤怒，其结果对共和党极为不利。 奥巴马总统多次公开指出削减预算带来的风险，经常与一线执法、教育、医疗等工作人员一同亮相，强调对民众生活的影响。尽管有批评声音认为他在“作秀”，但不少人担心这些警告或将成为现实。 “自动减支”只是潜在风险的开端。接下来的政府停摆或债务上限僵局同样可能带来政治冲击。一旦经济受挫，选民的不满极可能转向坚持紧缩主张的共和党人。 舆论势必推动下届大选风向，迫使议员思考恢复相关重要支出——这让主张财政保守的共和党在辩论中处于被动，而倾向扩大投资的民主党则会受益。 “自动减支”是华盛顿政治僵滞的缩影，两党未能在税收和开支问题上达成共识甚至成了“自掘坟墓”。目前民调显示，共和党的支持率仅为19%，而奥巴马的好感度则达到60%。过去的先例以及最新数据都显示，美国公众大多会把政府乱象的责任归咎于共和党。 多项调查显示，几乎一半美国人会把预算削减的不满全部推向共和党。面对人口结构变迁和舆论压力，共和党若继续坚持赤字削减的主张，恐怕难以再取胜。

article_content: Many gamers have that one classic title they've always wanted to play but never did. For me, that game was The 7th Guest—a legendary puzzle adventure that stood out during its original release because of its innovative FMV sequences and campy horror vibes. When Vertigo Studios announced a VR remake, I was thrilled, hoping to finally experience what made the game so special. While you can still buy the original version for modern PCs, much of its impact comes from the era's technology and presentation. The VR edition, rebuilt from scratch, offers a completely fresh experience, letting new players and veterans alike rediscover the haunted mansion in a more immersive way. It's especially well-suited for the Quest 3 and similar VR headsets. The heart of The 7th Guest's story is simple: six strangers are invited to a mysterious mansion by an odd host and ultimately meet grim ends. In the classic, players would unlock memorable FMV scenes—think over-the-top, theatrical acting against digital backdrops—each time they solved a puzzle. I worried the remake might lose some of that distinctive charm, especially since VR cutscenes often feel flat. But Vertigo Studios cleverly used volumetric video, allowing these FMV performances to play out in a 3D space. Now, you can walk around (or through) ghostly scenes as they unfold, retaining the cheesy energy of the original. Puzzles are fully redesigned for VR, borrowing concepts from the original but reimagined for interactive VR mechanics. One standout lets you divide a cake—now represented as a globe rather than a rectangle—by rotating it to ensure equal slices. The Spirit Lantern tool is another new feature; shining it reveals hidden elements, such as revived flowers or secret solutions, adding depth to the puzzle-solving. Not everything is perfect. Sometimes, the VR controls hinder more than help; rotating the virtual cake was tricky because of hand-tracking glitches. A theremin-based puzzle and a ground beef stack puzzle became frustrating when my in-game hands bugged out. One major glitch trapped an item under a bed, leaving me to rely on collectible hint coins to skip the puzzle. Fortunately, coins are plentiful. Despite these hiccups, The 7th Guest VR turned out to be my biggest virtual reality surprise of the year. The spirit of the original lives on, especially through its puzzles and atmospheric mansion. Getting that satisfying 'aha' moment from a tough challenge still feels fantastic. Most importantly, Vertigo Studios preserved what made the original so iconic: a playful, camp horror tone and creative puzzles. Rather than make everything grim and serious, they honored the game's roots while making it accessible for newcomers. With inventive puzzles and impressive use of VR technology, The 7th Guest VR is one of the most enjoyable games on the Quest platform. Available now on the Quest Store.
translated_content: 许多玩家心中都有一款一直想尝试却迟迟未玩的经典游戏。对我而言，这款游戏就是《第七位客人》（The 7th Guest）——这是一款传奇解谜冒险，因为其创新的真人影像（FMV）和戏剧性的恐怖氛围在当年非常独特。当 Vertigo Studios 宣布将其重制为VR版本时，我激动不已，终于能亲身体验这款迷人作品。 虽然原版现在依然可以买到，能在现代电脑上游玩，但它的魅力很大程度来自那个时代的技术和表现力。VR版完全从零开发，让新玩家和老粉都能以沉浸式方式重新走进闹鬼的庄园。特别推荐给 Quest 3 等主流VR头显用户。 《第七位客人》的故事主线其实很简单：六位陌生人被一位古怪的主人邀请到神秘宅邸，最终都遭遇不幸。在经典版中，玩家解开谜题后便能欣赏到表演夸张、舞台感十足的真人影像片段。 我原本担心重制版无法保留这种独特魅力，毕竟许多VR过场动画都显得平淡。不过 Vertigo Studios 巧妙地采用了体积视频技术，让这些真人表演在三维空间中重现。你能在场景中走动、甚至穿越‘幽灵影像’观看表演，原作那种‘B级片’的欢乐感得以延续。 解谜内容为VR彻底重制，既有原作致敬，又充分利用了交互式创新。比如其中一个谜题要求你分切蛋糕——现在蛋糕变成了球体，需要通过旋转来确保每块相等。Spirit Lantern（灵魂灯笼）是全新道具，照亮环境后可以看到复活的花朵或隐藏的线索，为解谜增添深度。 当然，并非所有地方都完美。有时候，VR操控反而让体验变差，转动虚拟蛋糕时因为手部跟踪失灵就很恼人。还有通过特雷门琴和碎肉塔进行的谜题，因手部bug体验变得十分挫败。曾发生道具被卡到床下无法取出的严重bug，只能依靠搜集到的提示币跳过谜题。好在这些提示币分布得还算充足。 尽管有些小瑕疵，《第七位客人》VR版却成了我今年最大的虚拟现实惊喜。原作精髓仍在，尤其是谜题和哥特式庄园氛围总让人欲罢不能，解出难关时那种‘豁然开朗’的成就感依然那么棒。 最重要的是，Vertigo Studios 很好地保留了原作标志性的‘欢乐鬼屋’风格和创新谜题。他们没有一味追求黑暗严肃，而是在继承经典的基础上让新玩家也能轻松入门。新颖的解谜机制和精巧的VR应用，让《第七位客人》VR成为 Quest 平台上最值得一玩的作品之一。 现已上线 Quest Store。

article_content: 5 ChatGPT Prompts to Identify Your Next Big Business Opportunity  What’s ahead for you—a major business breakthrough, a game-changing client, or an exciting deal? These opportunities might be closer than you think. Instead of waiting for the right moment, use ChatGPT to uncover possibilities and clarify your goals. Here are five prompts designed to help you explore new directions and open up fresh options for your business. To get started, copy, paste, and edit the brackets in each prompt within the same ChatGPT conversation for seamless context.  1. Discover Emerging Trends in Your Industry There could be significant developments on the horizon for your business. Tap into ChatGPT’s capabilities to sift through global data and identify emerging market trends. Consider how these trends might affect your ongoing business or next venture. For the best results, use this prompt with internet-enabled ChatGPT:  "Assume the role of a business analyst. Identify emerging market trends related to [your industry/business sector]. Analyze recent global news, social media trends, and market reports from the past six months. Focus on areas such as technological advancements, consumer behavior shifts, and new market entrants. Summarize the key trends and explain how they are impacting my business in [specific business area or industry], and what changes I can make today to capitalize on them."  2. Analyze What Your Customers Want Unlock your next big opportunity by understanding what your customers truly value and are willing to pay for. The more you know about their preferences and purchasing decisions, the better you can anticipate future needs. Use ChatGPT to analyze customer feedback for comprehensive insights into your target demographic. Advanced Data Analysis is recommended with this prompt:  "Analyze the attached spreadsheet containing customer feedback for [your business name]. Focus on comments related to customer satisfaction, reasons for sign-up, purchasing behaviors, and specific product or service feedback. Identify common themes, patterns, and recurring suggestions or complaints. Provide a detailed analysis of customer needs, preferences, and potential areas for improvement or innovation. Also, assess any trends in willingness to pay for certain features or services. Summarize your findings with actionable insights for our business strategy and product development going forward."  3. Find Gaps in the Market Once ChatGPT understands your business and audience, it can help you spot underserved niches or emerging needs. Identifying these gaps allows you to position your product or service where competition is low. This could be a breakthrough moment for your business. Try this prompt:  "Based on the analysis of emerging market trends and customer feedback previously provided, identify potential gaps in the market for my business and industry. Consider both current consumer demands and identified trends to spotlight niches or needs not adequately addressed by existing products or services. Explore opportunities for innovation or differentiation. Recommend strategies for my business to enter these market gaps effectively and achieve a significant impact. Also, provide insights on how filling these gaps could benefit my business financially and in terms of market positioning."  4. Understand Public Sentiment Online Leverage ChatGPT to analyze social media and online discussions about your brand or the problem your business addresses. If your brand isn’t widely recognized, focus on sentiments related to the broader issue you solve. This analysis helps reveal public perception and uncovers new opportunities:  "Search for social media mentions and online discussions about [your brand/product name]. If there is insufficient data due to the size of my brand, instead search for discussions about [specific problem your product/service solves]. Analyze the tone, sentiment, and key themes. Provide insights into my brand/product perception, or how the target audience discusses and experiences the problem I solve. Summarize findings to highlight public perception and potential opportunities for addressing these needs or improving brand perception."  5. Predict Future Market Shifts Stay ahead by asking ChatGPT to forecast upcoming industry trends and market shifts, using the latest data and developments. This allows you to keep your business strategy proactive, preparing for future changes and maintaining a competitive edge.  "Analyze the latest industry data and current affairs to forecast upcoming trends and market shifts in [your industry/business sector]. Focus on technological advancements, shifts in consumer behavior, economic factors, and any emerging patterns likely to impact the industry in the next 18-24 months. Interpret what these shifts mean for my industry over the long term and how they could influence market dynamics. Provide recommendations to help my business stay ahead, capitalize on opportunities, and maintain a competitive edge."  Using ChatGPT to Explore New Business Opportunities Knowledge is power—especially when used effectively. Instead of relying on guesswork, use ChatGPT prompts to gather and analyze essential information. Identify market trends, dive deep into customer needs, find market gaps, understand public sentiment, and predict future shifts. With these actionable prompts, you can stay well ahead in the game and open up a world of possibilities for your business.
translated_content: 5 个 ChatGPT 提示，帮你发现下一个大商机  未来会有什么等着你——重大商业突破、重要客户，还是令人兴奋的交易？这些机会其实可能就在眼前。与其被动等待，不如用 ChatGPT 主动发掘各种可能性、明确你的目标。以下五条实用提示，帮助你探索新方向，为事业打开更多选择。复制、粘贴并根据自身实际调整方括号内容，建议在同一个 ChatGPT 对话中操作，方便延续上下文。  1. 发现行业新兴趋势 你的业务可能即将迎来重大变化。利用 ChatGPT 的数据处理能力，分析全球信息，帮助你识别新兴市场趋势。思考这些趋势可能对你现在的业务或下一个项目产生的影响。建议使用联网版 ChatGPT，并参考以下提示：  “请扮演商业分析师，识别与 [你的行业/业务领域] 相关的新兴市场趋势。分析最近六个月的全球新闻、社交媒体趋势和市场报告，重点关注技术进步、消费者行为变化及新兴企业等。请总结主要趋势，说明这些趋势如何影响我在 [具体业务领域或行业] 发展，以及我今天可采取哪些措施把握机会。”  2. 深挖客户真实需求 要抓住下一个重大机会，关键在于了解客户真正看重什么、他们愿意为哪些东西付费。越了解他们的偏好和购买决策，就越能预测未来需求。利用 ChatGPT 分析客户反馈，获得目标用户的全面洞察。建议开启高级数据分析，试试以下提示：  “分析附带的表格，内含 [你的企业名称] 的客户反馈。重点关注与客户满意度、注册原因、购买行为及产品或服务反馈相关的内容。找出常见主题、模式及反复出现的建议或投诉。详细分析客户需求、偏好及改进或创新空间，并评估部分功能或服务的付费意愿趋势。以便于业务战略和产品开发的方式总结你的结论并提出可操作建议。”  3. 发现市场空白点 ChatGPT 了解你的业务和服务对象后，还能帮助你发现未被满足的细分市场需求。识别这些空白点，有助于你把产品或服务放到竞争较少、机遇更大的领域，可能带来业务上的突破。可尝试以下提示：  “基于前文分析的新兴市场趋势和客户反馈，识别我所在行业和企业的潜在市场空白。结合当前消费者需求和既有趋势，锁定目前产品或服务未被充分满足的领域。发掘差异化创新的机会。请给出我公司进入这些市场空白的策略，并说明填补这些空白对公司财务表现和市场定位的益处。”  4. 了解线上公众观点 用 ChatGPT 分析社交媒体与网络讨论，了解大家对你品牌或者你想要解决的问题持什么态度。如果品牌曝光度还不高，也可以关注公众对你解决的问题的讨论。这有助于摸清用户观点，发掘更多机会：  “搜索关于 [你的品牌/产品名称] 的社交媒体及在线讨论。如果数据稀缺，请转而搜索大家对 [你的产品/服务可解决问题] 的相关讨论和情感。分析讨论的语气、观点和主要话题。提供品牌/产品印象，或者目标用户对该问题的看法与体验。总结结果，突出公众评价和潜在机遇，或改善品牌形象的空间。”  5. 预测未来市场变化 做市场先行者，利用 ChatGPT 基于最新行业数据和动态预测未来市场趋势和变化。这样能让企业战略始终领先，应对变化并把握领先优势。  “分析最新行业数据和时事，预测 [你的行业/业务领域] 未来可能出现的趋势和市场动向。重点关注技术进步、消费行为变化、经济因素及可能在未来18-24个月对行业产生重大影响的新模式。解释这些变化对行业的长期意义及其对市场格局的影响。给出建议，帮助我公司提前布局，抓住新机会，保持竞争力。”  善用 ChatGPT，发掘商业新机遇 知识就是力量，用得好才能成事。别再凭直觉闯市场，用这些 ChatGPT 提示收集关键资讯。识别趋势、深挖客户需求、发现市场空白、了解用户想法、预测未来变化——结合这些建议，一步领先，开创更多商机！

The Tamil Nadu Assembly reconvened for a special session on Saturday, re-adopting 10 Bills from departments including law, agriculture, and higher education, all of which had recently been sent back by Governor RN Ravi. Opposition parties AIADMK and BJP staged separate walkouts to protest the proceedings. After the BJP's walkout, MLA Vanathi explained, "The BJP left the Assembly in opposition to the government's resolution criticizing the honourable Governor and resending Bills previously passed by this Assembly. We support federalism and believe the Governor is carrying out his constitutional responsibilities."

Earlier, Chief Minister M.K. Stalin presented a resolution to reconsider the 10 returned Bills, which had previously passed the House but were returned without any stated reason by Governor Ravi. Stalin asserted that the Governor's actions insulted both the Assembly and the people of Tamil Nadu.

Stalin further argued that it is the Governor’s constitutional obligation to approve Bills passed by the Assembly. He stated that returning Bills without seeking clarification amounted to disrespect for the elected state government. He also alleged that the central government was targeting non-BJP ruled states through their appointed Governors.

The Bills in question include two from 2020, two from 2023, and six passed last year. Under Rule 143 of the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly and Article 200 of the Indian Constitution, if the Bills are passed again and resubmitted to the Governor, assent cannot be withheld.

article_content: A 77-year-old New Zealand woman, June Armstrong, was fined after accidentally bringing a chicken sandwich with her when traveling from Christchurch to Brisbane, Australia, on May 2. Australian border officials fined Armstrong 3,300 New Zealand dollars (about $1,995 USD) for carrying the uneaten sandwich into the country. According to reports from the New Zealand Herald, a border officer advised Armstrong to appeal the fine, but her attempts only received automatic responses. Australia's Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Forestry (DAFF) provided an official comment only six months later, after the media intervened on Armstrong's behalf. Armstrong said she packed the sandwich before her flight and, while remembering to declare her prescription medication, forgot about the sandwich. She and her husband rely on their pensions, and she described the fine as a significant financial burden. 'Everybody I show the fine to is dumbfounded. They just can't believe it,' Armstrong told the Herald. A DAFF spokesperson told Business Insider that Armstrong would have needed an import permit to bring the sandwich into Australia. 'Meat has strict import conditions that can change quickly due to disease outbreaks,' the spokesperson explained, adding that fines can reach up to 6,260 Australian dollars (around $4,100 USD) for unauthorized food items. Similar incidents have occurred before. In August, one traveler was fined $1,200 for carrying a rose, and another was fined $1,870 for bringing McMuffin sandwiches from Bali to Australia.

article_content: Soccer City in Johannesburg, historically a venue for major black freedom rallies, will next month host a rugby match between the South African Springboks and New Zealand’s All Blacks, officials announced Wednesday. The stadium, which will host the 2010 World Cup final this weekend, is also where Nelson Mandela gave his first speech in Johannesburg after being released from prison in 1990. Situated near Soweto, a predominantly black township, Soccer City has become a symbol of national unity. South African Rugby Union president Oregan Hoskins said on the organization’s website: “This is a historic day—one all South Africans can celebrate. Bringing the Springboks to such an iconic world venue gives players and fans an excellent stage for rugby, as well as continuing the nation-building that sport has fostered throughout the FIFA World Cup.” Once dominated by white players, South African rugby has become more racially integrated since hosting the 1995 Rugby World Cup, and black players such as Chester Williams and Bryan Habana are now household names. Earlier this year, the Blue Bulls played a Super 14 match at Soweto’s Orlando Stadium after their regular Pretoria home became unavailable due to the World Cup. South Africa’s first home match of the 2010 Tri-Nations tournament—also featuring Australia—will be on August 21 at Soccer City (also called the National Stadium), which seats 88,791. To encourage attendance, the rugby union is offering over 9,000 tickets at 350 Rand ($45) and 5,000 at 100 Rand ($13), aiming to match the home rugby international record of 95,000 at Ellis Park, set when the British Lions visited in 1955. The fixture was originally scheduled for Ellis Park, but the Golden Lions agreed to move it to Soccer City. Lions chairman Kevin De Klerk said, 'The only thing that surprised us was the near-unanimous support from all our stakeholders. While we cherish Ellis Park, there was widespread agreement that this significant rugby match should be played at one of the country’s and world’s top stadiums. Special thanks to our key sponsors, who have supported this move despite major contractual adjustments, recognizing the potential benefits for rugby and South Africa.' The Springboks open their Tri-Nations title defense in New Zealand on Saturday, playing the All Blacks twice before meeting Australia in Brisbane on July 24.

article_content: Cristiano Ronaldo was initially greeted with boos at Anfield but left to applause after a standout performance. Few former Manchester United players have ever received such recognition from Liverpool fans, highlighting Ronaldo’s exceptional status. During his United years, Ronaldo had never scored at Anfield—but just 23 minutes into this Champions League match, that changed. His goal helped Real Madrid to a 3-0 victory over Liverpool, putting them at nine points from three games in Group B. Ronaldo's 70th Champions League goal leaves him one behind the competition's all-time leading scorer, Raul. Lionel Messi, with 69, is also in contention, making the record likely to fall soon. Benzema scored twice, ensuring Real’s seventh consecutive European win—a new club record. Despite pre-match anticipation for another classic European night at Anfield, Real dominated the first half and Liverpool were unable to recover. Ronaldo described his goal as 'special' and expressed satisfaction with the team's performance, noting their perfect start to the group stage. No club has retained the Champions League title since the tournament's current format began in 1992, but Real Madrid’s performance suggests they could end that streak. Real was missing Gareth Bale due to injury but still showcased their depth, with impressive performances from James Rodriguez, Toni Kroos, Luka Modric, and Isco. Liverpool, struggling since Luis Suarez's departure, has not been able to match last season’s form. Real Madrid, meanwhile, extended their winning streak to seven matches with 32 goals scored. Ronaldo opened the scoring with a skillful finish after a clever assist from James Rodriguez. Seven minutes later, Benzema doubled the lead with a header. Benzema added a third before halftime. Liverpool tried to respond in the second half, and Philippe Coutinho hit the post, but the home side could not reduce the deficit. Mario Balotelli was replaced at halftime after a disappointing first period. Real Madrid slowed the pace in the second half with the weekend 'Clasico' against Barcelona in mind. Ronaldo was substituted after 75 minutes. Coach Carlo Ancelotti praised his team for their performance, especially the first half, and considered himself fortunate to manage such quality players. Liverpool’s manager, Brendan Rodgers, acknowledged Real Madrid’s superiority and noted that defensive errors led to their defeat. He praised his team's second-half effort despite the loss. Liverpool now sits on three points in Group B, level with Ludogorets and Basel. Ludogorets earned its first Champions League win by beating Basel 1-0. Elsewhere, Juventus lost 1-0 to Olympiakos, Atletico Madrid won 5-0 over Malmo, Borussia Dortmund beat Galatasaray 4-0, Arsenal came from behind to beat Anderlecht 2-1, Bayer Leverkusen defeated Zenit 2-0, and Monaco and Benfica played to a 0-0 draw.

article_content: Chris Kooluris, a 37-year-old public relations professional, invested more than $32,000 to transform the bedroom of his Manhattan apartment in Murray Hill into a 1980s-style arcade. Inspired by the book 'Ready Player One,' Kooluris began redecorating and soon found his hobby evolving into an all-consuming obsession. The arcade-themed room features classic games such as Street Fighter II, Ms. Pac-Man, Punch-Out!, Tron, and Fix It Felix Jr., the fictional game from Disney's 'Wreck-It Ralph.' His collection includes Transformers memorabilia, Wreck-It Ralph action figures, and retro-style vending machines stocked with candy. Kooluris was engaged and living with his fiancée in her Brooklyn apartment. However, after failing to find a buyer for the apartment, he decided to keep his own place and immerse himself in the arcade project. As the room took shape, the relationship became strained, and ultimately, his fiancée broke off their engagement. Now single, Kooluris hosts weekly game nights for friends in his arcade room and sleeps on a futon with Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles bedding. Despite his love for his creation, he admits it’s difficult to fully enjoy the space, as it reminds him of his lost relationship.

article_content: The Georgia Capitol is seen on August 27, 2022, in front of the Atlanta skyline. State lawmakers will convene on Wednesday to begin work on new political district maps. ATLANTA — Georgia will open a special legislative session this Wednesday to redraw the state's political maps, following a federal judge’s ruling that the current district lines illegally dilute Black voters’ power. The new maps could shift the balance of power in the state legislature and Congress, where Republicans are holding onto a narrow U.S. House majority. Lawmakers have until December 8 to pass maps that comply with the federal Voting Rights Act, which prohibits discriminatory voting practices based on race and other traits. In October, U.S. District Court Judge Steve Jones ordered the Georgia General Assembly to add a majority-Black congressional district as well as additional majority-Black state House and Senate seats. "The evidence before this Court shows that Georgia has not reached the point where the political process has equal openness and equal opportunity for everyone," Jones wrote. Republicans control both chambers in Georgia’s legislature, granting them significant influence over map drawing. Even after passage by the legislature and approval from Republican Gov. Brian Kemp, the maps require final court approval. The process has proven contentious in other states under similar court orders. In Alabama, a court-appointed special master drew the final congressional map after federal judges found lawmakers’ revisions still violated the Voting Rights Act. Georgia Republicans say they will try to follow Judge Jones' order while protecting their incumbents and maintaining their political advantage. The proposed state Senate map, released Monday, creates a new majority-Black district in West Metro Atlanta and another to the south, areas where a growing Black population has fueled recent state growth. However, the map would dismantle two seats held by prominent Democratic incumbents. Judge Jones cautioned lawmakers not to create new majority-Black districts by eliminating existing minority opportunity districts elsewhere. Racial gerrymandering is illegal, but partisan gerrymandering is still permitted. Republican Senate leaders said in a statement, "The new plan fully complies with Judge Jones' order while also upholding Georgia's traditional principles." Charles Bullock, a University of Georgia professor and author of 'The History of Redistricting in Georgia,' warned that trying to bypass the court could be risky. "I would think that the Georgia legislature would take a lesson from what they saw happen in Alabama within the last few months," he said. "I can't imagine that the Republican majority would want a special master to come in and make significant changes to their districts." Democratic groups, including the Democratic Legislative Campaign Committee, criticized the proposed maps as gerrymandered and undemocratic. Public hearings this week will offer limited time for feedback, and major changes are unlikely before the maps are finalized. Andrea Young, executive director of the ACLU of Georgia, urged people to look beyond legal technicalities and political maneuvering, emphasizing the court's order as part of a larger historical struggle for Black representation. She said it reflects "the long-denied aspirations of Black Georgians to be full citizens, to be fully represented in a state where many of our ancestors were enslaved, where we suffered under Jim Crow laws, and where we now contribute to Georgia's economy and culture." While the state has appealed Judge Jones’ decision, it did not seek to pause the order during the appeals process. Lawyers expect the appeal could take months, so new maps will likely be in effect for at least the 2024 elections.
translated_content: 佐治亚州议会大厦2022年8月27日出现在亚特兰大天际线前。州立法者将在周三召开会议，开始绘制新的政治选区地图。 亚特兰大——佐治亚州将于本周三召开特别立法会议，重新划定该州的政治选区，此前一名联邦法官裁定现有选区线非法削弱了黑人选民的影响力。 新地图可能会改变州议会和国会的权力平衡，目前共和党人在美国众议院占据微弱多数。 立法者必须在12月8日之前通过符合联邦《投票权法案》的地图，该法案禁止基于种族和其他特征的歧视性投票行为。 今年10月，联邦地区法院法官史蒂夫·琼斯命令佐治亚州议会增加一个黑人占多数的国会选区，以及更多黑人占多数的州众议院和参议院席位。 琼斯在判决中写道：“本院面前的证据表明，佐治亚州在政治过程中还没有实现对所有人完全开放和平等的机会。” 共和党人控制着佐治亚州议会两院，因此对选区划分具有重大影响力。 即使立法机关通过并获得共和党州长布赖恩·坎普批准后，新地图仍需法院的最终审批。 在其他需要重新划分选区的州，这一过程同样充满争议。在阿拉巴马州，法院指定的特别专员最终制定了国会地图，因为联邦法官认为立法者的修订方案仍未遵守《投票权法案》。 佐治亚州共和党人表示，他们将尝试遵循琼斯法官的命令，同时保护现任议员并维护政党利益。 周一公布的参议院拟议选区地图，在亚特兰大西部都市区和南部各新建了一个黑人占多数选区——这些地区黑人数量的增长推动了州的人口增长。然而，地图将拆分由知名民主党现任议员代表的两个选区。 琼斯法官提醒立法者，不要通过取消其他少数族裔机会选区来新增黑人占多数选区。种族划区属非法，但政党划区仍被允许。 共和党参议院领导人在声明中表示：“新方案完全遵循了琼斯法官的命令，同时也维护了佐治亚州的传统原则。” 佐治亚大学教授、《佐治亚州重新划区历史》一书作者查尔斯·布洛克警告，试图规避法院指令存在风险。他表示：“我认为佐治亚州议会应当吸取阿拉巴马州最近几个月发生的案例经验。我无法想象共和党多数希望让特别专员介入并显著改变他们的选区。” 包括民主党立法竞选委员会在内的民主党团体批评该方案为“操控选区”且“不民主”。 本周的公众听证会将为反馈提供有限时间，预计在最终敲定选区前不会有重大调整。 佐治亚美国公民自由联盟（ACLU）执行董事安德莉亚·杨呼吁人们超越法律技术细节和政治角力，强调法院命令是黑人代表权历史性斗争的一部分。她表示，这体现了佐治亚黑人群体长期被剥夺的作为完整公民、全面获得代表权的诉求，“在我们的许多祖先曾被奴役、曾受吉姆克劳法影响的地方，如今我们纳税、推动经济和文化发展。” 尽管该州已对琼斯法官的裁决提起上诉，但在上诉期间并未寻求暂缓执行命令。律师们预测，上诉过程可能需数月，因此新的选区地图预计至少将在2024年大选中使用。

article_content: Twenty-six individuals suspected of entering Nigeria illegally, mainly from Cameroon and Burkina Faso, were apprehended by police in Ayua near Auchi, Edo State. The group, made up of 16 Cameroonian men, eight Cameroonian women, and a man and woman from Burkina Faso, was arrested on November 9, 2023, following a tip-off. Chidi Nwabuzor, spokesperson for the Edo State Police, stated that the detainees could barely speak English, only identifying their countries. Interrogations revealed that a Nigerian described as an Excavator Operator helped smuggle them in via the Cameroon border, reportedly for excavation jobs. The facilitator claimed to have experience living and working in Cameroon and brought the migrants into Nigeria for labor in the local community. On November 13, the suspects were transferred into the custody of the Nigeria Immigration Service (NIS) in Benin City. A source from the NIS disclosed that the state Comptroller of Immigration directed the migrants to be held, screened, and officially documented while investigations continue. Uruguay is set to become the first country to legalize and regulate marijuana production, sale, and consumption. While most countries are still debating drug policy reform, Uruguay leads the way, surpassing places like the Netherlands, where recreational marijuana remains technically illegal. The bill, having passed Uruguay's Chamber of Deputies and now before the Senate, outlines how marijuana will be regulated, who can grow it, and how the country will prevent cannabis tourism.

The Uruguayan government, which supports the measure, seeks to resolve a long-standing legal contradiction: marijuana consumption has been legal, but production and sale have not. “We seek to eliminate that incongruence,” said Julio Calzada, Secretary-General of the National Committee on Drugs. The legislation treats marijuana as a health issue and distinguishes between consumers and traffickers. According to Calzada, Uruguay’s decision comes after years of public debate and is rooted in its history of tolerance and rising concern over drug violence.

President Jose Mujica’s Broad Front coalition has a majority in the Senate, making it likely the bill will pass in October. Mujica has stated he will sign it into law if it passes. However, public support is lacking: a July poll by CIFRA/Gonzalez, Raga and Associates showed that 63% of Uruguayans opposed the bill, while only 26% supported it. Despite this, the government believes reform is in the nation’s best interest, and upcoming elections will give voters a voice on the matter.

Under the bill, individuals may grow up to six plants per household, yielding a maximum of 480 grams per year. Registered membership clubs of 15 to 45 people could grow up to 99 plants. Licensed pharmacies would sell marijuana to adult Uruguayan residents, aiming to prevent cannabis tourism. Unlicensed growers and sellers would face prison terms of 20 months to 10 years.

The Institute of Regulation and Control of Cannabis, a new government body, would supervise licensing and enforcement, maintain a buyer’s registry to ensure compliance, and oversee sanctions. The bill calls for educational programs about drug risks in schools, and prohibits all marijuana advertising.

Uruguay’s model reflects local challenges, particularly increased drug violence, and is not intended for wholesale adoption by others. The government anticipates international interest, even as domestic opposition remains strong.

乌拉圭有望成为全球首个将大麻生产、销售及消费合法化并纳入监管的国家。尽管大多数国家还在讨论毒品政策改革，乌拉圭已走在最前沿，甚至超过了名义上仍禁止娱乐性大麻的荷兰。这项法案已获众议院通过，现正提交参议院审议，明确规定大麻的监管方式、种植资格及如何防止"大麻旅游"。

乌拉圭政府支持该法案，旨在解决长期存在的法律矛盾：大麻消费是合法的，但生产和销售却不合法。国家药物委员会秘书长胡里奥·卡尔萨达表示：“我们希望消除这种不一致。”法案将大麻问题作为公共健康议题，并区分消费者与贩毒者。卡尔萨达称，乌拉圭经过多年的公开讨论才做出该决定，这一举措根植于该国的宽容传统以及应对毒品暴力上升的需求。

总统穆希卡领导的广泛阵线联盟在参议院拥有多数席位，因此该法案有望于十月通过。穆希卡已表示，若法案通过，他将予以签署使其成为法律。然而，民众对此支持度不高：CIFRA/Gonzalez, Raga与Associates今年七月的一项民调显示，63%的乌拉圭人反对该法案，支持者仅占26%。尽管如此，政府依然认为这项改革符合国家长远利益，并强调即将举行的大选将让选民表达观点。

法案规定，个人每户最多可种植六株大麻，每年产量不超过480克。注册会员俱乐部（15至45人）可合计种植最多99株，并需获得许可。持牌药房将向成年乌拉圭居民销售大麻，以防止“毒品旅游”。未获许可的种植和销售将面临20个月至10年监禁。

法案还将设立大麻监管与管控制度研究所，负责许可发放、执法、买家登记和处罚监督，同时要求在各级学校开展毒品危害教育，并全面禁止大麻广告。

乌拉圭模式聚焦本国特殊难题，尤其是毒品暴力恶化，并非建议他国照搬。尽管国内存在广泛反对，政府预计这一政策将在国际上引发关注。

article_content: Apple's next iPhone may be a new iPhone SE, rather than the iPhone 16 or iPhone 16 Pro. Multiple leaks have provided details about the upcoming iPhone SE, giving us a clearer picture of Apple's potential mid-range smartphone. Digital artist 4RMD has created new concept images of the next iPhone SE, combining recent leaks and Apple's established design language to produce a digital model based on available information. While these images may not reflect the final product, Apple's consistent approach to design evolution suggests they could be quite accurate. A major change is the updated design. The current iPhone SE uses a design first introduced with the iPhone 6 in 2014. The next SE is expected to feature the all-screen design from the iPhone X (2017) and the sharper edges from the iPhone 12, giving the new SE a look that is both familiar and distinctive. 4RMD's concept includes an Action Button, which was first seen on the iPhone 15 Pro and 15 Pro Max. Although this button is currently absent on the entry-level iPhone 15, leaks suggest it may become standard on all iPhone 16 models. If the new SE remains on sale for several years, it would make sense for its physical controls to match other iPhones. Another significant feature is the inclusion of USB-C. EU regulations now require standard charging ports, leading Apple to replace the Lightning port with USB-C in recent iPhone models. It is highly likely the new SE will also feature USB-C, making it easier for users to charge their devices without purchasing new accessories. As Apple's most affordable iPhone, the SE's switch to a standard charging port could enhance its appeal to budget-conscious consumers. The convenience of using existing USB-C chargers could be a key advantage. The three previous iPhone SE models were released in March 2016, April 2020, and March 2022. If Apple maintains this pattern, the new SE could debut in March 2024, possibly alongside new iPad models. For more updates, refer to Forbes' weekly Apple news digest.

article_content: Dr. Jumoke Oduwole, Special Adviser to President Bola Tinubu on the Presidential Enabling Business Environment Council (PEBEC), announced that the Federal Government has introduced over 180 reform programmes to support youth-owned businesses and enhance the country's overall business environment. According to a statement released in Abuja on Wednesday, Oduwole made this announcement during an event organized by Leap Africa, in partnership with the International Youth Foundation and Sahara Foundation. The programme, aimed at celebrating young innovators across Africa, focused on the theme, ‘Maximizing Africa’s Potential Through Disruptive Leadership and Innovation’. The organizers brought together over 1,500 entrepreneurs, investors, social innovators, and business leaders, both virtually and in person, to participate in the discourse. During her keynote address, Oduwole highlighted the importance of ethical innovation and encouraged young African innovators to embrace disruption to drive societal progress. She explained that, despite existing challenges, the continent is full of opportunities, with young leaders leading positive change. Since 2016, under PEBEC's systemic interventions, the Nigerian government has carried out 180 reforms aimed at improving the business environment for MSMEs, including many youth-led ventures. Kehinde Ayeni, Executive Director of LEAP Africa, stated that the Social Innovators Programme is the organization's flagship initiative that supports creative young Africans from countries including Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Sierra Leone, Rwanda, Cameroon, Burundi, Uganda, and Tanzania. She added that, now in its 10th year, LEAP Africa has supported over 279 social innovators with skills, mentorship, funding, and networks to help scale their social enterprises. The two-day event culminated in the recognition of fellows and alumni with awards and grants totaling up to $160,000, in collaboration with Sahara Foundation and International Youth Foundation. The awards included the Outstanding Fellows Award for the top ten fellows, the Innocent Chukwuma Award for Youth and Gender Empowerment in South Eastern Nigeria presented to Gift Muoneke of GreenEra Technology, and the Seyi Bickersteth Award for Financial Accountability presented to Jolis Nduwinana of Wege Company.

article_content: Horror is a genre frequently filled with sequels. When an original movie sees even moderate success, it often leads to a follow-up in hopes of financial gain. Unfortunately, many of these sequels are poorly received. For each Child’s Play, there is a Child’s Play 2. However, not all sequels are subpar; some can add to and even improve upon the original films. Within major horror franchises, three notable sequels stand out for expanding their stories and styles: Halloween II, A Nightmare on Elm Street 4, and Exorcist II: The Heretic. These films, which have often been underrated by critics and some fans, deserve renewed appreciation. Halloween II faced significant negativity upon release, primarily because it wasn’t the original Halloween and it gave Michael Myers a motive (as he pursues his long-lost sister), changing his mystique. Over time, this Rick Rosenthal-directed sequel has grown in estimation. Even after four decades and many new entries, it’s still considered one of the best sequels in the Halloween series. Halloween II is compelling because it continues the night of terror from the first film, following Jamie Lee Curtis’s character as she recovers and the town of Haddonfield falls into chaos trying to stop an unstoppable killer. The film increased the gore, which drew criticism then and now, but it effectively heightens the suspense. While the original Halloween is more of a thriller, Halloween II embraces the slasher genre, blending violence with chilling suspense. Halloween II is currently available on Peacock. Exorcist II: The Heretic is often cited as one of the most disappointing sequels, especially compared to the classic original. The story is confusing, and performances—particularly from Richard Burton and Linda Blair—were criticized. Despite its shortcomings, the film stands out for its unusual, dreamlike visuals created by director John Boorman and cinematographer William A. Fraker. The film’s distinctive, surreal style gives it an unusual energy that makes it unique, if not conventionally successful. Exorcist II: The Heretic is available on Max. A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors is typically seen as the best in the series, while Part 2: Freddy’s Revenge is revisited for its queer subtext. However, Part 4: The Dream Master deserves attention for its strong female protagonist, engaging supporting cast, creative kills, and offbeat humor. The film stands out for bringing back and eliminating previous survivors, keeping viewers guessing. Its memorable horror effects include inventive and bizarre death scenes. While not necessarily scary, it is imaginative, twisted, and entertaining. A Nightmare on Elm Street Part 4: The Dream Master is streaming on Max.
translated_content: 恐怖片是一个经常充斥续集的类型。当一部原创电影取得哪怕适度的成功时，通常都会推出续集以获取经济利益。不幸的是，许多续集反响平平。例如《灵异入侵记》之后有《灵异入侵记2》。但并非所有续集都逊色，有些作品甚至能丰富甚至提升原作。 在主流恐怖系列中，有三部值得一提的续集在剧情与风格上都有突破：《月光光心慌慌2》《猛鬼街4》，以及《驱魔人2：异端》。这些电影常被评论家和部分影迷低估，其实很值得重新审视与欣赏。 《月光光心慌慌2》上映时遭遇大量负面评价，主要因为它不如第一部经典，还赋予迈克尔·迈尔斯新的犯罪动机（追杀失散多年的妹妹），改变了他神秘的形象。随着时间推移，这部由里克·罗森撒尔执导的续集口碑渐好。即使在过去40年和十几部系列新作之后，它依然被认为是最棒的续集之一。 《月光光心慌慌2》吸引人的原因在于它直接延续了前作的恐怖之夜，讲述了杰米·李·柯蒂斯饰演的角色康复过程，以及哈登菲尔德小镇试图追捕无法无天杀手时陷入混乱。影片的血腥程度上升，虽然当时到现在都受到争议，但实际上加强了紧张气氛。第一部更偏向惊悚，而第二部则完全走向血腥劈杀路线，将暴力与毛骨悚然的悬念巧妙结合。《月光光心慌慌2》现可在Peacock平台观看。 《驱魔人2：异端》经常被认为是最失望的续集之一，尤其是与经典原作相比。剧情混乱，主演理查德·伯顿和琳达·布莱尔的表演也受到争议。尽管如此，这部影片在导演约翰·布尔曼和摄影威廉·A·弗雷克的共同努力下，展现梦幻独特的视觉风格。其超现实影像使其充满另类能量，虽不算传统意义上的成功，却绝对独树一帜。《驱魔人2：异端》现可在Max平台观看。 《猛鬼街3：猛鬼战士》常被认为是系列最佳，而第二部则因酷儿主题受到重新关注。但第四部《猛鬼街4：梦魇主宰》更值得推荐，它有强大女主角、亮眼配角、创意满满的死亡场景以及幽默感。电影大胆带回上集幸存者并逐一淘汰，让观众猜不到后续。其特效和离奇死亡桥段令人印象深刻。虽然不一定可怕，但极具新意，略带变态和趣味性，总让人眼前一亮。《猛鬼街4：梦魇主宰》现可在Max平台观看。

article_content: Two burglars were caught after breaking into a family home in Ipswich, Suffolk, using wheelie bins to access the balcony. Krzysztof Slowik, 24, and Andrzej Majewski, 34, ransacked the property by emptying drawers and cupboards. Alert neighbors saw the break-in and contacted the police. When officers arrived, they found a trail of chaos and discovered the two men pretending to be asleep in a child's bedroom. A torch was also found under a cot in the room. Both Slowik and Majewski were arrested and later admitted to burglary with intent to steal. At Ipswich Crown Court, Judge Rupert Overbury sentenced the men to a year in prison. The judge remarked that the burglary was premeditated but noted the family was not at home during the incident. Both men were charged and remanded in custody after giving 'no comment' interviews. During the trial, it was revealed that Majewski had lost his benefits two weeks prior to the break-in and was struggling financially. Slowik, who had worked at a factory, now faced losing his job.

Terry Adams, aged 58 or 59 and known as the founder of London's Clerkenwell Crime Syndicate, recently appeared at the High Court to answer allegations that he is using criminal proceeds to support a lavish lifestyle. Arriving in a self-designed blue suit, Adams described himself as 'frustrated' and claimed that he relies entirely on his wife, Ruth, for income, working unpaid as a 'creative' clothes designer.

Adams is contesting the £750,000 confiscation order imposed on him after his 2007 conviction for money laundering, arguing that he cannot pay due to financial hardship, and requesting the cancellation of his remaining £600,000 debt on similar grounds. He told the court that all his income comes from Ruth and described feeling uncomfortable about not contributing financially.

The prosecution, represented by Kennedy Talbot for the CPS, challenged Adams’ claims, pointing out that the couple’s annual identifiable spending averaged £97,000 from 2010 to 2013, nearly four times the UK national average. Details presented to the court included Ruth Adams’ expenditures, such as £12,044 on dental treatment, £2,500 on a dietary programme, and £3,850 on a spa membership. The couple also reportedly spent almost £15,000 on travel, restaurants, and entertainment, and over £5,000 on parking charges and congestion fees within a few years.

The prosecution suggested these spending patterns are inconsistent with Adams’ declared poverty and alleged that Adams has concealed assets and routed funds through associates. Adams denied these claims, stating that all along, even from prison, he had reported having no money.

The reporting also noted Adams’ history as a key figure in London’s organized crime in the 1980s, alongside his brothers, and references allegations of previous criminal activity including drug trafficking and high-profile robberies. Adams’ current court appearance follows his conviction for breaching a financial reporting order, which required him to declare all expenditures over £500 to the Serious Organised Crime Agency for ten years post-imprisonment.

article_content: Former Australian cricketer Simon O'Donnell has voiced his disapproval of farewell Tests, especially regarding David Warner's intention for a farewell Test at his home ground in Sydney against Pakistan. O'Donnell believes players should not have the privilege of choosing the venue and date for their retirement. Warner, 37, has previously stated he plans to end his Test career during the upcoming three-Test series against Pakistan, with the final match set for Sydney in January. Speaking on Sen Radio, O'Donnell said, "I don't like farewell tours. I didn't like it back in Steve Waugh's or Mark Taylor's days. Being asked to play for Australia is an honor." He emphasized that players should not dictate when they step down, stating, "I don't think anyone has the right to say, 'I'll finish on June 30 this year.'" Discussion turned to whether Warner's performance, either in the Ashes or white-ball cricket, should influence team selection. O'Donnell highlighted Cameron Bancroft's excellent recent form, questioning if Bancroft should wait another season if Warner's planned farewell goes ahead. "Do you make him wait another summer? Because that's what he'll have to do if Warner gets the spot," O'Donnell said. Bancroft, along with Steve Smith and Warner, was banned for a year after the 2018 'sandpaper-gate' ball-tampering scandal. O'Donnell concluded that it's time for Warner to retire from Test cricket, noting Warner's strengths in white-ball formats but suggesting the red-ball game requires separate consideration. He added that Australia's recent World Cup win complicates the decision. "Everyone will say, 'What about his World Cup?' so that might buy Warner some more time," O'Donnell remarked.
