article_content: Marine biologists are investigating the cause behind thousands of Humboldt squid washing ashore along a 12-mile stretch of Santa Cruz County coastline, from Aptos to Watsonville, on Sunday. The mass stranding remains a mystery. The public is strongly advised by scientists not to touch or consume the stranded squid, as they may harbor dangerous toxins. Scientists, including Hanna Rosen, a graduate student at Stanford University's Hopkins Marine Station, suspect the squid may have ingested toxic algae. Rosen told CBS San Francisco that she observed people attempting to return the squid to the sea, only to watch them re-strand themselves, possibly due to disorientation. According to Rosen, 'They don't see the shore often...they might not understand their surroundings and simply try to escape, not realizing swimming toward shore will strand them.' The majority of stranded squid are juveniles, as adults can reach up to six feet in length and weigh 100 pounds. Researchers believe they likely hatched in Monterey Bay but became unable to navigate back to open water. Tests indicate the squid were well-fed, having eaten smaller market squid and even each other—a normal behavior. Sunday's incident marks the third Humboldt squid stranding along the coast from Santa Cruz to Pacific Grove in the past six weeks. Scientists are currently examining the squid's stomach contents to detect possible ingested toxins contributing to their confusion. One prevailing theory is that toxic algae ingestion, possibly domoic acid, disoriented the squid and led to their beaching. Although traces of domoic acid have been found in some specimens, results remain inconclusive. Humboldt squid have not recently been observed in Monterey Bay, making these events especially unusual. Some experts speculate this year's El Niño weather may have drawn the squid into cooler northern and central California waters. Conservationists are not deeply concerned for the species, as Humboldt squid reproduce in large numbers. Video footage shows the squid carcasses scattered along Santa Cruz beaches.

article_content: This as-told-to essay is based on a conversation with Channing Muller, 38, who chose to sell her home in Tennessee and move into a smaller apartment in Chicago. The conversation has been edited for length and clarity. In 2017, I moved from Washington, DC, to Chattanooga, Tennessee, after a difficult breakup, hoping a new city would provide a positive change. In 2019, I bought a 1,765-square-foot, three-bedroom home for $275,000 with a $1,500 monthly mortgage. My goal was to slow down and focus more on family. Over time, my priorities shifted, and I started to feel like I had outgrown Chattanooga. In October 2022, I visited Chicago to run a marathon and was impressed by the city. When I returned to Tennessee, I realized it was time for a change. I wanted to live in a larger, more liberal city, and Chicago offered the activities and culture I was looking for, while still feeling approachable. In March 2023, I booked an Airbnb, packed up my dogs and cat, and drove to Chicago to try living in the city for a month. Afterward, I returned to Tennessee, listed my house for sale, stored much of my furniture, and donated other items. Now, I live in a two-bedroom, 1,200-square-foot apartment in Chicago, paying $2,050 a month in rent. I enjoy having less responsibility. My main concerns now are my pets, running my business, and training for marathons. Renting has allowed me to let go of unnecessary possessions—I adopted a Marie Kondo approach and kept only what truly brings me joy. When searching for an apartment, my only requirement was two bedrooms so I could work from home, and enough space for my two large dogs. I chose a walk-up building and don’t mind climbing three flights of stairs or sharing laundry facilities in the basement, although some people might consider these drawbacks. Back in Chattanooga, I thought I would grow into my house, but I ended up outgrowing it instead. Owning a home required much upkeep, like maintaining the yard and addressing repairs. I eventually became tired of that responsibility. As a renter, I can call someone to handle any issues, which lets me focus on my business, making friends, and training. Downsizing has changed my lifestyle, especially with my dogs. In Tennessee, I had a fenced yard for them, but now I take them outside for walks. I also used to host large dinner parties, but now my space comfortably fits just one or two friends. Although I’ll miss entertaining as the holidays approach, I’m content for now. article_content: Italian astronomers have used the Hubble Space Telescope (HST) to conduct high-resolution optical observations of the globular cluster NGC 6284. The results of this observational campaign, published on October 26 on the pre-print server arXiv, provide new insights into the properties and nature of this cluster. Globular clusters (GCs) are groups of tightly bound stars orbiting galaxies, serving as natural laboratories for the study of stellar and galactic evolution. Detailed studies of these objects help astronomers better understand the formation and evolution of early-type galaxies, as their origins are closely linked to periods of intense star formation. NGC 6284 (also known as GCL 53 or ESO 518-SC9) was discovered in 1784 and is estimated to be at least 11 billion years old. Despite being known for over two centuries, many parameters of this Galactic GC remain uncertain. Previous observations suggest that NGC 6284 is a mid-metallicity cluster located about 50,000 light years away, possibly associated with the Milky Way's thick disk. Recently, a research team led by Dan Deras from the University of Bologna, Italy, used the HST to further investigate NGC 6284. Their high-resolution HST optical observations enabled the first detailed photometric study of the cluster. The team produced the first high-quality color-magnitude diagram (CMD) for NGC 6284, extending about six magnitudes below the main sequence turn-off, which allowed them to analyze the cluster’s innermost regions in detail. Observations revealed that the center of gravity of NGC 6284 is offset by 1.5–3 arcseconds from previous measurements. The density profile shows a steep central cusp, indicating that NGC 6284 is likely a post-core collapse (PCC) cluster. The study found that NGC 6284 is about 43,000 light years from Earth, making it closer than previously thought. Its core radius and half-mass radius were measured at 2.15 and 9 light years, respectively, and the concentration parameter was calculated at 1.54. These values are typical for highly evolved GCs that have undergone core collapse. Based on HST data, the authors estimate that NGC 6284 is 13.3 billion years old. The cluster's metallicity was measured at -1.36, and its absolute reddening at 0.32, consistent with earlier findings.

article_content: Texas Republican Congressman Blake Farenthold is facing allegations of sexual harassment and gender discrimination from his former staffer, Lauren Greene. In court filings from December, Greene, who was terminated from her position, claims Farenthold made inappropriate remarks, including alleged comments about 'sexual fantasies' and 'wet dreams,' and created a hostile work environment. She also alleges that Farenthold, who is married and has two children, regularly drank excessively and often flirted with female staff, particularly redheads. Greene is seeking back pay and compensation for emotional distress, claiming wrongful termination and that Farenthold and his chief of staff contributed to an unhealthy workplace. Specific allegations include comments about Greene's appearance and attire, inappropriate jokes, and remarks about a proposition for a 'threesome.' Farenthold strongly denies these accusations in a 14-page court response, asserting any remarks he made about Greene's appearance were innocent and similar to compliments given to other staff of both genders. He also denies making any lewd comments or inappropriate jokes about Greene. Farenthold's office claims Greene was dismissed due to poor performance and failing to attend scheduled media events, and that the noted office culture was not problematic as described. The congressman has previously faced public scrutiny, including for an old photo taken with a lingerie-clad model at a Texas nightclub and for comments made on a frequent flyer forum, in which he joked about his wife and made remarks that have since been criticized as inappropriate. Despite controversies, Farenthold was first elected in 2010 and has been reelected twice in his largely Republican district.

article_content: The story of Congressman Jesse Jackson Jr. has taken unusual turns as reports emerge of his interest in martial arts and beliefs about a past life as a chariot driver. Jackson, 47, has rarely appeared in public since taking a leave of absence from Congress in June. He is currently under FBI investigation for allegedly misusing campaign funds to redecorate his home and may be indicted before his upcoming re-election. Former staff members have noted that Jackson expressed unconventional ideas, such as believing he was a chariot driver in a previous life, and reportedly practiced martial arts while nude at a Turkish bath. Frank Coconate, a former aide who once helped Jackson consider a run for Chicago mayor in 2006, told the Washington Post that he questioned Jackson's grasp on reality. Attorney and political adviser Frank Avila Jr. similarly stated that Jackson would perform martial arts routines while unclothed at a bathhouse he frequented. Jackson, the son of civil rights leader Rev. Jesse Jackson, was previously involved in the FBI's investigation into ex-governor Rod Blagojevich's attempt to sell Barack Obama's Senate seat after Obama became president in 2008. The Illinois congressman took medical leave from his duties on June 10 to treat depression and was admitted to clinics in Arizona and later the Mayo Clinic in Minnesota, where he was diagnosed with bipolar disorder. Although Jackson returned home to Washington last month, he has not actively participated in his re-election campaign. His wife, Sandi, recently suggested he might not return to work until after the election, depending on medical guidance. The Daily recently reported that Jackson continues to see doctors regularly and is still not well. The specific residence allegedly redecorated has not been confirmed, but Jackson's primary home is in Washington, D.C., and was briefly listed for sale, prompting speculation about his future. Jackson has faced multiple alleged scandals in recent years and remains on medical leave as he recovers from depression. Sources say the ongoing investigation is focused on whether he used campaign funds for home improvements. Jackson's attorney reportedly requested assurances from the FBI and U.S. Attorney's office that no charges would be filed before the November 6 election, but officials declined to make such a guarantee. Despite these circumstances, Jackson is expected to win re-election in his predominantly Democratic district in south Chicago, which he has represented for 17 years. His spokesperson declined to comment on the current FBI investigation. Allegations of political corruption have been a recurring issue among Chicago politicians for decades.

article_content: In a letter dated April 23, Michael Girgenti expressed a desire to avoid legal proceedings regarding the paternity of Kourtney Kardashian's son, Mason. Girgenti, a 26-year-old male model, claims he fathered Mason after an alleged affair with Kourtney. Instead of going straight to court, he wrote to Kourtney, urging her to agree to a DNA test. According to RadarOnline, the letter outlined his wish to avoid taking Kourtney and her partner, Scott Disick, to court. Girgenti requested a DNA test and warned that if Kourtney did not comply, he would initiate legal action. He assured her he didn't want to disrupt her family and stated his intent to be a responsible father if proven to be Mason's biological parent. Last week, Girgenti filed paperwork with the Los Angeles County Superior Court seeking joint custody of three-year-old Mason and requesting a court-ordered DNA test. He alleges that he and Kourtney had unprotected sex about nine months before Mason’s birth. The lawsuit details an allegedly brief relationship between Kourtney and Girgenti, which he claims began in August 2008 and included months of texting, some suggesting trouble in Kourtney’s relationship with Scott Disick. Gossip website TMZ reports that Girgenti has asked the court to order DNA tests for Kourtney, Mason, and Scott Disick, who is also the father of Kourtney's daughter, Penelope. A hearing is reportedly scheduled for next month. Kourtney was said to be 'furious' when the allegations first became public in March, but has not publicly commented. Her legal representative has also not responded to recent requests for comment. Her lawyer, Todd Wilson, told TMZ that Girgenti’s claims are unfounded and that this is yet another attempt to gain publicity through fabricated stories. Wilson stated, 'Scott Disick is Mason’s father,' and dismissed the lawsuit as baseless and a publicity stunt. Kourtney's and Michael Girgenti's first known meeting was during a 2008 photo shoot. Kourtney's attorney says no further contact occurred afterward. Girgenti alleges that after Mason’s birth, he attempted to get in touch with Kourtney after seeing photos of Mason. Previously, a legal representative for Kourtney refuted Girgenti's allegations as 'preposterous and an outrageous lie.' The Kardashian family has faced similar paternity rumors in the past, including speculation regarding Kourtney’s sister Khloe and half-sister Kylie Jenner. Nepal and Oman have earned their spots in the T20 World Cup 2024 after prevailing in the Asia Qualifier tournament held in Kathmandu. Oman secured qualification with a dominant 10-wicket victory over Bahrain in the semifinals, while Nepal achieved their place by defeating the UAE by eight wickets. This will be Oman's third T20 World Cup appearance, following previous entries in 2016 and 2021 where they exited in the early stages. Nepal is making a second appearance, their first since 2014, when they also didn't advance beyond the opening round.

Next year's T20 World Cup will be co-hosted by the West Indies and the United States. With these two qualifiers, 18 teams are now confirmed out of 20, and the remaining places will be determined at the Africa Qualifier in Namibia from November 20 to 23.

The confirmed teams for T20 World Cup 2024 are: hosts West Indies and USA; the top eight sides from 2022—Australia, England (the current defending champions), India, Netherlands, New Zealand, Pakistan, South Africa, and Sri Lanka; the next top-ranked teams—Afghanistan and Bangladesh; European qualifiers—Ireland and Scotland; East Asia-Pacific qualifier—Papua New Guinea; Americas qualifier—Canada; and from Asia—Nepal and Oman.

article_content: A recently declassified US intelligence report reveals that North Korea sent special forces teams to the United States in the 1990s, aiming to target nuclear power stations and major cities in the event of war. According to a Defense Intelligence Agency report dated September 13, 2004, North Korea infiltrated five units of specially trained commandos onto US territory, preparing them to strike key sites if hostilities broke out. The report states that the North Korean Ministry of People’s Armed Forces established five liaison offices in the early 1990s to facilitate the training and infiltration of operatives into the United States. Their mission was to attack nuclear power plants and major urban centers should conflict occur. Military experts believe these units were deployed because North Korea, at the time, lacked long-range missiles capable of reaching the US. The report indicates that one of the main motivations behind forming these units and infiltrating operatives was the slow progress in developing multi-stage ballistic missiles. At that time, North Korea was led by Kim Jong Il. Currently, the country is believed to possess at least two types of long-range ballistic missiles capable of reaching the United States. North Korea is known to have one of the world's largest numbers of special forces, with more than 60,000 commandos under the Reconnaissance Bureau, a branch of its Armed Forces. The Bureau has been linked to several terror attacks, including airline bombings, kidnappings, and assassinations. The intelligence source remains undisclosed but may have originated from a defector or electronic surveillance. The redacted report was released following a Freedom of Information Act request, as reported by the Washington Free Beacon. The information follows a separate incident involving hackers believed to be working for North Korea, who forced Sony Pictures to withdraw the release of the film 'The Interview', a satirical comedy about an attempt to assassinate Kim Jong Un. The hackers, purportedly from a cyber-warfare unit known as Bureau 121, issued threats referencing September 11 and stole approximately 100 terabytes of data, leading to significant potential financial losses for the studio. US government officials have stated that they are considering appropriate responses, such as cyber or financial sanctions. However, there is ongoing uncertainty about confirming North Korea’s responsibility for the cyberattack and the potential impact of any US actions.

article_content: U.S. Secretary of State Hillary Clinton expressed concern Friday that Iran and China are gaining significant influence in Central and South America, calling this trend 'quite disturbing.' Clinton emphasized that the United States must not 'turn our backs on countries in our own hemisphere.' Addressing a town hall at the State Department with senior Foreign Service Officers, Clinton discussed the Obama administration's commitment to improving relationships throughout the Western Hemisphere—even with its harshest critics, such as Venezuelan President Hugo Chavez. She also noted the administration is seeking reciprocal steps from Cuba’s leaders, following President Obama's easing of travel and other restrictions. Clinton criticized previous Bush administration efforts to isolate certain Latin American leaders as unsuccessful, noting the growing influence not only of Iran and China but also Russia across the region. 'What we are doing hasn't worked very well,' she said. 'They [Iran and China] are building very strong economic and political connections with many of these leaders. I don't think that is in our interests.' She pointed to Iran’s expanding presence in Nicaragua, mentioning the construction of a large Iranian embassy in Managua. Clinton remarked, 'You can only imagine what it's for.' She added that the U.S. was evaluating how to engage with Nicaraguan President Daniel Ortega as part of this broader regional approach. Regarding Cuba, Clinton stated the U.S. is awaiting a response from Raúl and Fidel Castro, expressing a desire for progress on political prisoners, human rights, and other issues. 'We would like to see some reciprocity from the Castros,' she said. 'My bottom line is what's best for America: how do we try to influence behavior that is more in our interest than not,' Clinton concluded. Later, at a ceremony honoring Foreign Service officers killed in the line of duty, Clinton appeared emotional while paying tribute to Brian Adkins, a 25-year-old diplomat recently killed in Ethiopia. 'Please know how grateful we are for his selflessness and service to his country,' she said. The names of Adkins and three other officers were added to a commemorative plaque at the State Department.

article_content: In response to over a dozen allegations of sexual assault from different women over many years, comedian Bill Cosby's lawyer released a statement on November 16. The statement asserted that these 'decade-old, discredited allegations' have resurfaced but that repetition does not make them true. Cosby's lawyer stated that he would not comment further and thanked his supporters, assuring them that at 77 years old, Cosby is doing his best work. No additional statements will be issued by Cosby or his representatives. This brief press release suggests that an accusation of rape cannot be true if it is old, previously doubted, or made against an elderly man. While it remains unclear what actually occurred, it is important not to dismiss these allegations outright. More than a dozen women have accused Cosby of similar patterns of abuse—being drugged, assaulted while alone with him, and then silenced. One woman, Barbara Bowman, now 46 and a married mother of two, claims Cosby repeatedly raped her when she was a teenage aspiring actress under his mentorship. Bowman says she has no financial motive, as she never sought or received money from Cosby, and the statute of limitations on her case has expired. Victims often take years to come to terms with and speak about their abuse, undergoing denial, shame, and self-doubt—common responses when betrayed by someone trusted. Speaking out about sexual abuse, especially by a famous person, requires tremendous courage and often subjects victims to invasive scrutiny and disbelief. Societal institutions, including law enforcement and the justice system, have sometimes been reluctant to believe victims, especially those accusing high-profile individuals. This contributes to the under-reporting and under-prosecution of sexual violence. Gradually, the stigma attached to being a rape victim is diminishing. There is growing understanding that victims may delay reporting or struggle to confront an abuser, and can feel confusion, shame, and reluctance. Experts emphasize the importance of believing those who come forward, regardless of how much time has passed. It is vital for media, businesses, and the justice system to treat allegations of sexual assault with dignity and compassion, and to recognize the bravery involved in speaking out. Continued effort is needed to address and prevent sexual violence in all areas of society, including campuses, the military, sports organizations, religious institutions, and homes.
translated_content: 针对多年来十几位女性对喜剧演员比尔·考斯比提出的性侵指控，考斯比的律师于11月16日发表声明。声明称，这些“数十年前已被否认的指控”虽被重提，但重复并不能证实其真实性。律师表示考斯比不会再做进一步回应，并感谢粉丝的支持，强调77岁的考斯比仍在全力以赴。考斯比及其代表不会再发表更多声明。 这份简短的新闻稿暗示，强奸指控如果是旧闻、曾被人质疑或对象是高龄男性，就不成立。事实真相目前尚不明确，但不应轻易否定这些指控。已有十多位女性称遭遇了类似的侵害模式：单独与考斯比相处时被下药、性侵，之后遭到噤声。 其中一名女性巴巴拉·鲍曼，现在46岁，是两个孩子的已婚母亲，她称自己在青少年时期作为考斯比的指导对象时曾多次被其强奸。鲍曼表示，她没有任何经济动机，因为她从未向考斯比索要或收到过金钱，且其案件的诉讼时效已过。 受害者往往需要多年才能面对并谈论自己的遭遇，这一过程伴随着否认、羞耻与自我怀疑——这是被信任之人背叛后的常见反应。举报名人性侵尤其需要极大勇气，且受害者通常会面对外界的质疑与隐私被侵犯。 包括执法机构与司法系统在内的社会机构，有时不愿相信受害者，特别是指控名人时。这加剧了性侵案件报告率和起诉率的不足。 随着时间推移，强奸受害者所承受的污名正在渐渐减少。越来越多人理解到，受害者可能会延迟报案、难以直面施害者，并感到困惑、羞耻和犹豫。 专家强调，无论过了多久，都应认真对待任何受害者的揭露。媒体、企业与司法系统应以尊重与同情对待性侵指控，并认同发声的勇气。社会各界——包括高校、军队、体育组织、宗教机构和家庭——都需要持续努力，防止和制止性暴力。

article_content: David Villa matched Lionel Messi at the top of Spain's scoring charts, netting his 13th and 14th goals of the season as Valencia secured a 4-1 derby win over Villarreal, who played over an hour with 10 men. Ever Banega put Valencia in front in the sixth minute, and Villa doubled their lead from the penalty spot after earning the foul that led to Villarreal defender Francisco Kiko being sent off. David Silva, now regaining form post-injury, made it 3-0 in the 56th minute, but Villarreal's Nilmar cut the deficit five minutes later. Villa added his second goal in stoppage time, drawing level with Barcelona’s Messi at 14 goals. The victory was a timely boost for Valencia after their Spanish Cup loss to Deportivo La Coruna and moved them just three points behind second-placed Real Madrid, who lost 1-0 to Athletic Bilbao on Saturday. In other action, Atletico Madrid continued their excellent start to 2010, clinching a third consecutive league win with a 3-2 triumph over Sporting Gijon at the Vicente Calderon Stadium. Goals from Diego Forlan, Paulo Assuncao, and teenager Ibrahima Balde propelled Atletico to within seven points of sixth-placed Sevilla. Earlier on Sunday, Real Mallorca extended their flawless home run to nine consecutive wins by defeating Deportivo La Coruna 2-0. Julio Alvarez struck the post in the 12th minute, but Mario Suarez eventually opened the scoring shortly after halftime before Chori Castro secured the result with a second goal eight minutes later. The win capped a strong week for Mallorca, who advanced to the Spanish Cup quarterfinals midweek and now sit fourth in the league, overtaking Deportivo and holding a Champions League spot.

An international team of astronomers has used the Atacama Large Millimeter/Submillimeter Array (ALMA) to study the supernova remnant LHA 120-N49. Their observations, detailed in a paper published November 3 on the arXiv pre-print server, offer valuable insights into the molecular clouds associated with this remnant.

Supernova remnants (SNRs) are expanding structures formed by the explosive death of massive stars. These remnants consist of material ejected by the supernova event, as well as interstellar matter swept up by the powerful shockwaves released in the explosion. Studying SNRs is crucial for understanding galaxy evolution, as they distribute heavy elements throughout the cosmos and help heat the interstellar medium. SNRs are also believed to accelerate galactic cosmic rays.

LHA 120-N49, or N49, is a prominent X-ray supernova remnant located in the Large Magellanic Cloud (LMC), with an apparent diameter of approximately 59 light years and an estimated age of 4,800 years. The explosion that created it is thought to have released around 1.8 sexdecillion ergs of energy. Past observations revealed that the environment around N49 contains molecular clouds and young stellar clusters. Notably, the shockwave from the supernova is interacting with dense, clumpy interstellar clouds on the remnant's eastern side.

Led by Hidetoshi Sano of Gifu University in Japan, the research team employed ALMA to examine this interaction. They observed the 12CO(J = 3–2) emission line using the ALMA Atacama Compact Array Band 7 during multiple sessions in August and September 2022. The study utilized 10–11 antennas of the 7-meter array and 3–4 antennas of the Total Power array across several dates.

The ALMA data revealed that molecular clouds form a clumpy distribution along the southeastern edge of N49's shell, exhibiting a high-intensity ratio in the observed emission lines. This pattern suggests active interactions between the supernova shockwave and the clouds. In total, eight molecular clouds were identified near N49. Measurements of their kinetic temperature and hydrogen number density indicate they were heated by supernova shocks.

Significantly, this work presents the first evidence of shock-heated molecular clouds in an extragalactic supernova remnant. Of the eight clouds, five maintain constant pressure and have not experienced shock evaporation during N49's existence, while the remaining three appear to be partially evaporating due to interactions with the shock.

一个国际天文学团队利用阿塔卡马大型毫米/亚毫米阵列（ALMA）对超新星遗迹LHA 120-N49进行了研究。他们的观测结果于11月3日发表在arXiv预印本服务器上，为该遗迹相关的分子云提供了重要的新见解。

超新星遗迹（SNRs）是由大质量恒星爆炸形成的扩展结构。这些遗迹包含爆炸时抛射出的物质以及爆炸冲击波席卷的星际物质。研究超新星遗迹对于理解星系演化极为重要，因为它们传播重元素并加热星际介质。此外，SNRs还被认为是银河宇宙射线的加速源。

LHA 120-N49（又称N49）是位于大麦哲伦云（LMC）的一颗明亮的X射线超新星遗迹，视直径约为59光年，估算年龄为4800年。其超新星爆炸释放的能量约为1.8乘十的三十三次方尔格。以往观测显示，N49周围环境中存在分子云和年轻恒星团。尤其是，来自该超新星的冲击波正在与遗迹东侧致密分块的星际云发生相互作用。

由日本岐阜大学的佐野英俊带领，研究团队利用ALMA观测了这一相互作用。他们于2022年8月至9月间，通过ALMA的Atacama Compact Array（ACA）7波段观测了12CO(J = 3–2)发射线，动用了7米阵列的10-11台天线以及Total Power阵列的3-4台天线。

ALMA数据揭示，N49包壳东南沿分布着分块的分子云，这些云在观测到的发射线中展现高强度比率。这表明超新星冲击波正与分子云发生显著相互作用。共鉴定出八个分子云，根据其运动温度和氢分子数密度推断，这些分子云受到了超新星冲击加热。

值得一提的是，这项工作首次在河外超新星遗迹中发现了冲击加热分子云的证据。在这八个分子云中，有五个保持恒定压力，在N49存在期间未经历冲击蒸发，其余三个则出现了部分蒸发迹象，可能因与冲击波的相互作用引起。

Imagine if weekends were longer than just two days. Carlos Slim Helú, who was named the world's richest man by Forbes in July 2014 with a net worth of about $79.6 billion, has suggested it’s time to change our approach to work. Speaking at a business conference in Paraguay, the 74-year-old Mexican telecom magnate advocated for employees to work just three days each week for around 11 hours a day, while extending their careers into their 70s. Slim contends that this new work structure would give people more time to relax, explore hobbies, or try new activities, leading to better overall quality of life. 

He has already put some of these concepts into practice at his company, Telmex. As reported by the Financial Times, some workers who join the company in their teens can retire before age 50, and others have the option to work four days per week with full pay. Even at his age, Slim stays active in his businesses and pursues his hobbies, such as collecting art. He opened Museo Soumaya—named after his late wife, Soumaya Domit—to share his appreciation for art and religious artifacts.

Slim also highlighted at the conference that education should be enjoyable and designed to teach students how to think critically, rather than simply memorizing information.

article_content: For the first time since the Israel-Hamas war began, the U.S. Department of Education is initiating several investigations into colleges and schools in response to reports of antisemitism and Islamophobia. These investigations are being carried out under Title VI, a law that prohibits discrimination based on race or shared ancestry. Currently, five cases concerning antisemitism and two cases concerning Islamophobia are under investigation across seven institutions: Cornell University, Columbia University, the University of Pennsylvania, Wellesley College, Lafayette College, Cooper Union, and the Maize Unified School District in Kansas. If these institutions are found to have violated federal law, they could lose federal funding or be referred to the Department of Justice for further action. Education Secretary Miguel Cardona told ABC News that removing federal funds would only occur if an institution refused to create a safe learning environment, which he does not believe reflects campus cultures. The department's primary goal is to ensure safe learning environments for all students. Complaints have surged at the Office of Civil Rights since the war started, with the Biden administration reminding schools that federal funding depends on compliance with anti-discrimination laws, protecting students perceived to be Jewish, Israeli, Muslim, Arab, or Palestinian. Recent complaints include a 27-page document from the Brandeis Center, a Jewish civil rights organization, detailing antisemitic incidents at the University of Pennsylvania and a controversial letter at Wellesley College. Wellesley College and the University of Pennsylvania both acknowledged receipt of letters from the Department of Education about the investigations and expressed intentions to cooperate. Other university and school district responses ranged from confirming cooperation to expressing surprise about the investigations. Some institutions, such as Columbia, Cornell, and Cooper Union, declined to comment. Tensions on U.S. campuses have intensified since October 7, with incidents of antisemitism and Islamophobia increasing alongside large demonstrations supporting various viewpoints on the conflict. Some recent incidents include an alleged hate crime involving an Arab Muslim student at Stanford University and a Cornell student being charged with threatening Jewish students. Three Jewish New York University students have also filed a lawsuit alleging inadequate protection from antisemitism. Jewish and Muslim advocacy groups, such as the Anti-Defamation League and the Council on American-Islamic Relations, have reported major spikes in discrimination reports since the war's onset.

article_content: French Culture Minister Frederic Mitterrand has refused to step down amid renewed scrutiny surrounding his 2005 book, 'The Bad Life,' in which he wrote about paying for sex with 'boys' in Thailand. Recent criticism reignited after he publicly defended filmmaker Roman Polanski, who was detained in Switzerland for an incident from decades earlier. Both the far-right National Front and the left-leaning Socialist Party have called for Mitterrand’s resignation. In response, he maintains his intention to remain in office. Mitterrand concedes his actions in Thailand were a mistake but insists they were not criminal. He clarifies that the people he described in his book were adult men, not minors, and that he strongly denounces both pedophilia and sex tourism. Mitterrand explained in interviews that his use of 'boys' referred to young men—never to underage individuals—and disavows allegations of supporting child exploitation, calling such assertions baseless. President Nicolas Sarkozy continues to support Mitterrand, commending his book for its candor and talent. Meanwhile, the National Front has held demonstrations and started petitions urging Mitterrand’s resignation, arguing his past actions have tarnished the reputation of the French government internationally. Leaders of the Socialist Party have called on President Sarkozy to reconsider Mitterrand’s post in light of France’s pledges to combat child exploitation and sex tourism. Some politicians suggest the public should decide by reading the book themselves. Mitterrand, who is openly gay and the nephew of former President Francois Mitterrand, points out that his book merges personal experience and fiction, arguing that critics mistakenly conflate homosexuality with criminality. Publication of excerpts detailing Mitterrand’s experiences in Thailand has sparked passionate debate and deepened the divide among the French public. In response to the growing controversy, Wikipedia has locked editing on Mitterrand’s entry. Ongoing public demonstrations and political debate continue as commentators and citizens question whether Mitterrand’s past conduct is compatible with his role as culture minister.

article_content: The annual Hockey Hall of Fame weekend in Toronto is a major event, featuring a four-day celebration that culminates in the induction ceremony broadcasted on TSN in Canada and NHL Network in the U.S. On Friday afternoon, the 2023 Hockey Hall of Fame inductees received their rings and saw their commemorative plaques added to the Great Hall in the Hockey Hall of Fame building in downtown Toronto. That night, the honorees participated in the opening faceoff of the Hall of Fame Game at Scotiabank Arena—a 5-4 shootout win for the Toronto Maple Leafs over the Calgary Flames. On Saturday, the inductees returned to the Great Hall to interact with fans. Sunday featured a ceremony where they received Hall of Fame jackets, followed by the annual Legends game. In the Legends game, 2023 inductees Pierre Turgeon and Caroline Ouellette will play for a team captained by 2012 Hall of Famer Adam Oates and coached by 2023 inductee Ken Hitchcock, opposing a team led by 2011 inductee Joe Nieuwendyk and featuring Henrik Lundqvist in net. At age 41, Henrik Lundqvist will be the only one of this year's three inducted goaltenders to suit up for the game. He concluded his 887-game career with the New York Rangers in 2020, retiring due to a heart condition. Mike Vernon, 60, retired in 2002 after 781 games and two Stanley Cup wins—one with the Calgary Flames in 1989 and another with the Detroit Red Wings in 1997. Tom Barrasso, 58, won back-to-back Stanley Cups with the Pittsburgh Penguins in 1991 and 1992, playing 777 games before retiring in 2003. This year marks the first time since 1962 that three goaltenders have been inducted in a single class, raising the total number of goalies in the Hall of Fame to 44. Other honorees in the Class of 2023 include Caroline Ouellette, Pierre Turgeon, Ken Hitchcock, and Pierre Lacroix (posthumously, with his son Eric Lacroix representing him). Caroline Ouellette, a four-time Olympic gold medalist with Team Canada and winner of six world championship gold medals, played college hockey at the University of Minnesota-Duluth, where she captained for two years. She also served as Canada's captain at the 2014 Sochi Olympics and has worked as a coach since retiring. Pierre Turgeon, drafted first overall by the Buffalo Sabres in 1987, scored 1,327 points in 1,294 NHL games over 19 seasons. His standout season was with the New York Islanders in 1992-93 when he scored 58 goals and 134 points, earning the Lady Byng Trophy. Turgeon is one of three NHL players to record at least 300 points with three different franchises. The others are Joe Mullen and Mark Recchi. Ken Hitchcock, who won a Stanley Cup with the Dallas Stars in 1999 and the Jack Adams Award as NHL coach of the year in 2012 with the St. Louis Blues, coached five NHL teams over 22 years. His 849 career wins rank him fourth all-time among NHL coaches. Pierre Lacroix began as a player agent before becoming general manager of the Quebec Nordiques in 1994. After the franchise moved to Colorado, he orchestrated the trade for legendary goaltender Patrick Roy, leading to Avalanche Stanley Cup wins in 1996 and 2001. Lacroix spent 19 years with the Nordiques/Avalanche organization, and his .623 winning percentage as GM is second all-time among those with at least 800 games, trailing only Montreal’s Sam Pollock. His son Eric played parts of three NHL seasons with the Avalanche. Pierre Lacroix passed away in 2020 at age 72.
translated_content: 多伦多一年一度的冰球名人堂周末是一项盛大活动，为期四天的庆典以加拿大全国TSN和美国NHL Network直播的入堂仪式作为高潮。 周五下午，2023年冰球名人堂入选者领取了戒指，并见证了他们的纪念牌匾被放置在多伦多市中心冰球名人堂大殿。 当晚，荣誉嘉宾们参加了在丰业银行体育馆举行的名人堂比赛开球仪式——多伦多枫叶队通过点球大战以5-4击败卡尔加里火焰队。 周六，入选者重返大殿与球迷互动。周日举行了授予名人堂夹克的仪式，之后是每年一度的传奇赛。 在传奇赛中，2023年入选者皮埃尔·特尔居隆和卡罗琳·乌埃莱特将代表一支由2012年入选名人堂的亚当·欧茨担任队长、2023年入选者肯·希区柯克执教的球队，对阵由2011年名人堂成员乔·纽因戴克领衔、2023年入选者亨里克·伦德奎斯特担任守门员的球队。 41岁的伦德奎斯特将是今年三位入选的门将中唯一出战传奇赛的球员。他在纽约游骑兵队效力887场后，于2020年因心脏健康问题退役。 现年60岁的迈克·弗农于2002年退役，总共出战781场，曾分别在1989年和1997年随卡尔加里火焰队和底特律红翼队夺得斯坦利杯。 现年58岁的汤姆·巴拉索在1991年和1992年随匹兹堡企鹅队连夺两届斯坦利杯，职业生涯共打了777场，2003年退役。 这是自1962年以来，首次有三名门将同时入选，名人堂门将总数增至44人。 2023年其他荣誉入选者包括卡罗琳·乌埃莱特、皮埃尔·特尔居隆、肯·希区柯克，以及皮埃尔·拉克罗瓦（追授，由其子埃里克·拉克罗瓦代为出席）。 卡罗琳·乌埃莱特是加拿大女队四次冬奥会金牌得主、六次世锦赛金牌获得者，在明尼苏达-德卢斯大学打大学冰球并担任队长两年。她也担任2014年索契冬奥会加拿大队长，退役后投身教练工作。 皮埃尔·特尔居隆于1987年被布法罗军刀队选为状元，他在19个赛季内参加过1,294场NHL比赛，累计1,327分。在1992-93赛季代表纽约岛人队时表现最为突出，打进58球，拿下134分，斩获绅士奖。 特尔居隆是NHL历史上，仅有的三位分别为三支球队都拿下至少300分的球员之一，另两位是乔·穆伦和马克·瑞奇。 肯·希区柯克曾于1999年与达拉斯星队一同捧杯，并于2012年获NHL年度最佳教练奖（杰克·亚当斯奖），执教五支NHL球队共22年。849场胜利位列NHL主教练历史第四。 皮埃尔·拉克罗瓦最初是一名球员经纪人，1994年成为魁北克北欧人队总经理。球队迁至科罗拉多后，他策划引入传奇门将帕特里克·罗伊，帮助球队于1996年和2001年两度斩获斯坦利杯。 拉克罗瓦在北欧人/雪崩队工作了19年，他担任总经理期间的胜率为0.623，在至少执教800场的总经理中排名第二，仅次于蒙特利尔加拿大人队的山姆·波洛克。他的儿子埃里克曾效力雪崩队三个赛季。皮埃尔·拉克罗瓦于2020年逝世，享年72岁。

article_content: Recent statistics reveal that a British schoolgirl underwent four abortions before the age of 16, reflecting a wider concern as over 200 girls under 16 have had multiple abortions in the past three years. Among them, five had three procedures before the legal age of consent. There are ongoing concerns from experts that some teenagers may be viewing abortion as an alternative to contraception. Department of Health figures indicate that in 2011, 84 under-16s had repeat abortions, rising to 89 out of 2,925 in 2012, then dropping to 68 out of 2,538 in the following year. Norman Wells from the Family Education Trust remarked that numerous teenagers might be engaging in sexual activity without fully understanding the consequences. Overall, 185,331 women in the UK had abortions last year, with 50 having nine or more. Additionally, in a legal case, a 13-year-old girl was allowed by a High Court judge to decide for herself about having an abortion, following her late-stage pregnancy being discovered after a family member noticed her physical changes. The girl, residing with her parents, decided she was not ready for motherhood and opted for a termination.

article_content: After nearly ten years as an executive coach, Antonia Bowring—founder of ABstrategies LLC and author of 'Coach Yourself!'—shares five key lessons she's learned from more than 5,000 hours of coaching. Her reflections are aimed at those seeking a balance between achievement and personal satisfaction: 1. Intentions and Goals: Setting intentions gives direction, but specific, measurable goals are what turn aspirations into reality. Bowring explains that when she decided to write her book, progress only happened after she broke the process into actionable steps, created deadlines, and held herself accountable. 2. Developing Good Habits: Personal transformation depends largely on consistently building positive habits. Bowring encourages continual experimentation to find routines that support who you want to become and stresses the importance of flexibility, especially for those who thrive on variety, such as people with ADHD. 3. Combining Logic and Emotion: Making good decisions often requires a nuanced balance between rational analysis and emotional intuition. Bowring notes that recognizing when to use your head or your heart, and shifting accordingly, can lead to stronger leadership and more thoughtful choices. 4. Mastering Deep Listening: Listening effectively—truly understanding and connecting with others—is more challenging than it seems, especially in today’s distracting environment. Bowring finds that mindfulness practices and regularly seeking feedback help clients become better listeners, which strengthens relationships and trust. 5. The Value of Curiosity: Adopting a curious mindset opens the door to meaningful change. Bowring observes that clients who approach challenges with genuine curiosity and humility experience significant personal and professional growth. Bowring emphasizes that these insights are less about chasing milestones and more about embracing the process of growth. She believes that steady practice, resilience, and learning from setbacks create the foundation for a rewarding, successful life—where the journey itself is the greatest achievement. Note: Forbes Coaches Council is an exclusive group for top business and career coaches.

article_content: A recent survey reveals that the majority of people in the UK thrive on routine, often repeating the same daily practices. Whether it's eating the same breakfast, reaching for a favorite mug, or going to bed and waking up on schedule, these familiar habits shape much of everyday life. Research by Clipper Teas found that three-quarters of Britons stick to set routines, choosing familiar brands, dining at regular spots, and shopping at preferred stores. Personal habits are equally consistent: one in five respondents reported having the same hairstyle for a decade. While routines provide comfort, they can also leave people feeling bored or trapped, with many describing their days as repetitive—almost like living in 'Groundhog Day.' For some, changing even small habits feels daunting. Thirty percent admitted they’re afraid to try new things, and few can imagine their lives any other way. Despite this, major changes such as switching jobs or ending relationships happen more often than trying new daily products like tea or moisturizer. Life coach Amanda Brown explains that routines offer a sense of safety and predictability. However, she encourages making small changes, suggesting that trying a new product—even something simple like a different tea—can build self-confidence. Repetition doesn’t stop with daily life; it also extends to vacation planning. According to Monarch Airlines, eight in ten UK travelers have returned to the same holiday destination more than once. Reasons include reliable weather, food preferences, familiar faces, and managing costs, with Spain, the Canary Islands, and France ranking as favorite return destinations. Andrew Swaffield, Managing Director of Monarch Airlines, notes that returning to known holiday spots simplifies planning and enhances the travel experience, especially for families. Still, he advocates for occasionally exploring new destinations to avoid getting stuck in a travel rut. In the end, while comfortable routines offer predictability, experts advise that making small changes can lead to new experiences and boost everyday satisfaction.

article_content: MUMBAI: Can a surgery span five days? It did for 24-year-old Tafita Fanambinantsoa Andriatsarafara from Madagascar, who had a rare spinal tumor affecting 10 vertebral segments. At Kokilaben Ambani Hospital in Andheri, Mumbai, surgeons recently removed a massive 2000cm3 tumor—about 30 times the size of an egg—in a single operation, after careful planning. Tafita suffered pain and increasing immobility since 2017, which was worsened by financial challenges and Covid-19 travel restrictions. In July, with assistance from the Madagascar government after the pandemic, he was brought to Mumbai for surgery. Orthopaedic oncosurgeon Dr. Manit Gundavda, who led the team, said: “It was a rare and giant grade 2 myxopapillary ependymoma.” Such spinal tumors are typically found at the base of the spinal cord and can interfere with cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) flow, greatly impacting brain and spinal function. Symptoms can include pain, numbness, or paralysis, based on the tumor’s size and location. Due to the tumor’s ongoing growth and delayed treatment, Tafita experienced paralysis and needed help moving. Upon his arrival in July, a multidisciplinary tumor board led by Dr. Gundavda decided to proceed with three eight-hour surgeries across five days. The first surgery focused on separating vital organs and blood vessels with involvement from urology and vascular surgery specialists. The second stage addressed the posterior spinal area, where the tumor was removed. The third session involved spinal reconstruction using metal rods and screws. Throughout his surgeries, Tafita required 30 units of blood or blood products. After surgery, he remained in the hospital for rehabilitation before returning home weeks later. CEO Dr. Santosh Shetty noted that Kokilaben Ambani Hospital’s full-time doctor policy was crucial for enabling this complex procedure. Dr. Gundavda emphasized that the surgery’s success depended on collaboration from various medical specialties. Now back in Madagascar, Tafita is focused on 6 to 12 months of physical rehabilitation. He first developed symptoms in 2017 after high school, managed to complete his studies online while immobilized, and found support through a government medical scheme and his brother’s initiative. Post-surgery, Tafita can now move and lift his back unaided, is largely pain-free, and uses a walker or wheelchair for mobility, though he still lacks sensation in his lower body.

article_content: Fewer than 100 wild ocelots remain in Texas, largely due to habitat loss from highways and other human infrastructure. Conservationists have installed gated wildlife exits along the busy State Highway 100 to protect these rare cats. Camera traps placed at these exits have revealed a diverse range of animals using the safe passages. A new study published in Frontiers in Ecology and Evolution highlights the success of wildlife protection fences and exits in southern Texas, which help native animals avoid car collisions. While researchers have not yet captured photos of ocelots using the exits—reflecting their extreme rarity—the data suggest these measures are likely benefiting them. The study focused on a fenced 12-kilometer (7.3 miles) stretch along State Highway 100 between Laguna Vista and Los Fresnos, monitored from early 2019 to November 2020. The infrastructure, featuring funnel-shaped protected paths and 10 wildlife exits, is designed to guide ocelots and other animals away from the highway and back into their habitats. Two automatic cameras at each exit recorded wildlife movement. In total, up to 10 mammal species—including coyotes, bobcats, jackrabbits, raccoons, and opossums—were documented using the wildlife exits. Researchers prioritized monitoring bobcats and coyotes due to their similarities with ocelots in habitat, diet, size, and behavior. 'We anticipated that the extreme rarity of ocelots would limit data collection,' said co-author Kevin Ryer, 'so we also focused on bobcats and coyotes, whose home ranges overlap with ocelots.' According to the Nature Conservancy, ocelots in southern Texas and northeastern Mexico are federally endangered, with population declines in the U.S. resulting from hunting and trapping. While hunting is now prohibited, habitat fragmentation and vehicle collisions remain major threats. The study notes that decreased landscape connectivity has led to smaller ocelot populations, reduced genetic diversity due to inbreeding, and increased roadkills. While animals documented by camera traps might not be as threatened as ocelots, it is still important to keep them off busy roads. Some species, such as coyotes, had trouble navigating the narrowest parts of the fenced sections, while bobcats, despite being less frequently photographed, had a higher success rate using the exits to stay safe. The researchers advocate for expanding these wildlife-friendly infrastructure projects, noting that collision mitigation is less costly when incorporated during construction rather than as a retrofit. 'Wildlife collision mitigation is less expensive to implement during the construction phase than after,' stated author Richard Kline of the University of Texas Rio Grande Valley. Photos captured by camera traps show a variety of South Texas animals utilizing the wildlife exits. translated_content: 德克萨斯州的野生豹猫数量已不足百只，主要是因为公路和其他人类设施让它们丧失了栖息地。保护组织已在繁忙的100号州高速沿线安装带闸门的野生动物通道，保护这种稀有猫科动物。安装在这些出口的自动相机显示，多种动物通过这些安全通道穿越道路。 《生态与进化前沿》发表的新研究强调，南德州的野生动物防护围栏和出口帮助本地动物避免被汽车撞击。尽管由于豹猫极为稀有，尚未拍到它们使用通道的照片，但数据显示这些措施很可能对它们有帮助。 该研究聚焦于100号州高速拉古纳维斯塔和洛斯弗雷诺斯之间约12公里长的围栏区域，监测时间为2019年初至2020年11月。设施包括像漏斗的一样的保护通道和10个野生动物出口，旨在引导豹猫及其他动物远离公路，回归自然栖息地。每个出口处都装有两台自动相机，记录野生动物的活动。 研究共记录到多达10种哺乳动物使用这些野生动物出口，包括郊狼、山猫、长耳大野兔、浣熊和负鼠。研究人员重点监测了山猫和郊狼，因为它们在栖息地、食性、体型和行为上与豹猫相似。研究合著者凯文·赖尔表示：'我们预料豹猫太稀有，难以直接获取太多数据，所以也关注了山猫和郊狼，它们的活动范围跟豹猫有重叠。' 自然保护协会指出，南德州和墨西哥东北部的豹猫被列为联邦濒危动物，美境内数量因为狩猎和诱捕下滑。现在虽然禁止猎捕，但栖息地破碎化和交通事故仍是主要威胁。研究提到，景观连通性不足导致豹猫数量下降、近亲繁殖减少基因多样性，同时路杀率上升。 即使摄像机捕捉到的动物没有豹猫濒危，为了它们安全也应避免出现忙碌公路上。有些动物如郊狼穿越围栏狭窄地带时会遇到困难，而山猫虽然出现频率较低，却更善用通道避开车辆。 研究者建议扩大此类有利于野生动物的基础设施建设，并说明将动物防撞措施纳入公路建设阶段，比事后改建更划算。得克萨斯大学格兰德河谷分校作者理查德·克莱恩表示：'野生动物防护措施在公路建设时实施要比事后加装省钱得多。' 自动相机拍摄到多种南德州野生动物使用这些安全通道。如需更多气候与环境报道，可查阅Earther的家庭减碳、去化石能源、灾难应急等指南。

article_content: How do you preserve a game like The 7th Guest? The original 1993 PC classic was a groundbreaking release, offering a uniquely dark narrative and impressive prerendered 3D graphics for its time. Today, however, it can easily be mistaken for a typical puzzle adventure of that era with cheesy acting and dated visuals. There’s only so much a simple remaster can do to capture the initial sense of wonder from such an old release. Vertigo Games has taken a completely new approach with The 7th Guest VR, opting for a ground-up reimagining instead of just porting the original into virtual reality. The new version features the same iconic spooky mansion, but now it’s fully explorable in 3D, and most of the puzzles and story elements have been freshly created. This remake imagines how The 7th Guest might look and feel with today’s technological advancements. The results are creative, though somewhat mixed. The 7th Guest VR shines as a campy haunted house adventure filled with intuitive escape room-style puzzles. However, the enjoyment is sometimes hampered by virtual reality quirks, particularly finicky motion controls. Aside from these challenges, the VR remake carries over much of the original’s DNA. Players are summoned to a haunted mansion on a stormy night, encountering ghosts, challenging puzzles, and eerie puppets along the way. One significant update is the expanded storyline, which transforms the 1993 plot into a full-fledged murder mystery. Players gradually learn what happened to the guests mysteriously invited to the house. The remake is filled with classic horror tropes and supernatural camp, serving as a nostalgic genre homage. The original 7th Guest was remarkable in 1993 for its use of pre-rendered 3D video, which inserted live actors into the game—a technical feat at the time. The VR remake aims to recreate that wow factor with volumetric video, enabling players to see and walk around 3D representations of the cast’s ghostly figures. Though not as revolutionary by today’s standards, this addition enhances the cinematic and immersive quality of the experience. The VR version revitalizes the spooky tone of the original, giving the old mansion a rich 3D makeover. Each room is detailed with cobwebs, weathered portraits, and dusty furniture, making Halloween ambiance come alive. These improvements are where The 7th Guest VR excels as a remake, successfully modernizing the ghost story while balancing suspenseful horror and playful campiness. Its tone is reminiscent of Disney’s Haunted Mansion rather than the outright scares of games like Phasmophobia, which suits the series well. While the game’s campy horror aesthetic makes for entertaining environments, the puzzle gameplay can be inconsistent. Each room functions as a mini escape room, featuring interconnected puzzles. Some puzzles are clever, blending traditional brain-teasers with tactile VR interactions—such as guiding cockroaches across a wall, manipulating magician’s props, or fitting queens on a chess board. These creative tasks are engaging and pay homage to the original’s quirky puzzles. However, The 7th Guest VR is sometimes limited by the current capabilities of VR technology. Controls can feel frustrating, especially when puzzles require precision, like placing dolls or pressing piano keys. In several cases, awkward interactions led to using auto-solve features out of frustration, rather than difficulty. These technical hiccups are reminiscent of the limitations faced by PC games in 1993, offering a parallel to that era’s growing pains. Overall, though The 7th Guest VR doesn’t fully match the refined gameplay of titles like The Room VR: A Dark Matter, it stands out as a bold and thoughtful remake. It captures the haunted house energy of the classic and provides a distinctive, modern experience. For fans both old and new, it’s a fun and atmospheric choice for Halloween gaming, especially for those wanting a spooky night in. The 7th Guest VR was reviewed on PlayStation VR2.
translated_content: 你要如何保存像《第七位贵客》这样的游戏？这款最初于1993年发布的PC经典游戏，以其独特的黑暗叙事和当时极为先进的预渲染3D图形，堪称突破性之作。但在现今看来，它很容易被误认为是一款表演俗套、画面过时的普通解谜冒险。简单的重制已难再唤起当年的惊艳。 Vertigo Games采取全新思路打造了《第七位贵客VR》，不是简单将原作移植进虚拟现实，而是完全重新构想。新版保留了标志性的幽灵豪宅，如今变为可自由探索的3D空间，大部分谜题和情节都焕然一新。这次重制用现代技术想象了《第七位贵客》的样子，结果虽有优缺点，但创意十足。 《第七位贵客VR》最精彩之处，是作为充满氛围的鬼屋冒险，包含直观的逃脱房谜题。不过，部分虚拟现实操作，特别是动作捕捉不够精准，偶尔影响体验。除去这些问题，VR重制版延续了原作的很多核心设定。玩家夜晚被召入一栋阴森诡异的豪宅，途中遇到幽灵、谜题和诡异人偶。 游戏最大亮点之一，是剧情大幅扩展，将1993年剧情升级为完整的谋杀悬疑。玩家逐步揭晓那些神秘受邀者的命运。重制版融合了经典恐怖元素与超自然情节，致敬类型传统。 原版《第七位贵客》因大规模采用预渲染3D视频、真人演员加入，1993年时技惊四座。VR重制作通过体积视频再现这种惊艳，玩家能自由绕着幽灵演员移动。虽然在当今标准下略显平常，但真切提升了沉浸感和电影氛围。 全新3D场景让豪宅焕然一新。每个房间都布满蛛网、斑驳画像和尘封家具，极具万圣节氛围。这些美术升级让《第七位贵客VR》作为重制表现出色，现代化诠释了经典鬼故事，在适度恐怖和幽默之间找到了平衡。整体调性像迪士尼鬼屋而非恐怖游戏《幽灵猎人》，非常契合原作精神。 虽然诙谐恐怖风格令人着迷，谜题体验则有些参差。有些房间像密室逃脱，有连锁解谜关卡。不少谜题集传统逻辑挑战和VR互动操作于一体，如引导蟑螂、玩魔术道具或在棋盘上摆放皇后等，这些创意致敬了原作的经典谜题。 然而，当前VR技术时有局限。某些需要精巧操作的谜题（如摆放玩偶、弹钢琴等）让操作令人抓狂。有时不得不靠自动破解省事，这更多是技术问题非难度设定。某种意义上，这也呼应了1993年PC游戏的技术局限，算是新旧时代的共同成长。 综合来看，《第七位贵客VR》虽未及《密室逃脱VR：暗物质》那标准，但作为一次充满创意的重制已然出色。它还原了鬼屋经典氛围，又带来了当代全新体验。新老玩家都能收获乐趣，是万圣节夜宅家的不错选择。《第七位贵客VR》评测平台为PlayStation VR2。

article_content: UK Prime Minister Rishi Sunak has cancelled a scheduled meeting with his Greek counterpart, Kyriakos Mitsotakis, after Greece renewed its request for the permanent return of ancient sculptures. The decision has sparked a diplomatic dispute over the 2,500-year-old Parthenon sculptures, which are currently housed in the British Museum. Greece has repeatedly requested that the sculptures be returned to Athens, but both the United Kingdom and the British Museum have declined. The ongoing disagreement has generated significant discussion and reaction on Greek social media. According to its website, the British Museum says it is seeking a 'new Parthenon partnership' with colleagues in Greece and that constructive discussions are ongoing.

article_content: To address the increasing number of migrants crossing the hazardous Darien Gap from Colombia, Panama and Costa Rica have launched a rapid bus service to move migrants straight to the Costa Rican border. Authorities in Panama estimate over 420,700 migrants have taken this route so far this year, and expect the yearly total to exceed 500,000. Large-scale smuggling operations have reduced the crossing time for physically strong migrants, allowing them to reach the US border in about two and a half weeks. This new bussing initiative is aimed at disrupting smuggling networks that charge migrants for passage, while also relieving overcrowding at reception centers in Panama. Recently, nearly 1,600 migrants were transferred via 30 buses from Panama to a migrant center in Corredores, Costa Rica. Earlier attempts by the US, Panama, and Colombia to slow migration through the region were unsuccessful, prompting the Biden administration to search for other solutions. The majority of migrants are from Venezuela, with additional groups from Ecuador, Colombia, and Haiti.

article_content: A group of toddlers were left terrified when riot police raided a street during a three-year-old's birthday party. Ethan Baker and his friends had been playing party games in Grimsby, Lincolnshire, when officers arrived, urging everyone to go inside. Witnesses said six police cars and seven riot vans appeared quickly, with a helicopter flying overhead. Martinique Molesworth, 21, said her son Ethan's birthday party was ruined by the dramatic police action. Parents hurriedly took their children indoors as police searched a car believed to be connected to an incident elsewhere. Families stayed inside for an hour until police said nothing suspicious had been found. 'They destroyed my son's birthday party. It was completely over the top – from what we could see, no one was doing anything wrong,' said Martinique. Ethan's aunt, Shelly Hughs, said: 'They thought someone had a gun, but the only sticks around were piñata sticks.' Humberside Police confirmed they responded to Eleanor Street at 3.07pm after tracing a car related to an earlier incident in Grimsby Road, Cleethorpes. Police searched the vehicle with specially trained officers but found nothing suspicious. The incident did not involve anyone at the birthday party.

Chuba Akpom, an 18-year-old forward widely seen as a future star, is making headlines at Arsenal by breaking records. Akpom has set a new club benchmark for the 10-meter sprint, posting an impressive 1.56 seconds and surpassing the times of well-known players like Theo Walcott and Thierry Henry. He shared his achievement on Twitter.

Beyond his speed, Akpom has also shown strong form this season, scoring four goals in three matches for Arsenal's under-21 team. Last week, he netted a hat-trick in the under-21s' 4-2 win over West Brom at the Emirates Stadium, with manager Arsene Wenger in attendance. As an England Under-20 international, Akpom stands out among Arsenal's talented group of young players.

Given his recent performances, there is increasing speculation that Akpom will soon receive more first-team opportunities, adding to his previous Capital One Cup appearance against West Brom. He may also aim to challenge the club's 40-meter sprint record, recently seized by right-back Hector Bellerin, who surpassed Theo Walcott's previous time. Manager Arsene Wenger continues to closely monitor Akpom's progress.

article_content: The Nigerian Society of Engineers (NSE) has highlighted inconsistent government policies—particularly on currency exchange rates, import regulations, and unreliable electricity—as central causes for the ongoing struggles in Nigeria's manufacturing sector. The NSE remarked that previous governments have often neglected to involve engineers in technological and industrial development. During a pre-conference briefing in Abuja, NSE President Tasiu Gidari-Wudil expressed concern about the steady disappearance of Nigeria’s non-oil exports and manufacturing industries, a reversal from the country’s more robust performance in the 1960s and 1970s when products like textiles, rubber, and coal were widely exported. Gidari-Wudil noted that unfavorable business conditions have driven foreign companies such as Volkswagen, Michelin, and Procter & Gamble to leave Nigeria. He also called attention to the unrealized potential of the Ajaokuta Steel Manufacturing Company, which has never become operational despite significant investment. He emphasized that Nigerian engineers are well-equipped to provide solutions and called for greater collaboration between the government and the NSE in tackling challenges facing the manufacturing and infrastructure sectors. The NSE has also recently analyzed concrete construction technologies and will present findings at its forthcoming annual conference. The conference will host prominent figures, including President Bola Tinubu as the Distinguished Guest of Honour and Vice President Kashim Shettima, who will be awarded an Honorary Fellowship, along with several federal ministers.

article_content: Starting in April 2016, the UK government will implement a single-tier state pension, providing a flat rate of £146 per week to those who have worked at least 35 years. This move will replace the older, more complicated system that included a basic pension plus means-tested supplements. A report by the Institute for Fiscal Studies (IFS) cautions that people born after the mid-1980s will generally receive less from the state pension than earlier generations, with high earners potentially missing out on as much as £2,300 annually. The IFS projects that 61% of those retiring between 2016 and 2020 will see their pensions increase, while 17% won’t experience any change. The new system is particularly beneficial for women who have taken time off for childcare, as well as low earners and the self-employed. However, the study notes that most born after 1986—especially younger and higher-earning workers—will end up worse off. For instance, a low earner born in 1986 and working 35 years could get nearly £1,000 less each year under the new model. Gemma Tetlow, an IFS author, pointed out that the proposed flat rate, even accounting for wage growth, is lower than what most young workers might expect unless they are long-term self-employed. The IFS recommends the government make it clear to younger people that extra personal savings will be required for retirement incomes matching those of older generations. Pensions Minister Steve Webb says the reform will give most people nearing retirement a higher state pension, adding that younger people benefit from a simpler system and have the option to top up their income with occupational pensions. Ultimately, the government hopes the change will simplify the pension landscape and reduce total public expenditure, though individuals, especially the young, must plan to save more on their own.

The Indian government will soon meet with social media platforms to address the issue of deepfakes, IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said on Saturday. He emphasized that platforms could lose safe harbour immunity if they do not take sufficient action to remove deepfake content. Vaishnaw mentioned that the government recently sent a notice to companies regarding deepfakes. While platforms have responded, he insisted that they must act more aggressively against such content.

"They are taking steps, but we believe many more actions are necessary. We're planning to convene all the platforms—likely in the next three to four days—for a brainstorming session to ensure they make adequate efforts to prevent deepfakes and clean up their systems," Vaishnaw told reporters. Asked whether major platforms like Meta and Google would be included, the minister confirmed they would be invited.

Vaishnaw clarified that the safe harbour clause under the IT Act, which protects most social media platforms, would not apply unless companies take adequate measures to address deepfakes. "The safe harbour clause does not apply if platforms fail to remove deepfakes," he said.

Recently, several deepfake videos targeting prominent actors went viral, sparking public outrage and concerns about the misuse of such technologies. On Friday, Prime Minister Narendra Modi warned that AI-generated deepfakes could create major crises and societal unrest, urging the media to help raise awareness and educate the public about their risks.

The White House warned Monday that U.S. funds to support Ukraine's immediate battlefield needs are limited, following Congress's decision to exclude additional Ukraine aid from the recent short-term government funding bill. According to U.S. officials, approximately $6 billion remains available for military support to Ukraine. White House Press Secretary Karine Jean-Pierre said this funding would meet Ukraine’s urgent battlefield requirements for a little while longer. Of this amount, about $5.4 billion is allocated to supply Ukraine with weapons and military equipment from existing U.S. stockpiles, made available after the Pentagon corrected an earlier accounting error. Another $1.6 billion remains from a previous $25.9 billion fund meant to replenish U.S. inventories. Officials noted there are no remaining funds for the Ukraine Security Assistance Initiative, which is designed for long-term weapons procurement, nor is there money left for Ukraine's humanitarian, budgetary, or economic needs.

The Pentagon has recently warned that the dwindling funds are affecting U.S. military readiness and that Congressional disagreements over aid are also having an impact. Pentagon Comptroller Michael McCord wrote to Congressional leaders last Friday, stating that replenishing U.S. military resources has already slowed because of funding uncertainties and warned of risks to military preparedness if the situation persists. President Joe Biden echoed a sense of urgency, cautioning on Sunday that while some time remains, it is rapidly running out. The Biden administration had requested an additional $24 billion for Ukraine for the last quarter of the year. When it became clear that Republicans in Congress would only agree to extend government funding for 45 days, the White House sought $6 billion to support Ukraine during that period. However, the stopgap measure approved by Congress to fund the government through mid-November did not include any new money for Ukraine.

Responding to questions about the narrowly averted government shutdown, Biden was asked if he trusts Speaker Kevin McCarthy in upcoming negotiations. Biden replied, "We just made one about Ukraine. So, we'll find out," but did not elaborate. Rep. Matt Gaetz (R-Fla.) has sought to remove McCarthy from the speakership, accusing him of making a "secret side deal" with Biden regarding Ukraine aid. On Monday, McCarthy denied any deal with Biden, stating that he only agreed to let White House officials meet with Congressional staff to discuss the aid request. Jean-Pierre declined to clarify Biden's comments or confirm whether he and McCarthy had recently discussed Ukraine aid, but emphasized that there is bipartisan support for continued assistance to Ukraine and that McCarthy has publicly voiced support for Ukraine's defense needs. "We're going to hold him to that," Jean-Pierre stated. ABC News' Luis Martinez, John Parkinson, and Lauren Peller contributed to this report.

五角大楼近期警告称，资金逐渐耗尽已对美军战备产生影响，国会关于对乌援助的争议同样波及国防。五角大楼预算主管迈克尔·麦考德上周五致信国会领导人表示，受资金不确定性影响，美军的库存补给已被迫放缓，若不及时补充将危及军队战备。拜登总统周日同样表达紧迫感，称“我们还有时间，但不多了”，并强烈呼吁国会批准更多对乌援助。拜登政府原本为今年最后一个季度申请了240亿美元乌克兰援助资金。当国会共和党人明确只愿再延长政府拨款45天后，白宫即寻求在此期间获得60亿美元对乌支持，但议会最终通过的短期开支法案未包含新的对乌资金。

Experiencing some criticism or negative reviews is part of the legal profession, making proactive management of your law firm’s reputation essential. Regularly sharing your firm’s positive developments not only balances any unfavorable feedback but also builds a trustworthy image that draws new clients and opportunities.

Consider these three strategies to boost your firm’s positive exposure:

1. Promote Achievements and Awards
Announce promotions, accolades, or industry honors received by your team to spotlight your pursuit of excellence. Spread the news via online posts, tag honorees, link to blog updates or press releases, update biographies, and include award logos to boost recognition and credibility.

2. Emphasize Community Involvement
Participation in local organizations or community projects shows social responsibility and helps foster a sense of trust among clients and partners. Share your community-related activities, even smaller efforts, on social media to demonstrate your firm’s commitment beyond legal work and positively influence public perception.

3. Reveal the Human Side of Your Team
Posting about festive events, office life, or hobbies gives people a glimpse of your team’s personality. Highlighting fun or personal moments—from staff gatherings to unique interests—helps to make your firm approachable, encouraging stronger ties with clients and diminishing the impact of occasional negative remarks.

Still, when weighing in on current events or political issues, proceed thoughtfully. Sharing opinions that align with your clients’ interests can reinforce your expertise, but it’s wise to remain respectful and mindful of your audience. If discussing sensitive matters, consider turning off comments and avoid targeting individuals, maintaining a stance of professionalism and informed insight rather than controversy.

By consistently promoting positive achievements and values, your firm can build a robust and resilient reputation. While negative feedback may occur, a focus on authentic, constructive communication ensures it remains just a small part of your larger, positive reputation.

Human remains have been discovered on the wrecked Costa Concordia, potentially resolving the fate of the last two missing victims from the infamous 2012 disaster, according to a spokesperson for Italy's civil protection agency. Divers planned to recover the remains, found on deck 4 of the ship, on Thursday afternoon.

The discovery comes shortly after engineers completed a complex operation to right the ship, almost 20 months after it capsized near Italy’s Giglio Island in January 2012. The cruise liner struck rocks in the Tyrrhenian Sea, resulting in 32 deaths out of more than 4,200 people on board. Among the victims were Russel Rebello, an Indian waiter last seen helping passengers escape, and Maria Grazia Trecarichi, a Sicilian passenger celebrating her 50th birthday with her daughter, who survived.

Authorities state that the disaster occurred after Captain Francesco Schettino ordered the vessel to deviate off course in order to salute a retired sea captain living on Giglio Island. Schettino now faces charges of manslaughter, causing a maritime disaster, and abandoning ship while passengers remained onboard. His ongoing trial, which resumed on Monday in Grosseto, features testimony from crew, passengers, island residents, and experts.

Schettino argues that he is being unfairly blamed, contending that malfunctioning watertight doors contributed to the ship's sinking and that a crew member's miscommunication played a key role. Recorded bridge communications reveal confusion over his orders, with the helmsman misunderstood whether to turn the ship left or right moments before the collision. However, expert testimony asserts that this misunderstanding likely made no difference in preventing the crash.

The engineering maneuver to upright the Costa Concordia, known as parbuckling, exposed previously submerged sections of the ship—revealing debris and personal effects. Now that the ship is upright, judges have agreed to a new examination of the wreck, including a walkthrough of the command bridge to reconstruct the night of the disaster.

The helmsman, Jacob Rusli Bin, alongside four others, has already been convicted as part of plea deals for their roles in the incident. Meanwhile, a Florence court is reviewing the legitimacy of their plea agreements while local residents express relief and begin recovery following the salvage operation.

据意大利民防部门发言人称，救援人员已在沉没的“歌诗达协和号”邮轮上发现了人类遗骸，这或为2012年海难最后两名失踪者的下落提供了答案。潜水员计划于周四下午打捞在四层甲板发现的遗骸。

此次发现发生在工程师们完成极具挑战性的扶正作业后，这艘邮轮在意大利吉利奥岛附近倾覆近20个月。2012年1月，该船在第勒尼安海触礁，船上4200余人中有32人遇难。遇难者包括印度籍服务员拉塞尔·雷贝洛（Russel Rebello），他最后一次出现是在协助乘客逃生；以及来自西西里的玛丽亚·格拉齐娅·特雷卡里奇（Maria Grazia Trecarichi），她原为庆祝50岁生日和17岁女儿同行，女儿幸存。

当局称此次事故源于时任船长弗朗切斯科·斯凯蒂诺（Francesco Schettino）让邮轮偏离航道，向吉利奥岛一位退休船长致敬。斯凯蒂诺现正面临过失杀人、造成海难和在乘客未撤离时擅自弃船等指控，其庭审已于周一在格罗塞托恢复，证人包括船员、乘客、岛民及专家。

斯凯蒂诺辩称自己遭到不公指责，称水密门失灵及沟通失误导致沉船。船桥录音显示，他的指令让舵手一度分辨不清方向，不过专家证词表明，这个误会对避免事故影响甚微。

协和号扶正工程（又称“滚转”作业）让原本浸水的船体部分暴露，现场可见残骸及个人物品。目前船体已恢复直立，法官同意再次勘查现场，包括让斯凯蒂诺引导法官重走事故当晚指挥舱。

舵手雅各布·鲁斯利·宾（Jacob Rusli Bin）及其他四人因涉案通过认罪协议获刑，佛罗伦萨法院正在复核这些协议的合法性。岛上居民在邮轮打捞后感到宽慰，开始逐步恢复生活。

article_content: BERLIN — Human remains believed to belong to a person missing since the devastating summer floods in western Germany more than two years ago have been found near the mouth of the small Ahr river, police said Tuesday. On October 15, individuals collecting garbage in the area where the Ahr flows into the Rhine in the town of Sinzig discovered several bones and bone fragments. Investigators conducted a DNA test, which police said confirmed the remains were of someone who had been missing since the 2021 floods. Authorities did not release any personal details, citing the need to protect the privacy of the victim's family. More than 230 people died in the floods that struck Germany and neighboring Belgium on July 14, 2021. The hardest-hit region was the Ahr valley—a wine-growing area south of Cologne—where more than 130 people died when heavy rainfall turned the Ahr river and nearby streams into torrents that destroyed houses, roads, and bridges. The remains discovered this month belonged to one of two people still unaccounted for.

article_content: Pursuing a career in games journalism has become increasingly challenging due to instability within the industry. This reality was underscored recently as The Escapist, a prominent gaming website, experienced a dramatic upheaval: its Editor-in-Chief, Nick Calandra, was dismissed for reportedly not meeting expectations set by its parent company, Gamurs. In solidarity, numerous staff members—including contributors and producers—chose to leave as well, often expressing intentions to embark on new ventures with Calandra. Among the departures, Yahtzee Croshaw stood out as he was the face of the widely acclaimed Zero Punctuation video series. Although Croshaw voluntarily resigned, he does not retain the rights to Zero Punctuation, meaning he will move forward without this recognizable brand. With these exits, The Escapist’s entire video department was dissolved. The site’s previous strategy to shift most video production to YouTube resulted in higher view counts but failed to generate sufficient revenue, ultimately contributing to this collapse. Currently, The Escapist remains operational in terms of publishing written articles, but it's uncertain how many writers or freelance contributors are left and whether a new video team will be assembled. On the other hand, Calandra and several former colleagues have launched a new initiative called Second Wind. This independent project, featuring many ex-Escapist staff including Croshaw, has attracted significant early interest—amassing over 40,000 YouTube subscribers and more than 900 supporters on Patreon, who are collectively contributing upwards of $1,100 a month. Striking out independently gives these creators more control but comes with financial risks. Second Wind’s initial audience loyalty may help it find footing, but the broader challenges of sustaining independent gaming media remain. Up to now, Gamurs has not made any public statement regarding the situation at The Escapist.

Wearing headphones while cycling is prohibited in several U.S. states, and officials in London are considering similar regulations in the UK. Seventeen-year-old student Benji Miller has developed a solution: the Allo, a device that securely attaches an iPhone to any bicycle handlebar and doubles as a speaker. The Allo enables cyclists to listen to music, make phone calls, and use navigation apps hands-free, all without obstructing their hearing, as earbuds do.

The Allo is powered by two AAA batteries and delivers sound up to 90 decibels—comparable to the volume of a train horn and louder than typical city traffic—ensuring that navigation and calls remain audible even on noisy roads. The case is made from durable, hardened plastic to protect the phone in case of accidents and is adjustable to fit handlebars of various sizes and angles.

Once mounted, users can easily turn the speaker on or off via a switch at the bottom. The basic Allo comes in white with a limited supply of gold versions available, and Miller is working on models for additional phones.

Miller launched a Kickstarter campaign for the Allo last month, aiming to raise $24,500 (£14,750). The campaign runs through April 13 and has collected $14,900 (£9,000) so far. Early supporters can purchase the Allo on Kickstarter for $40 (£24), with a planned retail price of $45 (£27) if the funding goal is met. Miller was motivated by the need for a safe, accessible way to use smartphones while cycling and was surprised that no similar product existed.

A grieving daughter has been ordered to pay £3,052.16 to Highcliffe Nursing Home for failing to give a month's notice of her father's death. Sue Cann, 54, from Christchurch, Dorset, was informed that a 28-day notice period payment was required when a resident 'moves out or passes away.' Ms. Cann received the bill the day after her father Kenneth's funeral. Kenneth Cann, a retired British Gas employee, had spent 17 months at the care home, paying £63,000 for his stay before his passing at age 79 following a long struggle with dementia.

Ms. Cann expressed shock at the demand, describing it as 'callous' and 'ridiculous,' stating, 'Nobody knows when they are going to die. In effect they are saying you have to pay 28 days after you have passed away. That is so callous.' She added that her father worked hard and saved for his retirement, only to have most of his savings spent on care fees. Kenneth's wife Winnie died nine months prior, after a fight with ovarian cancer.

Although Ms. Cann acknowledged her father was well cared for, she took issue with the notice charge, especially as the letter arrived immediately after the funeral. She said, 'I wouldn’t mind paying for a week. But to pay for a month — to cover food, laundry, and nursing care — is daylight robbery.'

Sheila Scott, CEO of the National Care Association, noted that while contracts may require notice if a resident leaves, it is not standard to enforce a full month's payment after a death. She suggested a week to ten days would be more appropriate to clear the room. Kingsley Healthcare’s CEO, Daya Thayan, apologized for any distress caused and confirmed contact with Ms. Cann. He explained that notice-period charges are common practice to allow families time to collect belongings and for the home to prepare accommodation for new residents. Following the incident, Kingsley Healthcare has reduced the post-death notice period to seven days and will delay contacting families until after the funeral.
